title: Director Industrial Relations Netherlands / People & Culture Country representative
description:
As our Director of Industrial Relations Netherlands, you will play a key role in creating a workplace where people thrive and where there's always a way to move forward together.

As Director of Industrial Relations Netherlands, you will lead a diverse Team of approximately 11 people. You will be reporting to the Vice President of Industrial Relations and are part of the Industrial Relations Management Team. Next to this you are the People & Culture (P&C) country representative in the Netherlands, by being the single point of contact for the Dutch CEO on general P&C topics related to Vattenfall N.V.

What will you do?

The main purpose of the position is to ensure that Industrial Relations Netherlands with constructive cooperation, co-determination and legal advice enables the business to fulfil strategies, meet targets and achieve necessary measures and development. Activities shall be executed within the frameworks of the P&C strategy, Industrial Relations strategy and the Business strategy.

Next to leading the IR team you are the P&C country representative in the Netherlands. In this role you are attending the Management Board of Vattenfall N.V. and represent them towards the Central Works Council. You are responsible for all P&C topics that do not have a clear ownership within one single Centre of Excellence within P&C and has a country overall importance. You ensure follow-up and decisions on P&C topics relevant for the Netherlands and transfer P&C topics to the designated P&C resources. You are P&C’s single point of contact for the Dutch Country Manager (CEO) in such topics. You also represent Vattenfall as P&C representative externally in the Netherlands when appropriate.

The key priorities include fostering constructive social dialogue, supporting organisational development and business transformation, and providing strategic guidance on workforce implications of change initiatives. The role contributes to ensuring that Vattenfall remains an attractive employer while continuously improving organizational effectiveness and adapting to evolving business needs.

Key responsibilities:

  • Responsible for policies and strategies relating to Industrial Relations and implementation thereof and guarantee that Vattenfall acts in accordance with current legislation and collective labour agreements;
  • Ensure constructive cooperation with internal and external stakeholders, as the Business Areas, Staff Functions, Supervisory Board, Board of Management, Works Councils, Unions and Employers Association;
  • Responsible from a strategic perspective for the collective labour agreement negotiations;
  • Participate in and contribute to cross-border co-operation within Industrial Relations, both in projects and in day-to-day business as well as in European Works Council (EWC) and EWC Working Committee;
  • Be the interface and negotiate with Works Councils/Unions in all occurring questions;
  • Ensure strategy and qualitative approach for the Employability Centre Netherlands in finding long-term solutions for redundant employees and implementation thereof;
  • Lead the strategic direction of Social Projects Netherlands and the Vattenfall Foundation, ensuring these initiatives create meaningful social impact, support business needs and contribute to Vattenfall’s role as a responsible employer in the Netherlands.

The organisation:

Industrial Relations Netherlands consists of approximately 11 employees. Next to 3 legal counsels providing the primary IR work, the Employability Centre (2 FTE), Social Projects – including the Vattenfall Foundation – (3 FTE) and Works Council Support (3 FTE) are also part of the Industrial Relations Netherlands team.


Location:
Amsterdam

Who are you?

As our ideal Director Industrial Relations Netherlands, you bring broad experience as a P&C Manager. You are proactive and performance oriented, like to drive change and to work in partnership with the business. As a leader, you show exemplary behavior in all dimensions of the Vattenfall LEAD model: Lead Yourself, Enable People, Align Teams, and Drive Performance.

Professional characteristics:

As our Head of Industrial Relations, you will bring the following qualifications:

  • (Law) Degree from university in the Netherlands or other relevant university degree;
  • Experience in high quality Industrial Relations consulting to employers including knowledge of employment and labour law;
  • Experience in negotiations with unions/works councils;
  • Multiple years of experience in complex, international, matrix organisations;
  • A demonstrable interest and track record in leading and developing people;
  • Fluent skills in Dutch and English, both verbally and written.

To be successful in the role you also bring:

  • A strategic and analytical perspective, and a vision for the people perspective in the business including the importance of working with employability;
  • Capability and flair to build a large contact network, both internally and externally;
  • Excellent stakeholder management skills and the ability to take on different perspectives;
  • Capability to generate confidence and build relationships in a flexible manner as well as having the drive to identify flexible solutions and, when necessary, build bridges within the framework of the P&C Strategy and strategy of Industrial Relations;
  • Capability to be a strong sparring partner for the Dutch Management Board members on a P&C Country level;
  • The right management style to coach, develop and motivate the Industrial Relations Netherlands team according to our LEAD leadership expectations.

Our offer
Good remuneration, a challenging and international work environment, and the possibility to work with some of the best in the field. You will be working in interdisciplinary teams and you can always count on support from committed colleagues. We offer attractive employment conditions and opportunities for personal and professional development.

More Information
We welcome your application in English. The last day to apply is 27th of September. Please do not wait until the last day when applying as we will be handling applications continuously throughout the duration of the process. We kindly request that you do not send applications by any means other than via our website.

For more information about the recruitment process you are welcome to contact our executive recruiter Manon Helleman via email: manon.helleman@vattenfall.com.

title: IT System Engineer
description:
Welcome to the future of cloud networking and security!

Cato Networks is the first company to converge enterprise networking and security into one centralized and global service that is delivered by cloud. It is led by networking and security pioneer Shlomo Kramer (Check Point, Imperva) and early investor (Palo Alto Networks, Exabeam, Trusteer and more). Cato’s unique technology inspired a brand-new product category, later named “SASE” by Gartner and a market expected to reach $28.5 billion by 2028.

This is your opportunity to get on the rocket ship and join a company that is building a cutting-edge enterprise network and secure cloud platform, and is on a fast track to becoming the worldwide market leader – don’t miss it!

About the Role

Cato Networks is the first company to converge enterprise networking and security into one centralized and global service that is delivered by cloud. It is led by networking and security pioneer Shlomo Kramer (Check Point, Imperva) and early investor (Palo Alto Networks, Exabeam, Trusteer and more). Cato’s unique technology inspired a brand-new product category, later named “SASE” by Gartner and a market expected to reach $28.5 billion by 2028.

This is your opportunity to get on the rocket ship and join a company that is building a cutting-edge enterprise network and secure cloud platform, and is on a fast track to becoming the worldwide market leader – don’t miss it!

We are looking for an experienced IT System Engineer to join our global IT team.

In this role, you will take ownership of critical enterprise infrastructure across cloud, identity, networking, virtualization, and SaaS environments. You will work closely with Security, DevOps, Engineering, and IT teams to build secure, scalable, highly available infrastructure while driving automation and operational excellence.

We are looking for someone who combines strong hands-on technical skills with a systems mindset — someone who can troubleshoot complex issues, automate repetitive work, improve existing architecture, and lead infrastructure initiatives from design through production.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage and improve cloud infrastructure, primarily in AWS, with exposure to Azure, GCP, and other cloud platforms.
  • Own identity and access management across cloud and SaaS environments, including Entra ID, SSO, IAM, RBAC, and user lifecycle processes.
  • Administer and troubleshoot Microsoft 365, VMware, networking, and other core enterprise infrastructure.
  • Automate operational and administrative tasks using Python, PowerShell, APIs, Infrastructure as Code, and AI-assisted tools.
  • Use AI effectively for scripting, troubleshooting, documentation, analysis, and improving IT operational workflows.
  • Manage enterprise endpoints and device compliance using Kandji and Microsoft Intune.
  • Troubleshoot complex infrastructure, cloud, identity, and connectivity issues and act as an escalation point for the IT team.
  • Partner with Security and Engineering teams to improve access controls, infrastructure security, monitoring, and compliance.
  • Proactively improve reliability, scalability, documentation, and operational processes.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in Systems Engineering, IT Infrastructure, or Cloud Infrastructure.
  • Strong experience with AWS and enterprise cloud environments.
  • Strong knowledge of Microsoft 365, Entra ID, IAM, SSO, and identity federation.
  • Strong scripting and automation skills using Python and/or PowerShell.
  • Strong practical experience using AI tools to accelerate scripting, troubleshooting, research, documentation, and IT automation, with an understanding of how to validate AI-generated output and use it securely.
  • Solid knowledge of networking fundamentals including DNS, DHCP, routing, VPNs, and firewalls.
  • Strong hands-on experience with MDM and endpoint management, including both Kandji and Microsoft Intune.
  • Hands-on experience with VMware vSphere/ESXi.
  • Experience with APIs and automation tools; Terraform experience is an advantage.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills and the ability to independently own complex technical issues.
  • Self-driven, hands-on, and comfortable working in a fast-paced global environment.

Personal Attributes

- Excellent interpersonal and communication skills.

- Self-starter with strong troubleshooting and analytical skills.

- Adaptable and thrives in a dynamic, rapidly changing environment.

- Able to manage multiple priorities and work independently under pressure.

Why Join Cato Networks?

Be part of a transformative cloud-native company that’s reshaping secure networking. We’re scaling rapidly and offer a unique opportunity to work on cutting-edge technologies in a global, mission-driven environment.

title: Cyber Threat Exposure Management Analyst
description:
We are seeking a Cyber Threat Exposure Analyst to support our exposure management programme across the estate. The role spans vulnerability management, attack surface management, cloud security posture, and secure development practice. Working as a fully contributing team member, you will own end-to-end vulnerability lifecycle activity, maintain prioritised exposure views, and communicate risk clearly to internal stakeholders. You operate with limited supervision, take clear ownership of your assignments, and consistently deliver to a high standard of quality.

Key Responsibilities

Attack Surface Management (ASM / EASM)

  • Maintain a continuous inventory of Internet-facing assets, shadow IT, domains, subdomains, certificates, cloud services, APIs, and third-party-hosted assets.
  • Operate EASM/CAASM tooling to surface unowned or unmanaged assets and route them to the correct owner.
  • Enrich attack surface findings with threat intelligence, active exploitation trends, and KEV data to support prioritisation.
  • Proactively identify gaps in asset coverage and bring forward improvement ideas without waiting to be directed.

Vulnerability Management

  • Own the end-to-end vulnerability lifecycle: identification, risk-based triage, remediation tracking, and closure validation.
  • Apply CVSS, EPSS, and business context to set remediation SLAs and escalation paths.
  • Maintain vulnerability management policies, standards, and reporting cadence aligned to ISO 27001 and NIST CSF.
  • Break down complex vulnerability backlogs into prioritised, actionable components and drive them to closure with minimal supervision.

Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM)

  • Monitor cloud misconfigurations, identity risk, and posture drift across AWS, Azure, and OCI.
  • Partner with cloud platform teams to remediate CSPM findings and reduce recurring misconfiguration classes.
  • Extend CSPM coverage as new cloud services, apps, and workloads are onboarded.
  • Build and maintain strong working relationships with platform and engineering teams; negotiate remediation timelines and handle pushback constructively.

CTEM / Exposure Management

  • Operate the Scope, Discover, Prioritise, Validate, and Mobilise phases of the CTEM programme.
  • Consolidate attack surface, vulnerability, and posture data into a single exposure view for stakeholders.
  • Track and report exposure reduction metrics against agreed KPIs, maintaining accurate and well-organised records across all workstreams.

Secure SDLC

  • Embed security requirements, threat modelling, and secure code review checkpoints into the SDLC.
  • Work with engineering teams to reduce vulnerability injection at source rather than relying only on downstream remediation.
  • Maintain secure-by-design standards and guidance for development teams.

Pentest & Purple Team Support

  • Support the commission and management of third-party penetration testing and purple team engagements.
  • Review scope, rules of engagement, and quality of third-party findings before acceptance.
  • Translate external test results into prioritised, actionable remediation guidance for internal teams.

Reporting & Stakeholder Communication

  • Produce dashboards and reports translating technical exposure data into business risk language for senior stakeholders.
  • Present exposure trends, remediation progress, and residual risk to management and audit/compliance functions.
  • Support audit and certification cycles (ISO 27001, Cyber Essentials Plus, SOC 1, client MSP audits) with evidence of exposure management practice.
  • Adapt communication style to the audience; explain technical risk clearly to non-technical colleagues and business stakeholders.

Ways of Working

  • Meet all team commitments and deadlines; support colleagues encountering blockers and contribute to a collaborative team environment.
  • Seek out and act on feedback; treat problems as learning opportunities and continuously update skills and knowledge.
  • Adapt readily to changing priorities, new tooling, and evolving threat landscapes without disruption to delivery quality.
  • Live and demonstrate Version 1 Core Values in everyday work, acting as a visible example for more junior colleagues.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
  • 3+ years' experience in cyber security with hands-on exposure to vulnerability management, attack surface management, and/or cloud security.
  • Relevant certifications: CompTIA CySA+, CEH, OSCP, CISSP, or equivalent.
  • Working knowledge of NIST CSF, ISO 27001, MITRE ATT&CK, and CTEM principles.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills; able to translate technical risk for non-technical stakeholders.

Beneficial Skills

  • Hands-on experience with EASM/CAASM, CSPM, or exposure management platforms.
  • Familiarity with AI-augmented vulnerability triage or detection tooling.
  • Experience with Defender XDR, Defender CSPM, Zscaler, Tanium, or equivalent platforms.
  • Familiarity with Identity Security Posture Management (ISPM) and attack path mapping.
  • Exposure to regulatory/audit frameworks such as Cyber Essentials Plus, SOC 1, or FSQS.

Why Version 1?

At Version 1, we believe in providing our employees with a comprehensive benefits package that prioritises their wellbeing, professional growth, and financial stability.

  • Share in our success with our Quarterly Performance-Related Profit Share Scheme, where employees collectively benefit from a share of our company's profits

  • Strong Career Progression & mentorship coaching through our Strength in Balance & Leadership schemes with a dedicated quarterly Pathways Career Development programme

  • Flexible/remote working, Version 1 is tremendously understanding of life events and people’s individual circumstances and offer flexibility to help achieve a healthy work life balance

  • Financial Wellbeing initiatives including; Pension, Private Healthcare Cover, Life Assurance, Financial advice and an Employee Discount scheme

  • Employee Wellbeing schemes including Gym Discounts, Bike to Work, Fitness classes, Mindfulness Workshops, Employee Assistance Programme and much more. Generous holiday allowance, enhanced maternity/paternity leave, marriage/civil partnership leave and special leave policies

  • Educational assistance, incentivised certifications, and accreditations, including AWS, Microsoft, Oracle, and Red Hat

  • Reward schemes including Version 1’s Annual Excellence Awards & ‘Call-Out’ platform.

  • Environment, Social and Community First initiatives allow you to get involved in local fundraising and development opportunities as part of fostering our diversity, inclusion and belonging schemes.

And many more exciting benefits… drop us a note to find out more.

title: Integrated Marketing Program Manager
description:

About this role:

The Lead Business Control Management Officer will support Commercial Banking lending transformation initiatives by providing risk and control oversight across strategic business, data, and technology programs. This role will partner closely with Commercial Banking Operations, Corporate and Investment Banking Lending Operations, Front Office teams, Data Risk Management, and Technology partners to assess business and control impacts resulting from large-scale transformation efforts.

In this role, you will:

  • Lead risk and control assessments – (RCSA) for Commercial Banking lending transformation initiatives, including loan platform modernization, nCino implementation, AutoBooking deployment, LIQ conversions, operating model redesign, and process transformation efforts.

  • Evaluate the impact of AI, data-driven solutions, citizen development initiatives, and automation technologies on business processes, controls, and regulatory compliance requirements.

  • Collaborate across Corporate & Investment Banking Lending Operations (CIBLO), Commercial Banking Operations (CBO), and Front Office partners to develop end-to-end process and control solutions.

title: Identity and Access Management Operations Analyst
location: St Leonards, New South Wales, au
description:
At Ramsay Health Care, technology plays a critical role in supporting the delivery of safe, high-quality patient care. We’re looking for an Identity and Access Management (IAM) Operations Analyst to join our Cyber Security team and help ensure our people have the right access to the right systems, at the right time.

Reporting to the Head of Identity and Access Management, you’ll be responsible for the day-to-day operation of Ramsay Australia’s digital IAM services, working closely with our IAM Engineering and Cyber Security teams.

What you’ll do

This is a hands-on operational role where you’ll help manage the full lifecycle of user identities and access across the organisation.

Manage user identity lifecycles, including provisioning, de-provisioning and access modifications

  • Fulfil IAM access requests from stakeholders in line with established business rules and controls
  • Conduct access reviews and audits to support security and compliance requirements
  • Investigate and resolve access-related issues within agreed service levels
  • Monitor and respond to IAM-related security incidents and unauthorised access attempts
  • Maintain IAM systems and configurations in accordance with change management processes and engineering guidance
  • Work with internal and external teams to troubleshoot and resolve IAM incidents
  • Maintain clear documentation, reporting and operational processes
  • Support the adoption and integration of IAM technologies and evolving industry best practice

Please note: there is a rare, but potential need to participate in an out-of-hours on-call roster.

A key part of the role will be balancing the needs of the business with our Cyber Security requirements, ensuring access is practical for our people while maintaining strong security and compliance controls.

What you’ll bring

You’ll have 2–3+ years’ experience in Identity and Access Management, particularly across user lifecycle management and onboarding/offboarding.

We’re looking for:

  • Strong knowledge of IAM principles including least privilege, privileged access management, authentication, authorisation and access control lifecycles
  • Experience working within an IT Service Management / ITIL environment
  • Hands-on experience with cloud-based IAM platforms such as Okta, Azure AD, CyberArk and on-prem AD/ARS
  • Strong problem-solving and incident management skills
  • The ability to work collaboratively across technical and business teams
  • Excellent communication skills and a customer-focused approach
  • An understanding of the importance of security, compliance and risk in a large organisation

Experience with frameworks and regulations such as NIST, Essential Eight, Privacy and AHPRA would be advantageous, as would knowledge of Single Sign-On (SSO) and Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA).

A degree in Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Business Systems, Computer Science or a related discipline is also desirable.

What’s in it for You?

At Ramsay, we care for our people by offering benefits that truly support your career, wellbeing and lifestyle, including:

  • Grow your career with recognition programs, employee referral bonuses, scholarships, free access to LinkedIn Learning and the Ramsay Leadership Academy
  • Save more every day with Ramsay Rewards, giving you exclusive deals at 100+ retailers, restaurants, travel providers and more
  • Enjoy peace of mind with lower hospital cover costs and higher extras limits on services like General and Major Dental, plus pharmacy and allied health discounts
  • Find balance through flexible rostering options, flexible leave and access to free, confidential counselling and wellbeing support 24/7

Why Join Ramsay?

At Ramsay Health Care, “people caring for people” is at the heart of everything we do. We are:

  • Australia’s largest private hospital operator, with over 74 sites and 35,000 staff
  • A values-led workplace where you’ll be supported personally and professionally

title: GLOBALG.A.P Option 2 QMS Auditor (Crops)
location: Tauranga, Bay of Plenty Region, nz
description:
• GLOBALG.A.P. QMS Auditor (Crops)
  • Location: Tauranga
  • Pay Range: $100K to $120K (depending on skills & experience)
  • Position Type: Permanent position / 40 hours per week

Are you passionate about food safety, quality systems, and auditing in the agricultural sector? We are looking for a qualified GLOBALG.A.P. Option 2 QMS Auditor to join our dynamic team.

This is a great opportunity for a highly motivated and experienced professional to play a vital role in auditing and certifying quality management systems, farm operations, and plant production businesses. The successful candidate will contribute to the continual improvement of quality systems and help ensure farms and food production sites meet the highest certification standards.

About the Role:

The role involves undertaking a systematic and independent process of obtaining and objectively examining information to determine the degree of conformity with prescribed criteria. This includes evaluating processes, records and systems to ensure compliance with the defined standards and requirements of relevant programmes. As an approved QMS Auditor, you will assess farms and food operations to verify compliance with GLOBALG.A.P. Option 2 certification requirements. You will evaluate processes, records and systems while developing and maintaining strong professional relationships with clients and stakeholders.

This is an opportunity to travel throughout Aotearoa New Zealand and work alongside growers and exporters within the horticulture sector, supporting them as they take their products to market.

The position is based in Tauranga, New Zealand, and requires regular travel throughout New Zealand. During peak season, the role may require travel and working away from home for up to two weeks per month.

This is a permanent, full-time position of 40 hours per week, Monday to Friday. Additional hours may occasionally be required during peak season.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Conduct audits of Quality Management Systems and crop production systems to verify compliance with certification standards.
  • Analyse records and processes to assess adherence to regulatory and food safety requirements.
  • Prepare and deliver accurate, timely audit reports, manage non-conformances, and maintain audit records.
  • Maintain up-to-date technical knowledge in food safety, market standards, regulatory requirements, audit techniques and accreditation.
  • Build and maintain professional relationships with clients and stakeholders.
  • Support audit teams, training, programme development, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Ensure compliance with company procedures, health and safety requirements, and administrative processes.

Technical Skills and Qualifications:

  • Tertiary diploma (2+ years) in horticulture, agricultural science, or a related field.
  • At least 2 years' experience post-study in the agricultural industry (Crops).
  • A total of 3 years' experience in agriculture-related work.

OR

  • Tertiary diploma (2+ years) in a food-related discipline.
  • At least 4 years of practical experience in farm operations or technical production management (Crops).

AND

  • LEAD auditor training based on ISO/IEC Principles, minimum duration of 37 hours.
  • Practical auditing experience of 10 days in management systems (e.g. ISO/ IEC 9000, BRCGS Food or GLOBALG.A.P. Option 2 standards).

Preference will be given to applicants already approved as a GLOBALG.A.P. Option 2 QMS Auditor under a recognised certification body. Candidates who meet the technical qualification and experience requirements may also be considered.

Experience & Knowledge:
• Knowledge of the horticulture industry and agribusiness sector.
• Experience in local and international market standards, regulatory environments, food safety, and quality systems.
• Background in agribusiness sector operations and compliance.
• Strong auditing, reporting, and problem-solving skills.

Skills Required:
• Excellent communication and stakeholder management.
• Ability to analyse processes objectively and ensure adherence to standards.
• Effective time and project management skills.

A full driver's licence, or the ability to obtain a New Zealand driver's licence, is required.

Please note we are looking for an already approved GLOBALG.A.P. Option 2 QMS Auditor OR someone with the technical skills/qualifications already listed above.

Why Join Us?

  • Relocation support available for the successful candidate.
  • Opportunity to build a career in New Zealand’s world-renowned horticulture and agribusiness sector.
  • Enjoy a lifestyle that offers access to beaches, outdoor recreation, and a strong work-life balance.
  • Work and travel throughout New Zealand while supporting leading growers and exporters.
  • Join a welcoming and collaborative team environment in one of the world’s most scenic agricultural regions.
  • Professional growth and development opportunities.

If you're ready to make a difference in the agriculture sector, please apply online.

You'll keep the machinery behind every People process running excellently – performance, learning, benefits, time & absence, engagement – and grow, deliberately, toward owning Workday modules of your own. If you want a genuine launchpad into HR technology with senior specialists who invest in teaching, this is it.


THE CHALLENGE:

  • Execute mass data loads (EIBs) for org changes, regular uploads, annual cycles and corrections – accurately and audit-proof.

  • Run the operational side of quarterly and annual cycles: performance, calibration, talent and compensation review support.

  • Resolve escalated Workday tickets (tier 2) across modules – and fix the root causes, not just the symptoms.

  • Own structured testing for Workday releases and projects, plus our data retention and purging routines.

  • Implement Workday configuration improvements – starting with simpler changes and developing into ownership of larger areas.

  • Support with Workday report and dashboard improvements, ensuring appropriate security for every audience, and clean data as the basis for our insights.

ABOUT YOU:

Must have:

  • 1–4 years in HRIS, HR systems, HR operations or people analytics – Workday experience strongly preferred.

  • Precision with data: you reconcile before you publish and keep an audit trail by instinct.

  • Organised and calm during live cycles – structured, deadline-driven, dependable.

  • A service mindset with curiosity: you resolve issues properly and spot patterns worth fixing.

  • Clear, confident communication with both technical and business teams. Adept at training and keeping it simple for our end users.

  • Ambition to grow into a Workday specialist – we're hiring someone we intend to develop.

Nice to have:

  • Hands on experience with Workday configuration, EIBs, security assignments, support, and testing.

title: AI Enabled Full Stack Engineer
description:
Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all.

Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.

As an AI Full Stack Engineer, you will be responsible for designing, developing, deploying, and supporting AI-enabled applications and enterprise solutions across the full technology stack. You will collaborate closely with business partners, product teams, and fellow engineers to translate business needs into scalable, reliable, and maintainable solutions while advancing the adoption of AI-enabled software engineering practices.

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Design, build, test, deploy, and operate full-stack software solutions supporting business and manufacturing operations.

  • Own solutions end-to-end, including system architecture, implementation, testing, observability, deployment, operational support, and lifecycle management.

  • Collaborate with business stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into scalable technical solutions.

  • Contribute to platform enablement, architecture decisions, code reviews, and engineering best practices.

  • Design and implement custom AI agents to automate tasks, orchestrate workflows, provide decision support, enable summarization capabilities, and perform multi-step reasoning.

  • Build and integrate systems using Model Context Protocol (MCP) to enable structured interactions between AI models, tools, agents, and enterprise systems.

  • Develop and integrate AI-powered solutions utilizing Large Language Models (LLMs), enterprise search, embeddings, APIs, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures.

  • Apply AI-assisted development practices to accelerate software development, testing, documentation, code modernization, and overall engineering productivity.

  • Ensure AI-enabled systems meet enterprise requirements for reliability, resiliency, security, performance, observability, maintainability, and data protection.

  • Partner with cross-functional teams to deploy solutions into mission-critical manufacturing environments and provide ongoing operational support.

  • Participate in a rotating 24x7 on-call support model and provide timely response and resolution for production incidents impacting critical business and manufacturing operations.

  • Demonstrate Micron's core values of People, Innovation, Tenacity, Collaboration, and Customer Focus in all aspects of work.

Required Qualifications

  • Strong foundation in full-stack software engineering fundamentals, including object-oriented design, clean code practices, testing strategies, and long-term maintainability.

  • Proven experience developing, deploying, and supporting production-grade software systems.

  • Experience with backend services, API development, service integrations, and data persistence technologies.

  • Strong understanding of scalable system architecture, application performance, reliability, and operational excellence.

  • Experience working in cloud-native environments, CI/CD pipelines, containerized deployments, Kubernetes platforms, and modern DevOps practices.

  • Experience working with relational and non-relational databases and modern data storage technologies.

  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across engineering, product, and business teams.

  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to balance innovation with operational reliability.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience designing and implementing custom AI agents beyond traditional chatbot solutions.

  • Practical experience with Prompt Engineering, Context Window Management, Tool Invocation, Agent Skills, and AI-assisted development practices.

  • Experience integrating systems using Model Context Protocol (MCP) or equivalent structured agent and tool frameworks.

  • Experience building and operationalizing Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions.

  • Understanding of hallucination risks, AI failure modes, security boundaries, permissions management, and guardrails in AI-powered systems.

  • Experience with technologies such as C#, ASP.NET, Angular, REST APIs, SQL, NoSQL databases, Kubernetes, and cloud-native platforms.

  • Experience leveraging AI technologies to improve software delivery speed, engineering productivity, and business outcomes.

title: Member of Technical Staff- Quality Engineer
description:
Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.

This type of work—work that changes the world—is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

THE ROLE

We are hiring a senior quality engineer to own System Testing for Pure’s FlashArray products. You will validate stability, resiliency, and performance under sustained, production‑like workloads, far beyond basic functional testing.

You will design and run multi‑week, customer‑like scenarios that combine workloads, failovers, upgrades, and fault injections, and use the insights to influence architecture, design, and release decisions.

This is a hands‑on, high‑impact role at the intersection of architecture, systems, and large‑scale testing—acting as a key quality gate before releases reach Pure’s customers.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Own System Testing strategy for releases
    Define System Testing strategy and test plans for major features and releases, focusing on stability, longevity, and end‑to‑end behavior, not just feature correctness.
  • Design realistic, high‑value scenarios
    Build scenarios that mirror Pure customer environments: mixed workloads (block, file, object), long‑running IO, failovers, NDUs, hardware events, and background operations (replication, snapshots, quotas, etc.), combining automation with targeted “tortures”.
  • Drive execution and triage on System Testing beds
    Own System Testing environments (arrays, initiators, OSes, accessories); keep them healthy, representative, and well‑instrumented. Monitor runs, triage failures quickly, separate infra issues from product bugs, and file high‑quality defects with clear workload, scale, logs, and impact—driving them to closure with Dev, PM, and Release teams.
  • Be a key voice in release readiness
    Act as a primary quality gate for Release Candidates: define System Testing entry/exit criteria, sign‑off requirements, and soak expectations (for example, 24–48h+ without critical events). Summarize findings, risks, and recommendations and provide data‑driven input on go/no‑go decisions.
  • Lead technically and mentor others
    Coach mid‑level and junior QE engineers (System Testing and system test) on test design, debugging, triage, and long‑running validation best practices. Refine System Testing processes, playbooks, and governance in partnership with engineering managers and technical leaders.
  • Advance automation, tooling, and observability
    Partner with automation teams to extend System Testing workflows (workload drivers, torture suites, health checks, dashboards). Improve observability for System Testing: metrics, alerting, and automated log/triage helpers that make issues obvious and actionable.

WHAT YOU BRING

  • 10+ years in software QA / system test / performance / reliability engineering, with significant experience in system‑level or longevity testing of complex distributed or storage systems.
  • Strong understanding of storage concepts (block, file, snapshots, replication, HA/failover, NDUs) and their behavior under sustained load and fault conditions.
  • Proven ability to design and execute long‑running scenarios that surface race conditions, memory leaks, scaling issues, and resiliency gaps.
  • Strong debugging skills across host, network, storage system, logs, and metrics.
  • Hands‑on experience with Linux and at least one of VMware, Windows, or Kubernetes.
  • Solid experience with test automation (Python, shell), CI pipelines, and result dashboards.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead cross‑functional collaboration with Development, System Test, Release, and Support.
  • Clear written and verbal communication; comfortable presenting complex findings and risk assessments to senior engineers and leaders.
  • Directory services and identity:AD, LDAP, Kerberos, ID mapping — and how per-tenant auth domains explode the test matrix.
  • Linux systems skills:shell, networking (VLANs, sub-interfaces, routing,ip,tc), service debugging, log and core analysis at scale

Nice‑to‑have

  • Background in enterprise storage.
  • Experience with performance engineering, capacity / longevity modeling, or customer‑data‑driven test design.
  • Exposure to AI‑assisted test design or triage and interest in using new tools to improve coverage and efficiency.
  • Experience working with different hypervisors, backup applications, databases, video streaming or healthcare applications/workloads is a plus
  • Prior multi-tenancy / RBAC / virtual-array isolation work in storage or cloud.
  • Replication and DR:async/ADR, sync-rep, ActiveCluster or metro-cluster, split-brain and resync validation.
  • QoS and quotatest background.

title: Assistant Counselor for Caddie Program
description:
DMSF seeks to hire an Assistant Counselor for its Caddie Program. The Caddie Program allows student scholars to gain job experience, earn money, improve communication skills, and potentially apply for the Chick Evans Scholarship- a full tuition and housing scholarship for high-achieving caddies with limited financial means.

Assistant Counselors report to the Head Counselor in overseeing Scholars who participate in the summer Caddie Program. The job entails living with the Scholars in the dorm, transporting them to work in the morning (in vehicles provided by DMSF), picking them up at the conclusion of their work day, and supervising them for the balance of the day. The Assistant Counselor will typically have free time between 9am - 2pm, as well as from Sunday evenings until Tuesday mornings, when most Scholars go home. DMSF seeks to hire two Assistant Counselors, one for the boy’s program and one for the girl’s program. DMSF anticipates hiring educators, teachers, or college/graduate students to serve as Assistant Counselors. Responsibilities include:

● Living in dorms with Scholars

● Ensuring the Caddies are routinely transported to and from work each day

● Supervising Scholars while at the dorms and coordinating weekly activities, such as guest speakers, social events, and workshops

● Transporting Scholars to and from weekly First Tee programming to learn the game of golf

● Providing Scholars transportation to trains on Sunday afternoon and from trains on Tuesday morning if their clubs are not accessible to the station

● Maintaining records of tips and loops per Caddie

● Support with logistics related to food service and vehicle maintenance (e.g. ensuring vehicles have gas)

● Enforcing DMSF policies and procedures

● Reporting to DMSF on a regular basis about Scholars and the program

● Undergraduate degree required or in progress

● Experience working with and supervising young adults

● Excellent supervisory and communication skills

● Valid driver’s license and an infraction-free driving record for the past two years

● General understanding of the game of golf and caddying is helpful but not required

DMSF is an organization that prioritizes workplace culture, collaboration, timely and thorough communication and effective project management.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

title: Kalder alle supersælgere! Circle K Hårlev søger en sælger på 15 timer.
description:
Job Description

Kære fremtidige kollega.

Først og fremmest, lad os starte med at sige, at et job som Sælger hos Circle K ikke er for alle. Men det er et job der passer til mange, og måske også dig?

At arbejde som sælger på Circle K er ikke som ethvert sælgerjob. Os der arbejder her er vilde med det, og spørger du en af vores uundværlige sælgere om hvorfor, vil de bl.a. nævne: Selvstændighed, fleksibilitet og ansvar.

Vi leder efter en positiv teamplayer som:

  • Har en sælger gemt I sig, motiveres af salg og kan levere en service lidt ud over det sædvanlige
  • Kan bevare overblikket og humøret, når der kommer uforudsete udfordringer ind af døren, og formår at løse dem med sund fornuft. Også selvom der er lang kø
  • Har en interesse for at tilberede mad. For vi elsker det! Og vi ser derfor gerne, at du har lyst til, at lave de lækreste sandwich og de bedste burgere.
  • Forstår vigtigheden af, at vores kunder får den bedste oplevelse når de besøger os. Dette indebærer også at butikken, kundetoilet og forplads er ren og pæn.
  • Du forstår betydningen af, at arbejde i et team, hvor alle er afhængige af- og stoler på, at hver løfter sit. Og til tider er villig til at give lidt ekstra.

Hvad kan I tilbyde mig?

Vi er en dynamisk, handlingsorienteret organisation, hvor vi arbejder sammen som ét team. Vi tager ikke os selv alt for højtideligt og engagerer os ikke i politik eller bureaukrati. Vi værdsætter diversitet og forskellige måder at tænke og arbejde på.

Det er altafgørende at du har lysten og motivationen til at lære nye ting, udvikle dig og bidrage til vores ”one-team” kultur. Hvis du har ambitionen om at bygge en karriere, får du unikke muligheder i Circle K, så længe du har den motivation der skal til.

Udover helt unikke udviklingsmuligheder, tilbyder vi et job med yderst attraktive fordele og personalegoder. Som en del af vores Circle K familie vil du bl.a. få medarbejderrabat på brændstof, bilvask samt på mad og drikkevarer i vores butikker.

description:
Radiation Engineer - Millennium Space Systems

Company:

Millennium Space Systems

Millennium Space Systems, a part of Boeing Defense, Space and Security (BDS), is a fast, agile small satellite company focused on national security space. Our missions have direct impact to global security, like missile warning and Earth observation.

Our team is curious, bold and innovative. We take risks, innovate and explore new techniques and technologies. We influence change because we challenge the status quo. And when we watch our satellites launch, we know each one of us made it happen.

Job Summary

The Radiation Engineer will derive radiation environments and apply those environments to electronic parts selection and development of appropriate test plans and procedures.

Responsibilities

  • Derive radiation environments for specific mission profiles using CREME96, OMERE, SPENVIS or similar tools

  • Evaluate customer radiation requirements for TID, Total Ionizing Dose and SEE, Single Event Effects

  • Assist with evaluation of electronic parts for new and existing designs

  • Develop test plans

  • Assist with construction of test set ups

  • Test harness design

  • Coordinate test hardware procurement

  • Coordinate with TID & SEE results

  • Bachelor of Science degree in Engineering, Engineering Technology (including Manufacturing Technology), Computer Science, Data Science, Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry or non-US equivalent qualifications directly related to the work statement

  • Topical knowledge and application of radiation environments for TID, Displacement Damage, SEE

  • Topical knowledge of radiation effects on microelectronics

  • Ability to read and analyze schematics

  • This position requires the ability to obtain a U.S. Security Clearance for which the U.S. Government requires U.S. Citizenship. A final U.S. clearance Post Start is required

Everpure Cloud Azure Native is a generally available service that brings enterprise-grade block storage natively to Azure. With the first version already live, we are expanding the service into new use cases and markets while improving its reliability, operability, and customer experience.

Our Foundation team owns a Go-based control-plane service that coordinates how customers provision and use storage in Azure. Around it, we work with a modern cloud stack including Temporal and other platform services for workflows, automation, and observability. This is a production cloud service: the code you write directly shapes how customers deploy, scale, and operate storage in their Azure environments.

You’ll work on a core storage service in a major public cloud, as part of a joint effort between Everpure and Microsoft. You’ll design and evolve APIs and service behavior in the critical path of real customer workloads, collaborating closely with engineers across both companies.

Clear API contracts, long-lived interfaces, test automation, and CI/CD are fundamental to how we build. You’ll have the opportunity to own services end to end and solve complex distributed-systems problems in the public cloud.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Own and evolve a production cloud service that powers Everpure Cloud Azure Native, taking features from idea and design through deployment and operation in Azure for real customers.
  • Build new capabilities and improve existing ones within the control-plane service, from refining user flows and exposing system state to usage metering and other capabilities that improve the customer experience.
  • Improve service reliability and operability through test automation, CI/CD, metrics, alerting, and engineering practices that enable the team to deliver changes safely.
  • Shape how we build by contributing to the tools, technologies, and engineering patterns we use across Go, Python, Azure, Temporal, and other platform services.
  • Continuously improve the system by simplifying code and APIs, identifying opportunities to make the service safer and easier to operate, and acting on learnings from postmortems.
  • Collaborate across teams and companies, working with engineers across Everpure Cloud and Microsoft on joint design, integrations, and incident follow-ups.
  • Share ownership of the service in production, including on-call responsibilities, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvements to how the team builds and operates the platform.
  • We are primarily an in-office environment and therefore, you will be expected to work from the {{OFFICE_LOCATION}} office in compliance with Everpure's policies, unless you are on PTO, or work travel, or other approved leave.

WHAT YOU BRING

  • Experience building and maintaining backend services or APIs in production, with an understanding of reliable and scalable software design.
  • Strong programming skills in at least one modern language, such as Go, Python, Java, or C#, with openness to working primarily with Go and learning new technologies where needed.
  • Experience taking software end to end, from design and implementation through testing, deployment, monitoring, and iterative improvement in production.
  • Strong problem-solving and debugging skills, including working through issues that cross service boundaries, APIs, and infrastructure components.
  • Ability to design and evolve maintainable APIs and services, considering reliability, compatibility, and long-term operation.
  • Ability to collaborate and communicate effectively across engineering teams, sharing technical ideas and giving and receiving constructive feedback.

title: Test Engineer, Advanced
description:
About Gartner IT:

Join a world-class team of skilled engineers who build creative digital solutions to support our colleagues and clients. We make a broad organizational impact by delivering cutting-edge technology solutions that power Gartner. Gartner IT values its culture of nonstop innovation, an outcome-driven approach to success, and the notion that great ideas can come from anyone on the team.

About this role:

This is a hands-on technical role responsible for guiding the design, development, and execution of test strategies and automation frameworks. This role provides technical expertise to the QA team, mentors test engineers, and collaborates closely with developers, product owners, and project managers to ensure high-quality product delivery.

Skills & Experience

  • Lead the technical implementation of test strategies, frameworks, and automation solutions for web and mobile applications.

  • Participate in the recruitment and onboarding of new QA team members.

  • Hands-on experience with UI, API, and DB test automation, including framework design and maintenance.

  • Strong expertise in implementing and maintaining automated test solutions to minimize manual testing.

  • Experience with CI/CD tools (Jenkins, Gitlab, etc.) to integrate automated testing into build pipelines.

  • Solid understanding of Agile, BDD, DevOps, and modern QA methodologies.

What you will do:

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Design, develop, and maintain robust test automation frameworks for functional and non-functional testing (UI, DB, API, performance, etc.).

  • Lead the creation and execution of comprehensive test plans, test cases, and test scripts, ensuring alignment with project requirements and quality standards.

  • Own the execution and reporting of system, integration, end to end, and regression testing activities.

  • Identify, document, and prioritize defects with appropriate severity; collaborate with development teams to resolve issues efficiently. Lead and own defect triage calls with product owner and development team.

  • Implement and advocate QA best practices, tools, and metrics within the team.

  • Drive the automation strategy for assigned projects, ensuring coverage and efficiency.

  • Review and optimize test case management and defect tracking processes (e.g., JIRA).

  • Provide clear and concise status updates, including metrics and risk assessments, to project stakeholders.

  • Collaborate with developers, product owners, and scrum teams to align testing with project goals and customer requirements.

  • Stay current with emerging technologies and trends in test automation, integrating new tools and techniques as appropriate.

  • Support and coach team members in technical problem-solving and professional development.

What you will need

A strong IT professional with 4–6 years of experience in software testing. The candidate should have excellent technical, analytical, and communication skills, and demonstrate high ownership and accountability.

Must have: (Primary skill sets)

  • 4-6 years of experience in QA

  • Proven experience designing and implementing manual and automated test solutions.

  • Proficient in leading end-to-end test management across the software lifecycle

  • Hands-on experience with industry-standard test automation tools: Selenium, Playwright, JUnit, TestNG, JMeter, Cucumber, Appium, Postman, Report Portal.

  • Proficiency with test case management and defect tracking tools (e.g., JIRA)

  • Experience integrating test suites with DevOps/CICD pipelines (GIT, Jenkins, etc.).

Who you are

  • Excellent communication and prioritization skills.

  • Able to work independently or as a technical leader within a team in a fast-paced Agile-Scrum environment.

  • Owns success – Takes responsibility for the quality and delivery of solutions.

  • Strong attention to detail, end-user quality, and usability.

  • Self-motivated and excellent problem-solving skills.

Who are we?

At Gartner, Inc. (NYSE:IT), we guide the leaders who shape the world.

Our mission relies on expert analysis and bold ideas to deliver actionable, objective business and technology insights, helping enterprise leaders and their teams succeed with their mission-critical priorities.

Since our founding in 1979, we’ve grown to 20,000 associates globally who support over 13,000 client enterprises in ~90 countries and territories. We do important, interesting and substantive work that matters. That’s why we hire associates with the intellectual curiosity, energy and drive to want to make a difference. The bar is unapologetically high. So is the impact you can have here.

What makes Gartner a great place to work?

Our vast, virtually untapped market potential offers limitless opportunities – opportunities that may not even exist right now – for you to grow professionally and flourish personally. How far you go is driven by your passion and performance.

We hire remarkable people who collaborate and win as a team. Together, our singular, unifying goal is to deliver results for our clients.

Our teams are inclusive and composed of individuals from different geographies, cultures, religions, ethnicities, races, genders, sexual orientations, abilities and generations.

We invest in great leaders who bring out the best in you and the company, enabling us to multiply our impact and results. This is why, year after year, we are recognized worldwide as a great place to work.

Gartner is the world authority on AI

At Gartner, you’ll join a company at the very center of the AI revolution. Gartner has proactive, objective guidance throughout clients’ AI journeys. We set the standard for how organizations leverage artificial intelligence to drive meaningful impact. You’ll have access to unmatched resources, expertise, and technology, and play a key role in helping Gartner and our clients innovate and grow as we leverage AI to transform business and technology landscapes.

It’s an exciting time to be at Gartner, with limitless opportunities to make a real impact, grow your skills, and build a lasting, meaningful career in a field that’s reshaping the way we operate. If you’re passionate about AI and want to be part of a team that’s guiding the leaders who shape the world, Gartner is the place for you.

In our hybrid work environment, we provide the flexibility and support for you to thrive — working virtually when it's productive to do so and getting together with colleagues in a vibrant community that is purposeful, engaging and inspiring.

title: Senior Risk & Governance Engineer
description:
About AlphaSense:

The world’s most sophisticated companies rely on AlphaSense to remove uncertainty from decision-making. With market intelligence and search built on proven AI, AlphaSense delivers insights that matter from content you can trust. Our universe of public and private content includes equity research, company filings, event transcripts, expert calls, news, trade journals, and clients’ own research content.

The acquisition of Tegus by AlphaSense in 2024 advances our shared mission to empower professionals to make smarter decisions through AI-driven market intelligence. Together, AlphaSense and Tegus will accelerate growth, innovation, and content expansion, with complementary product and content capabilities that enable users to unearth even more comprehensive insights from thousands of content sets. Our platform is trusted by over 6,000 enterprise customers, including a majority of the S&P 500. Founded in 2011, AlphaSense is headquartered in New York City with more than 2,000 employees across the globe and offices in the U.S., U.K., Finland, India, Singapore, Canada, and Ireland. Come join us!

About the Role

AlphaSense's GRC function is making a deliberate investment in automation and engineering, and we need a Senior GRC Engineer to lead that charge. You will design and build the technical automation that powers our compliance testing, evidence collection, risk monitoring, and GRC platform integrations—and you will own the governance architecture for how AI and agentic systems are built and deployed at AlphaSense. You sit at the intersection of security engineering and compliance operations. You are not just AI-curious; you are AI-native in practice: you use LLMs and agents for real substantive work—analysis, drafting, automation, code, investigation—and you apply rigorous judgment about where AI creates leverage, where it introduces risk, and where a human must remain in the loop. The goal is continuous compliance infrastructure that generates its own proof, not a compliance team that sprints to collect evidence before each audit cycle.The conventional GRC playbook was not built for a company like AlphaSense—and we are not following it. We are building a GRC engineering function that we believe represents what the entire industry will eventually need to become: automated, AI-native, and architected like a product rather than operated like a process. The frameworks are still catching up. The tooling is still maturing. We are doing the work now that others will reference later. If you want to build something that sets the standard—not follow one—this is the role.

Key Responsibilities

Compliance Automation Engineering

Design, build, and maintain automated compliance testing pipelines that continuously validate control adherence across cloud infrastructure, SaaS platforms, and internal systems. Replace point-in-time manual evidence collection with always-on automated checks. Pull evidence directly from APIs—cloud audit logs, identity systems, configuration posture, secrets management—without relying on screenshots or control owner self-attestation.

GRC Platform Engineering & Integration

Own the technical configuration and integration of the GRC platform (Drata or equivalent). Build custom API integrations, automated evidence connectors, and workflow automation that reduce manual control owner burden and keep evidence artifacts current. Know where the platform solves the problem and where custom code is the better answer.

AI-Native GRC Workflows

Develop and deploy AI-assisted workflows for evidence summarization, control narrative drafting, risk analysis, vendor questionnaire triage, and policy gap detection. Build with LLMs and agentic frameworks as a professional standard—not an experiment. Apply domain-specific judgment: know where AI helps, where it hurts, and where sensitive data, attacker-controlled inputs, or privileged access require a human in the loop.

AI & Agentic Systems Governance

Own the governance framework for AlphaSense's AI and agentic systems. Define the policies, control sets, and compliance posture that govern how agents are built and deployed—and build ahead of the compliance frameworks that are still catching up. Anticipate new policy requirements, adapt existing controls, and ensure the governance architecture is ready before auditors ask about it.

Policy as Code & Control Architecture

Build the policy program as code: policies in version control, peer-reviewed, with requirements expressed as enforceable rules and automated checks rather than static documents. Design a common controls framework that satisfies SOC 2, ISO 27001, ISO 42001, and future frameworks from a single control reference—no rework across frameworks.

Continuous Control Monitoring & Observability

Instrument controls with observability tooling so the GRC team receives real-time signals on control health rather than discovering failures at audit time. Build the data pipelines and dashboards that give engineering and product teams live visibility into their risk and compliance posture. Define alerting thresholds and remediation runbooks that make distributed control ownership practical.

Security Tooling Integration & Audit Readiness

Build and maintain integrations between GRC tooling and the broader security stack—SIEM, EDR, CSPM, identity platforms, and vulnerability management. Collaborate with the compliance team and auditors to understand evidence requirements, then engineer automated pipelines that pre-populate and maintain audit evidence. Maintain clear technical documentation and runbooks for all GRC automation so non-engineering GRC team members can operate and extend it.

What Success Looks Like

  • Security and compliance controls are clearly documented, tested, and consistently implemented—with evidence generated by integrations, not collected by hand
  • Risks and compliance gaps are identified early, tracked with owners, and remediated in partnership with technical teams before auditors find them
  • GRC processes scale alongside platform growth and new customer or regulatory requirements without proportional headcount growth
  • Stakeholders across Engineering, Legal, and Product view the GRC function as a trusted, enabling partner—not a compliance checkpoint
  • AI tools are used deliberately and responsibly: output is validated, sensitive data is protected, and automation creates leverage without introducing new risk
  • Compliance evidence is generated by automated pipelines, not collected by hand—audit readiness is a continuous state, not a quarterly sprint
  • The policy program lives in version control, is peer-reviewed, and control requirements are expressed as enforceable checks rather than static PDFs
  • Engineering and product teams have live visibility into their compliance and risk posture without needing to ask the GRC team

Who You Are

Basic Requirements

  • 6+ years of experience in GRC, information security, risk management, or IT audit, preferably in a SaaS or cloud-native environment
  • Strong understanding of security and compliance frameworks including SOC 2, ISO 27001, NIST CSF 2.0, and CIS Controls; working knowledge of ISO 42001 and NIST AI RMF
  • AI-native mindset: you use AI tools—LLMs, agents, automation—for real, substantive work including analysis, drafting, evidence gathering, and workflow automation. You apply judgment about where AI creates leverage and where a human must stay in the loop
  • Proficiency with GRC platforms for evidence management and control testing (Drata, Vanta, AuditBoard, ServiceNow GRC, or equivalent)
  • Familiarity with cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and the security and compliance posture tooling that runs on them (CSPM, SIEM, identity platforms)
  • Experience supporting external audits across security or privacy domains, including evidence collection, control walkthroughs, and auditor interaction
  • Hands-on experience implementing automated control collection and continuous control monitoring—designing pipelines and integrations that pull evidence directly from systems rather than relying on manual artifact submission or self-attestation
  • Working knowledge of risk registers, control libraries, and policy governance lifecycles
  • Strong written communication, analytical thinking, and attention to detail; able to produce clear audit responses, risk narratives, and control documentation under deadline
  • 6+ years of experience in security engineering, DevSecOps, GRC tooling, or compliance automation—with ownership of both the policy/control side and the technical implementation
  • Coding ability that ships: Python or equivalent—you can call APIs, build integrations, schedule jobs, and deploy a working pipeline without help. Show us something you built
  • Hands-on experience building integrations with GRC platforms via APIs or native connectors, and direct evidence collection from cloud environments (AWS Config, GCP SCC, Azure Policy, or equivalent)
  • Demonstrated professional use of AI and LLM tools to automate documentation, analysis, or workflow tasks—with clear judgment about where AI creates leverage and where guardrails are required
  • Version control and CI/CD practices (Git, GitHub Actions, or equivalent); comfort with infrastructure-as-code concepts.

Nice to Have

  • Relevant certifications: CISA, CRISC, CISM, CISSP, CCSK, or ISO 27001 Lead Auditor/Implementer
  • Experience with AI governance frameworks including ISO 42001, NIST AI RMF, EU AI Act, or OECD AI Principles
  • Exposure to SOX ITGC cycles—managing evidence, walkthroughs, and findings with external auditors
  • Privacy program crossover: data mapping, DPIAs, GDPR/CCPA operational compliance
  • Scripting or automation experience (Python, JavaScript, or low-code tools) applied to GRC or compliance workflows
  • Experience with SOAR platforms or agentic AI orchestration frameworks (LangChain, n8n, Tines, AutoGen, or similar) applied to security or GRC workflows
  • Familiarity with policy-as-code and infrastructure-as-code approaches (Terraform, OPA/Rego) in a compliance context
  • Experience shipping LLM or agent-powered tooling that automates security or compliance activities and was adopted by a broader team
  • Background in detection engineering, security operations, or offensive security—you understand how the systems being governed actually fail
  • Experience building governance frameworks specifically for AI or agentic systems: model risk controls, ISO 42001 implementation, LLM deployment guardrails

title: Senior Fullstack Engineer (Java + React.js)
description:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

Company Description

Okta is the leading independent provider of enterprise identity. The Okta Identity Cloud enables organizations to securely connect the right people to the right technologies at the right time. With over 6,500 pre-built integrations to

applications and infrastructure providers, Okta customers can easily and securely use the best technologies for their business. Over 7,950 organizations, including 20th Century Fox, JetBlue, Nordstrom, Slack, Teach for America, and Twilio,

trust Okta to help protect the identities of their workforces and customers.

Position Description

We are seeking an experienced Full Stack Senior Software Engineer to play a key role in building and scaling the Okta Recovery Vault (ORV). This team is responsible for Okta's enterprise-grade soft-delete and object recovery capability,

designed to protect critical identity objects (Users and Groups) from accidental or malicious deletion.

As a Senior Engineer, you will own the technical design, implementation, and operational reliability of critical components within our real-time, high-fidelity recovery system — spanning backend services and the admin-facing UI that customers

use to review and restore their data. You will solve complex engineering problems around identity preservation (UUIDs) and relationship restoration—including group memberships, app assignments, and password hashes—while also crafting

intuitive, performant workflows that let admins confidently recover from data loss events.

Job Duties and Responsibilities

- Feature Execution: Drive the technical design and end-to-end implementation of complex features, such as granular and bulk recovery workflows across Free and Advanced Resilience tiers — from backend APIs to the admin console UI.

- Component Design: Design and build reliable core components for real-time recovery systems that capture deletion events, support scalable data restoration, and surface clear, actionable recovery status to end users.

- UI/UX for Recovery Workflows: Build responsive, accessible front-end experiences (e.g., recovery dashboards, bulk restore flows, audit views) that make complex backend recovery operations easy for admins to understand and act on.

- Relationship & State Management: Solve challenging engineering problems around relationship restoration (group memberships, app assignments, device enrollments) and state consistency, and reflect that state accurately in the UI.

- Security & Compliance: Implement secure logging and tracking for all recovery operations (soft-delete, restore, permanent-delete) in Syslog to adhere to strict audit and compliance standards.

- Product & Cross-Functional Alignment: Partner with Product Managers, Designers, and technical leads to clarify requirements, define technical scope, and break down complex projects into actionable milestones across the stack.

- Operational Excellence: Participate in on-call rotations, troubleshoot production issues (backend and frontend), perform root cause analysis (RCAs), and enhance system observability, logging, and metrics.

- Code Quality & Technical Standards: Champion engineering best practices through thorough code reviews, automated testing (unit, integration, and UI), and comprehensive technical documentation.

- Team Growth: Provide guidance and peer mentorship to intermediate and junior engineers on the team to foster technical growth and code quality across the full stack.

Required Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

- Experience: 5+ years of hands-on software engineering experience building and scaling highly reliable, production-grade full stack applications.

- Backend Expertise: Strong proficiency in object-oriented programming, with extensive experience in Java and the Spring Boot framework.

- Frontend Expertise: Solid experience building modern, component-based web UIs (e.g., React, TypeScript) including state management, performance optimization, and accessibility best practices.

- Distributed Systems: Solid experience with distributed system patterns, asynchronous job processing, and event-driven architectures (essential for bulk restore operations).

- Data Management: Proficiency with relational databases (e.g., MySQL) and caching strategies (e.g., Redis) to manage state and high-throughput data snapshots.

- API Design: Proven experience designing, building, and maintaining robust RESTful APIs, and consuming them to build seamless, responsive front-end experiences.

- Problem Solving & Ownership: Proven track record of independently breaking down ambiguous requirements into clean, scalable software designs across the entire stack.

Nice to Haves

- Familiarity with Identity and Access Management (IAM) standards (SCIM, SAML, OAuth, OIDC) or directory services (AD, LDAP).

- Experience with resilient systems design (e.g., retry strategies, circuit breakers, rate limiting).

- Hands-on experience with feature flagging frameworks and gradual/canary deployment strategies.

- Experience with queueing systems or message brokers (e.g., Kafka).

- Experience with design systems / component libraries and cross-browser/responsive UI testing.

Education and Training

B.S. or M.S. in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience).
