title: Staff Engineer, Lighting Systems
description:
About Lucid

At Lucid, we are creating exceptional mobility experiences through innovation to drive the world forward. Built on Lucid’s proprietary technology and software-defined vehicle architecture, our award-winning vehicles bring our “Compromise Nothing™” approach to the global automotive market. That means refusing to choose between performance and sustainability, design and engineering, ambition and integrity. In Lucid Air and Lucid Gravity, we have designed and built vehicles that have redefined their segments, combining exceptional range, performance, design, and expansive space in a single experience.

We achieve this through deep vertical integration, with design, engineering, and production happening in-house across our global offices and manufacturing facilities. Our teams come from industries around the world, united by a shared commitment to excellence. By refusing to settle, you can help redefine what’s possible and shape the future of mobility.

Position Overview

The Staff Engineer, Lighting Systems (Resident Engineering) will serve as the primary on-site technical owner for plant-related lighting topics, supporting launch readiness, production stabilization, issue resolution, and continuous improvement across lighting systems. This role requires a hands-on engineer with a strong combination of mechanical design, hardware integration, supplier coordination, validation, and manufacturing support skills. The ideal candidate will operate with high ownership, urgency, and accountability to ensure lighting components meet engineering requirements, plant build requirements, quality expectations, and program milestones.

Key Responsibilities

• Act as the on-site technical owner for lighting systems during prototype builds, launch, ramp-up, and production stabilization.
• Own plant-related lighting topics, including fit, function, packaging, sealing, mounting, assembly feasibility, end-of-line issues, and vehicle-level integration concerns.
• Act as the primary technical liaison between AMP-2 KSA, global lighting engineering teams (Europe and North America), suppliers, and manufacturing organizations to ensure alignment on technical issues, priorities, launch readiness, and execution.
• Lead root cause analysis for lighting concerns identified during builds, launch, production, validation, or field feedback, and coordinate containment and corrective action plans
• Support mechanical and hardware troubleshooting for lighting modules, including brackets, housing, lenses, connectors, PCBs, light guides, harness interfaces, electronic control units, and mounting features.
• Review and interpret CAD data, 2D drawings, GD&T, specifications, EBOMs, release documentation, DFMEA PFMEA, DVP&Rs, and supplier technical documents to support plant execution.
• Coordinate engineering changes, deviations, temporary approvals, build concerns, and design improvements needed to support production readiness and program timing.
• Participate in line trials, build events, quality reviews, launch meetings, supplier reviews, and vehicle-level issue resolution activities.
• Work with suppliers and internal teams to validate corrected parts, confirm design intent, and ensure readiness for continued production use.
• Track open lighting issues, owners, timing, risk level, containment status, and permanent corrective actions to ensure transparent execution.
• Provide clear written and verbal updates to leadership on issue status, technical risk, launch readiness, and escalation needs.
• Identify and escalate program risks early, providing clear technical recommendations and recovery plans for leadership.
• Lead sustaining product improvement activities for lighting systems where appropriate with close collaboration with teams in HQ.

Skills

• Strong lighting systems development capability, with demonstrated understanding of concept development, design release, validation, tooling, launch readiness, and serial production support.
• Mechanical engineering skill set required to evaluate plastics, injection molding, sealing strategy, thermal considerations, assembly feasibility, mounting concepts, tolerance management, and vehicle-level packaging.
• Ability to work across lighting hardware and electrical interfaces, including PCBs, connectors, LED drivers, wiring, control units, diagnostics, functional behavior of lighting devices, basic EE components, and double-sourcing considerations.
• Problem-solving skills required to support root cause analysis, containment, corrective actions, validation of fixes, and production issue resolution in a launch or manufacturing environment.
• Technical proficiency with CATIA or 3DX, GD&T, 2D and 3D stack-up analysis, SQL, CANalyzer, and the ability to read and interpret CAD models, engineering drawings, technical specifications, DFMEA, DVP&R, and supplier documentation.
• Collaboration skills required to work directly with plant teams, quality, manufacturing, suppliers, and global engineering teams in a fast-paced launch and production environment.
• Strong organizational and execution skills, including the ability to track multiple open issues, drive ownership, communicate status clearly, and maintain visibility to timing, risk, containment, and permanent corrective actions.
• Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications and engineering issue-tracking tools required to manage launch, quality, validation, and production readiness activities.
• Hands-on capability to reflash PCBAs and support software or calibration updates required for lighting module troubleshooting and validation.
• Hands-on capability to operate electrical measurement equipment, including multimeters, oscilloscopes, power supplies, and related tools used to diagnose lighting hardware and EE component concerns.
• Understanding of end-of-line requirements, specifications, and validation activities required for production readiness, including headlamp aiming and related lighting checks.
• Working knowledge of lighting homologation and regulatory requirements relevant to the position, including FMVSS 108, ECE R48, ECE R149, and GB 4785.

Minimum Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Mechatronics, Electrical Engineering, Physics, or related technical field required.
• 10+ years of automotive OEM or Tier 1 experience in lighting systems, resident engineering, launch, manufacturing support, or production issue resolution.
• Experience with automotive lighting development, validation, launch, plant support, quality concerns, and sustaining improvements.
• Ability to read and evaluate CAD models, 2D drawings, GD&T, specifications, and release documentation using CATIA, 3DX, or equivalent tools.
• Ability to support plant builds, supplier visits, line trials, issue investigations, validation activities, and launch-critical events.
• Strong communication and ownership to align cross-functional teams, drive issue closure, and manage timing, risk, containment, and corrective actions.

Success Profile

A successful Staff Engineer, Lighting Systems as part of Resident Engineering team is hands-on, structured, and highly accountable. This person can move quickly between plant floor concerns and engineering-level problem solving, translating technical issues into clear actions with owners, timing, and risk visibility. The role is best suited for an engineer who can combine mechanical judgment, hardware understanding, supplier coordination, and launch discipline to protect program’s milestones and ensure lighting systems are successfully integrated into production.

Compensation & Benefits: Lucid offers a comprehensive and competitive benefits package including medical, dental, and vision insurance; life and disability coverage; paid time off; paid holidays, paid sick leave; and a 401(k) retirement plan. Hourly/non-exempt employees accrue up to 120 hours paid time off, and salaried/exempt employee accrue up to 160 hours paid time off. Eligible employees may also participate in Lucid’s equity program and/or a discretionary annual cash incentive program. Incentive and equity awards, if applicable, are determined based on individual performance, role scope, market considerations, and overall company results, in accordance with the terms of the applicable plans.

Join Micron Technology at a defining moment in our AI and smart manufacturing transformation.   • Ability to apply AI literacy and digital fluency to use AI-enabled tools responsibly and effectively for research, analysis, content creation, problem-solving, operational tasks, automation, and achieving business outcomes.

Must Have Soft Skills

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Effective communication and collaboration skills.
  • Ability to learn quickly and adapt in a fast-paced environment.

Highly Desirable / Preferred Skills or Experience

  • Experience in semiconductor manufacturing, industrial automation, or smart manufacturing environments.
  • Exposure to MLOps, machine learning model deployment, or enterprise AI applications.
  • Familiarity with MES, Industrial IoT, or equipment automation systems.

Embody Micron's Core Values

  • Tenacity – Show grit and determination.

  • Customer Focus – Deliver excellence and value.

title: Lead AI Engineer

Wells Fargo is seeking a Lead AI Engineer.

  • Architect and deliver scalable Python-based applications, APIs, microservices, and data engineering pipelines using cloud-native and distributed processing technologies.

  • Mentor engineering teams and lead strategic technology initiatives, accelerating adoption of emerging AI technologies while delivering measurable business value.

Required Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of Software Engineering experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education

Desired Qualifications

  • Strong software engineering background with 8+ years of experience developing and delivering enterprise-scale applications, platforms, and distributed systems, with expert proficiency in Python, object-oriented design, design patterns, asynchronous programming, API development, automation, performance tuning, and debugging.
  • Extensive experience in data engineering and large-scale data processing, including the design and implementation of scalable ETL/ELT pipelines, data ingestion frameworks, orchestration solutions, and transformation processes using technologies such as Spark, Pandas, Databricks, and other distributed computing platforms.
  • Proven hands-on experience building production-grade Generative AI solutions, with at least 3+ years focused on LLM-based applications, utilizing GPT and enterprise LLMs, LangChain, LangGraph, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Agentic AI, multi-agent systems, prompt engineering, embeddings, and semantic retrieval techniques.
  • Demonstrated success designing and deploying enterprise AI applications, including AI assistants, copilots, intelligent chatbots, knowledge retrieval platforms, document intelligence systems, and AI-driven automation solutions that deliver measurable business value.
  • Deep understanding of knowledge management and search architectures, including vector databases and retrieval technologies such as Pinecone, OpenSearch, FAISS, ChromaDB, Neo4j knowledge graphs, semantic search, NLP, and information retrieval frameworks.

title: Kalder alle supersælgere! Circle K Kuldyssen søger en sælger på 15 timer
description:
Job Description

Kære fremtidige kollega

Først og fremmest, lad os starte med at sige, at et job som Sælger hos Circle K ikke er for alle. Men det er et job der passer til mange, og måske også dig? Vi leder lige nu efter vores nye kollega til Kuldyssen, som kan hjælpe hen over sommerperioden.

At arbejde som sælger på Circle K er ikke som ethvert sælgerjob. Os der arbejder her er vilde med det, og spørger du en af vores uundværlige sælgere om hvorfor, vil de bla nævne: Selvstændighed, fleksibilitet og ansvar.

Vi leder efter en positiv teamplayer som:

  • Har en sælger gemt I sig, motiveres af salg og kan levere en service lidt ud over det sædvanlige
  • Kan bevare overblikket og humøret, når der kommer uforudsete udfordringer ind af døren, og formår at løse dem med sund fornuft. Også selvom der er lang kø
  • Har en interesse for at tilberede mad. For vi elsker det! Og vi ser derfor gerne, at du har lyst til, at lave de lækreste sandwich og de bedste burgere.
  • Forstår vigtigheden af, at vores kunder får den bedste oplevelse når de besøger os. Dette indebærer også at butikken, kundetoilet og forplads er ren og pæn.
  • Du forstår betydningen af, at arbejde i et team, hvor alle er afhængige af- og stoler på, at hver løfter sit. Og til tider er villig til at give lidt ekstra.

Hvad kan I tilbyde mig?

Hos Circle K er der plads til alle! Vi værdsætter diversitet og forskellige måder at tænke og arbejde på, og vi arbejder altid samme som One team!

Det er altafgørende at du har lysten og motivationen til at lære nye ting, udvikle dig og bidrage til vores ”one-team” kultur. Hvis du har ambitionen om at bygge en karriere, får du unikke muligheder i Circle K, så længe du har den motivation der skal til.

title: RBAC Discovery & Solutions Integration Specialist
description:
Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all.

Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.

As an RBAC Discovery & Solutions Integration Specialist in Micron’s Identity and Access Governance Team, you will help drive the identification, design, and implementation of Micron’s global access control solutions across applications, data platforms, and enterprise systems. You will lead the onboarding of new applications and data access capabilities, integrate Role Based Access Control (RBAC) into new technologies and business processes, and support global critical initiatives. You will partner with collaborators across the company to implement scalable solutions that advance Micron’s Zero Trust strategy.

In this role, you will be a key member of the RBAC Core Team, responsible for designing and delivering solutions that strengthen access governance while growing RBAC coverage into new applications, data domains, and systems. This is a dynamic, high-impact opportunity for a motivated individual looking to advance a career in Identity and Access Management (IAM) with a variety of possibilities and challenges.

Responsibilities:

  • Participate on the RBAC project’s core team by assisting with key decision making, problem identification, and supporting activities that advance the program.

  • Identify and drive access control improvements that strengthen security, support least-privilege access, and protect Micron's intellectual property.

  • Partner with business, IT, security, and application teams to discover, assess, and document applications, systems, data repositories, and access control models used across the organizations.

  • Analyze application, system and data platform purpose, business processes, sensitive data exposure, authentication methods, authorization models, and existing and new security configurations for RBAC readiness, including security design opportunities and access control gaps.

  • Stay updated on the latest security trends and design solutions to integrate them into Micron’s security framework.

  • Bringing to bear AI powered tools and other technologies to improve analysis, research, and operational efficiency.

  • Support program maturity and broaden your skills by contributing and leading special projects that expand RBAC coverage and access governance across the enterprise.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent experience) in Information Security, Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, with 5+ years of professional experience.

  • Strong expertise in Identity and Access Management (IAM), Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), and IAM platforms/integrations, with SailPoint experience preferred.

  • Hands-on experience with directory services (AD, LDAP, Entra ID, Unix LDAP), data platforms (GCP, Snowflake), and governance of structured and unstructured data sources.

  • Advanced analytical and problem-solving skills with experience managing complex systems, large datasets, ambiguous ownership models, and data-driven reporting using Excel and AI-powered tools.

  • Self-motivated, diligent, and collaborative professional with good communication skills and the ability to work effectively across diverse teams, cultures, and organizational boundaries.

​Preferred Qualifications:

  • Minimum of 2 years of experience in Identity and Access Management, with a focus on RBAC preferred.

  • Experience with configurable security setups in tools like SharePoint, Tableau, Confluence, PowerBI, or similar platforms is preferred.

  • Relevant certifications such as CIMP, CISM, CISSP or similar are a plus.

As a world leader in the semiconductor industry, Micron is dedicated to your personal wellbeing and professional growth. Micron benefits are designed to help you stay well, provide peace of mind and help you prepare for the future. We offer a choice of medical, dental and vision plans in all locations enabling team members to select the plans that best meet their family healthcare needs and budget. Micron also provides benefit programs that help protect your income if you are unable to work due to illness or injury, and paid family leave. Additionally, Micron benefits include a robust paid time-off program and paid holidays. For additional information regarding the Benefit programs available, please see the Benefits Guide posted on .

title: Project Interior Designer V
description:
If you think your skills, experience and aspirations make you a good match for this position, we encourage you to apply. This position may be filled anywhere in the United States.
ABOUT THE ROLE
This senior-level position is a leadership role within our multi-disciplinary team, responsible for guiding and mentoring project teams across multiple interior design projects. The Interior Designer V will demonstrate expertise in furniture planning, specification, procurement coordination, design leadership, storytelling, and strategic impact. This role requires proactive communication, independent conceptualization, and a commitment to quality and standards. The individual will serve as a furniture subject matter expert, collaborate with design leaders and contribute to business development and community engagement.
HERE'S WHAT YOU'LL DO
  • Provide leadership to the client and project team in establishment of the project goals and vision.
  • Operates with high autonomy and strategic influence, guiding firm-wide standards, mentoring teams, and setting design direction independently.
  • Provide interior design leadership across multiple projects with a focus on furniture planning, building a strong conceptual strategy for the project that is rooted in the client’s vision and aspirations.
  • Guides and motivates teams, leads the creative process, and promotes firm strategies, policies, and procedures.
  • Expected to conceptualize, set direction for design, with a focus on furniture planning, and oversee production and discipline coordination.
  • Lead the interior design approach of the project’s goals through all phases of the project (the Pursuit, Programming and Visioning, Concept Design, Schematic Design, Design Development, Construction Design, Procurement and Construction Administration).
  • Evaluate client needs, analyze and effectively document design objectives and spatial requirements.
  • Coordinate and delegate project design work and code compliance.
  • Collaborate work with other disciplines, including architecture, engineering, strategy, experiential branding and consultants.
  • Conduct a review of drawings and support functions in conformance with project time, budget and quality constraints.
  • Delegation and oversight of and production of design visualization.
  • Collaborate with project leaders to develop project work plans for the interior design components of the project and monitor design staff adherence to schedule.
  • Lead client meetings and maintain strong client relationships.
  • Implement, follow, maintain, and enforce interior design standards used throughout interior design team in all project aspects/phases.
  • Lead the development of and/or oversee documentation for furniture, fixtures, and equipment (FFE) throughout all phases of the interior furniture design work, as required.
  • Lead the development of material palettes that communicate stories and support the client’s objectives
  • Specification oversight.
  • Mentor and guide less experienced interior design staff.
  • Actively participate and promote design excellence and firm strategies.
  • Collaborate with design leadership and participate in business development opportunities, and industry events
  • Consult with furniture manufacturers, dealers, product vendors and industry partners, building strong relationships in the design community.
  • Lead and/or participate in marketing activities, including proposal development and interviews.
  • Participate in construction administration activities, including site visits, review of submittals and shop drawings, and conducting punch lists. Site visits frequently require a physical walk-through of site.
  • Ensure sustainability metrics goals are met for projects.
  • Work within project budgets and schedules to meet profitability goals.
  • Maintain 80% billable time and 10% marketing time.
  • May perform other duties as required.
HERE'S WHAT YOU'LL NEED
  • Bachelor or Master's degree in Interior Design, Interior Architecture, or relevant field required.
  • A minimum of 10 years of related experience is required.
  • Current NCIDQ certification or applicable certification/licensure preferred.
  • Ability to provide interior design leadership focusing on furniture across multiple projects.
  • Strong experiential design, storytelling and technical skills as well as the knowledge of building and life safety codes required.
  • Exceptional presentation, organizational, team building, collaboration and communication skills are a must.
  • The ability to build and maintain client relationships is essential.
  • Experience leading a high performing team and mentoring staff is required.
  • Conceptualization and ability to set direction for furniture planning, furniture palettes, specifications and implementation.
  • Application of standards and quality process adherence.
  • Production oversight and discipline coordination.
  • Critical thinker and highly analytical.
  • Must be a fully qualified professional able to perform work with a high degree of self-motivation, autonomy and strategic influence.
  • Proficiency with Revit, Enscape, Bluebeam, Microsoft Office, and Adobe Creative Suite required.
  • Travel as required.
The salary range for this position is $98,328 to $122,933 annually. This salary range is the range we believe is the anticipated range of possible base compensation at the timing of the posting. We may ultimately pay more or less than the anticipated salary range for the position. Employees may be eligible for discretionary bonuses. We offer a full benefit package including medical, dental and vision coverage and flexible spending account options and voluntary insurances. We have paid time off, flex-time schedules, remote work options and a 401k plan and employee perk programs. For a general overview of our benefits, please visit our careers page at . Actual compensation may vary from posting based on geographic location, work experience, education and/or skill level.
ABOUT OUR FIRM
CannonDesign is a design practice where strategy, experience, architecture, engineering, and social impact converge. We don’t just dream up solutions — we create and bring them to life in ways to solve some of the biggest challenges facing our clients and the society. At the heart of everything we do is Living-Centered Design, a bold commitment to using our talents to not just improve the world but to truly reshape it for the better. It’s more than a philosophy — it’s who we are, and it drives us to make a meaningful, lasting difference every day.
ABOUT WORKING HERE
  • We are relentless in our pursuit of client adoration (not simply satisfaction). Consistent delivery of the best service is what we are about.
  • We are committed to ensuring our practice provides equal opportunities for all employees, as we strive to connect with communities around us and focus on the future of design. We support equity, diversity, and inclusion efforts that benefit all employees through the leadership of our DEI Council, our Employee Resource Groups which are open to everyone, and other community initiatives.
  • We’re about communication and transparency here. If you want to talk to someone about an idea you have, or a challenge that needs addressing, we’re ready for you.
Please note that candidates can only apply to our positions on our company Careers site. It's not uncommon for scammers to create positions that look legitimate on other sites; never enter your information or apply for CannonDesign positions on any platform. Should an issue arise that you feel we should be aware of, please contact us. Please provide your resume and portfolio when applying.

title: Head Counselor for Caddie Program
description:
DMSF seeks to hire two Head Counselors for its Caddie Program. The Caddie Program allows student scholars to gain job experience, earn money, improve communication skills, and potentially apply for the Chick Evans Scholarship- a full tuition and housing scholarship for high-achieving caddies with limited financial means.

The Head Counselor has overall responsibility for the Scholars who participate in the summer Caddie Program. The job entails living with the Scholars in the dorm, transporting them to work in the morning (in vehicles provided by DMSF), picking them up at the conclusion of their work day, and supervising them for the balance of the day. The Head Counselor will typically have free time between 9am - 2pm, as well as from Sunday evenings until Tuesday mornings, when most Scholars go home. DMSF anticipates hiring educators, teachers, or college/graduate students to serve as Assistant Counselors.

DMSF seeks to hire two Head Counselors for the Caddie Program, one for the boy’s program and one for the girl’s program.

Responsibilities include:

● Living in dorms with Scholars

● Ensuring the Caddies are routinely transported to and from work each day

● Supervising Scholars while at the dorms and coordinating weekly activities, such as guest speakers, social events, and workshops

● Transporting Scholars to and from weekly First Tee programming to learn the game of golf

● Providing Scholars transportation to trains on Sunday afternoon and from trains on Tuesday morning if their clubs are not accessible to the station

● Maintaining records of tips and loops per Caddie

● Maintaining all logistics related to food service and vehicle maintenance (e.g. ensuring vehicles have gas)

● Enforcing DMSF policies and procedures

● Reporting to DMSF on a regular basis about Scholars and the program

● Communicating with parents as it relates to Scholar transportation logistics, behavior, illness, or free time activities, etc.

● Undergraduate degree required

● Experience working with and supervising young adults

● Excellent supervisory and communication skills

● Valid driver’s license and an infraction-free driving record for the past two years

● General understanding of the game of golf and caddying is helpful but not required

DMSF is an organization that prioritizes workplace culture, collaboration, timely and thorough communication and effective project management.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

title: Launch Engineer
description:
About Lucid

At Lucid, we are creating exceptional mobility experiences through innovation to drive the world forward. Built on Lucid’s proprietary technology and software-defined vehicle architecture, our award-winning vehicles bring our “Compromise Nothing™” approach to the global automotive market. That means refusing to choose between performance and sustainability, design and engineering, ambition and integrity. In Lucid Air and Lucid Gravity, we have designed and built vehicles that have redefined their segments, combining exceptional range, performance, design, and expansive space in a single experience.

We achieve this through deep vertical integration, with design, engineering, and production happening in-house across our global offices and manufacturing facilities. Our teams come from industries around the world, united by a shared commitment to excellence. By refusing to settle, you can help redefine what’s possible and shape the future of mobility.

Position Overview

The Launch Engineer is responsible for planning, coordinating, and executing all launch activities associated with new vehicle programs, engineering changes, and manufacturing readiness. This role serves as a key interface between Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, Supply Chain, Logistics, Program Management, and Product Development teams to ensure successful vehicle launches from concept through Start of Production (SOP). The Launch Engineer leads readiness assessments, build event coordination, issue management, validation activities, and operational readiness execution to ensure safety, quality, cost, timing, and volume objectives are achieved.

Key Responsibilities

1. Launch Planning & Readiness

  • Support the development and execution of launch plans for new vehicle programs and major product changes.
  • Update launch deliverables, milestones, and readiness criteria.
  • Coordinate cross-functional activities to ensure launch requirements are achieved.
  • Monitor launch timing and escalate risks that may impact program objectives.
  • Support Open-to-Go assessments and build readiness reviews.

2. Build Event Coordination

  • Lead preparation and execution of prototype, pilot, validation, and production builds.
  • Coordinate vehicle scheduling and build plans with all participating functions.
  • Ensure materials, tooling, equipment, manpower, and documentation are available and ready.
  • Facilitate daily build reviews and issue resolution meetings.
  • Track build performance metrics and lessons learned.

3. Issue Management & Problem Resolution

  • Collect, document, prioritize, and monitor launch-related issues.
  • Drive closure plans with responsible teams.
  • Utilize structured problem-solving methodologies to resolve launch issues.
  • Escalate critical issues to leadership when required.
  • Track issue trends and support management reporting.

4. Manufacturing Readiness

  • Assess manufacturing process readiness against launch requirements.
  • Support validation of equipment, tooling, automation, software, and production systems.
  • Verify operational readiness of manufacturing shops.
  • Ensure readiness metrics are achieved prior to production milestones.

5. Product & Process Validation

  • Support new product introduction (NPI) activities.
  • Coordinate vehicle and process validation builds.
  • Ensure engineering changes are properly implemented and validated.
  • Track launch quality metrics and process capability indicators.
  • Support root cause analysis and corrective action implementation.

6. Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Facilitate communication between Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, Supply Chain, Program Management, Logistics, and Supplier teams.
  • Drive alignment on launch priorities and deliverables.
  • Lead launch meetings and action-item tracking.
  • Provide launch status updates to management and executive leadership.

7. Reporting & Governance

  • Develop launch readiness dashboards and reports.
  • Maintain launch scorecards and milestone trackers.
  • Support Launch Governance Reviews and executive launch reporting.
  • Present launch status, risks, countermeasures, and recovery plans.

8. Continuous Improvement

  • Capture lessons learned from launch activities.
  • Support development of launch standards and best practices.
  • Identify opportunities to improve launch efficiency and risk management processes.
  • Contribute to future program readiness and organizational learning.

Skills

  • Deep understanding of vehicle assembly.
  • Understanding of APQP principles
  • Aware of Project management fundamentals
  • Experience with Data analysis and reporting tools
  • Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Power BI, PowerPoint)
  • Experience launching manufacturing and production lines.
  • Hands-on experience with process validation, commissioning, and manufacturing quality systems.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Electrical, or Mechatronics Engineering (Master’s preferred).
  • 3+ years of experience in automotive manufacturing.

Hourly/non-exempt employees accrue up to 120 hours paid time off, and salaried/exempt employee accrue up to 160 hours paid time off. title: Senior Software Engineer, Enterprise Commerce – Data (SFCC)

  • Strong JavaScript skills and experience with requireJs, TypeScript and Node.js.

  • Ability to own complex technical problems, identify root causes, and implement reliable engineering solutions.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with React and headless commerce
  • Experience with Adobe Commerce and PHP.
  • Experience with Adobe Commerce Cloud Service (ACCS) and Adobe App Builder.
  • Experience with other enterprise commerce platforms, including headless or composable commerce.

$163,000—$214,000 USD

FLEXIBLE WORKPLACE STRATEGY:

Algolia’s flexible workplace model is designed to empower all Algolians to fulfill our mission to power search and discovery with ease. title: Senior Engineer / Scientist
location: Kirtland Air Force Base, NM, us
description:
BryceTech is seeking a Senior Engineer/Scientist to provide scientific, engineering, and technical advisory support to the Air Force Research Laboratory (AFRL) Space Warfare Directorate (AFRL/RJ) and Information and Spectrum Warfare Directorate (AFRL/RF) under the JUPITER program at Kirtland AFB, New Mexico.

The Senior Engineer/Scientist will provide technical expertise and advisory support for research and development, technology planning, technical assessments, strategic planning, and technology investment activities. The position will support AFRL efforts to develop, evaluate, demonstrate, and transition advanced technologies and systems that address evolving warfighter requirements.

The JUPITER mission encompasses space warfare and information and spectrum warfare technologies, including space communications, positioning, navigation and timing, space warfare cyber, modeling and simulation, space warfare evaluation and analysis, defensive space warfare control, space warfare situational awareness, intelligence, surveillance and reconnaissance, high-powered electromagnetics, laser systems, electro-optics, and related technologies.

Responsibilities

  • Provide senior-level scientific, engineering, and technical advisory support to AFRL/RJ and AFRL/RF
  • Support technical and strategic planning activities related to space warfare and information and spectrum warfare technology investments
  • Evaluate technologies, systems, concepts, and research and development activities for technical merit, feasibility, capability, maturity, and potential warfighter impact
  • Conduct and support technical studies, analyses, evaluations, assessments, and trade studies
  • Provide technical input to near-term and long-term technology investment and acquisition strategies
  • Support the development, assessment, and refinement of technology and enterprise investment approaches

title: Clinical Retention Specialist (North-MA, NY, PA, NJ, ME, CT, RI, NH, VT )
description:
Job Summary

Clinical Retention Specialist
Overview
The Clinical Retention Specialist is a clinically driven retention role focused on strengthening long term adoption of Omnipod® products and improving health and quality of life outcomes for people living with diabetes. This position blends deep clinical expertise, consultative selling, and relationship management to retain customers through high impact education, proactive issue resolution, and personalized clinical support.
The ideal candidate is a dynamic, results oriented clinical educator who thrives in a fast paced, high volume phone/virtual environment and partners closely with internal teams and healthcare providers. Through value driven clinical conversations, this role reinforces confidence in Omnipod therapy and proactively addresses barriers to long term use. Operates as an individual contributor without formal people management responsibility. Requires independent judgment in managing day to day customer interactions, prioritizing outreach, and delivering clinical education within defined parameters.
________________________________________
Key Responsibilities
Clinical Expertise & Education
• Applies foundational, evidence‑based diabetes management knowledge to support patient interactions and contribute to successful use of Omnipod therapy, following established guidelines and with appropriate guidance.
• Deliver personalized education and training to new and existing patients, and healthcare providers within the assigned region—via phone and virtual platforms.
• Provide proactive follow up, clinical consultation, recommendations, and troubleshooting to ensure sustained device adoption.
• Educate customers and HCPs on Omnipod data and reporting tools to promote informed clinical conversations and therapy optimization.
• Determines appropriate actions for routine and moderately complex scenarios and escalates issues that fall outside established guidelines
• Directly impacts customer satisfaction, therapy continuity, and retention outcomes within an assigned geographic territory.
• Maintain current clinical licensure, CDCES certification, and Omnipod product credentials to ensure compliant, accurate guidance.
Customer & Healthcare Provider Engagement / Retention (Sales Based)
• Serves as a clinical retention contact for an assigned geographic territory, supporting customer retention efforts and contributing to sustained adoption of Omnipod therapy through consistent engagement and use of established processes and guidance

• Supports delivery of business results across the assigned region by executing plans, engaging stakeholders, and monitoring performance using established processes and guidance.

• Conduct proactive outreach to assess satisfaction, reinforce product value, and resolve concerns, aligning outreach timing with regional time zones and access considerations.

• Utilize clinical retention selling techniques to influence continued Omnipod use through education, confidence building, and outcome focused discussions.

• Identify early indicators of disengagement or churn through data assessment and analytics in partnership with the data science teams and collaborate with Customer Success teams to deploy targeted, regionally informed save strategies.

• Identifies and assesses common barriers to therapy continuation (clinical, behavioral, logistical, and access‑related), including geographic differences, and applies standard approaches to support practical, patient‑centered solutions with moderate guidance.

• Develop a working knowledge of the regional healthcare landscape, including key health systems, diabetes centers, referral patterns, and payer considerations that may impact therapy continuation.

• Partner with healthcare providers within the assigned geography to align education with treatment plans and reinforce long term therapy adoption

• Share compelling patient success stories and regional clinical insights during retention conversations to reinforce the value of Omnipod solutions.
________________________________________
Cross Functional Collaboration
• Collaborate closely with Clinical Services Managers, regional field teams, and sales leadership to coordinate territory based retention efforts and ensure a seamless, unified customer experience.

• Partner with Customer Success, Customer Care Retention, Commercial, Marketing, Data Insights, and Voice of the Customer teams to enhance regional engagement strategies and workflows.

• Identify and communicate regional trends, risks, and opportunities related to customer engagement, access, and outcomes to inform cross functional strategy.

• Contribute to the development of educational tools, customer journeys, and targeted retention campaigns informed by geographic and population specific insights.

• Support clinicians and customers with clinical software and digital diabetes management tools, providing guidance on workflow efficiency and best practices appropriate to local practice environments.________________________________________
Data Analysis & Documentation
• Accurately document all customer interactions, outcomes, and next steps in Salesforce activities and campaigns.
• Reviews engagement data, usage patterns, and retention metrics at individual and regional levels to identify trends and potential risks, and supports identification of improvement opportunities using standard tools and guidance.

• Participate in data driven initiatives designed to improve regional retention performance and overall program effectiveness.

• Shares insights that contribute to incremental improvements in retention programs and customer workflows, leveraging standard tools and established processes.________________________________________
Education & Experience
• Bachelor’s degree required.
• Active, professional clinical credentials required, such as:
o Registered Nurse (RN)
o Registered Dietitian (RD)
• 3+ years of experience training and/or supporting insulin pump patients.
• Direct experience working with healthcare providers in a diabetes care setting.
• Current Certified Diabetes Care and Education Specialist (CDCES) credential required.
• Ability to maintain all required professional licensure and Omnipod product certifications.
• Demonstrated ability to communicate effectively and persuasively with diverse audiences via phone and virtual platforms.
________________________________________
Skills & Competencies
• Strong clinical acumen with expertise in diabetes technology and data interpretation.
• Excellent phone presence with exceptional interpersonal, customer service, and communication skills.
• Consultative, influence based approach to customer engagement and retention.
• Proven ability to build trust and long term relationships in a remote, phone based environment.
• Strong problem solving, workflow optimization, and objection handling skills.
• Self directed, process oriented, and adaptable in a fast paced retention focused setting.
• Proficiency in Microsoft Office and Salesforce.
• Prior industry, commercial, or sales adjacent clinical experience strongly preferred.
________________________________________
Physical & Work Requirements
• Remote position – must live in assigned geographic region
• Home workspace must meet company security and productivity standards.
• Ability to sit and speak on the phone for extended periods during scheduled shifts.
• Manual dexterity required for computer and headset use.
• Availability for occasional evenings, weekends, holidays, and limited travel as needed

description:

Gartner is looking for well-rounded and motivated developers to join the Marketing Integration/Intelligence team. The team follows a 2-week Agile sprint model and works on advanced techniques for high-performance web development, data analytics, and system integration.

  • Create designs and style guides for business requirements.

  • Experience working with Git or a similar repository management tool.

  • Strong understanding of OOPS, Design principles, and Distributed systems.

  • Strong understanding of security best practices.

  • Experience working with front-end development using HTML and CSS (Bootstrap or Material UI)

  • Experience working with JavaScript (Typescript, React, Angular, Vue, jQuery, etc.)

  • Experience working with cloud platforms like AWS/Azure

  • Experience working with Docker, Jenkins, Splunk, and Datadog

  • Experience working with Oracle Eloqua, Marketo, or Salesforce Marketing Cloud

  • Experience with Apex coding

Who you are:

  • Bachelor’s degree or foreign equivalent degree in Computer Science or a related field required.

  • Excellent communication and prioritization skills.

  • Able to work independently or within a team proactively in a fast-paced AGILE-SCRUM environment.

  • Owns success – Takes responsibility for the successful delivery of the solutions.

  • Strong desire to improve upon their skills in software development, frameworks, and technologies.

title: Senior Premier Banker - Point Loma
description:
Why Wells Fargo:

Are you looking for more? Find it here. At Wells Fargo, we're more than a financial services leader – we’re a global trailblazer committed to driving innovation, empowering communities, and helping our customers succeed. We believe that a meaningful career is much more than just a job – it’s about finding all of the elements to help you thrive, in one place. Living the Well Life means you’re supported in life, not just work. It means having robust benefits, competitive compensation, and programs designed to help you find work-life balance and well-being. You’ll be rewarded for investing in your community, celebrated for being your authentic self, and empowered to grow. And we’re recognized for it – Wells Fargo once again ranked in the top five on the 2026 LinkedIn Top Companies list of best workplaces “to grow your career” in the U.S. Join us!

About this role:

Wells Fargo is seeking a Senior Branch Premier Banker (SAFE) to play a pivotal role within our National Branch Network. This role grows, deepens, and manages relationships with affluent customers and those with more complex financial needs, serving as their primary point of contact for banking products and services through scheduled appointments, lobby engagement, and proactive outreach. This role is designed for growth oriented professionals who lead with advice to acquire and deepen relationships through meaningful discovery and translate customer goals into comprehensive financial strategies. You will own and actively grow a defined book of business, leveraging goals based planning, and prudent risk oversight to deliver integrated solutions across deposits, investments, credit, home lending, and business banking. In addition, you’ll help customers with everyday banking needs-opening accounts, handling service requests, and ensuring a seamless experience making it easier for them to manage their banking with confidence. Success in this role is driven by strong relationship acumen, proactive customer engagement, and seamless collaboration with internal partners across Wealth, Home Lending, and Business Banking to deliver a differentiated customer experience.

Wells Fargo rewards behaviors that consistently create long term customer value and support customers in making informed financial decisions. You’ll be supported with digital tools, industry leading training, ongoing coaching, and backed by one of the most recognized brands in banking. This role offers a clear platform for career growth for experienced professionals who excel at building trust, managing a portfolio, and delivering holistic, multi product solutions.

In this role you will:

  • Proactively acquire new affluent consumer and business customers while deepening existing relationships through strategic outreach, referrals, and pre-planned customer appointments
  • Lead discovery‑driven conversations to understand customer goals and deliver tailored banking and credit strategies that strengthen relationships, increase retention, and drive balanced growth across deposits, lending, and investments
  • Serve as the primary financial partner delivering comprehensive, multi‑product guidance and ongoing reviews across life stages and evolving financial needs
  • Partner with a team of professionals across Wealth, Home Lending, and Business Banking to deliver integrated solutions by coordinating warm introductions, setting clear expectations, and taking personal ownership to convert qualified opportunities into closed outcomes
  • Champion digital adoption by educating customers on self-service and mobile banking options to elevate satisfaction, engagement, and service efficiency
  • Serve as an active member of the branch team by advising colleagues on relationship development and the management of complex client needs
  • Demonstrate risk excellence through accurate documentation, sound judgment, timely issue escalation, and adherence to policies and regulations to support strong control outcomes
  • The Senior Branch Premier Banker LP (license pending) role is a temporary position until employee has successfully completed licensing requirements and SAFE registration. Upon successful completion, employees will transition to the Senior Branch Premier Banker (SAFE) role. Employees hired into the Senior Branch Premier Banker LP role who are not fully licensed will participate in the Branch Network Licensed Banker program.

Required Qualifications:

  • 4+ years of customer service experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education
  • 3+ years of experience building and maintaining effective relationships with customers and partners
  • 3+ years of experience recommending products and services

Desired Qualifications:

  • Experience recommending financial products and translating customer goals into clear, actionable recommendations
  • Demonstrated ability to proactively source, acquire, and deepen relationships through proactive outreach and building strong internal partnership to support the customer experience
  • Proven experience managing a book-of-business, documentation of planning conversations, and consistent follow-through to drive retention and growth across deposits, lending, and investments
  • Experience coaching or supporting peers to strengthen team performance and customer impact
  • Demonstrated ability to communicate clearly and confidently, listen with empathy, and build credibility and trust quickly with others
  • Financial services industry experience in one or a combination of the following: consumer, home lending, business banking, or investments
  • 3+ years of experience in a licensed financial services position
  • Successfully completed Financial Industry Regulatory Authority (FINRA)Series 6 and 63 exams (or FINRA recognized equivalents) sufficient to qualify for immediate FINRA registration
  • State Insurance license(s)

Job Expectations:

  • Ability to work a schedule that will include most Saturdays
  • This role requires FINRA Series 6 and Series 63 (or FINRA recognized equivalents), and State Insurance license(s) which must be active or completed within a designated timeframe. For any FINRA qualification exams earned after Sept. 30, 2018, the Securities Industry Essentials (SIE) exam is also required.
  • For the following states where hired, FINRA Series 65 (or equivalent) examination will also be required within a specified period of time: AK, AL, CT, DE, HI, IA, ID, IN, KS, MD, MI, MN, MS, NC, ND, NE, NM, SC, SD, TN, TX, UT, VA, WA, WI, and WY. Wyoming allows referral-only licensed bankers to receive the IAR registration without the Series 65/66. Requirements may change based on current state regulations.
  • Obtaining and maintaining required FINRA licenses is necessary for continued employment. This role also requires meeting enhanced financial fitness and criminal background standards. Wells Fargo will begin the FINRA review process once an offer is accepted.
  • SAFE registration is required at the time of employment and Wells Fargo will initiate the process after your start date.Loan Originators must meet LO/CFPB requirements and comply with Wells Fargo policies, including standards related to financial responsibility, character, fitness, and criminal background. A credit report may be reviewed (credit score not included) and additional ongoing screening may apply.
  • This position is not eligible for Visa sponsorship

Pay Range

Reflected is the base pay range offered for this position. Pay may vary depending on factors including but not limited to demonstrated examples of prior performance, skills, experience, or work location. Employees may also be eligible for incentive opportunities.

title: Associate Manufacturing Technician (Weeknight Shift - Onsite)
description:
Job Summary

Step into a high-growth, innovation-driven manufacturing environment where your technical skills and mechanical aptitude can truly shine. As an Associate Manufacturing Technician, you’ll play a hands-on role operating and maintaining cutting-edge automated equipment used to produce industry-leading products.



Position Overview:
The Associate Manufacturing Technician will be a critical contributor in a mission that truly represents a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to join a company that is making significant investments in establishing US manufacturing, expanding internationally, and delivering a consistent cadence of product innovations to the market and investing in its people.

The successful candidate will be responsible for operating and maintaining highly automated and advanced manufacturing equipment necessary to produce our signature product. This individual will be trained and cross-trained to both operate and repair issues across a variety of technologies including: heat staking, laser welding, mechanical swaging, printed circuit board (PCB) handling and testing, robotic automation, metal stamping and bending, form/fill/seal medical packaging, and high-speed discrete component assembly. In addition to equipment operation and maintenance, this individual will be responsible for the product quality performance of the equipment and basic machine troubleshooting in the event of faults and machine stops. This position requires mechanical aptitude, technical ability, machine troubleshooting and problem-solving skills, and the willingness to work in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.

Responsibilities:
• Perform equipment operation, basic repair, and minor daily/weekly preventative maintenance tasks to meet all standards for safety, quality and efficiency. These tasks must be completed under minimal supervision.
• Maintain machine raw material feeds, perform any fault clearing and clear stoppages on automated equipment.
• Utilize human machine interfaces (HMIs) to identify and correct shifts in process control.
• Ensures adequate raw material is prepared correctly and jobs are run in a timely manner to ensure on-time delivery.
• Executes equipment inspections and generates emergency, corrective, and/or preventative work orders as needed.
• Troubleshoot and identify potential solutions for minor mechanical errors, safety issues or general operating inefficiencies within the production processes.
• Able to utilize computer systems to support in the material inventory and quality management processes.
• Participates in manufacturing processes to support new product design transfer, process development, equipment validations, and process validations.
• Investigates and resolves process issues within their equipment cells.
• Perform routine cleaning/inspection/lubrication of machinery.
• Works from specifications, work orders, and general instructions from Production Supervisor/Team Lead.
• Safely follow standard operating procedures including but not limited to material handling, record keeping, packaging, and shipment preparation. Must follow all Good Manufacturing Practices (GMPs).
• Notifies Team Leader or Production Supervisor of any discrepancies to ensure quality standards and safety of operations are always maintained .
• Excellent attention to detail, good organization, and capable of working independently with minimal instruction from production supervisor.
• Able to work in small groups and cross functional teams to troubleshoot issues, identify and implement collective corrective actions.
• Maintain a clean work environment suitable for medical device manufacturing and cleanroom production.
• Performs other duties as required

Education and Experience:
Preferred Minimum Requirements:
• High School Diploma or GED

Preferred Skills and Competencies:
• Self-starter capable of dealing with a variety of tasks in a fast paced, multi-tasking environment.
• Must be proficient in English language to be able to read documentation, communicate, and write.
• Ideal candidate will have keen eye for quality, is dependable, and will work collaboratively within a team, and possess a positive attitude.
• Previous experience working in a clean room environment.
• Previous experience with debugging and optimizing assembly processes.
• Experience in a start-up production environment is a plus.
• Manufacturing experience in a regulated industry is a plus.
• Mechanical Aptitude – Knowledge of and experience with industrial machines and tools, including design, uses, repair, and maintenance.
• Production & Processing – Knowledge of raw materials, measurement instruments, production processes, quality control, and other techniques for the manufacture and distribution of goods.
• Mathematics – Knowledge of basic arithmetic.
• Problem Solving – Recognizes problems and understands root cause analysis techniques/concepts.

Physical Requirements (if applicable):
• Required to stand for at least 75% of working time per shift, with walking at least 50% of working time per shift.
• Required to reach above shoulder frequently and below waist occasionally.
• Required to push and pull.
• Ability to lift up to 20lbs occasionally, 5-20lbs frequently.

NOTE: This position requires on-site working (requires on-site office/plant/lab work). #LI-Onsite

Additional Information:



Compensation & Benefits:

For U.S.-based positions only, the annual base salary range for this role is $18.16 - $27.24

This position may also be eligible for incentive compensation.

We offer a comprehensive benefits package, including:
• Medical, dental, and vision insurance
• 401(k) with company match
• Paid time off (PTO)
• And additional employee wellness programs

Application Details:
This job posting will remain open until the position is filled.
To apply, please visit the Insulet Careers site and submit your application online.

Actual pay depends on skills, experience, and education.

Insulet Corporation (NASDAQ: PODD), headquartered in Massachusetts, is an innovative medical device company dedicated to simplifying life for people with diabetes and other conditions through its Omnipod product platform. The Omnipod Insulin Management System provides a unique alternative to traditional insulin delivery methods. With its simple, wearable design, the tubeless disposable Pod provides up to three days of non-stop insulin delivery, without the need to see or handle a needle. Insulet’s flagship innovation, the Omnipod 5 Automated Insulin Delivery System, integrates with a continuous glucose monitor to manage blood sugar with no multiple daily injections, zero fingersticks, and can be controlled by a compatible personal smartphone in the U.S. or by the Omnipod 5 Controller. Insulet also leverages the unique design of its Pod by tailoring its Omnipod technology platform for the delivery of non-insulin subcutaneous drugs across other therapeutic areas. For more information, please visit insulet.com and omnipod.com.

We are looking for highly motivated, performance-driven individuals to be a part of our expanding team. We do this by hiring amazing people guided by shared values who exceed customer expectations. Our continued success depends on it!

At Insulet Corporation all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

title: Sr. Partnership Development Specialist
description:
*** Looking for a candidate who is local to the Bay area - local travel required ***

Job Description

Are you energized by meeting new people, building excellent, trusted relationships, and creating partnerships that make a meaningful difference in the community?

Do you enjoy being out in the field, visiting prospective partners, learning what matters to them, and finding the right approach that makes them want to work with you?

Do you enjoy making sure every partnership is the right fit, putting on your detective hat to understand the employer’s needs, evaluate potential partners, and confirm all requirements are met?

The Partnership Development Specialist is an engaging, field-based business development professional responsible for building excellent, trusted relationships with hospitals, healthcare organizations, clinical education departments, and other clinical providers. These partnerships create the clinical learning opportunities nursing students need to complete their education and enter the healthcare workforce.

This is a consultative outside sales role for someone who is personable, persuasive, persistent, and comfortable developing relationships face to face. You will represent Unitek in the community, establish long-term relationships with clinical education leaders and healthcare decision-makers, and clearly communicate how partnering with Unitek benefits their organization, their patients, and the future healthcare workforce.

Why Join Unitek

At Unitek Learning, your work will help shape the future of healthcare. By creating partnerships that open doors for students and strengthen the healthcare workforce, you will help change lives, improve access to care, and make communities healthier and stronger.

Job Responsibilities:

Business Development, Partnership Relationship Management, Client Engagement

  • Build excellent, trusted relationships with clinical education departments, healthcare leaders, and key decision-makers through regular face-to-face visits, thoughtful communication, and consistent follow-up. Maintain strong partnerships and ensure current partners feel valued, supported, and confident working with Unitek.
  • Identify and pursue new clinical partnership opportunities within an assigned territory, expand existing partnerships to create additional clinical learning opportunities, and independently prioritize opportunities to consistently meet goals.
  • your approach accordingly. Create a positive and memorable partner experience that differentiates Unitek from other schools competing for clinical placements. Maintain consistent, thoughtful follow-up that keeps Unitek memorable and moves opportunities forward.
  • Secure signed affiliation agreements and clinical placement opportunities needed to support students and program growth.
  • Present partnership proposals, address questions and concerns, and negotiate agreements with clinical and operational leaders. Clearly communicate how partnering with Unitek supports students, healthcare organizations, patients, and the future healthcare workforce.
  • Conduct regular in-person visits with hospitals, clinics, skilled nursing facilities, and other healthcare organizations. Collaborate with nursing leadership to evaluate prospective sites, coordinate visits, confirm they support student learning needs, and secure signed affiliation agreements and clinical placement opportunities.
  • Support employer engagement and business development by representing Unitek at advisory boards, hosted and community events, conferences, networking opportunities, and marketing initiatives that strengthen Unitek’s industry presence.
  • Support clinical partnership documentation, onboarding, and ongoing education program compliance activities to ensure sites meet and maintain academic, regulatory, and accreditation requirements.
  • Track outreach, meetings, opportunities, agreements, and follow-up activity in the company CRM.
  • Travel and Field Expectations: This is a field-based role that regularly travels throughout the assigned territory. At least 70% of working time will be spent meeting prospective and existing partners in person.

You May Be a Great Fit If You:

  • Prefer meeting people face to face, enjoy driving and travel, and like building a visible presence in the community.
  • Easily start conversations, build rapport, and make a strong, positive, and memorable impression.
  • Naturally and creatively build genuine, authentic, trusted relationships with different personalities and professional audiences.
  • Listen closely, understand what motivates each prospective partner, and communicate a clear, compelling value proposition tailored to their needs.
  • Are comfortable with prospecting, cold outreach, consistent follow-up, negotiation, and closing, while remaining persistent without being overly aggressive.
  • Are motivated by goals, enjoy turning conversations into results, and want your work to help students succeed and strengthen the healthcare workforce.

What Success Looks Like:

  • Clinical and healthcare education partners know you, trust you, and value their relationship with Unitek.
  • Prospective partners remember you, respond to your outreach, and view you as genuine, responsive, and professional.
  • You understand what motivates each partner, adapt your approach, and clearly communicate the value of working with Unitek.
  • You remain persistent and creative throughout the sales cycle and move opportunities from the first conversation to a signed agreement.
  • You work effectively with academic leadership and personnel, connect the right leaders, and develop partnerships and agreements that support program and compliance needs.
  • You consistently meet goals for new agreements, expanded clinical placements, and long-term partner relationships.

Salary Range: $70k-$80k

Minimum Requirements:

  • 5 or more years of experience in sales, outside sales, business development, recruiting, account management, client relations, workforce development, employer relations, healthcare partnerships, or a comparable relationship-based role is preferred.
  • Candidates with strong experience in outside sales, recruiting, employer relations, staffing, account management, medical sales, or other relationship-based business development roles are encouraged to apply. Healthcare or education experience is helpful but not required.
  • Demonstrated ability to build excellent, trusted relationships and maintain long-term professional partnerships, with strong consultative sales, presentation, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.
  • Excellent verbal, written, organizational, and interpersonal skills
  • Willing and able to travel frequently throughout the assigned geographic area. Dependable transportation and a safe driving record are required.
  • Comfortable using Microsoft Office, spreadsheets, databases, and CRM systems.

Must Have:

  • An engaging, confident, and persuasive communication style, with the ability to comfortably initiate conversations with new contacts.
  • Ability to communicate a concise, compelling value proposition and adapt the message to different audiences.
  • Persistence and creativity in following up, re-engaging contacts, and moving prospective partnerships forward.
  • Comfortable meeting and communicating with executives, clinical education leaders, directors, and other healthcare decision-makers.
  • Able to collaborate effectively with academic leaders, clinical coordinators, administrative staff, and other internal and external partners.
  • Able to work independently, manage an assigned territory, prioritize opportunities, and consistently meet goals.
  • A genuine interest in face-to-face relationship building, frequent local travel, and representing Unitek in the community.

We Offer:

  • Medical, Dental and Vision starting the 1st of the month following 30 days of employment
  • 2 Weeks’ starting Vacation per year. Increasing based on years of service with company
  • 12 paid Holidays and 2 Floating Holiday
  • Company Paid Life Insurance at 1x’s your annual salary
  • Leadership development and training for career advancement
  • Tuition assistance and Forgiveness for you and your family up to 100% depending on the program

title: Customer Experience Strategy Lead (all genders)
description:
The role

Within Global Customer Experience (GCX), our mission is to provide a world-class customer experience across the HelloFresh Group by advancing our service from reactive to proactive. We aim to stay ahead of customer needs, ensuring that every interaction—whether part of the "happy path" or a necessary recovery step—is seamless, data-driven, and strengthens the customer relationship.

As part of the Compensation team, we own the global frameworks and policies that define how we categorize errors and compensate customers. The Customer Experience Lead is a subject matter expert focused on the strategic evolution of these frameworks. You will drive experimentation and segmentation to ensure our compensation logic is both customer-centric and cost-effective. By maintaining our global error categories and fraud policies, you will directly support our goal of reducing friction and protecting the business’s bottom line.

Above all, we are looking for people who will make HelloFresh better. We believe there are many different ways of developing skills and we love diverse experiences! So even if you don’t “tick all the boxes” but think you’d thrive in this role, we would really like to learn more about you.

What you’ll do

  • Strategic Vision & Cross-Functional Leadership: Architect the new vision for global error categorization and compensation; proactively lead the alignment across Ops, Tech, and Local Markets to ensure our recovery logic reflects a deep understanding of upstream operational realities and downstream customer impact.
  • Steer Global Experimentation: Drive the end-to-end strategic roadmap for compensation A/B testing; define high-level hypotheses to identify the most effective recovery levers and lead the global rollout of results that shift the needle on NPS and TCVA.
  • Strategic Financial Stewardship: Leverage sophisticated data-driven insights to oversee global compensation spend; proactively identify trends and business interrelationships to optimize the balance between aggressive cost-effectiveness and world-class customer centricity.
  • Policy Governance & Systems Thinking: Own and evolve the global Fraud and Compensation policy framework; act as a strategic partner to regional teams to resolve complex, sensitive policy gaps while ensuring global consistency and long-term scalability.
  • Act as a mentor and peer-coach within the GCX team, elevating the group's collective subject matter expertise.

What you’ll bring

  • Obsessive Customer Centricity & Strategic Empathy: A profound understanding of the "unhappy path" and the ability to translate customer empathy into GCX frameworks. You don't just solve for the immediate fix; you architect solutions that win back trust while advancing our 2026 goal of moving from reactive to proactive service.
  • Advanced Analytical Reasoning & Business Stewardship: You possess the business acumen and proficiency in SQL/Excel to lead the rethink of our entire error categorization approach. You won't just create business cases; you will define the vision for how we measure "cost-effective yet customer-centric" success. You’ll act as a lead partner to Analytics teams to steer test designs and transform complex data into high-impact rollout strategies.
  • Credible Stakeholder Leadership & Influence: Implementation at this level requires more than just securing buy-in; it requires navigating the interrelationships between Tech, Ops, and local markets. You are a "credible voice" who uses active listening and structured communication to align conflicting departmental priorities toward a common global objective.
  • Strategic Project Management & Global Execution: You are expected to steer your recommendations from a high-level vision to global execution. This requires a "relentless prioritization" mindset, leveraging a pragmatic delivery focus to implement organizational change without compromising on the excellence of our global standards

What we offer

  • Health - You are covered by private health insurance through Enel Med
  • Hybrid Working Schedule - We work in-office 3 days a week to align on goals, with flexible hours to support work-life balance and personal needs
  • Holidays - You receive 26 days of paid vacation each year, providing you time to rest and recharge
  • Learning and Development - An annual Learning & Development budget and a Mentoring Program to support your ongoing professional growth
  • Employee Referral Program - Our team members can participate in our internal employee referral program and receive a bonus for recommending successful candidates to open roles
  • Daily Comforts - Free coffee, drinks, and fresh fruit are available to keep you refreshed throughout the day
  • Physical Wellbeing - Subsidized Multisport membership that gives you access to thousands of sports and wellness facilities, including gyms, swimming pools, and fitness classes across the country, with various card options to suit different needs.
  • Employees are eligible for a reimbursement of up to PLN 250 toward the purchase of corrective glasses or contact lenses once every two years. This benefit is contingent upon a recommendation for corrective eyewear being explicitly stated on the medical certificate issued during your occupational health examination.
  • Retirement - Subsidized PPK Scheme
  • Employees will be paid a lump sum to cover the anticipated costs of electricity and necessary access to telecommunications lines. The Lump Sum shall be paid in the amount of PLN 50 monthly.

HelloFresh is on a mission to change the way people eat, forever!

Since our 2011 founding in Europe’s vibrant tech hub, Berlin, we’ve become the world's leading meal kit provider, delivering to over 4.2 million households worldwide in 15 countries across 3 continents.

title: Senior Specialist, Compound Management
description:
The Senior Specialist, Compound Management is responsible for the receipt, registration, storage, tracking, preparation, and distribution of chemical and biological samples that support Deciphera's drug discovery programs. This hands-on laboratory role serves as a critical partner to research teams by ensuring sample integrity, inventory accuracy, timely request fulfillment, and complete documentation. The successful candidate will collaborate across Chemistry, Biology, IT, Facilities/EHS, CROs, and external partners to support efficient research operations and advance discovery programs.

What You'll Do

  • Manage the receipt, registration, storage, tracking, and inventory of compounds, intermediates, CRO materials, and DMSO stock solutions to ensure sample integrity and traceability.
  • Prepare, weigh, aliquot, solubilize, and dispense compounds while fulfilling requests for internal research teams and external collaborators with accuracy and efficiency.
  • Coordinate compound shipments and sample distribution activities, including labeling, documentation, and communication with CROs and research partners.
  • Maintain and support compound management databases, inventory systems, and informatics workflows while ensuring accurate recordkeeping and data integrity.
  • Identify opportunities to improve processes, enhance system capabilities, and develop SOPs, work instructions, and workflow documentation.
  • Partner with research, IT, Facilities/EHS, and external stakeholders to support safe, compliant, and efficient laboratory operations.

What We're Looking For

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Chemistry, Analytical Chemistry, Biochemistry, Biology, or another related scientific discipline.
  • 3+ years of experience in compound management, sample management, laboratory operations, CRO environments, or research within the biotechnology, pharmaceutical, or life sciences industry.
  • Exceptional organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to effectively manage samples, inventories, documentation, and competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Hands-on experience with sample weighing, solution preparation, aliquoting, inventory management, tracking, and laboratory documentation.
  • Experience working with scientific databases, LIMS, inventory management platforms, or compound registration systems.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across scientific, technical, operational, and external partner groups.
  • Commitment to laboratory safety, data integrity, accurate documentation, and continuous improvement.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Degree concentration in Chemistry, Analytical Chemistry, or a closely related chemical science.
  • Experience in compound management within a biotechnology, pharmaceutical, or CRO environment.
  • Experience improving compound management workflows, laboratory systems, data migration efforts, or process documentation.
  • Working knowledge of chemical safety, hazardous materials handling, OSHA requirements, and laboratory compliance practices.
  • Ability to identify operational challenges, propose practical solutions, and support the successful adoption of new processes and systems.

Deciphera is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. The base salary pay range for this role is $93,000 - $128,000. Actual compensation packages will depend on various factors, including but not limited to depth of experience, education, skillset, overall performance, and location.

Deciphera believes in providing a competitive compensation and benefits package to all employees. Our base salary is just one component of Deciphera's competitive total rewards strategy that also includes annual performance bonus, a long-term incentive plan, a full range of benefits, and other incentive compensation plans (if applicable).

Benefits

  • Competitive salary and annual bonus
  • Comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision insurance, 401(k) retirement plan with company match, and more
  • Generous parental leave and family planning benefits
  • Outstanding culture and opportunities for personal and professional growth
