title: Senior Mission Assurance Engineer
description:
Senior Mission Assurance Engineer

Company:

The Boeing Company

Boeing Defense Space & Security (BDS) is looking for a Senior Mission Assurance Engineer to join our Space, Intelligence & Weapons (SI&WS) team. This position is to help ensure the success of space missions. The selected candidate will be able to work in El Segundo, CA

The selected candidate will be a core member of a fast-paced, productive, and close-knit engineering team. Mission Assurance Engineers are integral to the entire product lifecycle to identify, analyze, mitigate and verify the integrity of our Boeing products. This includes collaboration with all facets of engineering from technology investment, concept development, requirements definition, and design, build, integration, test, and demonstration of products in their fielded environments.

Primary responsibilities:

  • Chair Mission Assurance Independent Reviews (MAIRs), Technical Independent Reviews (TIRs), Flight / Test Mission Assurance Readiness Reviews (F/TMARRs) and Non-Advocate Reviews for program milestones (per the Enterprise Standard Gated Process (ESGP)) to assure program success.
  • Manage and lead eRCCAs.
  • Document risk assessments, analysis and control of hardware, software, and chemical hazards.
  • Support design activities to provide independent assessment of system readiness.
  • Evaluate customer/operational needs to define system performance requirements and derived safety requirements, as well integration of technical parameters to assure compatibility of physical, functional, and program interfaces.

Basic Qualifications (Required Skills and Experience):

  • Bachelor of Science degree in Engineering, Engineering Technology (including Manufacturing Technology), Computer Science, Data Science, Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry or non-US equivalent qualifications directly related to the work statement
  • Ability to obtain a U.S. Security Clearance for which the U.S. Government requires U.S. Citizenship
  • 9+ years of experience in an engineering discipline
  • Experience with aircraft systems (e.g., navigation, avionics, fuel, hydraulics, pneumatic, etc.) including operations and troubleshooting

Preferred Qualifications (Desired Skills and Experience):

  • Experience conducting first flight readiness reviews or flight test mission assurance readiness reviews
  • An Active U.S. TS/SCI security clearance
  • Experience with Model Based Systems Engineering (MBSE)
  • 4+ years of experience with spacecraft, payloads, ground systems, and/or space mission systems
  • Experience applying systems engineering principles during the development of complex hardware/software solutions on an aerospace platform

title: Data Engineer - Principal Engineer
description:

Wells Fargo is seeking a Principal Engineer to lead the architecture and strategy behind enterprise metadata, data lineage, and AI-enabled data platforms that power critical business decisions across the organization. This is a high-impact opportunity to shape long-term technology direction, influence senior leaders, and drive innovation at enterprise scale.


In this role, you will:

  • Act as an advisor to leadership to develop or influence applications, network, information security, database, operating systems, or web technologies for highly complex business and technical needs across multiple groups
  • Lead the strategy and resolution of highly complex and unique challenges requiring in-depth evaluation across multiple areas or the enterprise, delivering solutions that are long-term, large-scale and require vision, creativity, innovation, advanced analytical and inductive thinking

  • Provide vision, direction and expertise to leadership on implementing innovative and significant business solutions

  • Define scalable architecture patterns for metadata ingestion, scanning, lineage derivation, and repository integration.
  • Standardize onboarding approaches across diverse technology stacks and domains.
  • Ensure consistency of metadata models and interoperability with enterprise governance platforms.

  • Accelerate Metadata Coverage Across the Bank

  • Lead initiatives to rapidly expand metadata harvesting and scanning coverage from legacy and modern platforms.
  • Drive automation strategies that reduce manual metadata capture and improve onboarding velocity.
  • Enable industrial-scale adoption of metadata management capabilities.

  • Deliver Enterprise Lineage Capabilities

  • Lead engineering efforts for element-level lineage and lineage-as-a-service capabilities.
  • Support regulatory, risk, operational resilience, and change management requirements through trusted lineage.
  • Reduce time required for impact analysis and root-cause investigations.

  • Drive Innovation and AI Enablement

  • Advance AI-assisted metadata enrichment, semantic discovery, knowledge graph creation, and automated governance workflows.
  • Enable future-state capabilities that support AI adoption through improved data visibility, discoverability, and trust.

  • Provide Technical Leadership Across Multiple Agile Teams

  • Mentor engineering teams across metadata management, data quality, observability, platform engineering, and governance tooling.
  • Resolve complex cross-domain integration challenges and guide critical architectural decisions.
  • Partner with senior technology and business leaders to align roadmaps and execution priorities.

Required Qualifications:

  • 7+ years of Engineering experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education
  • 5+ years of experience defining and implementing enterprise architecture strategies for metadata management, data lineage, data governance, or related data platforms.
  • 5+ years of experience leading large-scale technology modernization, migration, or transformation initiatives across complex enterprise environments.
  • Demonstrated experience designing scalable metadata ingestion, scanning, cataloging, and lineage solutions across diverse technology platforms.
  • Strong understanding of metadata management, business glossary frameworks, data lineage, data observability, data quality, and data governance practices.


Desired Qualifications:

  • Advanced degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Data Management, or a related discipline.
  • 10+ years of experience designing, developing, and supporting enterprise-scale data management, metadata management, governance, lineage, catalog, or data quality platforms.
  • Deep expertise in modern data architecture, cloud-native platforms, distributed systems, and enterprise data ecosystems.
  • Demonstrated experience leading large-scale platform modernization, migration, and transformation initiatives across complex organizations.
  • Strong understanding of metadata management, business glossary frameworks, data lineage, data observability, data quality, and data governance practices.
  • Experience with enterprise data platforms and technologies such as Databricks, Snowflake, Hadoop, Oracle, SQL Server, Kafka, OpenShift/Kubernetes, and cloud services.
  • Proven ability to define engineering roadmaps, influence architecture decisions, and drive technology strategy across multiple business and technology organizations.
  • Experience implementing automation, AI/ML, or GenAI capabilities to improve data discovery, governance, operational efficiency, and developer productivity.
  • Strong knowledge of software engineering best practices, including CI/CD, DevSecOps, site reliability engineering, observability, and platform engineering principles.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead and mentor engineers, architects, and technical teams while fostering a culture of innovation, accountability, and operational excellence.
  • Excellent executive communication and stakeholder management skills, with a proven ability to influence senior leadership and drive cross-functional alignment.
  • Experience working in highly regulated financial services environments with an understanding of risk management, compliance, security, and data privacy requirements.

title: Relief Medical Interpreter / Translator, Arabic
description:
JOB SUMMARY

This paragraph summarizes the general nature, level and purpose of the job.

Under the direct supervision of the Assistant Manager of Interpreter Services, conducts medical and general interpreting/translating for the patient care staff and for patients and their families. Acts as a cultural consultant to staff and as advocate for non-English speaking patients/families. Assesses and monitor their patient's understandings of the information conveyed and keeps physicians/nurses informed as to the level of that understanding. Suggests referrals to medical staff, clinical social workers, patient relation staff, chaplains, and ancillary staff. Records services provided in patient chart.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

The essential functions listed are typical examples of work performed by positions in this job classification. They are not designed to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, tasks, and responsibilities. Employees may also perform other duties as assigned.

Employees must abide by all Joint Commission Requirements including but not limited to sensitivity to cultural diversity, patient care, patient rights and ethical treatment, safety and security of physical environments, emergency management, teamwork, respect for others, participation in ongoing education and training, communication and adherence to safety and quality programs, sustaining compliance with National Patient Safety Goals, and licensure and health screenings.

Must perform all duties and responsibilities in accordance with the hospital's policies and procedures, including its Service Standards and its Code of Conduct.

* Performs medical interpretation for patients and their families in consecutive and sight translation modalities, including in-group setting. Independently interprets simple encounters accurately and completely (e.g., admissions, simple new patient and follow up encounters, etc.). With periodic supervision, interprets complex encounters accurately and completely (e.g., Care conferences, Psych, Consents, etc.).
* Performs medical translation for patients and their families. Independently translates, edits and proofreads simple After Visit Summaries in an accurate, clear and timely manner (e.g., maternity, well baby, basic surgery procedures, etc.). With periodic supervision, translates, edits and proofreads complex After Visit Summaries in an accurate, clear and timely manner (e.g., correspondence, Transplant, Oncology, medical procedures and instructions, etc., and other pertinent documents as necessary).
* Connects patients and families to hospital resources, as needed.

Shares observations with medical staff, clinical social workers, patient experience staff, chaplains, and ancillary staff about potential patient's needs to ensure quality patient care.


* Responds to Code emergency requests, confirms language preference, and provides interpretation for crisis interventions as necessary.
* May arrange interpretation for all languages for patients and families including: outside agencies, phone interpretation, spoken and sign language services, as needed.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

Any combination of education and experience that would likely provide the required knowledge, skills and abilities as well as possession of any required licenses or certifications is qualifying.

Education: Bachelor's degree in translation and interpretation
Experience: None Required

OR


Education: Bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university
Experience: Completion of medical interpreting training accepted by certification boards and one (1) year of interpreting experience.

KNOWLEDGE

These are the observable and measurable attributes and skills required to perform successfully the essential functions of the job and are generally demonstrated through qualifying experience, education or licensure/certification.

* Native or near-native ability in verbal and written communications in both English and non-English working language.
* Knowledge of Medical Terminology.
* Ability to perform consecutive interpreting and sight translation.
* Knowledge of cultural, health literacy and perceptual factors that may affect patient treatment and communication.
* Ability to establish and maintain excellent client relationships, exhibit exemplary interpersonal skills and exercise sound judgment and professionalism in business and personnel matters.
* Ability to maintain confidentiality of sensitive information.
* Ability to remain calm under pressure and apply sound judgment.
* Ability to work well with individuals at all levels of the organization.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

The Physical Requirements and Working Conditions in which the job is typically performed are available from the Occupational Health Department. Reasonable accommodations will be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the job.

Pay Range
Compensation is based on the level and requirements of the role.
Salary within our ranges may also be determined by your education, experience, knowledge, skills, location, and abilities, as required by the role, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data.
Typically, new team members join at the minimum to mid salary range.
Minimum to Midpoint Range (Hourly): $42.73 to $47.79

description:

Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.

As a Process Integration Engineer working in the fast-paced DRAM R&D Memory Group, you will be instrumental in developing Micron’s core memory technology serving AI-enabled customers. Your focus will be on the development and integration of critical technology which enables future DRAM memory scaling for Micron. You will develop the structural and electrical requirements for one or more modules and work in conjunction with Process Development and supporting teams to seamlessly integrate new module solutions into the entire process flow.

title: Content Solutions Specialist
description:
The Media Operations, Operations & Technology group is responsible for prepping content needed for domestic and international distribution as well as broadcast operations. This includes transcode, edit and delivery services to meet client fulfilment around the globe 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. Aside from supporting the day-to-day content supply, this position becomes integral to the success of high-profile LRP and strategic goals. We also support marketing supply chains as well as network stunts and events, which have included the Olympics, FIFA World Cup, and the Superbowl in the past.

The Content Solutions Specialist is responsible for strategy, administration, workflow design & solutions, integrations, and day-to-day operational builds. This role sits at the intersection of business stakeholders, clients, product, engineering, and operations; translating requirements into scalable content supply chain workflows and DAM/MAM solutions that support fast turnaround projects and LRP goals. This role designs and implements automations that support the full media asset lifecycle—from ingest through metadata enrichment & translations, QC, versioning, transcoding, delivery, and archival.

The ideal candidate is deeply technical, operationally minded, and comfortable both gathering requirements from non-technical partners, and working closely with product and engineering to bring short term and long term workflow designs into the larger supply chain.

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Design, build, and support end-to-end DAM/MAM supply chain workflows covering:
    • Asset ingest (file- and API-based)
    • Metadata validation, normalization, transformation and enrichment
    • Automated QC and review workflows
    • Transcoding and proxy generation
    • Versioning, derivatives, packaging, and delivery
  • Design and support API-based integrations between internal and third-party tooling and clients, for both upstream/downstream systems (e.g., MAMs, encoders, delivery platforms, analytics, metadata stores).
  • Partner with Engineering on REST APIs, MCP integrations, webhooks, JSON/XML schemas/contracts, event-driven patterns, and authentication models.
  • Build and maintain integration workflows using low-code (Java, YAML, Python, etc.) and automation platforms (e.g., Qibb, Power Automate/Logic Apps, ETLworks, AirTable) to orchestrate cross-system handoffs, automate operational processes and reduce manual touchpoints.
  • Build and support ETL metadata architecture, schemas and workflows supporting content ingestion, transformation, validation, enrichment, and fulfillment.
  • Support and integrate supplementary CSC/Marketing Supply chain systems including AI Video & Image Technologies, Orange Logic DAM, Telestream Vantage Encoding, AWS EMC, Fabric Metadata, and other marketing, metadata, analytics, and discovery tools that intersect with the media content lifecycle.
  • Design and build agentic AI/ML‑enabled workflows using Microsoft Copilot Studio (or equivalent), creating agents that streamline operational pain points, enable self‑service, orchestrate multi‑step workflows, and improve team productivity.
  • Create productivity and support solutions using our tools to enhance BAU & Projects.
  • Advise and maintain vendor engagement, including feature requests, issue escalation, release validation, and platform upgrade risk/benefits.

description:
Why Wells Fargo:

Are you looking for more? Find it here. At Wells Fargo, we're more than a financial services leader – we’re a global trailblazer committed to driving innovation, empowering communities, and helping our customers succeed. We believe that a meaningful career is much more than just a job – it’s about finding all of the elements to help you thrive, in one place. And we’re recognized for it – Wells Fargo once again ranked in the top five on the 2026 LinkedIn Top Companies list of best workplaces “to grow your career” in the U.S. Join us!

About this role:

Wells Fargo is seeking a Senior Branch Premier Banker (SAFE) to play a pivotal role within our National Branch Network. This role grows, deepens, and manages relationships with affluent customers and those with more complex financial needs, serving as their primary point of contact for banking products and services through scheduled appointments, lobby engagement, and proactive outreach. This role is designed for growth oriented professionals who lead with advice to acquire and deepen relationships through meaningful discovery and translate customer goals into comprehensive financial strategies. You will own and actively grow a defined book of business, leveraging goals based planning, and prudent risk oversight to deliver integrated solutions across deposits, investments, credit, home lending, and business banking. In addition, you’ll help customers with everyday banking needs-opening accounts, handling service requests, and ensuring a seamless experience making it easier for them to manage their banking with confidence. Success in this role is driven by strong relationship acumen, proactive customer engagement, and seamless collaboration with internal partners across Wealth, Home Lending, and Business Banking to deliver a differentiated customer experience.

Wells Fargo rewards behaviors that consistently create long term customer value and support customers in making informed financial decisions. You’ll be supported with digital tools, industry leading training, ongoing coaching, and backed by one of the most recognized brands in banking. This role offers a clear platform for career growth for experienced professionals who excel at building trust, managing a portfolio, and delivering holistic, multi product solutions.

In this role you will:

  • Proactively acquire new affluent consumer and business customers while deepening existing relationships through strategic outreach, referrals, and pre-planned customer appointments

  • Lead discovery‑driven conversations to understand customer goals and deliver tailored banking and credit strategies that strengthen relationships, increase retention, and drive balanced growth across deposits, lending, and investments

  • Serve as the primary financial partner delivering comprehensive, multi‑product guidance and ongoing reviews across life stages and evolving financial needs

  • Partner with a team of professionals across Wealth, Home Lending, and Business Banking to deliver integrated solutions by coordinating warm introductions, setting clear expectations, and taking personal ownership to convert qualified opportunities into closed outcomes

  • Champion digital adoption by educating customers on self-service and mobile banking options to elevate satisfaction, engagement, and service efficiency

  • Serve as an active member of the branch team by advising colleagues on relationship development and the management of complex client needs

  • Demonstrate risk excellence through accurate documentation, sound judgment, timely issue escalation, and adherence to policies and regulations to support strong control outcomes

  • The Senior Branch Premier Banker LP (license pending) role is a temporary position until employee has successfully completed licensing requirements and SAFE registration. Upon successful completion, employees will transition to the Senior Branch Premier Banker (SAFE) role. Employees hired into the Senior Branch Premier Banker LP role who are not fully licensed will participate in the Branch Network Licensed Banker program.

  • 3+ years of experience building and maintaining effective relationships with customers and partners

  • 3+ years of experience recommending products and services

Desired Qualifications:

  • Experience recommending financial products and translating customer goals into clear, actionable recommendations

  • Demonstrated ability to proactively source, acquire, and deepen relationships through proactive outreach and building strong internal partnership to support the customer experience

  • Proven experience managing a book-of-business, documentation of planning conversations, and consistent follow-through to drive retention and growth across deposits, lending, and investments

  • Experience coaching or supporting peers to strengthen team performance and customer impact

title: Java Software Engineer -Vice President - Parametric
description:
ABOUT MORGAN STANLEY:
Morgan Stanley is a leading global financial services firm providing a wide range of investment banking, securities, wealth management and investment management services. With offices in more than 41 countries, the Firm's employees serve clients worldwide including corporations, governments, institutions and individuals. For further information about Morgan Stanley, please visit www.morganstanley.com.

ABOUT PARAMETRIC:
Parametric is part of Morgan Stanley Investment Management, the asset management division of Morgan Stanley. We partner with advisors, institutions, and consultants to build portfolios focused on what's important to them and their clients. A leader in custom solutions for more than 30 years, we help investors access efficient market exposures, solve implementation challenges, and design multi-asset portfolios that respond to their evolving needs. We also offer systematic alpha and alternative strategies to complement clients' core holdings.

This role is part of Parametric's hybrid working model, which includes working in the office 3 days a week and choosing to work remotely or in the office the remaining days of the week.

ABOUT THE TEAM:
The Investment Systems team at Parametric:
We are building financial software that solves for some of the world's most complex financial opportunities. This includes building solutions to provide customized direct index exposure while making tax sensitive asset selection to improve overall after-tax portfolio returns.
We design and build scalable multi-asset portfolio management solutions, secure platforms for creating financial applications and low-code workflows, and a core data platform that delivers trusted financial data.

ABOUT THE ROLE:
We are looking for individuals that have a strong curiosity and passion for learning new things, while continuously challenging oneself to build things better and more scalable.

The Principal Software Engineer is responsible for providing both technical and people leadership, project delivery, process development, training and support. The role partners across the Equity Investments and Client Activities team, Core Services, and the externally facing Digital Team to design and develop technology solutions that support Direct Indexing business priorities and improve business processes. The role spans multiple services within the team, building out underlying components that provide critical services to the Equity Portfolio Management Platform. These services help streamline rule-based portfolio analytics, order generation and straight through processing enabling exception driven portfolio management.

This position will report into the Investments & Innovation Platform team and work closely with team leads across Technology teams, Business Analysis as well as Business Partners. In this role, you will lead developers and projects and provide mentoring opportunities to the development team.

A critical objective for this role is to support the architecture and deliver scalable enterprise solutions, leveraging AWS cloud native technologies, designing and implementing micro-services and a relentless focus on performance and resilience.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Design and develop proprietary solutions for the Equity Direct Indexing portfolio management teams

  • Provide technical leadership by directly managing a team of engineers, guiding and mentoring them to achieve their highest potential while collectively advancing the goals and projects of the engineering team.

  • Drive vision and strategy for the team while exemplifying strong leadership skills, including communication, consensus building, elevated standards, ownership, accountability, and project management.

  • Design, develop, and maintain services and API to support various business needs

  • Leverage scalable and distributed computing principles to build the next generation of services

  • Ensures that software solutions remain integrated, efficient, and appropriate for a highly regulated industry.

  • Create unit/integration/functional/performance tests

  • Conduct code reviews of other developers

  • Share experience, knowledge, and ideas to the team to improve processes and productivity

  • Maintain regular collaboration with teams and stakeholders in the US West Coast time zone, including flexibility to support overlapping working hours when needed.

JOB QUALIFICATIONS
Required Experience: 12+ years
Skill set: Software design / Dev/ Java / J2EE / relational database

Primary Skills

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related area of study

  • 12+ years of hands-on development experience managing all aspects of technical projects with a proven track record of delivering well architected and well written software solutions.

  • 3+ years of managing software development teams and providing direct guidance, mentorship, project leadership, and team development while fostering an engaging, collaborative environment and building strong cross-team relationships

  • Strong Java and Spring Boot experience

  • Experience with microservices and distributed systems

  • Strong debugging and troubleshooting skills
    Strong aptitude for highly efficient data structures and algorithms

  • Cloud native development experience a plus: AWS is preferred

  • Exposure to event-driven architecture (e.g., Kafka)

  • Working knowledge of SQL , RDBMS ,NoSQL database engines such as Redis & DynamoDB

  • Experience using enterprise AI development tools, including GitHub Copilot Enterprise and GitHub Spec Kit, to enable AI-powered Specification-Driven Development.

  • Proven track record of becoming a subject matter expert in areas related to current assignments.

  • Demonstrated initiative, ownership, and a results-oriented approach to solving complex business and technology challenges.

  • Demonstrated sound judgment, integrity, and a commitment to delivering high-quality outcomes in a collaborative environment.

  • Strong communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence technical and business stakeholders.

  • Familiarity with AI and related technologies, with the ability to apply them in a business or technical context

Good to Have Skills

  • Experience with React or modern front-end frameworks

  • Strong knowledge of relational databases and SQL

  • Asset management experience

  • Experience governing enterprise AI agents through secure access, auditability, human oversight, and emerging standards.


Parametric believes each member of our organization makes a significant contribution to our success. That contribution should not be limited by the assigned responsibilities. Therefore, this job description is designed to outline primary duties and qualifications. It is our expectation that every member of our team will offer his/her/their services wherever and whenever necessary to ensure the success of our client services.

WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT FROM MORGAN STANLEY:

At Morgan Stanley, we raise, manage and allocate capital for our clients – helping them reach their goals. We do it in a way that’s differentiated – and we’ve done that for 90 years. Our values - putting clients first, doing the right thing, leading with exceptional ideas, committing to diversity and inclusion, and giving back - aren’t just beliefs, they guide the decisions we make every day to do what's best for our clients, communities and more than 80,000 employees in 1,200 offices across 42 countries. title: Software Engineer
description:
Air Liquide Healthcare Australia are a leading and dedicated supplier of medical gases, homecare and sleep services. We specialise in respiratory diseases and have a strong reputation in sleep diagnostics and CPAP therapy.

The main objective of this position is to support, monitor, and optimize Air Liquide Healthcare's business-critical systems, including MS Dynamics GP, SQL databases, API integrations, and reporting systems. The Software Engineer serves as the primary point of contact for internal IT and system-related issues, collaborates with external IT partners to resolve support tickets, and develops automation tools, reports, and database processes to improve operational efficiency and streamline business operations.

Reporting to the Digital & IT Manager.

How will you CONTRIBUTE and GROW?

  • Support and monitor MS Dynamics GP, SQL databases, reporting tools, integrations, and business-critical systems

  • Act as the first point of contact for internal IT and system-related issues

  • Coordinate with the external IT company for support tickets, server matters, patching, updates, and service issues

  • Maintain and improve SQL databases, queries, views, stored procedures, reports, and data processes

  • Develop and maintain SQL Back Up Schedules, batch jobs, management reports, operational reports, and system reports

  • Use SQL, PowerShell, APIs, CSV, JSON, and automation tools to improve system efficiency

  • Support API integrations, data imports/exports, and system-to-system data exchange

  • Assist with Power BI dashboards, KPI reports, and business intelligence reporting

  • Support Global IT teams related to upcoming ERP, local user support with reporting, data, and system queries

  • Identify system improvements and help streamline business processes

4. Guidelines and Expectations

The Software Engineer should be able to:

  • Autonomously monitor and support business-critical systems, including MS Dynamics GP and SQL databases, to ensure high system availability and minimal operational disruption.

  • Prioritize and act as the first point of contact for internal IT and system-related issues, troubleshooting and resolving issues efficiently.

  • Coordinate effectively with external IT partners on server management, patching, updates, and escalation of support tickets, ensuring timely resolution of issues.

  • Proactively identify system inefficiencies and propose automated workflows or tools (e.g., SQL, PowerShell, APIs) to streamline operations and improve database processes.

  • Effectively collaborate with local users and global IT teams to support ERP migrations, local data/reporting needs, and system queries.

  • Assist internal users with custom reports and Power BI dashboards to support data-driven decision-making.

  • Maintain accurate documentation of database structures, API integrations, queries, and stored procedures to ensure knowledge sharing and business continuity.

  • Escalate complex system issues, architectural changes, or security concerns to the Digital & IT Manager in a timely manner.

  • Comply at all times with Air Liquide Healthcare's policies, procedures, quality management system (QMS), and data privacy guidelines.

Are you a MATCH?

  • ERP experience will be highly regarded

  • Experience with APIs,data integrations, CSV, XML, JSON, and automation tools

  • Strong SQL database administration and reporting experience

  • Strong MS Dynamics Great Plains experience is essential

  • programming skills are essential

  • Good understanding of ERP and business systems

  • Power BI skills will be an advantage

  • Strong troubleshooting, communication, and problem-solving skills

  • Ability to work independently and manage priorities

About Air Liquide

A world leader in gases, technologies and services for Industry and Health, Air Liquide is present in 78 countries with approximately 64,500 employees and serves more than 3.8 million customers and patients. Oxygen, nitrogen and hydrogen are essential small molecules for life, matter and energy. They embody Air Liquide’s scientific territory and have been at the core of the company’s activities since its creation in 1902.

Our Differences make our Performance


At Air Liquide, we are committed to build a diverse and inclusive workplace that embraces the diversity of our employees, our customers, patients, community stakeholders and cultures across the world.

We welcome and consider applications from all qualified applicants, regardless of their background. We strongly believe a diverse organization opens up opportunities for people to express their talent, both individually and collectively and it helps foster our ability to innovate by living our fundamentals, acting for our success and creating an engaging environment in a changing world.

title: Senior Systems Operations Engineer
description:
About this role:

Wells Fargo is seeking a Senior Systems Operations Engineer.

In this role, you will:

  • Lead and coordinate enterprise vulnerability management activities across infrastructure, middleware, database, cloud, and application platforms.
  • Analyze security vulnerabilities, assess risk exposure, and partner with technology teams to drive timely remediation.
  • Monitor and manage vulnerability remediation performance against established service level objectives and enterprise risk standards.
  • Collaborate with infrastructure, application, security, and architecture teams to prioritize and mitigate critical security risks.
  • Identify opportunities for automation and process improvements to enhance vulnerability management effectiveness and reduce manual effort.
  • Lead operational reviews and provide guidance on vulnerability remediation strategies, exception management, and risk treatment options.
  • Develop and maintain vulnerability dashboards, scorecards, and executive reporting to support decision-making.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert for vulnerability management processes, controls, and industry best practices.
  • Support security audits, regulatory reviews, and risk assessments related to vulnerability management.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on reducing enterprise vulnerability exposure and improving compliance.

Required Qualifications:

  • 4+ years of Systems Engineering, Technology Architecture experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education

Desired Qualifications:

  • Experience supporting enterprise vulnerability management, patch management, security operations, or infrastructure risk management programs.
  • Strong understanding of operating systems, middleware, databases, cloud technologies, and enterprise infrastructure. Systems Engineering, Information Security, Infrastructure Engineering,
  • Manage end-to-end vulnerability remediation activities across multiple Lines of Business (LOBs).
  • Monitor vulnerability scanning results and ensure accurate identification, prioritization, tracking, and remediation of security vulnerabilities.
  • Partner closely with infrastructure, middleware, database, and application teams to ensure vulnerabilities are remediated within policy-defined timelines.
  • Conduct vulnerability triage and risk assessments, including validation of findings, severity review, and prioritization recommendations.
  • Investigate and validate false positives through analysis of system configurations, operating systems, software versions, and compensating controls.
  • Facilitate remediation planning sessions and coordinate emergency and critical vulnerability response activities.
  • Drive vulnerability backlog reduction initiatives and identify long-term remediation strategies for recurring vulnerabilities.
  • Support vulnerability exception reviews, risk acceptance processes, and compensating control assessments.
  • Analyze emerging security threats, vendor advisories, and critical vulnerabilities to determine enterprise impact.
  • Produce daily, weekly, monthly, and quarterly metrics and reporting related to vulnerability exposure, remediation effectiveness, compliance, and risk posture.
  • Partner with Information Security, Risk Management, and Technology organizations to improve vulnerability management governance and operational effectiveness.
  • Develop automation solutions and reporting capabilities to improve visibility into vulnerability remediation progress.
  • Communicate risk exposure, remediation status, and escalation items to senior technology leaders, CIOs, CTOs, and security stakeholders.
  • Lead root cause analysis efforts for recurring vulnerabilities and drive preventive solutions.

Job Expectations:

  • 4+ years of experience in vulnerability management, cybersecurity operations, infrastructure security, risk management, or related disciplines.
  • 3+ years of experience working with vulnerability scanning and management platforms such as Qualys, Tenable, Rapid7, or similar technologies.
  • 2+ years of experience performing security data analysis, trend analysis, and executive-level reporting.
  • 3+ years of experience using business intelligence and reporting tools such as Power BI, Tableau, ServiceNow, Jira, or equivalent platforms.
  • Strong knowledge of vulnerability scoring methodologies including CVSS and risk-based prioritization frameworks.
  • Experience analyzing operating system, middleware, database, and application vulnerabilities across enterprise environments.
  • Experience developing and maintaining dashboards, KPIs, and metrics related to vulnerability remediation and security risk reduction.
  • Knowledge of patch management processes and associated operational controls.
  • Experience managing cross-functional remediation efforts involving technology, security, and business stakeholders.
  • Ability to interpret security advisories, vendor bulletins, and emerging threat intelligence.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to present complex technical risks to both technical and executive audiences.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage escalations, coordinate remediation efforts, and influence stakeholders across multiple organizations.
  • Experience identifying opportunities for process optimization and automation within vulnerability management programs.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
  • Experience with Qualys Vulnerability Management and Policy Compliance.
  • Knowledge of enterprise patching and vulnerability governance frameworks.
  • Experience with Python, SQL, and automation technologies for vulnerability analytics and reporting.
  • Understanding of cloud security concepts across Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud environments.
  • Security certifications such as Security+, GSEC, CISSP, CISM, or equivalent.

title: 26-27 Associate Director of Academic Operations (ADAO)
description:
Here’s what you need to know:

The Associate Director of Academic Operations (ADAO) will be the face of day-to-day academic operations for our students, staff and teachers. They will work collaboratively with the Director of School Operations (DSO), Teaching and Learning (T&L), and the school leadership team to ensure that the operational needs of teachers and of the instructional program are being met. They also partner with our KIPP Forward (KF) team to support their efforts in preparing for college and career readiness. The ADAO will be a critical player in supporting our schools’ operations so that our school leader and instructional staff can focus on what matters most: helping our students get to and through college.

Here’s what you’ll be doing:

School Schedule Development and Maintenance / Registrar

  • In partnership with the DSO and T&L, leads the annual school schedule build for the coming school year and is ultimately the owner of the school’s master schedule.
  • Reviews transcripts and schedules all new students in PowerSchool
  • Implements any necessary schedule changes requested by students and/or staff throughout the school year
  • Supports students in ensuring that they are on track for graduation as needed.
  • Completes transcript requests for students that have transferred or graduated
  • In coordination with School leader, maintain the course catalog and bell schedule

Test Coordination and Administration (PSAT, SAT, State Testing, AP, iReady)

  • Serve as the school's testing coordinator for PSAT, SAT, AP, and NJ state assessments — rostering, scheduling, proctor training, day-of administration, makeups, and irregularity reporting
  • Ensures appropriate student testing environment and coordinates with T&L and tech team as necessary
  • Attends any required CMO (Charter Management Organization) and/or state trainings

Home Instruction Coordination

  • Lead the home instruction process for students on medical home instruction and suspension in compliance with all state requirements
  • Serve as the external vendor liaison and ensure contracts are in place and purchasing orders are setup for home instruction
  • Update Student Information Systems with the required program information
  • Regularly audit to ensure compliance with home instruction requirements and that teachers are providing required services

Academic Operations

title: Director, Premium Client Services | TB Rays
description:
ABOUT LEGENDS GLOBAL

Legends Global is the premier partner to the world’s greatest live events, venues, and brands. We power unforgettable experiences through a fully integrated suite of premium services—delivered seamlessly through our white-label model to keep our partners front and center.

With a global network of more than 450 venues, hosting 20,000 events and welcoming 165 million guests annually, Legends Global brings unmatched scale and expertise across every touchpoint—from feasibility and consulting to sales, partnerships, hospitality, merchandise, venue management, and world-class content and booking.

At Legends Global, you’ll help shape the future of sports and live entertainment, working on projects that leave a lasting legacy alongside people who play to win. Our core values—Align, Scale, Connect, Team, Win—guide how we show up every day and at every level. We surround our people with experts to learn from, build a culture rooted in collaboration, and recognize real impact. If you’re driven to work on the biggest stages in sports and entertainment and want to be part of the unstoppable team behind the world’s greatest live events, venues, and brands—this is where you belong.

The Director, Premium Client Services will be responsible for overseeing all services related to ticketing, premium ticketing, and suites for the Tampa Bay Rays' new stadium project. This individual will serve as a dedicated champion for client satisfaction, owning the full buyer journey from purchase through stadium opening. Responsibilities include managing contracts, processing payments in real time, and ensuring a seamless, high-touch experience throughout every stage of the client relationship. The Director will also proactively build relationships with clients and identify new revenue opportunities to support the organization's premium service goals.

The Tampa Bay Rays are developing a state-of-the-art ballpark at Hillsborough College in Tampa’s Westshore district, targeting a 2029 opening. This public-private partnership anchors the Champions Quarter mixed-use district. With 11,500 premium seats designed to set new MLB benchmarks, Legends Global seeks exceptional leaders to drive this transformational project.

WHAT YOU’LL DO (KEY RESPONSIBILITIES & OUTCOMES)

  • Lead the planning, development and activation of all service offerings including the creation of a service identity and pioneering a proactive service culture
  • Project manage key initiatives as needed to ensure coordination across revenue lines when dealing with external parties including third-party agencies, architects, hospitality, etc. to develop and streamline sales processes that improve sales efficiency. Key examples include the ongoing function of the sales center, marketing campaigns, website, brochure, etc
  • Key role in maintaining alignment between sales, marketing, business operations, finance, and other stakeholders to share insights and centralize information. Key examples include monthly reporting, budget reconciliation and tracking.
  • Plan and execute key industry networking events to identify new business and create experiences for prospective clients
  • Attract, mentor, and manage a team of service minded individuals. Champion a positive culture through team building, professional development, and innovative techniques
  • Foster strong, collaborative working relationships with the Tampa Bay Rays organization and business partners

QUALIFICATIONS

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty with energy and enthusiasm. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent
  • Minimum of 6-8 years of successful sales & service management experience (sports business a plus)
  • Skilled analyzing data, developing concise recommendations and presenting to executive leadership
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills to develop strong working relationships with partners, teammates, and other stakeholders
  • Ability to manage a high level of detail across multiple projects and to prioritize efficiently
  • High emotional intelligence, intellectual curiosity and desire to grow professionally
  • Ability to prioritize and meet competing deadlines independently
  • Ability to manage multiple task simultaneously, while remaining organized, efficient and calm under pressure
  • Proven ability to work collaboratively in a team-oriented environment
  • Execution

WORK ENVIRONMENT & TRAVEL

  • Role requires regular on-site presence to support project launch, client partnership, team leadership, and venue-related activity.
  • Ability to work both traditional and non-traditional hours, including nights, weekends, holidays, and event-based schedules as business needs require.
  • Travel may be required for meetings, training, client engagement, industry events, and Legends Global business needs.

Legends Global has assembled the most powerful network in sports, live entertainment, and venues — not just the collection of venues and partners, but the people behind them. You’ll work alongside exceptional talent, collaborate with experienced leaders and subject matter experts, and contribute to projects that set the standard for excellence across sports, entertainment, hospitality, and live experiences. Every win here is earned, not assumed — if you’re driven by growth and delivering innovative solutions, you’ll thrive here at Legends Global.

COMPENSATION

Competitive pay, commensurate with experience, skills, and qualifications. This role may also be eligible for an incentive. Legends Global offers a competitive total rewards package, including medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance, paid vacation, and 401k plan.

DEPARTMENT

Legends Global Sales

title: Head of Engineering, Field Verification
description:
Who we are

Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month.

As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually.

Why Poland

Poland is a new and deliberate addition to our engineering map. We recently made our first technology hire in the country, and we are looking at Poland as a long-term strategic location for senior hires, particularly within our engineering organisation. Joining now means joining early, and helping shape what our presence here becomes.

So, now we are looking for our Head of Engineering, Field Verification to join us in Poland.

About the role

Field Verification is how Moniepoint knows that the people and businesses on our platform are real. Every Moniepoint customer, retail and business, requires a completed field verification as part of KYC. The platform coordinates physical, in-person checks — verifying individuals, business owners, business addresses and loan guarantors — and it serves nearly every part of the company: onboarding, loans, compliance and the fraud team.

The system works today. A back office gives each business unit visibility and control over its own verification requests. A mobile-friendly web app puts the work in the hands of Field Verification Officers and the cluster leads who manage them across local government areas. An API layer lets other business units push verification requests in and receive results back by webhook, and an assignment algorithm routes each request to an officer close enough to carry it out.

We want to be straightforward about the rest. This domain has never had a dedicated engineering leader, and that is the single biggest constraint on it. The team is one lean, cross-functional squad — an Engineering Manager, four engineers and a QA — carrying verification volume for the entire customer base. They have done that impressively well, but running lean means running in keep-the-lights-on mode, and a long list of things that would make this platform substantially better has been waiting for someone to own it.

That list is the role. Trip and route management, so an officer can plan an optimal day across several sites rather than making a separate journey for each one — today we pay for a round trip per verification, and the logistics are nowhere near optimal. Capacity management. A native mobile app, wanted for a long time and never resourced. Liveness and identity verification tooling, exposed as APIs the rest of the business can build on. And as Moniepoint expands into markets where identity verification is as difficult as it is in Nigeria, Kenya among them, a platform that works beyond a single country.

There is a great deal of room to build here. Whoever takes this on will set the direction rather than inherit someone else's plan, on a system that already carries real weight for the business.

As Head of Engineering, Field Verification, your responsibilities will include:

  • Owning the technical strategy, architecture and roadmap for the Field Verification platform end to end, and setting direction for a domain that has been running without dedicated engineering leadership.
  • Moving the platform from keep-the-lights-on operation to deliberate, prioritised development.
  • Leading and growing the existing cross-functional team, and building the organisation out as scope expands.
  • Building the operational efficiency layer — trip and route optimisation, task allocation and capacity management for field officers.
  • Owning the platform's client-facing surface: the APIs and webhooks that other business units integrate with, and the back office those units rely on.
  • Delivering a native mobile experience for field officers.
  • Ensuring verification data is structured, auditable and fit for compliance scrutiny.
  • Building for multi-country expansion as Moniepoint enters new markets.
  • Partnering closely with Product and with the business units that depend on the platform — onboarding, loans, compliance and fraud.
  • Defining architecture standards, engineering processes and quality metrics, and hiring and developing engineers and Engineering Managers.

Who you are

  • You have built things yourself, and grew into leadership from there. We are explicit about this: we are not looking for someone who moved into management early and has led from a distance since. We want an engineer who became a leader.
  • You are capable across disciplines. Backend, web and mobile. This platform spans all three and you will need credibility in each — a specialist in one layer will struggle here.
  • You have built platforms, not just products. Systems used by several distinct groups of users and internal business units, with the flexibility to serve requirements you did not anticipate.
  • You are a problem solver first. We would rather have someone adaptable than someone with the exact domain experience. Having built across different industries — fintech, e-commerce, logistics or otherwise — is a positive signal, not a scattered CV.
  • You have 10+ years of overall software engineering experience, with substantial hands-on production engineering and strong backend depth. Our backend environment is Java and Spring Boot.
  • You have at least 5 years of engineering leadership, including managing Engineering Managers.
  • You collaborate well with product and business stakeholders, and can translate operational requirements into engineering solutions.
  • Experience working with location and geospatial data is a strong plus, including map integrations.
  • Experience with route, trip or delivery optimisation is a strong plus.
  • Experience building for compliance — where data must be structured to evidence what was done and when — is a strong plus.
  • Experience with identity, KYC or verification platforms is a plus. None of these four are requirements.

Cultural Alignment

As well, we assess every candidate across eight dimensions that define how great leaders operate at Moniepoint. We look for evidence of all eight throughout the process, not just in a single conversation.

  • Customer Obsession: Build deep empathy for users. Solve problems intuitively, and fix root causes, not just tickets.
  • Craft: Master the fundamentals. Reason from first principles, make trade-offs explicit, and raise the bar on quality.
  • Systemisation: Turn repeating decisions into scalable mechanisms. Reduce cognitive load and raise engineering quality.
  • Urgency: Move with disciplined speed. Act autonomously within scope, remove friction, and escalate risks early.
  • Ownership: Treat the platform as your own. Take initiative across boundaries and follow through without reminders.
  • No Ego: Put the mission first. Share credit, welcome debate, and never protect status over team outcomes.
  • Candour: Surface uncomfortable truths and risks early. Intelligent failure is welcome; concealment is not.
  • Integrity: Stay truthful and ethically consistent. Refuse toxic behavior. Performance without integrity is unacceptable.

What Success Looks Like

  • The domain has clear technical ownership and direction for the first time.
  • The team out of keep-the-lights-on mode and delivering against a prioritised roadmap.
  • Measurable improvement in field officer efficiency — more verifications per trip, lower cost per verification.
  • A native mobile experience shipped for field officers.
  • Verification data that stands up to compliance scrutiny across every business unit the platform serves.
  • The platform ready to support a new market.
  • A team grown beyond its current size, with a strong bench of engineers and managers.

Why Join Us

  • A genuinely greenfield mandate on a system that already matters. Every customer Moniepoint onboards passes through this platform.
  • A lean, capable team making outsized impact, and the remit to build the organisation around them.
  • Breadth: backend, web, mobile, location data, compliance and operational optimisation in one domain.
  • Be part of a mission-driven company expanding access to financial services for millions of businesses and individuals.

What To Expect in The Hiring Process

  • A preliminary phone call with the recruiter.
  • 60 minute High level System Design round with one of our Engineering Managers.
  • 60 minute Panel Interview with 2 of our Head of Engineering leaders. 30 minutes focused on a technical deep dive into your CV and into a project or system you built in the past. 30 minutes focused on testing for leadership attributes.
  • 60 minute Stakeholder Management Round with one of our Product Heads/VPs, focused on your stakeholder management and collaboration skills with product and business.
  • 60 minute Technical round and Culture fit interview with our Co-founder & Group CTO (the hiring manager).

title: Network Engineer
description:
NEXTDC is looking for a hands on network engineer to operate and continuously improve the IT and OT network estate across our data centres. You'll take day to day ownership of configuration, troubleshooting and change execution in a Juniper, Fortinet, Ivanti, OpenGear and Aruba environment, working closely with our Network, Security, OT and Facilities teams.

This is a core engineering role for someone who prefers solving problems at the CLI to escalating them. Scripting, automation and AI assisted tooling are a growth area here, not a barrier to entry.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Operating, configuring and troubleshooting switching, routing, firewalls, VPN and wireless across the IT and OT estate
  • Owning standard changes and incident diagnosis, improving runbooks as you go
  • Supporting incident and problem management, and identifying recurring risks
  • Establishing core monitoring and logging: device onboarding, alert rules and dashboards
  • Integrating monitoring with ITSM, CMDB and DCIM where possible
  • Contributing to automation of repetitive tasks such as config backup, compliance checks and bulk changes

This opportunity will see you working with world leaders in our space. Join our Malaysian journey now and be an integral part of our success.

  • 5 to 10 years in network engineering or operations, with strong hands on experience in production enterprise or data centre environments: switching, routing, firewalls, VPN, HA and segmentation (any vendor)
  • Genuine troubleshooting ownership, comfortable diagnosing across multiple vendor platforms from the CLI
  • Solid grasp of enterprise wireless fundamentals, remote access VPN and out of band management
  • JNCIA-MIST or JNCIA-SEC, or willing to obtain within your first 90 days
  • Desirable: Juniper (Mist, EX, QFX, SRX, MX), Fortinet (FortiGate/FMG/FAZ), ClearPass, Ivanti VPN, OpenGear or Aruba
  • Desirable: OT/ICS exposure and IEC 62443 style segmentation, Python or Ansible automation, and comfort using AI coding assistants

  • Seize this exciting opportunity to join one of Australia’s fastest growing companies and play a key contributing role in the future of AI and the digital economy

  • Join an inclusive, diverse and values driven working culture supporting hybrid work practices

  • Enjoy awesome employee benefits (gifted share options, NEXTDC days, volunteer days, professional development, holistic wellbeing and mental health programs and more)

  • Great opportunities to progress within our company (grow as we grow)

Our mission is to continue building a diverse and inclusive workforce which represents the communities in which we operate.

Make NEXTDC your next move.

title: Senior Branch Premier Banker Spring Township Wyomissing
description:
Why Wells Fargo:

Are you looking for more? Find it here. At Wells Fargo, we're more than a financial services leader – we’re a global trailblazer committed to driving innovation, empowering communities, and helping our customers succeed. We believe that a meaningful career is much more than just a job – it’s about finding all of the elements to help you thrive, in one place. Living the Well Life means you’re supported in life, not just work. It means having robust benefits, competitive compensation, and programs designed to help you find work-life balance and well-being. You’ll be rewarded for investing in your community, celebrated for being your authentic self, and empowered to grow. And we’re recognized for it – Wells Fargo once again ranked in the top five on the 2026 LinkedIn Top Companies list of best workplaces “to grow your career” in the U.S. Join us!

About this role:

Wells Fargo is seeking a Senior Branch Premier Banker (SAFE) to play a pivotal role within our National Branch Network. This role grows, deepens, and manages relationships with affluent customers and those with more complex financial needs, serving as their primary point of contact for banking products and services through scheduled appointments, lobby engagement, and proactive outreach. This role is designed for growth oriented professionals who lead with advice to acquire and deepen relationships through meaningful discovery and translate customer goals into comprehensive financial strategies. You will own and actively grow a defined book of business, leveraging goals based planning, and prudent risk oversight to deliver integrated solutions across deposits, investments, credit, home lending, and business banking. In addition, you’ll help customers with everyday banking needs-opening accounts, handling service requests, and ensuring a seamless experience making it easier for them to manage their banking with confidence. Success in this role is driven by strong relationship acumen, proactive customer engagement, and seamless collaboration with internal partners across Wealth, Home Lending, and Business Banking to deliver a differentiated customer experience.

Wells Fargo rewards behaviors that consistently create long term customer value and support customers in making informed financial decisions. You’ll be supported with digital tools, industry leading training, ongoing coaching, and backed by one of the most recognized brands in banking. This role offers a clear platform for career growth for experienced professionals who excel at building trust, managing a portfolio, and delivering holistic, multi product solutions.

In this role you will:

  • Proactively acquire new affluent consumer and business customers while deepening existing relationships through strategic outreach, referrals, and pre-planned customer appointments
  • Lead discovery‑driven conversations to understand customer goals and deliver tailored banking and credit strategies that strengthen relationships, increase retention, and drive balanced growth across deposits, lending, and investments
  • Serve as the primary financial partner delivering comprehensive, multi‑product guidance and ongoing reviews across life stages and evolving financial needs
  • Partner with a team of professionals across Wealth, Home Lending, and Business Banking to deliver integrated solutions by coordinating warm introductions, setting clear expectations, and taking personal ownership to convert qualified opportunities into closed outcomes
  • Champion digital adoption by educating customers on self-service and mobile banking options to elevate satisfaction, engagement, and service efficiency
  • Serve as an active member of the branch team by advising colleagues on relationship development and the management of complex client needs
  • Demonstrate risk excellence through accurate documentation, sound judgment, timely issue escalation, and adherence to policies and regulations to support strong control outcomes
  • The Senior Branch Premier Banker LP (license pending) role is a temporary position until employee has successfully completed licensing requirements and SAFE registration. title: Supervisor, Technical Operations Center
description:
The Supervisor, Technical Operations Center is responsible for overseeing the successful execution of scheduled and live broadcast operations, ensuring transmission systems, equipment, and workflows operate reliably across studio, field, and remote environments. This role provides operational leadership, technical oversight, and timely resolution of broadcast issues to ensure continuity and quality of service.

Job Duties:

  • Oversees the development, implementation, and delivery of operational solutions, including system planning, resource coordination, deployment, installation, testing, and implementation within the Technical Operations Center and provides hands on technical support.
  • Oversees and helps plan the execution of the day-to-day activities, assignments, staffing requirements, and operational concerns of the Video Control Operations, Media Management Operations, and Technical Operations teams.
  • Ensures operational and technical services consistently meet or exceed internal customer and business expectations, collaborating with cross-functional teams to resolve issues quickly and effectively.
  • Maintains team knowledge and technical capabilities through ongoing training, cross-training, documentation, and implementation of new technologies, workflows, systems, and operational procedures.
  • Partners with department leadership on managing operational capacity and resource planning to ensure appropriate staffing, technical resources, and infrastructure are available to support daily operations, special events, and evolving business requirements.
  • Develops, implements, and continuously improves operational processes, procedures, and standards to increase efficiency, reliability, consistency, and overall operational effectiveness.
  • Collaborates with senior management and technical leadership to execute strategic initiatives, identify opportunities for improvement, and re-engineer operational workflows and processes when appropriate.
  • Participates in operational transformation, technology implementation, infrastructure upgrades, and continuous-improvement projects while performing additional responsibilities as business needs require.
  • Establishes and maintains strong working relationships with News, Sports, Entertainment, Engineering, and other internal stakeholders, as well as external partners, service providers, and vendors.
  • Supports the development of technicians and engineers to maintain a high level of technical proficiency, operational readiness, and consistent execution of established procedures and standards.
  • Maintains the ability to effectively perform operator-level roles and responsibilities as operational needs require.
  • Works under the direct supervision of Director, Technical Operations and is responsible for completing any other tasks as assigned by Manager or Supervisor as needed

Basic Requirements:

  • Minimum of five (5) years of experience in broadcast operations, transmission operations, technical operations, broadcast engineering, or a related television/media environment, including demonstrated leadership or supervisory experience.

  • Fluent English and Spanish (both written & verbal)

  • Exhibits strong technical knowledge of broadcast transmission workflows and infrastructure, including IP-based video transport, satellite, fiber-optic networks, bonded cellular technology, and other contribution and distribution platforms.
  • Advanced understanding of IP transmission technologies and protocols, including SRT, RTMP/UDP, multicast/unicast workflows, network addressing, port configuration, signal routing, and troubleshooting of IP-based contribution feeds.
  • Demonstrated experience configuring, monitoring, troubleshooting, and supporting satellite, fiber, IP, and bonded transmission paths for live and recorded broadcast operations.
  • Strong understanding of broadcast video and audio standards, including video formats, frame rates, encoding/decoding, audio embedding and mapping, signal conversion, synchronization, and quality-control practices.
  • Prior experience working within a Technical Operations Center, Network Operations Center, Master Control, Transmission Operations Center, or comparable mission-critical broadcast environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot complex technical and operational issues under time-sensitive conditions while maintaining continuity of live broadcast operations.
  • Proven leadership skills with experience supervising, training, mentoring, and developing technical and operational personnel.
  • Ability to effectively manage multiple simultaneous live events, transmission paths, technical resources, and operational priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to respond effectively to changing operational priorities, emergency situations, transmission failures, and other time-sensitive broadcast issues while maintaining a high level of professionalism and attention to detail.

Desired Characteristics:

  • Exceptional communication, time management, analytical and organizational skills with the ability to collaborate effectively with Engineering, News, Sports, Entertainment, Production, vendors, transmission providers, and external partners.
  • Self-starter who exhibits ownership on assigned tasks and who will push for solutions that solve immediate problems while building towards long-term goals
  • Ability to multitask and work in a fast paced, dead-line driven environment
  • Accustomed to working in a team and collaborating with all levels within the organization
  • Ability to build rapport with clients and manage expectations
  • Ability to effectively be flexible in approach, and respond well to pressure
  • Ability to lead and direct others, promote positive work environment and problem solve
  • Process oriented, good at identifying and implementing best practices
  • Change agent, creative and adaptable when facing challenges

Additional Requirements

  • This position is required to be performed full-time from an NBCUniversal-designated worksite.
  • Must be willing to work in Miami, Florida
  • Willingness to travel and work overtime, and on weekends with short notice
  • Must have a valid driver’s license
  • The candidate must be willing to work flexible hours including late and/or last-minute scheduling changes in a 24/7 production work environment.
  • Must be available to work (whenever necessary for show production) early mornings, evenings, holidays and weekends.
  • Must have unrestricted work authorization to work in the United States.
  • Must be covered by Solutions, NBCU’s Alternative Dispute Resolution Program

title: Transport Operator - Brendale
description:
Do you love driving? As an HC driver at ALDI, you can turn driving into a rewarding career. Our Transport Operators serve as the vital link in our supply chain, connecting our warehouses with our stores, and ensuring our customers have access to the products they love.

What does the role involve?

With the opportunity to make a real difference to real people, ALDI is a place you’ll feel proud to work.
