title: Head of Engineering, Field Verification
description:
Who we are

Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month.

As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually.

Why India

Powering that scale takes engineering talent well beyond our home markets - which is where India comes in. India is our second-largest team by headcount, with close to 150 people, and it continues to grow. The team here is one of our strongest, and it has become central to how we build and run our platform globally, with world class team members joining us from Tide, Uber, Flipkat, Amazon, GoTo/Gojek, Paytm, Airtel Payments, Visa, BharatPe, MoneyView, and many others.

So, now we are looking for our Head of Engineering, Field Verification, to join us in India.

About the role

Field Verification is how Moniepoint knows that the people and businesses on our platform are real. Every Moniepoint customer, retail and business, requires a completed field verification as part of KYC. The platform coordinates physical, in-person checks — verifying individuals, business owners, business addresses and loan guarantors — and it serves nearly every part of the company: onboarding, loans, compliance and the fraud team.

The system works today. A back office gives each business unit visibility and control over its own verification requests. A mobile-friendly web app puts the work in the hands of Field Verification Officers and the cluster leads who manage them across local government areas. An API layer lets other business units push verification requests in and receive results back by webhook, and an assignment algorithm routes each request to an officer close enough to carry it out.

We want to be straightforward about the rest. This domain has never had a dedicated engineering leader, and that is the single biggest constraint on it. The team is one lean, cross-functional squad — an Engineering Manager, four engineers and a QA — carrying verification volume for the entire customer base. They have done that impressively well, but running lean means running in keep-the-lights-on mode, and a long list of things that would make this platform substantially better has been waiting for someone to own it.

That list is the role. Trip and route management, so an officer can plan an optimal day across several sites rather than making a separate journey for each one — today we pay for a round trip per verification, and the logistics are nowhere near optimal. Capacity management. A native mobile app, wanted for a long time and never resourced. Liveness and identity verification tooling, exposed as APIs the rest of the business can build on. And as Moniepoint expands into markets where identity verification is as difficult as it is in Nigeria, Kenya among them, a platform that works beyond a single country.

There is a great deal of room to build here. Whoever takes this on will set the direction rather than inherit someone else's plan, on a system that already carries real weight for the business.

As Head of Engineering, Field Verification, your responsibilities will include:

  • Owning the technical strategy, architecture and roadmap for the Field Verification platform end to end, and setting direction for a domain that has been running without dedicated engineering leadership.
  • Moving the platform from keep-the-lights-on operation to deliberate, prioritised development.
  • Leading and growing the existing cross-functional team, and building the organisation out as scope expands.
  • Building the operational efficiency layer — trip and route optimisation, task allocation and capacity management for field officers.
  • Owning the platform's client-facing surface: the APIs and webhooks that other business units integrate with, and the back office those units rely on.
  • Delivering a native mobile experience for field officers.
  • Ensuring verification data is structured, auditable and fit for compliance scrutiny.
  • Building for multi-country expansion as Moniepoint enters new markets.
  • Partnering closely with Product and with the business units that depend on the platform — onboarding, loans, compliance and fraud.
  • Defining architecture standards, engineering processes and quality metrics, and hiring and developing engineers and Engineering Managers.

Who you are

  • You have built things yourself, and grew into leadership from there. We are explicit about this: we are not looking for someone who moved into management early and has led from a distance since. We want an engineer who became a leader.
  • You are capable across disciplines. Backend, web and mobile. This platform spans all three and you will need credibility in each — a specialist in one layer will struggle here.
  • You have built platforms, not just products. Systems used by several distinct groups of users and internal business units, with the flexibility to serve requirements you did not anticipate.
  • You are a problem solver first. We would rather have someone adaptable than someone with the exact domain experience. Having built across different industries — fintech, e-commerce, logistics or otherwise — is a positive signal, not a scattered CV.
  • You have 10+ years of overall software engineering experience, with substantial hands-on production engineering and strong backend depth. Our backend environment is Java and Spring Boot.
  • You have at least 5 years of engineering leadership, including managing Engineering Managers.
  • You collaborate well with product and business stakeholders, and can translate operational requirements into engineering solutions.
  • Experience working with location and geospatial data is a strong plus, including map integrations.
  • Experience with route, trip or delivery optimisation is a strong plus.
  • Experience building for compliance — where data must be structured to evidence what was done and when — is a strong plus.
  • Experience with identity, KYC or verification platforms is a plus. None of these four are requirements.

Cultural Alignment

As well, we assess every candidate across eight dimensions that define how great leaders operate at Moniepoint. We look for evidence of all eight throughout the process, not just in a single conversation.

  • Customer Obsession: Build deep empathy for users. Solve problems intuitively, and fix root causes, not just tickets.
  • Craft: Master the fundamentals. Reason from first principles, make trade-offs explicit, and raise the bar on quality.
  • Systemisation: Turn repeating decisions into scalable mechanisms. Reduce cognitive load and raise engineering quality.
  • Urgency: Move with disciplined speed. Act autonomously within scope, remove friction, and escalate risks early.
  • Ownership: Treat the platform as your own. Take initiative across boundaries and follow through without reminders.
  • No Ego: Put the mission first. Share credit, welcome debate, and never protect status over team outcomes.
  • Candour: Surface uncomfortable truths and risks early. Intelligent failure is welcome; concealment is not.
  • Integrity: Stay truthful and ethically consistent. Refuse toxic behavior. Performance without integrity is unacceptable.

What Success Looks Like

  • The domain has clear technical ownership and direction for the first time.
  • The team out of keep-the-lights-on mode and delivering against a prioritised roadmap.
  • Measurable improvement in field officer efficiency — more verifications per trip, lower cost per verification.
  • A native mobile experience shipped for field officers.
  • Verification data that stands up to compliance scrutiny across every business unit the platform serves.
  • The platform ready to support a new market.
  • A team grown beyond its current size, with a strong bench of engineers and managers.

Why Join Us

  • A genuinely greenfield mandate on a system that already matters. Every customer Moniepoint onboards passes through this platform.
  • A lean, capable team making outsized impact, and the remit to build the organisation around them.
  • Breadth: backend, web, mobile, location data, compliance and operational optimisation in one domain.
  • Be part of a mission-driven company expanding access to financial services for millions of businesses and individuals.

What To Expect in The Hiring Process

  • A preliminary phone call with the recruiter.
  • 60 minute High level System Design round with one of our Engineering Managers.
  • 60 minute Panel Interview with 2 of our Head of Engineering leaders. 30 minutes focused on a technical deep dive into your CV and into a project or system you built in the past. 30 minutes focused on testing for leadership attributes.
  • 60 minute Stakeholder Management Round with one of our Product Heads/VPs, focused on your stakeholder management and collaboration skills with product and business.
  • 60 minute Technical round and Culture fit interview with our Co-founder & Group CTO (the hiring manager).

title: Security Engineer – DevSecOps and Security Architect
description:
About us

PhysicsX is a deep-tech company with roots in numerical physics and Formula One, dedicated to accelerating hardware innovation at the speed of software.
We are building an AI-driven simulation software stack for engineering and manufacturing across advanced industries. By enabling high-fidelity, multi-physics simulation through AI inference across the entire engineering lifecycle, PhysicsX unlocks new levels of optimization and automation in design, manufacturing, and operations — empowering engineers to push the boundaries of possibility. Our customers include leading innovators in Aerospace & Defense, Materials, Energy, Semiconductors, and Automotive.

You’ll bring deep expertise in DevSecOps, application security, hands-on experience securing web applications and APIs, and a strong understanding of modern development workflows. title: Asset Protection Coordinator
description:
POSITION SUMMARY: The Asset Protection Coordinator is an hourly position that directly reports to the Market Asset Protection Manager and will maintain and monitor all asset protection, security, compliance, and safety related functions within a facility. The mission of the Asset Protection team is aimed at reducing shrink, maintaining accurate inventory, maintaining compliance, and ensuring a safe and secure environment for our employees and customers. This mission is achieved through administrative reviews of reports, availability on our sales floor to observe and educate for best practices, and through monitoring compliance with established safety, inventory, and shrink directives.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

  • Assists in driving training and continued development for all Outfitters on all shrink, safety, and security related functions within a store.

  • Monitors criminal cases, appear in court, and testify as warranted.

  • When assigned or authorized, may conduct information gathering and integrity interviews.

  • Assists in investigating irregularities to our Firearms protocols relating to compliance or process concerns.

title: ERP Systems Graduate
description:
Location: Hams Hall, Birmingham (with travel to other Arvato UK sites as required)

Salary: £30,000p.a

Contract: 18 month Graduate Programme

Hours: Full-time 40 hours, Monday to Friday

Launch Your IT Career with Arvato

Are you a technically minded graduate who enjoys understanding how things work, solving problems and finding better ways of doing things?

We’re looking for a ERP Systems Graduate to join Arvato UK in a unique role sitting between our IT and Business Process Management (BPM) teams.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone at the start of their career who has an interest in technology, systems and business processes and wants to develop their skills in a fast-paced, operational environment.

What will you be doing?

You’ll help bridge the gap between our business teams and IT, developing an understanding of how our processes and systems work together and identifying opportunities to improve them.

As you develop within the role, you will:

  • Learn how our ERP and wider business systems support day-to-day operations.
  • Work with IT, Business Process Management and operational teams to understand business requirements.
  • Map and analyse existing business processes.
  • Help identify process issues, inefficiencies and opportunities for improvement.
  • Support the investigation of system and process-related problems.
  • Use data and logical thinking to help identify root causes.
  • Explore how technology, automation and system changes could improve business processes.
  • Help translate business requirements into clear information for technical teams.
  • Support testing and implementation of system and process improvements.
  • Build your technical knowledge and understanding of ERP systems, coding and process management.

What are we looking for?

We don't expect you to arrive knowing everything. This is a graduate opportunity, so we're interested in your technical aptitude, curiosity and potential to develop.

We'd particularly like to hear from graduates with:

  • A degree in IT, Computer Science, Business Information Systems, Software Engineering, Business & Technology or a related subject.
  • An understanding of ERP systems and how technology supports business operations.
  • Some exposure to coding, programming or scripting, either through university, projects or personal learning.
  • An interest in business processes and process improvement.
  • Strong analytical and logical problem-solving skills.
  • A structured and process-driven approach to work.
  • The confidence to ask questions and challenge how things are currently done.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to work with both technical and non-technical colleagues.
  • A genuine interest in developing a career where technology meets business improvement.

What will make you successful?

You don't need to be an experienced developer or ERP specialist.

We're looking for someone who can look at a business problem and think:

“Why is this happening, how does the process work, what is the system doing, and how could we make it better?”

If you're naturally curious, enjoy problem solving and want to build a career combining IT, systems, data and business process improvement, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Incident Operations Commander
description:
Who We Are:

Alpaca is a US-headquartered, global leader in agent-first brokerage infrastructure for stocks, ETFs, options, crypto, fixed income, 24/5 trading, and more.

Amongst our subsidiaries, Alpaca is a licensed financial services company, serving hundreds of financial institutions across 40 countries with our institutional-grade APIs. This includes broker-dealers, investment advisors, wealth managers, hedge funds, and crypto exchanges, totalling over 10 million brokerage accounts.

Our global team is a diverse group of experienced engineers, traders, and brokerage professionals who are working to achieve our mission of opening financial services to everyone on the planet. We're deeply committed to open-source contributions and fostering a vibrant community, continuously enhancing our award-winning, developer-friendly API and the robust infrastructure behind it.

Alpaca is proudly backed by $400 million in funding from top-tier global investors including Portage Ventures, Spark Capital, Tribe Capital, Social Leverage, Horizons Ventures, Opera Tech Ventures, SBI Group, Derayah Financial, Unbound, Peak XV, Elefund, and Y Combinator.

Our Team Members:

We're a dynamic team of 400+ globally distributed members who thrive working from our favorite places around the world, with teammates spanning the USA, Canada, Japan, Hungary, Nigeria, Brazil, the UK, and beyond!

We're searching for passionate individuals eager to contribute to Alpaca's rapid growth. If you align with our core values—Stay Curious, Have Empathy, and Be Accountable—and are ready to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply.

Role

Serve as the on-duty commander for Alpaca's most critical incidents, directing cross-functional response to restore service quickly, keeping the right people engaged and informed, and making sure every incident leaves behind something the organisation can act on.

You do not fix the outage. You make the response reliable: correct severity, the right engineers in the room, mitigation that does not stall, leaders informed in time, and follow-up work that survives the call.

Things You Get To Do

  • Command incidents end to end. Take command from declaration to mitigation, keeping responders focused on stopping customer and partner impact as fast as possible. Run the bridge, keep observers out of the responders' way, and name a stall out loud when you see one.
  • Classify and hold the line on severity. Set severity at declaration and re-check it as facts arrive. Risk advises on financial and regulatory materiality; the call is yours.
  • Engage the right people, fast. Identify the owning team by service, symptom and blast radius, page them, and expand the responder set the moment the first team is wrong or not enough. When a page goes unanswered, escalate - and escalate the escalation. Bring in the leaders who must make business calls: feature flags, traffic shedding, failover, freeze-or-ship.
  • Hold the bridge, and protect the people fixing it. Keep engineering and technical support uninterrupted - questions from stakeholders, partners and executives come to you. Be the single source of truth to the partner communications team on impact, severity and timing: you decide when a status page update or partner contact is needed, they write and send it, and chasing a late or stale update is yours.
  • Run follow-the-sun handoffs. Deliver warm, high-fidelity handoffs across regions: current impact and severity, mitigation path and next actions, who is in the room, outstanding decisions, and what must not be dropped. The incoming commander confirms ownership before you step away - command never goes dark at a region boundary.
  • Close the loop, on the clock. Maintain the timeline of facts as the incident runs rather than reconstructing it afterwards - in a regulated business that record has to hold up long after the call ends. Once mitigated, make sure a blameless retrospective is scheduled with a named owner and a timebox, and record where the cause sits - that choice sets which follow-up items are mandatory. Every action item needs a real ticket, one named accountable, a priority and a category, delivered inside the agreed service level. If a postmortem produces nothing but low-priority items, treat that as a signal the analysis stopped early and escalate to SRE rather than passing it on.
  • Automate the coordination away. Coordination is the part of this job that should eventually belong to a machine. Every manual prompt you send - the update that is due, the question nobody answered, the partner nobody contacted - is a candidate for automation, and the direction we are heading is AI handling the routine so commanders can spend their attention on judgement. You get us there by working to the decision trees, saying where they are wrong, and being honest about which of your instincts are actually rules.

Who You Are (Must-Haves)

  • 4+ years commanding or co-commanding high-severity incidents in a production engineering, SRE or technical operations environment.
  • You direct technical responders under pressure without being the person writing the fix.
  • You make and defend crisp severity and escalation decisions, and you take charge without waiting to be asked. Command means waking senior people at 03:00, interrupting an executive, and telling an experienced engineer to stop what they are doing - with an audience watching. It is a visible, directive role and it needs to be instinctive.
  • You can read a dashboard and judge for yourself whether impact has actually stopped.
  • You communicate clearly with engineers, executives and partner-facing stakeholders - and you know the difference between briefing the comms function and speaking for the company.
  • You are comfortable holding other teams to account in the moment, across a reporting line that is not yours, without turning it into friction.
  • You thrive in a follow-the-sun model with clean cross-region handoffs.
  • You understand FinTech concepts and the trust stakes of API-driven financial platforms.
  • You use AI tools and agentic automation to reduce manual toil and speed up response.
  • You will work a regional coverage window as part of a global 24x7 Incident Commander roster.

Who You Might Be (Nice-to-Haves)

  • Formal incident command training - ITIL, Major Incident Management or crisis management.
  • Experience with modern incident management and on-call platforms.
  • You have written severity rubrics, decision trees, escalation matrices, runbooks or incident playbooks.
  • You have commanded in game days, tabletop exercises or incident simulations, not only in production.
  • You have partnered with problem management or reliability programme functions to roadmap incident follow-ups.
  • Online securities trading or capital markets experience, or another regulated, market-hours-sensitive domain.

How We Take Care of You:

  • Competitive Salary & Stock Options
  • Health Benefits
  • New Hire Home-Office Setup: One-time USD $500
  • Monthly Stipend: USD $150 per month via a Brex Card

Alpaca is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace dedicated to pursuing and hiring a diverse workforce.

title: Head of Engineering, Field Verification
description:
Who we are

Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month.

As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually.

Why Kenya

Kenya is where our next chapter begins. Following our acquisition of Sumac Microfinance Bank, we're preparing to go live — which means the people we hire here help build a business from its first day, not inherit one. How we execute in Kenya will shape how we approach every market we enter after it, making this one of the most consequential engineering mandates in the business right now. This is the natural extension of our mission: to drive financial inclusion, and help millions of business owners and individuals across the African continent achieve financial happiness and success.

So, now we are looking for our Head of Engineering, Field Verification to join us in Kenya.

About the role

Field Verification is how Moniepoint knows that the people and businesses on our platform are real. Every Moniepoint customer, retail and business, requires a completed field verification as part of KYC. The platform coordinates physical, in-person checks — verifying individuals, business owners, business addresses and loan guarantors — and it serves nearly every part of the company: onboarding, loans, compliance and the fraud team.

The system works today. A back office gives each business unit visibility and control over its own verification requests. A mobile-friendly web app puts the work in the hands of Field Verification Officers and the cluster leads who manage them across local government areas. An API layer lets other business units push verification requests in and receive results back by webhook, and an assignment algorithm routes each request to an officer close enough to carry it out.

We want to be straightforward about the rest. This domain has never had a dedicated engineering leader, and that is the single biggest constraint on it. The team is one lean, cross-functional squad — an Engineering Manager, four engineers and a QA — carrying verification volume for the entire customer base. They have done that impressively well, but running lean means running in keep-the-lights-on mode, and a long list of things that would make this platform substantially better has been waiting for someone to own it.

That list is the role. Trip and route management, so an officer can plan an optimal day across several sites rather than making a separate journey for each one — today we pay for a round trip per verification, and the logistics are nowhere near optimal. Capacity management. A native mobile app, wanted for a long time and never resourced. Liveness and identity verification tooling, exposed as APIs the rest of the business can build on. And as Moniepoint expands into markets where identity verification is as difficult as it is in Nigeria, Kenya among them, a platform that works beyond a single country.

There is a great deal of room to build here. Whoever takes this on will set the direction rather than inherit someone else's plan, on a system that already carries real weight for the business.

As Head of Engineering, Field Verification, your responsibilities will include:

  • Owning the technical strategy, architecture and roadmap for the Field Verification platform end to end, and setting direction for a domain that has been running without dedicated engineering leadership.
  • Moving the platform from keep-the-lights-on operation to deliberate, prioritised development.
  • Leading and growing the existing cross-functional team, and building the organisation out as scope expands.
  • Building the operational efficiency layer — trip and route optimisation, task allocation and capacity management for field officers.
  • Owning the platform's client-facing surface: the APIs and webhooks that other business units integrate with, and the back office those units rely on.
  • Delivering a native mobile experience for field officers.
  • Ensuring verification data is structured, auditable and fit for compliance scrutiny.
  • Building for multi-country expansion as Moniepoint enters new markets.
  • Partnering closely with Product and with the business units that depend on the platform — onboarding, loans, compliance and fraud.
  • Defining architecture standards, engineering processes and quality metrics, and hiring and developing engineers and Engineering Managers.

Who you are

  • You have built things yourself, and grew into leadership from there. We are explicit about this: we are not looking for someone who moved into management early and has led from a distance since. We want an engineer who became a leader.
  • You are capable across disciplines. Backend, web and mobile. This platform spans all three and you will need credibility in each — a specialist in one layer will struggle here.
  • You have built platforms, not just products. Systems used by several distinct groups of users and internal business units, with the flexibility to serve requirements you did not anticipate.
  • You are a problem solver first. We would rather have someone adaptable than someone with the exact domain experience. Having built across different industries — fintech, e-commerce, logistics or otherwise — is a positive signal, not a scattered CV.
  • You have 10+ years of overall software engineering experience, with substantial hands-on production engineering and strong backend depth. Our backend environment is Java and Spring Boot.
  • You have at least 5 years of engineering leadership, including managing Engineering Managers.
  • You collaborate well with product and business stakeholders, and can translate operational requirements into engineering solutions.
  • Experience working with location and geospatial data is a strong plus, including map integrations.
  • Experience with route, trip or delivery optimisation is a strong plus.
  • Experience building for compliance — where data must be structured to evidence what was done and when — is a strong plus.
  • Experience with identity, KYC or verification platforms is a plus. None of these four are requirements.

Cultural Alignment

As well, we assess every candidate across eight dimensions that define how great leaders operate at Moniepoint. We look for evidence of all eight throughout the process, not just in a single conversation.

  • Customer Obsession: Build deep empathy for users. Solve problems intuitively, and fix root causes, not just tickets.
  • Craft: Master the fundamentals. Reason from first principles, make trade-offs explicit, and raise the bar on quality.
  • Systemisation: Turn repeating decisions into scalable mechanisms. Reduce cognitive load and raise engineering quality.
  • Urgency: Move with disciplined speed. Act autonomously within scope, remove friction, and escalate risks early.
  • Ownership: Treat the platform as your own. Take initiative across boundaries and follow through without reminders.
  • No Ego: Put the mission first. Share credit, welcome debate, and never protect status over team outcomes.
  • Candour: Surface uncomfortable truths and risks early. Intelligent failure is welcome; concealment is not.
  • Integrity: Stay truthful and ethically consistent. Refuse toxic behavior. Performance without integrity is unacceptable.

What Success Looks Like

  • The domain has clear technical ownership and direction for the first time.
  • The team out of keep-the-lights-on mode and delivering against a prioritised roadmap.
  • Measurable improvement in field officer efficiency — more verifications per trip, lower cost per verification.
  • A native mobile experience shipped for field officers.
  • Verification data that stands up to compliance scrutiny across every business unit the platform serves.
  • The platform ready to support a new market.
  • A team grown beyond its current size, with a strong bench of engineers and managers.

Why Join Us

  • A genuinely greenfield mandate on a system that already matters. Every customer Moniepoint onboards passes through this platform.
  • A lean, capable team making outsized impact, and the remit to build the organisation around them.
  • Breadth: backend, web, mobile, location data, compliance and operational optimisation in one domain.
  • Be part of a mission-driven company expanding access to financial services for millions of businesses and individuals.

What To Expect in The Hiring Process

  • A preliminary phone call with the recruiter.
  • 60 minute High level System Design round with one of our Engineering Managers.
  • 60 minute Panel Interview with 2 of our Head of Engineering leaders. 30 minutes focused on a technical deep dive into your CV and into a project or system you built in the past. 30 minutes focused on testing for leadership attributes.
  • 60 minute Stakeholder Management Round with one of our Product Heads/VPs, focused on your stakeholder management and collaboration skills with product and business.
  • 60 minute Technical round and Culture fit interview with our Co-founder & Group CTO (the hiring manager).

description:
The VP, Conference Strategic Partnerships has a primary focus of supporting Gartner Conferences’ collaboration with our BTI Sales and Global Services & Delivery organizations, ensuring Conference programs, enablement and strategies are in place to capitalize on driving Growth and Retention for Gartner. This role will lead the teams responsible for supporting Conference enablement activities and overall support of regional Sales and Services teams in their journey to conferences, while leading global initiatives to ensure effective collaboration. This role will also play a key role in ensuring the Conference organization has a clear understanding of Gartner’s Sales and Service priorities and how they can best leverage conferences.

In our hybrid work environment, we provide the flexibility and support for you to thrive — working virtually when it's productive to do so and getting together with colleagues in a vibrant community that is purposeful, engaging and inspiring.

title: Junior Operations Client Partner
description:
About the role

As a Junior Operations Client Partner, you will start your career in a role that combines client interaction, project coordination, and data-driven problem solving.

You will work closely with experienced colleagues and gradually develop your ability to support client projects, understand business needs, and contribute to delivering high-quality solutions.

This role is designed for recent graduates, offering structured onboarding, training, and continuous learning opportunities.

What you will do

  • Support day-to-day interactions with clients, helping to respond to operational requests
  • Work alongside experienced team members to understand client requirements and expectations
  • Assist in coordinating projects, timelines, and deliverables
  • Help translate client needs into clear internal tasks and follow up on progress
  • Collaborate with multiple teams across Operations, Customer Success, and Sales
  • Contribute to resolving client queries related to data, delivery timelines, or quality
  • Participate in team meetings, project discussions, and client calls
  • Support quality checks and ensure outputs meet expected standards

What you will learn

During your first months, you will build a strong foundation in:

  • How global clients use data and insights to drive business decisions
  • Project coordination and stakeholder communication
  • Client service fundamentals and account management
  • Data analysis and problem-solving in a real business environment
  • Internal processes and tools used in international operations teams

You will gain hands-on experience working with real client data and develop skills that are highly valued across consulting, analytics, and client-facing roles.

What we’re looking for

  • Recent graduate (Bachelor’s or Master’s degree)

title: Internship for Printed Circuit Board (Iasi)
description:
The SQM (Supplier Quality Department) department’s main goal is to ensure that suppliers fulfill AUMOVIO standards in terms of quality. The SQM department is responsible to ensure that new projects that are being introduced into AUMOVIO will be awarded to the best suppliers, matching the requirements of each particular project. It is the department where extensive improvement projects are carried out in order to bring suppliers to state-of-the-art standards in terms of quality and communication.

All suppliers that produce PCBs for AUMOVIO are audited and released by a SQM Engineer, before any actual production can begin. It is a vital department, for any business, responsible for quality assurance and also tasked with the mission to communicate customer and international requirements down the supply chain and ensure they are fulfilled.

The SQM is often times required to get involved in topics more or less outside of his area of expertise, i.e. logistics, development, purchasing and thus has to have a much broader view on the business, than just quality assurance and acquire more varied knowledge.

Do you want to be a Internship for Printed Circuit Board ? These should spark your interest:

Your responsibilities:

  • Help the SQM Engineers with quality documentation verification , administration and tracking;
  • Create, monitor and close APQP forms (Advanced Product Quality Planning);
  • Review PPAP (Production Part Approval Process) documentation and initiate the approval procedure for the lead SQM engineer;
  • Support in Product/Process Change Notifications release coordination;
  • Work with AUMOVIO quality internal tools;
  • Work in international and multidisciplinary teams;
  • Interact with various AUMOVIO departments;
  • Interact with global PCB suppliers.

You can be a perfect match to our team if you have:

  • Ongoing Master’s degree in a relevant field (mechanics, electronics) and willing to work on a full time program (8h/day);
  • Knowledge of mechanical manufacturing processes (drilling, routing, lamination etc.); chemical processes is a plus;
  • Knowledge of geometric dimensioning & tolerances;
  • Microsoft Office demonstrated skills (Excel, PowerPoint, Word) are required;
  • Fluent in written and spoken English language skills is mandatory;
  • Self-reliant working style, well organized and punctual;
  • Able to prioritize work ;
  • Demonstrates initiatives and adapts quickly.

A mentor will support you to stepwise take over own responsibility after an initial training phase which will familiarize you with our products, tools, processes and organization.

What we offer:

  • Annual bonus;
  • Meal tickets - With a value of 35 Ron;
  • Flexible working time;
  • Referral bonuses - We encourage colleagues to refer new candidates to us and, at the same time, to get the chance to receive a bonus;
  • Private Health Insurance – Health is the most important, so we offer you private medical insurance which offers a wide range of medical services;
  • Discounts at our partners – We collaborate with different vendors, and we receive discounts for various products/ services like rubbers, restaurants;
  • System for Rewarding Improvement Ideas – We have an internal improvement program (Idea Management) that gives you the opportunity to come with ideas and to be honored with an attractive bonus (this is established by the CIM team according to your improvement idea);
  • Happy days – If you or your child is getting married, or you become a parent, you receive some extra free days;
  • Life events celebration - If your family is growing, we praise your newborn with a bonus;
  • Unfortunate events - In case of unhappy events in your life, we support you by offering you free days and financial support (handled on a case-by-case basis);
  • Expect to start your days of annual vacation days from a minimum of 22 days with extending the period proportional to the length of work within AUMOVIO;
  • Sabbatical year - Take up to one year off and come back on the same position, according to our internal policies;
  • Professional development - Many opportunities to develop yourself within the company;
  • Diversity and multicultural mindset - We encourage you to join us no matter who, where, what you are. We have colleagues from different nations and a variety of languages are spoken in our company;
  • In-house restaurant & coffee corner.

Ready to take your career to the next level? The future of mobility isn’t just anyone’s job. ​Make it yours! ​Join AUMOVIO. Own What’s Next.​

Join us for our National Hiring Event:

• (Bass Pro Shops, 18001 Bass Pro Drive, Independence, MO, 64055,

816-795-4300)

Be prepared to interview for various positions on the spot!

Apply prior to arrival to expedite the process at basspro.com/careers.

POSITION SUMMARY:

The Seasonal Events Associate performs duties associated with store events, participates in “short term” assignments and seasonal events to support the store as needed throughout the year.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

  • Support a strong commitment to world class customer service and ensures a pleasant and productive shopping experience for all customers.

  • Provide a legendary experience for every customer, every time by assisting customers in making buying decisions by: identifying and evaluating customers' needs, making product recommendations based off of this analysis and promoting programs including, but not limited to CLUB Membership, VOC and In-Store Pick-up

  • Establish and maintain effective working relationships with Management, coworkers, children and customers.

  • Assist with the execution of seasonal events.

  • Facilitate "in-house" outdoor skills workshops.

  • Participate in Store “events” as scheduled.

  • Keep work area clean, neat and safe at all times.

  • All other duties as assigned

EXPERIENCE/QUALIFICATIONS:

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITY

  • Ability to calculate figures such as discounts and make change to customers

  • Ability to perform data entry, analyze reports and ledgers

  • Ability to communicate in a friendly and professional manner to our customers and other Associates

  • Ability to function in a noisy and hectic environment, with children and parents

TRAVEL REQUIREMENTS:

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Constantly communicate with others to exchange information

  • Occasionally repeat motions that may include the wrists, hands and/or fingers.

  • Occasionally work in low or high temperatures

  • Occasionally work in outdoor elements such as precipitation and wind.

  • Occasionally work in noisy environments

  • Light work that may occasionally require lifting or moving objects weighing up to 100 pounds (utilizing a team lift as needed)

INDEPENDENT JUDGEMENT:

  • Performs tasks and duties under general supervision, using established procedures and innovation. Chooses from limited alternatives to resolve problems. Occasional independent judgment is required to complete work assignments. Often makes recommendations to work procedures, policies, and practices.

Enjoy discounts on retail merchandise, our restaurants, world-class resorts and conservation attractions!

title: TDT CMOS PI
description:
Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all.

Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.

Additional Responsibilities

  • Align TDT CMOS Device development and transfer objectives with Technology Development sites.
  • Drive and ensure close collaboration with Design, TCAD, Modeling, and Product Engineering groups across Micron sites.
  • Collaborate with process integration module owners and process owners to drive electrical characterization of CMOS devices and CMOS circuits and identify device improvement opportunities.
  • Utilize technology development and transfer knowledge to develop new technology nodes to mature manufacturing capability while achieving key program metrics.
  • Ensure CMOS devices meet electrical, performance, power, variability, and reliability targets required for product success.
  • Drive close collaboration with device and process integration development groups at other Technology Development sites.
  • Collaborate closely with manufacturing fabs to facilitate successful technology transfer and production ramp.
  • Contribute to the fundamental understanding of CMOS technology and its impact on overall product figures of merit.
  • Lead cross-functional exploration and development of future CMOS device architectures, including non-planar transistor technologies, by partnering with Device, TCAD, Process Integration, Design, and Manufacturing teams to enable future DRAM technology roadmaps.
  • Drive adoption of AI, machine learning, advanced analytics, and engineering automation solutions to accelerate technology development, root-cause analysis, model generation, and engineering decision-making.
  • Develop and deploy digital methodologies that improve engineering efficiency, data utilization, and development cycle time.

Skills Required / Qualifications

(Candidates are not expected to meet all requirements)

Education

  • PhD or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Physics, Microelectronics, Materials Science, or a related field.

Technical Qualifications

  • Minimum 5 years of semiconductor industry experience with expertise in CMOS device design, process integration, and fabrication technologies. DRAM experience is highly desirable.
  • Strong understanding of semiconductor device physics, transistor fundamentals, process integration, variability, reliability, and characterization techniques.
  • Experience using process and device TCAD simulation tools (Synopsys Sentaurus or equivalent).
  • Experience with data analysis tools such as JMP, CEDA, Python, MATLAB, or equivalent.
  • Experience with DOE methodologies and statistical analysis techniques.
  • Familiarity with advanced CMOS architectures, scaling challenges, and emerging transistor technologies is highly desirable.
  • Experience driving technology development and transfer programs in a manufacturing environment.

AI & Digital Engineering Qualifications

  • Experience applying AI, machine learning, data science, or advanced analytics techniques to semiconductor technology development, process optimization, or engineering problem-solving is preferred.
  • Proficiency in Python, data analytics, automation frameworks, or large-scale data mining methodologies is highly desirable.
  • Experience developing automated engineering workflows, dashboards, predictive models, or AI-assisted solutions is a plus.
  • Ability to leverage Generative AI tools and engineering copilots to improve productivity, technical communication, and development efficiency.
  • Passion for applying emerging AI technologies to transform semiconductor development and manufacturing workflows.

Professional Skills

  • Strong technical leadership and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to lead complex cross-functional initiatives and influence stakeholders across organizations.
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Mandarin fluency preferred.
  • Self-motivated with demonstrated ability to work effectively in a global team environment.

About Micron Technology, Inc.

We are an industry leader in innovative memory and storage solutions transforming how the world uses information to enrich life for all. With a relentless focus on our customers, technology leadership, and manufacturing and operational excellence, Micron delivers a rich portfolio of high-performance DRAM, NAND, and NOR memory and storage products through our Micron® and Crucial® brands. Every day, the innovations that our people create fuel the data economy, enabling advances in artificial intelligence and 5G applications that unleash opportunities — from the data center to the intelligent edge and across the client and mobile user experience.

title: Production Operative
description:
Days, Evenings and Nights Available

Days & Evenings: £24,484.20 per year (£12.90 per hour)
Nights: £24,484.20 plus £3,120 annual night allowance

At Valeo Foods Blackburn, we're growing.

Thanks to new customer wins and increasing demand, we're looking for more people to join our production team and help us create some of the products found in homes and on supermarket shelves across the UK.

If you've ever enjoyed chocolate-coated treats, PoppEggs, Mini Eggs or nougat products, there's a good chance they've started their journey through a factory like ours.

The reality is that none of it happens without great people.

That's where you come in.

Whether you're looking for a fresh start, a stable long-term career, or your first step into manufacturing, we're interested in people with the right attitude. You don't need years of experience. You don't need a perfect CV. You just need to be reliable, willing to learn and ready to be part of a team that takes pride in what it does.

A Typical Day

No two shifts are exactly the same, but you'll spend your time helping to keep our production lines running efficiently and safely.

You might be preparing ingredients, operating machinery, carrying out quality checks, packing finished products or making sure everything is running as it should. Some days will be busy, some will be challenging, but you'll always be surrounded by colleagues who support each other and work together to get the job done.

The products we make are enjoyed by millions of people, and every person on site plays a part in making that happen.

We're much more interested in your attitude than your previous job title.

If you're someone who:

  • Turns up and gives their best
  • Enjoys working as part of a team
  • Takes pride in doing a good job
  • Likes being active and hands-on
  • Wants to learn new skills

then we'd love to hear from you.

Previous manufacturing or factory experience can be helpful, but it isn't essential. Many of our colleagues joined with no experience at all and have gone on to build successful careers with us.

    Days

    Monday to Friday
    7:00am - 3:00pm

    Evenings

    Monday to Friday
    3:00pm - 11:00pm

    Nights

    Sunday to Thursday
    11:00pm - 7:00am

    For many people, this starts as a production role and becomes much more.

    • Cycle to Work scheme

title: Head of Engineering, Field Verification
description:
Who we are

Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month.

As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually.

Why the UK

The UK is home to our headquarters where more than 70 team members are based, with team members joining us from companies like Tide, Klarna, Revolut, Capital One, Teya, Wise, Starling, Monzo, and many others! Our London office is located at Sea Containers, just by London Bridge - this is also where a significant number of our most senior leaders sit, which makes it a natural base for a Head of Engineering.

So, now we are looking for our Head of Engineering, Field Verification to join us in UK.

About The Role

Field Verification is how Moniepoint knows that the people and businesses on our platform are real. Every Moniepoint customer, retail and business, requires a completed field verification as part of KYC. The platform coordinates physical, in-person checks — verifying individuals, business owners, business addresses and loan guarantors — and it serves nearly every part of the company: onboarding, loans, compliance and the fraud team.

The system works today. A back office gives each business unit visibility and control over its own verification requests. A mobile-friendly web app puts the work in the hands of Field Verification Officers and the cluster leads who manage them across local government areas. An API layer lets other business units push verification requests in and receive results back by webhook, and an assignment algorithm routes each request to an officer close enough to carry it out.

We want to be straightforward about the rest. This domain has never had a dedicated engineering leader, and that is the single biggest constraint on it. The team is one lean, cross-functional squad — an Engineering Manager, four engineers and a QA — carrying verification volume for the entire customer base. They have done that impressively well, but running lean means running in keep-the-lights-on mode, and a long list of things that would make this platform substantially better has been waiting for someone to own it.

That list is the role. Trip and route management, so an officer can plan an optimal day across several sites rather than making a separate journey for each one — today we pay for a round trip per verification, and the logistics are nowhere near optimal. Capacity management. A native mobile app, wanted for a long time and never resourced. Liveness and identity verification tooling, exposed as APIs the rest of the business can build on. And as Moniepoint expands into markets where identity verification is as difficult as it is in Nigeria, Kenya among them, a platform that works beyond a single country.

There is a great deal of room to build here. Whoever takes this on will set the direction rather than inherit someone else's plan, on a system that already carries real weight for the business.

As Head of Engineering, Field Verification, your responsibilities will include:

  • Owning the technical strategy, architecture and roadmap for the Field Verification platform end to end, and setting direction for a domain that has been running without dedicated engineering leadership.
  • Moving the platform from keep-the-lights-on operation to deliberate, prioritised development.
  • Leading and growing the existing cross-functional team, and building the organisation out as scope expands.
  • Building the operational efficiency layer — trip and route optimisation, task allocation and capacity management for field officers.
  • Owning the platform's client-facing surface: the APIs and webhooks that other business units integrate with, and the back office those units rely on.
  • Delivering a native mobile experience for field officers.
  • Ensuring verification data is structured, auditable and fit for compliance scrutiny.
  • Building for multi-country expansion as Moniepoint enters new markets.
  • Partnering closely with Product and with the business units that depend on the platform — onboarding, loans, compliance and fraud.
  • Defining architecture standards, engineering processes and quality metrics, and hiring and developing engineers and Engineering Managers.

Who You Are

  • You have built things yourself, and grew into leadership from there. We are explicit about this: we are not looking for someone who moved into management early and has led from a distance since. We want an engineer who became a leader.
  • You are capable across disciplines. Backend, web and mobile. This platform spans all three and you will need credibility in each — a specialist in one layer will struggle here.
  • You have built platforms, not just products. Systems used by several distinct groups of users and internal business units, with the flexibility to serve requirements you did not anticipate.
  • You are a problem solver first. We would rather have someone adaptable than someone with the exact domain experience. Having built across different industries — fintech, e-commerce, logistics or otherwise — is a positive signal, not a scattered CV.
  • You have 10+ years of overall software engineering experience, with substantial hands-on production engineering and strong backend depth. Our backend environment is Java and Spring Boot.
  • You have at least 5 years of engineering leadership, including managing Engineering Managers.
  • You collaborate well with product and business stakeholders, and can translate operational requirements into engineering solutions.
  • Experience working with location and geospatial data is a strong plus, including map integrations.
  • Experience with route, trip or delivery optimisation is a strong plus.
  • Experience building for compliance — where data must be structured to evidence what was done and when — is a strong plus.
  • Experience with identity, KYC or verification platforms is a plus. None of these four are requirements.

Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month.

As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually.

Why Poland

Poland is a new and deliberate addition to our engineering map. We recently made our first technology hire in the country, and we are looking at Poland as a long-term strategic location for senior hires, particularly within our engineering organisation. Joining now means joining early, and helping shape what our presence here becomes.

So, now we are looking for our Head of Engineering, Sales & Marketing Tools, to join us in Poland.

About The Role

Sales and Marketing Tools owns MonieCRM, the operating system for Moniepoint's 50,000-strong sales network. This is not a CRM we bought — it is a workforce operations platform built entirely in-house for a multi-level field sales hierarchy, and it is how those teams run their day to day: the portfolio of businesses they manage, their own teams, their goals and performance, the physical and digital resources they need in the field, and an emerging AI-assisted support layer. Sixteen capabilities span onboarding and network management, pipeline and portfolio, performance and goals, compensation, and sales experience and support.

A significant part of the domain moves money. The platform owns wallets, commission calculation and attribution, cashout and welfare funds for a network that drives the overwhelming majority of company revenue — which makes financial correctness, not just availability, a core engineering requirement of the role.

Alongside that, the domain covers partner management, a rewards and retention platform serving tens of millions of users, and our marketing technology stack, including the engineering and customisation of Braze, the platform we use for customer engagement. The mandate is modernisation and reliability: re-architecting systems that have grown very quickly and making them dependable at a scale of more than 20 million users. This is a platform engineering and legacy modernisation challenge first and foremost, and prior CRM or SalesTech experience is genuinely not required.

Who You Are

  • You have 10–15 years of overall software engineering experience, with at least 5 years leading engineering teams through growth phases.
  • 5+ years of hands-on, production-level experience writing and shipping Java code as a practising engineer. This means years spent writing Java yourself, not years spent overseeing teams who write it.
  • At least 5 years of experience managing managers — leading an engineering organisation through other engineering leaders, rather than running a single team.
  • You have proven platform engineering experience at scale — building and running complex distributed systems, not feature delivery alone.
  • You have navigated legacy migrations and re-architecture projects at 20M+ user scale.
  • You have strong backend engineering skills in high-throughput, data-intensive distributed systems, and are proficient in Java and Spring Boot.
  • You have managed and developed large engineering teams of 20 or more members.
  • Experience building systems where financial correctness matters — commissions, payouts, wallets, ledgers or equivalent — is a strong advantage.
  • A fintech or payments background is strongly preferred. CRM or SalesTech domain experience is nice to have and explicitly not required.
  • Exposure to customer engagement or marketing automation platforms such as Braze is a plus, but not a requirement.

Cultural Alignment

As well, we assess every candidate across eight dimensions that define how great leaders operate at Moniepoint. We look for evidence of all eight throughout the process, not just in a single conversation.

  • Customer Obsession: Build deep empathy for users. Solve problems intuitively, and fix root causes, not just tickets.
  • Craft: Master the fundamentals. Reason from first principles, make trade-offs explicit, and raise the bar on quality.
  • Systemisation: Turn repeating decisions into scalable mechanisms. Reduce cognitive load and raise engineering quality.
  • Urgency: Move with disciplined speed. Act autonomously within scope, remove friction, and escalate risks early.
  • Ownership: Treat the platform as your own. Take initiative across boundaries and follow through without reminders.
  • No Ego: Put the mission first. Share credit, welcome debate, and never protect status over team outcomes.
  • Candour: Surface uncomfortable truths and risks early. Intelligent failure is welcome; concealment is not.
  • Integrity: Stay truthful and ethically consistent. Refuse toxic behavior. Performance without integrity is unacceptable.

What Success Looks Like

  • The domain has clear technical ownership and direction for the first time.
  • The team out of keep-the-lights-on mode and delivering against a prioritised roadmap.
  • Measurable improvement in field officer efficiency — more verifications per trip, lower cost per verification.
  • A native mobile experience shipped for field officers.
  • Verification data that stands up to compliance scrutiny across every business unit the platform serves.
  • The platform ready to support a new market.
  • A team grown beyond its current size, with a strong bench of engineers and managers.

Why Join Us

  • A genuinely greenfield mandate on a system that already matters. Every customer Moniepoint onboards passes through this platform.
  • A lean, capable team making outsized impact, and the remit to build the organisation around them.
  • Breadth: backend, web, mobile, location data, compliance and operational optimisation in one domain.
  • Be part of a mission-driven company expanding access to financial services for millions of businesses and individuals.

What To Expect in The Hiring Process

  • A preliminary phone call with the recruiter.
  • 60 minute High level System Design round with one of our Engineering Managers.
  • 60 minute Panel Interview with 2 of our Head of Engineering leaders. 30 minutes focused on a technical deep dive into your CV and into a project or system you built in the past. 30 minutes focused on testing for leadership attributes.
  • 60 minute Stakeholder Management Round with one of our Product Heads/VPs, focused on your stakeholder management and collaboration skills with product and business.
  • 60 minute Technical round and Culture fit interview with our Co-founder & Group CTO (the hiring manager).

Moniepoint is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to building an inclusive organisation.

title: Yield Enhancement SEM & ETM Process Shift Technician
description:
Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all.

Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.

Job Summary:

Micron Technology is seeking driven and thorough Yield Enhancement Failure Analysis (YE FA) Lab SEM & ETM Process Technicians. In this role, you will perform inline targeting procedures using SEM (Scanning Electron Microscope) and ETM tools (including Exsolve, TEM Link, and Metrios) to capture high-quality images. These procedures will follow either customized customer instructions or standardized protocols. As a key contributor to the world’s leading memory and storage solutions provider, you will be at the forefront of innovation. This position requires a strong sense of responsibility and enthusiasm, reflecting Micron’s core values: People, Innovation, Tenacity, Collaboration, and Customer Focus.

Responsibilities:

  • Performs SEM analysis requests following detailed instructions, applying basic cross-sectioning techniques for sample preparation and ETM analysis.

  • Prioritizes SEM and ETM tasks based on the current request queue, coordinating with supervisors to adjust priorities when necessary.

  • Collaborate with customers, peers, and supervisors to clarify instructions and ensure accurate, targeted results.

  • Completes analysis requests by interpreting collected data and providing well-supported conclusions.

  • Certified and trained to operate all necessary lab equipment for SEM and ETM analysis, while strictly adhering to safety protocols.

  • Proactively identifies and reports minor equipment issues to prevent major disruptions, supporting overall lab efficiency.

  • Maintains all required training certifications in accordance with area guidelines.

  • Keeps up-to-date technical knowledge of device structures and functions for both current and upcoming components.

  • Recommends process improvements and partners with leadership to implement effective changes.

  • Actively shares knowledge and insights to support team collaboration and continuous learning.

AI-Enabled Analysis and Productivity

title: MTS 2, Software Engineer (BackEnd)
description:
At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Join eBay’s Advertising and Marketing Technology teams to build the platforms, services, and user experiences that help sellers grow their business and make eBay the destination website for existing and new customers. You’ll work on high-scale systems spanning frontend applications, backend services, APIs, data pipelines, and AI-assisted engineering workflows, partnering closely with product, design, analytics, and applied science. We’re looking for engineers who can turn business problems into reliable, maintainable software, make sound technical tradeoffs, and take ownership from design through production. This role is a strong fit for someone who enjoys solving practical engineering problems in a fast-moving environment where performance, quality, and measurable customer impact matter.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Design and build innovative advertising, marketing platform features that help eBay sellers, advertisers grow their business and help eBay become the dominant eCommerce platform.

  • Develop scalable, highly available applications, APIs, and services using technologies such as Marko, React, Node.js, Java, and Scala.

  • Own end-to-end delivery of complex features, from technical design and architecture through deployment and production support.

  • Drive technical decisions, system design, and cross-team collaboration to ensure scalable, reliable, and maintainable solutions.

  • Leverage AI-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude Code) throughout the development lifecycle for coding, debugging, testing, and code review to increase engineering velocity.

  • Contribute to AI-powered advertising and marketing features by collaborating with ML engineers on LLM integrations, recommendation systems, and intelligent campaign optimization.

  • Contribute to a culture of continuous learning, Agile development, open-source collaboration, and rapid software delivery.

  • Mentor team members, participate in technical discussions, and help shape engineering best practices across the organization.

Job Requirements:

  • BS/BA in Computer Science or related field plus 8 years work experience or MS with 6 years of relevant experience.

  • Strong experience in Java (17+) and building services with Spring Boot or similar frameworks.

  • Experience building scalable backend systems and RESTful APIs in distributed environments.

  • Experience with event-driven architectures and message queues (Kafka, RabbitMQ, or similar).

  • Experience with relational (Oracle/Postgres/MySQL) and/or NoSQL (Cassandra/MongoDB) databases, including schema design and query optimization.

  • Familiar with Big Data stack (Hadoop, Spark, Flink etc).

  • Proven ability to own end-to-end system design: writing technical design documents, leading design reviews, and making architectural decisions for multi-service features.

  • Experience designing scalable distributed systems with a track record of evaluating trade-offs. (consistency, availability, latency, cost) and driving technical alignment across teams.

  • Experience with AI-assisted development practices and tools to increase engineering productivity (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, or equivalent).

  • Experience building or integrating LLM-powered features, agentic workflows, or AI-driven automation in production systems is a plus.

  • Strong ownership mentality with ability to drive work end-to-end in a collaborative environment.

  • Exposure to GraphQL and experience in building Federated GraphQL APIs is highly desirable.

  • Experience on contributing to open-source is a plus.

title: Mission Assurance Engineer, OPS - Millennium Space Systems
description:
Mission Assurance Engineer, OPS - Millennium Space Systems

Company:

Millennium Space Systems

Millennium Space Systems, a part of Boeing Defense, Space and Security (BDS), is a fast, agile small satellite company focused on national security space. Our missions have direct impact to global security, like missile warning and Earth observation.

Our team is curious, bold and innovative. We take risks, innovate and explore new techniques and technologies. We influence change because we challenge the status quo. And when we watch our satellites launch, we know each one of us made it happen.

Job Summary

As an Operations Systems Engineer supporting the Mission Assurance team, you will serve as the independent interface between our internal operations team and program customers. This role is strategic and cross-functional, designed to revolutionize how we operate our on-orbit vehicles. You will independently approach on-orbit activities seeking to preemptively identify and solve challenging engineering problems and find the solutions that lead to mission success by evaluating program designs within the context of risk and opportunity. Your mission is to systematically identify, define, and integrate mission assurance principles across the entire satellite lifecycle to drive significant increases in efficiency, quality, and mission success. Mission Operations requires composure in high-pressure situations, in-depth knowledge of both the space vehicles and ground segment, and an ability to respond to anomalous scenarios in real-time. You will be directly responsible for Millennium’s critical assets.

This position's internal job code is Systems Engineer. Our team is currently hiring for a Level 3 and 4.

Responsibilities

  • Coordinate mission assurance efforts, including risk management, discrepancy resolution, and design review, for one or more programs as the Program Mission Assurance Engineer

  • Ensure appropriate implementation of previous corrective actions and lessons learned to the current operations environment

  • Translate complex engineering and operational challenges into clear, actionable requirements and lessons learned for upcoming programs

  • Review and understand the operational architecture strategy for both space and ground segments, including command and control, mission planning, mission data processing, and the associated infrastructure to support all activities in the context of the mission and associated risks

  • Work and coordinate with integration, testing, and mission operation crews to review, generate, and implement necessary training prior to critical mission events

  • Provide oversight for lead technical authorities during mission operations for both the space and ground segments

  • Be the focal for customer and internal leadership during critical mission activities

  • Contribute to oversight of nominal on-orbit operations for Millennium’s entire fleet of on-orbit spacecraft

  • Participate in mission operations and anomaly resolution efforts

This position is expected to be 100% onsite. The selected candidate will be required to work onsite at one of the listed location options.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor of Science degree in Engineering, Engineering Technology (including Manufacturing Technology), Computer Science, Data Science, Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry or non-US equivalent qualifications directly related to the work statement

  • 5+ years experience with at least 3+ years related to real-time satellite or launch vehicle command and control

  • Working knowledge of satellite subsystems, ground systems, space missions, and/or OPSCON design

  • Experience delivering operational products to customer environments

  • Willingness to support occasional off-nominal working hours during critical 24/7 mission operations activities

  • This position requires the ability to obtain a U.S. Security Clearance for which the U.S. Government requires U.S. Citizenship. A final U.S. clearance Post Start is required

Preferred Qualifications

  • Active TS/SCI clearance

  • Advance degree in Aerospace, Electrical, Software, Computer, Mechanical Engineering, or related field

  • Experience in leading multidisciplinary technical teams, especially to resolve anomalous scenarios

  • Experience with external customer briefing/interfacing

  • Deep knowledge of satellite systems engineering, including all satellite subsystems

  • Guidance, Navigation, and Control; Electrical Power; Thermal Control; Telemetry, Tracking, and Command; Propulsion; etc.

  • Experience with iterative and agile processes

  • Knowledge of orbital dynamics, maneuver planning, and orbit determination techniques

  • Experience designing fault detection and response, as well as designing space vehicle autonomy

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with a proven ability to understand complex workflows and translate complex technical concepts between different audiences

title: Lead AI Engineer
description:
About this role:

Wells Fargo is seeking a Lead AI Engineer.

In this role, you will:

  • Lead the design, development, and deployment of enterprise-scale AI platforms and GenAI solutions, leveraging LLMs, Agentic AI, RAG, and knowledge retrieval architectures.
  • Architect and deliver scalable Python-based applications, APIs, microservices, and data engineering pipelines using cloud-native and distributed processing technologies.
  • Establish engineering standards, best practices, and AI/LLMOps frameworks to ensure secure, reliable, and production-ready AI solutions across the organization.
  • Collaborate with senior technology leaders, data engineers, architects, and business stakeholders to solve complex technical challenges and drive innovation at scale.
  • Mentor engineering teams and lead strategic technology initiatives, accelerating adoption of emerging AI technologies while delivering measurable business value.

Required Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of Software Engineering experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education.

Desired Qualifications

  • Strong software engineering background with 8+ years of experience developing and delivering enterprise-scale applications, platforms, and distributed systems, with expert proficiency in Python, object-oriented design, design patterns, asynchronous programming, API development, automation, performance tuning, and debugging.
  • Extensive experience in data engineering and large-scale data processing, including the design and implementation of scalable ETL/ELT pipelines, data ingestion frameworks, orchestration solutions, and transformation processes using technologies such as Spark, Pandas, Databricks, and other distributed computing platforms.
  • Proven hands-on experience building production-grade Generative AI solutions, with at least 3+ years focused on LLM-based applications, utilizing GPT and enterprise LLMs, LangChain, LangGraph, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Agentic AI, multi-agent systems, prompt engineering, embeddings, and semantic retrieval techniques.
  • Demonstrated success designing and deploying enterprise AI applications, including AI assistants, copilots, intelligent chatbots, knowledge retrieval platforms, document intelligence systems, and AI-driven automation solutions that deliver measurable business value.
  • Deep understanding of knowledge management and search architectures, including vector databases and retrieval technologies such as Pinecone, OpenSearch, FAISS, ChromaDB, Neo4j knowledge graphs, semantic search, NLP, and information retrieval frameworks.
  • Strong experience building REST APIs, microservices, and cloud-native applications with scalable, secure architectures leveraging cloud platforms such as GCP and associated AI/ML services.
  • Solid expertise in database technologies, including SQL, NoSQL, graph databases, data modeling, and enterprise data architecture principles.
  • Strong understanding of modern software engineering practices, including CI/CD, DevOps, automated testing, code reviews, observability, security, Agile methodologies, AI/LLMOps, and production deployment frameworks.

Job Expectations:

  • Demonstrate deep expertise in Python development, building scalable, high-performance applications, automation frameworks, APIs, and enterprise-grade solutions using modern software engineering principles.
  • Design and implement robust data engineering and ETL pipelines leveraging Databricks, Spark, and distributed processing frameworks to ingest, transform, enrich, and manage large-scale structured and unstructured datasets.
  • Architect and deliver Generative AI solutions using Large Language Models (LLMs), Agentic AI, LangChain, LangGraph, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) frameworks to solve complex business challenges and enhance developer productivity.
  • Develop and optimize knowledge retrieval platforms through semantic search, vector databases (Pinecone, OpenSearch, FAISS), Neo4j knowledge graphs, embeddings, and advanced information retrieval techniques.
  • Build secure, scalable, and cloud-native enterprise AI applications including copilots, intelligent assistants, automation platforms, and document intelligence solutions using microservices, APIs, AI/LLMOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, and production deployment frameworks.

  • Understand the methods, principles, and practices required for the operation and maintenance of the mechanical, plumbing and electrical systems.
