title: Head of Engineering, Field Verification
description:
Who we are

Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month.

As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually.

Why Portugal

We have a small but strong group of team members in Portugal, having joined us from companies like Feedzai and OLX. As we continue to build out our engineering organisation across Europe, Portugal is a market we are actively hiring into.

So, now we are looking for our Head of Engineering, Field Verification to join us in Portugal.

About the role

Field Verification is how Moniepoint knows that the people and businesses on our platform are real. Every Moniepoint customer, retail and business, requires a completed field verification as part of KYC. The platform coordinates physical, in-person checks — verifying individuals, business owners, business addresses and loan guarantors — and it serves nearly every part of the company: onboarding, loans, compliance and the fraud team.

The system works today. A back office gives each business unit visibility and control over its own verification requests. A mobile-friendly web app puts the work in the hands of Field Verification Officers and the cluster leads who manage them across local government areas. An API layer lets other business units push verification requests in and receive results back by webhook, and an assignment algorithm routes each request to an officer close enough to carry it out.

We want to be straightforward about the rest. This domain has never had a dedicated engineering leader, and that is the single biggest constraint on it. The team is one lean, cross-functional squad — an Engineering Manager, four engineers and a QA — carrying verification volume for the entire customer base. They have done that impressively well, but running lean means running in keep-the-lights-on mode, and a long list of things that would make this platform substantially better has been waiting for someone to own it.

That list is the role. Trip and route management, so an officer can plan an optimal day across several sites rather than making a separate journey for each one — today we pay for a round trip per verification, and the logistics are nowhere near optimal. Capacity management. A native mobile app, wanted for a long time and never resourced. Liveness and identity verification tooling, exposed as APIs the rest of the business can build on. And as Moniepoint expands into markets where identity verification is as difficult as it is in Nigeria, Kenya among them, a platform that works beyond a single country.

There is a great deal of room to build here. Whoever takes this on will set the direction rather than inherit someone else's plan, on a system that already carries real weight for the business.

As Head of Engineering, Field Verification, your responsibilities will include:

  • Owning the technical strategy, architecture and roadmap for the Field Verification platform end to end, and setting direction for a domain that has been running without dedicated engineering leadership.
  • Moving the platform from keep-the-lights-on operation to deliberate, prioritised development.
  • Leading and growing the existing cross-functional team, and building the organisation out as scope expands.
  • Building the operational efficiency layer — trip and route optimisation, task allocation and capacity management for field officers.
  • Owning the platform's client-facing surface: the APIs and webhooks that other business units integrate with, and the back office those units rely on.
  • Delivering a native mobile experience for field officers.
  • Ensuring verification data is structured, auditable and fit for compliance scrutiny.
  • Building for multi-country expansion as Moniepoint enters new markets.
  • Partnering closely with Product and with the business units that depend on the platform — onboarding, loans, compliance and fraud.
  • Defining architecture standards, engineering processes and quality metrics, and hiring and developing engineers and Engineering Managers.

Who you are

  • You have built things yourself, and grew into leadership from there. We are explicit about this: we are not looking for someone who moved into management early and has led from a distance since. We want an engineer who became a leader.
  • You are capable across disciplines. Backend, web and mobile. This platform spans all three and you will need credibility in each — a specialist in one layer will struggle here.
  • You have built platforms, not just products. Systems used by several distinct groups of users and internal business units, with the flexibility to serve requirements you did not anticipate.
  • You are a problem solver first. We would rather have someone adaptable than someone with the exact domain experience. Having built across different industries — fintech, e-commerce, logistics or otherwise — is a positive signal, not a scattered CV.
  • You have 10+ years of overall software engineering experience, with substantial hands-on production engineering and strong backend depth. Our backend environment is Java and Spring Boot.
  • You have at least 5 years of engineering leadership, including managing Engineering Managers.
  • You collaborate well with product and business stakeholders, and can translate operational requirements into engineering solutions.
  • Experience working with location and geospatial data is a strong plus, including map integrations.
  • Experience with route, trip or delivery optimisation is a strong plus.
  • Experience building for compliance — where data must be structured to evidence what was done and when — is a strong plus.
  • Experience with identity, KYC or verification platforms is a plus. None of these four are requirements.

Cultural Alignment

As well, we assess every candidate across eight dimensions that define how great leaders operate at Moniepoint. We look for evidence of all eight throughout the process, not just in a single conversation.

  • Customer Obsession: Build deep empathy for users. Solve problems intuitively, and fix root causes, not just tickets.
  • Craft: Master the fundamentals. Reason from first principles, make trade-offs explicit, and raise the bar on quality.
  • Systemisation: Turn repeating decisions into scalable mechanisms. Reduce cognitive load and raise engineering quality.
  • Urgency: Move with disciplined speed. Act autonomously within scope, remove friction, and escalate risks early.
  • Ownership: Treat the platform as your own. Take initiative across boundaries and follow through without reminders.
  • No Ego: Put the mission first. Share credit, welcome debate, and never protect status over team outcomes.
  • Candour: Surface uncomfortable truths and risks early. Intelligent failure is welcome; concealment is not.
  • Integrity: Stay truthful and ethically consistent. Refuse toxic behavior. Performance without integrity is unacceptable.

What Success Looks Like

  • The domain has clear technical ownership and direction for the first time.
  • The team out of keep-the-lights-on mode and delivering against a prioritised roadmap.
  • Measurable improvement in field officer efficiency — more verifications per trip, lower cost per verification.
  • A native mobile experience shipped for field officers.
  • Verification data that stands up to compliance scrutiny across every business unit the platform serves.
  • The platform ready to support a new market.
  • A team grown beyond its current size, with a strong bench of engineers and managers.

Why Join Us

  • A genuinely greenfield mandate on a system that already matters. Every customer Moniepoint onboards passes through this platform.
  • A lean, capable team making outsized impact, and the remit to build the organisation around them.
  • Breadth: backend, web, mobile, location data, compliance and operational optimisation in one domain.
  • Be part of a mission-driven company expanding access to financial services for millions of businesses and individuals.

What To Expect in The Hiring Process

  • A preliminary phone call with the recruiter.
  • 60 minute High level System Design round with one of our Engineering Managers.
  • 60 minute Panel Interview with 2 of our Head of Engineering leaders. 30 minutes focused on a technical deep dive into your CV and into a project or system you built in the past. 30 minutes focused on testing for leadership attributes.
  • 60 minute Stakeholder Management Round with one of our Product Heads/VPs, focused on your stakeholder management and collaboration skills with product and business.
  • 60 minute Technical round and Culture fit interview with our Co-founder & Group CTO (the hiring manager).

description:
Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all.

Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.

Our Yield Analysis team plays a critical role in enabling Micron’s next generation memory products and supporting the historic expansion of our Boise manufacturing site. We combine deep semiconductor expertise, advanced analytics, and cross-functional collaboration to accelerate yield learning, improve product quality, and drive manufacturing excellence. Join a team that is shaping the future of semiconductor innovation through data-driven problem solving and continuous improvement.
As a Deviation & Yield Tail Yield Analysis Engineer, you will lead efforts to identify, characterize, and resolve yield loss mechanisms that impact manufacturing performance. This role offers the opportunity to leverage advanced analytics, AI-enabled tools, failure analysis, and model-based problem solving to uncover root causes, drive corrective actions, and deliver sustainable yield improvement across high-volume manufacturing operations.
Responsibilities:
  • Monitor probe yield performance to identify yield deviations, yield-tail losses, emerging failure signatures, and excursion events using lot, wafer, die, bitmap, and parametric analysis
  • Lead MBPS and root cause investigations using hypothesis-driven problem solving, statistical analysis, fault trees, and process correlation techniques to achieve verified physical root cause
  • Drive defect characterization and failure analysis activities by correlating electrical signatures, inspection data, EFA/PFA findings, and yield-loss mechanisms
  • Partner with Process Integration, Process Engineering, RDA, Quality, Manufacturing, and Failure Analysis teams to implement and validate corrective and preventive actions
  • Develop and deploy analytics, dashboards, automation solutions, and AI-enabled workflows that improve issue sourcing, RCA efficiency, and yield performance
Minimum Qualifications:
  • Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Materials Science, Physics, or a related technical discipline
  • 10+ years of semiconductor industry experience
  • 10+ years of experience in semiconductor physics, transistor operation, scaling limitations, reliability fundamentals, and CMOS characterization methods
  • 7+ years of experience using data analysis tools such as JMP, Python, or similar software
  • Demonstrated experience performing data-driven yield analysis and root cause investigations in a semiconductor manufacturing environment
Preferred Qualifications:
  • DRAM manufacturing experience
  • 5+ years of experience in yield-tail analysis, yield deviation sourcing, or RDA within a manufacturing or high-volume manufacturing environment
  • Experience using AI-assisted analytics to enhance data interpretation, anomaly detection, and yield improvement initiatives
  • Experience developing automation, dashboards, or AI-enabled solutions that improve engineering productivity and problem-solving effectiveness

As a world leader in the semiconductor industry, Micron is dedicated to your personal wellbeing and professional growth. Micron benefits are designed to help you stay well, provide peace of mind and help you prepare for the future. title: Due Diligence Consultant
description:
About this role:

Wells Fargo is seeking a Due Diligence Consultant (DDC) in Financial Crimes Operations as part of Enterprise Functions. Learn more about the career areas and lines of business at wellsfargojobs.com. The Transactional Risk & Intelligence Group (TRIG) is a centralized function within Financial Crimes Operations that delivers actionable transactional analysis and intelligence reporting. TRIG is seeking a DDC to perform transaction-based reviews of customers with elevated and complex risk profiles to generate actionable recommendations to line of business risk management teams. In this role, the DDC will support in executing Financial Institutions Group (FIG) correspondent banking reviews and complex financial intermediary reviews.


In this role, you will:

  • Own client onboarding process to mitigate risk through a due diligence process
  • Participate in conducting less complex client due diligence processes, research and identify opportunities to mitigate risk
  • Consult and provide support to interpret policies, guidelines and governance programs
  • Support business in execution of due diligence reporting processes and controls
  • Review and analyze client onboarding processes or challenges that require research, evaluation, and selection of alternatives
  • Exercise independent judgment to guide medium risk deliverables
  • Aggregate, evaluate and report results and escalate where necessary
  • Present recommendations for resolving more complex situations and exercise independent judgment while developing expertise in the due diligence function, policies, procedures and compliance requirements
  • Collaborate and consult with peers, colleagues, managers and internal and external customers to resolve issues and achieve goals
  • Conduct deep due diligence research on high-risk customers and analyze customer transactions and demographic data points to identify new or emerging customer financial crimes risks, and/or customers presenting a heightened risk within a portfolio.
  • Evaluate moderate to high complexity customer to determine appropriate level of escalation and ultimate recommendation, in consultation with manager/team lead/reviewer.
  • Work with 1,000s of rows and cells of data in Microsoft Excel to perform the analysis on data points ranging from geography to transactional values and volumes to relational data.
  • Work with the group’s data partners, mid-level managers, and cross-functional business partners to develop strategies, techniques, and tools to facilitate the advancement of reviews.
  • Write transactional reports with bolstered observations and risk dispositions that help business partners better understand customer’s behavior and manage the risk.
  • Communicate findings and provide appropriate direction to manager/team lead/reviewer and business partners.
  • Participate in low to moderately complexity project initiatives.
  • File unusual activity reports in a timely manner.
  • Maintain organized and detailed documentation of review results or recommendations by following all established procedures/processes.


Required Qualifications:

  • 2+ years of Due Diligence experience, or equivalent (including risk management, client service, operations support, or business process management) demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education


Desired Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Accounting, Economics, National Security & Intelligence Studies or other relevant field.
  • BSA/AML compliance experience and/or experience and understanding of risk management principles; financial crimes risk management experience highly preferred
  • Knowledge of Wells Fargo systems (WCIS, Cornerstone, Hogan, OIB, etc.) and products (wires, ACH, check products, cash vault, etc.).
  • Industry certifications (e.g., CAMS certified and/or Wells Fargo AML/Sanctions Credential Program, etc.).
  • Strong computer skills utilizing Microsoft Office Suite with in-depth Excel experience (including Pivot Tables and performing analysis of large data sets). Must be highly proficient in the use of Microsoft PowerPoint and Word. Knowledge and experience with SharePoint, Tableau, and other similar applications is desired.
  • Ability to evaluate risks and to communicate relevant risk in a simple, decisive, timely and market-appropriate manner.
  • Foreign language skills.
  • Ability to manage large and complex sets of data.
  • Ability to build strong partnerships and to work across multiple cultures. Proven interpersonal, organization, and presentation skills.
  • Strong verbal and written communications


Job Expectations:

Schedule:

  • Schedule: Monday thru Friday, 8:00 am - 5:00pm

Training:

  • You will be receive in-depth on-the-job training, and coaching to learn about Wells Fargo banking products, procedures, and services.
  • Training will be for 90 days Monday thru Friday, 8:00 am - 5:00 pm on the job. You are required to attend the full duration of 90 days training
  • This position is Hybrid after training
  • This position is not eligible for Visa sponsorship

Posting Location: 401 Las Colinas Blvd, Irving TX

  • (Selected candidate must reside within a commutable distance to this location and must be able to work on-site at the posted location )

13 Sep 2026

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other legally protected characteristic.

Employees support our focus on building strong customer relationships balanced with a strong risk mitigating and compliance-driven culture which firmly establishes those disciplines as critical to the success of our customers and company. They are accountable for execution of all applicable risk programs (Credit, Market, Financial Crimes, Operational, Regulatory Compliance), which includes effectively following and adhering to applicable Wells Fargo policies and procedures, appropriately fulfilling risk and compliance obligations, timely and effective escalation and remediation of issues, and making sound risk decisions. title: OSHC Coordinator (Qualified) | Cockburn Area

Join eBay’s Advertising and Marketing Technology teams to build the platforms, services, and user experiences that help sellers grow their business and make eBay the destination website for existing and new customers. You’ll work on high-scale systems spanning frontend applications, backend services, APIs, data pipelines, and AI-assisted engineering workflows, partnering closely with product, design, analytics, and applied science. We’re looking for engineers who can turn business problems into reliable, maintainable software, make sound technical tradeoffs, and take ownership from design through production. This role is a strong fit for someone who enjoys solving practical engineering problems in a fast-moving environment where performance, quality, and measurable customer impact matter.

  • Develop scalable, highly available applications, APIs, and services using technologies such as Marko, React, Node.js, Java, and Scala.

  • Own end-to-end delivery of complex features, from technical design and architecture through deployment and production support.

  • Drive technical decisions, system design, and cross-team collaboration to ensure scalable, reliable, and maintainable solutions.

  • Leverage AI-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude Code) throughout the development lifecycle for coding, debugging, testing, and code review to increase engineering velocity.

  • Contribute to AI-powered advertising and marketing features by collaborating with ML engineers on LLM integrations, recommendation systems, and intelligent campaign optimization.

  • Contribute to a culture of continuous learning, Agile development, open-source collaboration, and rapid software delivery.

  • Mentor team members, participate in technical discussions, and help shape engineering best practices across the organization.

  • BS/BA in Computer Science or related field plus 10 years work experience or MS with 8 years of relevant experience.

  • Strong experience in Java (17+) and building services with Spring Boot or similar frameworks.

  • Experience building scalable backend systems and RESTful APIs in distributed environments.

  • Experience with event-driven architectures and message queues (Kafka, RabbitMQ, or similar).

  • Experience with relational (Oracle/Postgres/MySQL) and/or NoSQL (Cassandra/MongoDB) databases, including schema design and query optimization.

You are energized by:

title: [L6-1] Staff, Detection Platform Engineer (Detection Engineering)
description:
본 공고는 재직 임직원을 대상으로 하는 사내 공모 전용입니다. (임직원 추천은 Link로 진행)

This posting is exclusively for internal employees. (Employee referrals are submitted via the Link)

지원 시에는 반드시 첨부된 ‘사내 공모 지원서 양식’을 작성한 후, 쿠팡 이메일 계정으로 접수해 주시기 바랍니다.

To apply, please complete the attached ‘Internal Transfer Request Form’ and submit it via your Coupang email address.

  • 사내 공모 정책: [Link]
  • Internal Transfer Policy: [Link]

회사 소개

쿠팡은 고객 감동 실현을 위해 존재합니다. 고객들이 "쿠팡 없이 그동안 어떻게 살았을까?" 라고 말할 때, 비로소 우리의 미션을 실현하고 있음을 알 수 있습니다. 고객들의 쇼핑과 식사, 생활 전반을 편하게 만들겠다는 유일한 집념으로 쿠팡은 수억 달러 규모의 이커머스 산업 전반의 혁신을 이끌고 있습니다. 쿠팡은 가장 빠르게 성장하는 이커머스 기업 중 하나로, 국내 커머스 업계에서의 독보적인 입지와, 고객 신뢰를 구축했습니다.

쿠팡은 스타트업 문화를 기반으로 한 글로벌 대형 상장사라고 자부합니다. 이것이 창립 당시의 기민함을 지하며, 신규 서비스를 끊임없이 출시하며 비즈니스를 확장해 나가는 우리의 성장 동력입니다. 쿠팡의 모든 임직원에게는 기업가 정신을 갖추고 새로운 혁신과 이니셔티브를 추진할 수 있는 기회가 주어집니다. 주저 없이 일에 뛰어들어 성과를 이루고자 하는 과감성이, 바로 쿠팡이 일하는 방식의 본질입니다. 쿠팡에서는 여러분 자신, 동료, 팀 그리고 회사 전체가 매일 성장하는 모습을 목격할 것입니다.

쿠팡의 모든 직원은 커머스의 미래를 만들겠다는 쿠팡의 미션에 진심입니다. 우리는 고객의 문제를 해결해 나가고, 전통적인 관념과 통념에 맞서며 실현 가능한 한계를 뛰어넘고 있습니다. 고가용성 (always-on) 과 최첨단의 앞선 기술 (high-tech), 초연결사회 (hyper-connected world) 에서의 놀라운 업무 경험을 원하신다면, 지금 바로 쿠팡에 합류하세요.

팀 소개

Detection Engineering(DE) 팀은 쿠팡 보안조직(Digital Trust) 내에서 보안 위협의 탐지와 대응 자동화를 엔드투엔드로 설계하고 구현하는 팀입니다. 위협 시나리오 정의부터 로그 수집, 탐지 룰 배포, AI 기반 자동 대응까지 전 주기를 한 팀에서 커버하며, Detection-as-Code 철학을 기반으로 모든 탐지 로직을 코드로 관리합니다.
DE팀은 AI 기술을 각 도메인에 적극적으로 접목하고 있습니다. AI-SOC를 직접 구현하고, 보안 로그의 AI 기반 분석, LLM을 활용한 자동화 등, AI는 별도 기능이 아닌 팀 전체의 업무 방식에 내재되어 있습니다.
이 포지션은 SIEM과 SOAR를 아우르는 보안 탐지·자동화 전 영역에서 깊은 기술적 전문성을 발휘하는 역할입니다. 데이터 파이프라인부터 탐지 엔진, 자동화 워크플로우, AI-SOC까지 DE팀의 기술 스택 전체를 관통하는 시야로 아키텍처 설계와 기술적 난제 해결에 기여합니다.

이런 분과 함께하고 싶습니다
  • 하나의 도메인에 갇히지 않고, 데이터부터 자동화까지 전체를 조망할 수 있는 분
  • "이게 왜 이렇게 되어 있지?"라는 질문에서 시작해 아키텍처를 개선한 경험이 있는 분
  • 직접 코드를 쓰면서도, 동료 엔지니어에게 좋은 영향을 주는 분
  • 복잡한 문제를 단순하게 정리하고, 명확한 근거로 방향을 제시할 수 있는 분

업무 내용

  • 보안 데이터 플랫폼(SIEM) 및 자동화 플랫폼(SOAR) 전체 아키텍처에 대한 기술적 방향 수립 및 설계
  • 대규모 보안 로그 파이프라인의 안정성, 성능, 비용 효율성에 대한 아키텍처 레벨의 문제 해결
  • SOAR 워크플로우 및 AI-SOC 체계의 설계, 기술적 난제 해결, 품질 기준 정의
  • Detection-as-Code 프레임워크의 고도화 — 탐지 룰 라이프사이클, 테스트 자동화, 배포 파이프라인 개선
  • 보안 솔루션 선정·도입·교체에 대한 기술적 평가
  • 전사 보안 아키텍처 변경, 신규 시스템 도입 시 DE 관점의 기술 자문 및 영향도 분석
  • AI/LLM 기반 보안 자동화의 아키텍처 설계

자격 요건: Lv6-1 Engineer

  • 보안 엔지니어링 또는 보안 인프라 분야 경력 10년 이상
  • SIEM 플랫폼의 아키텍처, 데이터 파이프라인, 탐지 엔진에 대한 깊은 기술적 이해 — 구축부터 대규모 운영, 성능 최적화, 마이그레이션까지 경험
  • SOAR 또는 보안 자동화 플랫폼의 설계·구축·운영 경험 — 워크플로우 설계 원칙, 솔루션 연동 아키텍처, 장애 대응 체계에 대한 실무 역량
  • Python 기반의 개발 역량 — 프로토타이핑에서 프로덕션 수준의 코드까지 작성할 수 있는 엔지니어
  • 다양한 보안 솔루션(EDR, CTI, 티켓 시스템, 클라우드 보안 서비스 등)의 동작 원리와 연동 방식에 대한 폭넓은 실무 경험
  • AI/LLM 기반 보안 자동화 또는 AI-SOC 시스템에 대한 이해 — LLM Agent 아키텍처, 프롬프트 설계, 자동 분석/판단 워크플로우 구축 경험
  • 복잡한 기술적 문제를 구조화하고, 트레이드오프를 명확히 정리할 수 있는 역량
  • SIEM과 SOAR를 모두 깊이 있게 다뤄본 경험 — 두 영역의 접점에서 아키텍처 의사결정을 내려본 경험
  • 클라우드 환경(AWS 등)에서의 대규모 시스템 아키텍처 설계 및 운영 경험

우대 사항

  • AI-SOC 또는 LLM 기반 보안 자동화 시스템의 아키텍처 설계 또는 도입 경험
  • 대규모 보안 데이터 플랫폼의 비용 최적화 프로젝트 수행 경험
  • Detection-as-Code 또는 보안 데이터 모델링(OCSF, CIM 등)에 대한 깊은 이해
  • 보안 솔루션 선정·교체 과정에서 기술 평가를 수행한 경험
  • Kubernetes 기반 인프라의 보안 로그 수집 및 모니터링 아키텍처 설계 경험
  • 이커머스/핀테크 등 대규모 트래픽 환경에서의 보안 인프라 운영 경험
  • 엔지니어링 프로세스(코드 리뷰, 설계 리뷰, 기술 표준 등) 개선에 기여한 경험

근무지: 쿠팡 서울 구의오피스

전형 절차 및 안내 사항

  • 전형절차
    • 서류전형 - 대면(화상)면접 – 최종 합격
    • 전형절차는 직무별로 다르게 운영될 수 있으며, 일정 및 상황에 따라 변동될 수 있습니다.
    • 전형 일정 및 결과는 지원서에 등록하신 이메일로 개별 안내 드립니다.
  • 참고사항
    • 본 공고는 모집 완료 시 조기 마감될 수 있습니다.
    • 지원서 내용 중 허위사실이 있는 경우에는 합격이 취소될 수 있습니다.
    • 취업 보호 대상자(보훈대상자, 장애인 등)는 관련 법률에 따라 채용우대를 받을 수 있습니다.
    • 직급과 담당 업무 범위는 후보자의 전반적인 경력과 경험 등 제반사정을 고려하여 변경될 수 있습니다. 이러한 변경이 필요할 경우, 최종 합격 통지 전 적절한 시기에 후보자와 커뮤니케이션 될 예정입니다.
    • 채용 및 업무 수행과 관련하여 요구되는 법령상 자격이 갖추어지지 않은 경우 채용이 제한될 수 있습니다.

개인정보 처리방침

  • 쿠팡 그룹은 입사지원자 개인정보 처리방침(아래 링크)에 따라 귀하의 개인정보를 수집하여 처리합니다.

서류 반환 정책

  1. 본 고지는 『채용절차의공정화에관한법률』 제11조제6항에 따른 것 입니다.
  2. 당사 채용에 응시한 구직자 중 최종 합격이 되지 못한 구직자는 『채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률』에 따라 제출한 채용서류의 반환을 청구할 수 있음을 알려 드립니다. 다만, 홈페이지 또는 전자우편으로 제출된 경우나 구직자가 당사의 요구 없이 자발적으로 제출한 경우에는 그러하지 아니하며, 천재지변이나 그 밖에 당사에게 책임 없는 사유로 채용서류가 멸실된 경우에는 반환한 것으로 봅니다.
  3. 위2항 본문에 따라 채용 서류 반환 청구를 하는 구직자는 채용 서류 반환 청구서 [채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률 시행규칙 별지 제 3 호 서식]를 작성하여 이메일 (recruitingops@coupang.com) 로 제출하면, 제출이 확인된 날로부터 14 일 이내에 지정한 주소지로 등기우편을 통하여 발송해 드립니다. 이 경우 등기우편요금은 수신자 부담으로 하게 되오니 유념하시기 바랍니다.
  4. 당사는 위2항 본문에 따른 구직자의 반환 청구에 대비하여 채용 여부가 확정된 날로부터 180 일간 구직자가 제출한 채용서류 원본을 보관하게 되며, 그때까지 채용서류의 반환을 청구하지 아니할 경우에는 『개인정보 보호법』에 따라 지체 없이 채용서류 일체를 파기할 예정입니다.
  5. 단, 위 1항 내지 4항의 내용은 대한민국의 노동 관계 법령이 적용되는 경우에만 적용됩니다. 그 이외의 경우에는 적용되지 않습니다.

반드시 첨부된 ‘사내공모지원서 양식’을 작성 후 제출하여 주시기 바랍니다.

title: Intern - SSD Manufacturing
description:
Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all.

Join an inclusive team passionate about one thing: using their expertise in the relentless pursuit of innovation for customers and partners. The solutions we build help make everything from virtual reality experiences to breakthroughs in neural networks possible. We do it all while committing to integrity, sustainability, and giving back to our communities. Because doing so can fuel the very innovation we are pursuing.

Location
Micron Singapore Bendemeer (MSB)

Department
Solid State Drive Manufacturing Operations

Project Title
Solid State Drive Manufacturing Productivity and Operational Improvement

Project Description
The Solid State Drive Manufacturing Intern will undertake a structured improvement project within the Manufacturing Operations team. The intern will apply industrial engineering, lean manufacturing, and data analytics principles to identify opportunities related to productivity, quality, safety, material flow, and operational efficiency.

The project may cover Front End of Line, Middle End of Line, Back of Line, or Configure-to-Order manufacturing operations. The intern will gain practical exposure to semiconductor manufacturing while collaborating with Manufacturing, Industrial Engineering, Process Engineering, Test Engineering, Quality, and Planning stakeholders.

Where relevant, the intern will use AI-Enabled analytics tools, Generative AI, or an AI Assistant to enhance data analysis, identify patterns, develop visualizations, and improve project documentation.

Objective of the Project
The objective is to provide the intern with practical experience in manufacturing improvement methodologies while contributing to a defined project that improves operational performance. The project will enable the intern to translate engineering knowledge into data-driven recommendations and sustainable improvement solutions.

Opportunities for Full Time Employment
Upon successful completion of the internship, the intern may be considered for future full time employment opportunities, subject to satisfactory performance, role availability, and business needs.

Project Scope
The intern will undertake one or more of the following project areas:

  • Conduct manufacturing time studies and process observations to identify non-value-added activities and improvement opportunities.

  • Analyze production layouts, material flow, logistics arrangements, workplace organization, and ergonomic conditions.

  • Evaluate process quality, capacity, utilization, throughput, and other manufacturing performance indicators.

  • Develop dashboards or visualization solutions using Excel, Power BI, Tableau, or suitable AI-Enabled analytics tools.

  • Propose and evaluate improvement solutions through data analysis, impact assessment, and implementation planning.

Learning Opportunities

  • Gain practical knowledge of Solid State Drive and semiconductor manufacturing processes.

  • Apply lean manufacturing, continuous improvement, and industrial engineering principles in a manufacturing environment.

  • Build experience in data collection, statistical analysis, visualization, and AI-Enabled ways of working.

  • Develop project management, structured problem-solving, and cross-functional stakeholder engagement skills.

Deliverables

  • Current-state assessment supported by relevant manufacturing data and process observations.

  • Analysis of improvement opportunities, expected benefits, risks, and implementation considerations.

  • Selected improvement proposal, pilot, or implementation plan with measurable project indicators.

  • Dashboard, visualization, analytical model, or reporting tool, where applicable.

  • Final presentation and project documentation covering outcomes, recommendations, lessons learned, and sustainability considerations.

Impact of the Project

  • Improve manufacturing productivity, capacity utilization, or operational efficiency.

  • Reduce non-value-added activities, process variation, or inefficient material movement.

  • Enhance workplace safety, ergonomics, quality controls, or visual management practices.

  • Increase visibility of manufacturing performance through data analytics and visualization.

Skillsets Required

  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and data interpretation skills.

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and familiarity with data visualization tools such as Power BI or Tableau.

  • Familiarity with SQL, Python, statistical analysis, Generative AI, an AI Assistant, or other AI-Enabled analytics workflows is an advantage.

  • Good written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present technical findings clearly.

  • Ability to manage a defined project independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional stakeholders.

Course of Interest
The ideal candidate should be pursuing a bachelor’s degree in Industrial Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Electrical or Electronic Engineering, Data Analytics, Operations Management, or a related engineering discipline.

Duration of Period
The ideal candidate should be able to commit to a full time internship period of 5 months from Jan to May 2027.

title: People, Culture & Equity Business Partner, Labour Relations / Partenaire d’affaires Personnel, culture et équité Relations de travail
description:
Title: PC&E Business Partner, Labour Relations

Department: People, Culture, & Equity (PC&E)

Terms: Permanent, full-time (34 hours/week, Monday-Thursday)

Location: Proximity to one of our three offices is preferred: Vancouver (xʷməθkʷəy̓əm, Sḵwx̱wú7mesh, and səlilwətaɬ territories), Montreal (Kanien’kehà:ka territory) or Toronto (Tkaronto, the traditional territory of many nations including the Mississaugas of the Credit, the Anishinaabe, the Chippewa, the Haudenosaunee, and the Wendat peoples).

Work Environment: This position is hybrid, with a combination of remote work and 1 day per week required in office. Please note, this will increase to two days per week in the future.

Reports to: Director, People & Culture

Salary: 73,215 - 75,412

Type: Union-exempt

Application Deadline: September 11, 2026

THE ROLE:

This is a vital and hands-on role that provides Human Resources support to our three offices across Canada. The PC&E Business Partner, Labour Relations leads the daily functions of the PC&E department including but not limited to: recruitment, administering benefits, managing leaves, and enforcing organization policies and procedures in addition to creating and maintaining strong working relationships with all members of staff.

Operating within a unionized environment, the Business Partner plays a key role in labour relations, supporting collective agreement interpretation, grievance resolution, and collaborative union-management engagement. The role requires a deep understanding of HR best practices, labour law compliance, and positive labour relations strategies to uphold a fair and supportive work environment.

The role contributes to PC&E strategy and supports training initiatives with the Manager. The Business Partner also contributes to and leads specific processes in performance management and recruiting in conjunction with other team members. The PC&E Business Partner, Labour Relations carries out and has input into DSF’s people initiatives and engages in building culture, providing great internal employee support, and driving HR excellence and process improvement.

This role requires a strong understanding of HR best practices across multiple provinces (Ontario, Québec, and British Columbia), as well as Knowledge in employment law, expertise in employee relations, and collective bargaining environments.

Responsibilities:

Talent & Workforce Management

  • Lead recruitment process for management level and below. Assists in recruitment process for executive level roles
  • Update job descriptions as required
  • Collaborate with Finance on budgeting required for recruitment
  • Provide support to administrator for onboarding procedures
  • Support performance management, employee retention, and engagement strategies to maintain a thriving workforce.
  • Accessible to all employees and proactive in employee relations

Benefits & Compensation

  • Administrate DSF’s group benefit plan
  • Lead DSF’s wellness initiatives including Headspace
  • Update compensation bands as needed
  • Participate in compensation reviews
  • Support with annual salary increase process in conjunction with Finance
  • Manage salary bands as determined by the collective agreement

Training

  • Develop annual training plan and lead implementation
  • Research potential training opportunities and align with key learning objectives for staff.
  • Provide employee support in professional development processes and training programs

Termination

  • Support Manager and Director in termination process
  • Oversee offboarding with support from Coordinator
  • Conduct exit interviews

Labour Relations & Union Engagement

  • Interpret and apply collective agreements, ensuring compliance and fostering a respectful, productive labour-management relationship.
  • Serve as a resource to managers and employees on union-related matters, ensuring clear communication and understanding of rights, responsibilities, and processes.
  • Support grievance handling and dispute resolution, working collaboratively with the union and leadership to facilitate fair and constructive outcomes.
  • Support in union negotiations, labor-management meetings, and collective bargaining processes as needed.
  • Ensure progressive discipline and performance management processes align with collective agreements, labor law, and organizational values.
  • Partner with the union on workplace initiatives, ensuring collaborative problem-solving and joint advocacy on people and culture matters.

HR Operations & Compliance

  • Ensure HR policies and programs comply with federal and provincial employment legislation
  • In conjunction with the team, ensure maintenance of accurate HR records, analytics, and reporting, ensuring data-driven decision making
  • Make recommendations to improve the delivery of HR practices and services
  • Prepare and update employee employment letters and related documentation for all changes in employment conditions, ensuring accuracy and compliance with organizational policies and collective agreements.

HRIS Project

  • Lead project team researching new HRIS
  • Engage with HRIS vendors
  • Support in implementation, and lead the day-to-day project coordination

Other Duties as Required

POSTE : Partenaire d’affaires PC&E, Relations de travail

DÉPARTEMENT : Personnes, Culture et Équité (PC&E)

CONDITIONS : Poste à temps plein permanent (34 heures par semaine, du lundi au jeudi).

LIEU : Lieu de travail flexible, dans l’un de nos trois bureaux situés à Vancouver (territoire des Nations xʷməθkʷəy̓əm, des Sḵwx̱wú7mesh et des səlilwətaɬ), à Montréal (territoire des Kanien’kehà:ka) et à Toronto (Tkaronto, le territoire traditionnel de nombreuses Nations dont les Mississaugas de Credit, les Anichinabés, les Ojibwés, les Haudenosaunee et les Wendat).

ENVIRONNEMENT DE TRAVAIL : Ce poste est offert en mode hybride, combinant le télétravail et une présence au bureau d’une (1) journée par semaine. Veuillez noter que cette présence au bureau augmentera à deux (2) journées par semaine ultérieurement.

SOUS LA RESPONSABILITÉ DE : Directrice, Personne, Culture & Équité

TYPE : Poste non syndiqué

SALAIRE : $73,215 - 75,412

DATE LIMITE DE CANDIDATURE : 11 septembre 2026.

LE POSTE

Il s'agit d'un rôle essentiel et opérationnel qui fournit un soutien en ressources humaines à nos trois bureaux au Canada. Le ou la Partenaire d’affaires PC&E dirige les activités quotidiennes du service Personnes, Culture et Équité (PC&E), notamment le recrutement, l’administration des avantages sociaux, la gestion des congés et l’application des politiques et procédures organisationnelles, tout en développant et en maintenant des relations de travail solides avec l’ensemble du personnel.

Travaillant au sein d'un environnement syndiqué, le ou la partenaire d’affaires joue un rôle clé en relations de travail, notamment en soutenant l’interprétation de la convention collective, le règlement des griefs et une collaboration constructive entre le syndicat et l’employeur. Ce rôle exige une connaissance approfondie des meilleures pratiques en ressources humaines, de la conformité aux lois du travail et des stratégies favorisant des relations de travail positives afin de maintenir un milieu de travail équitable et bienveillant.

Le poste contribue également à la stratégie PC&E et soutient les initiatives de formation en collaboration avec la gestionnaire. Le ou la partenaire d’affaires participe à la mise en œuvre et à la gestion de processus liés à la gestion du rendement et au recrutement, en collaboration avec les autres membres de l’équipe.

Le ou la partenaire d’affaires PC&E contribue à la réalisation des initiatives liées au personnel de DSF, participe activement au développement de la culture organisationnelle, assure un soutien de grande qualité aux employé·e·s et favorise l’excellence opérationnelle ainsi que l’amélioration continue des processus RH.

Ce rôle nécessite une solide compréhension des meilleures pratiques en ressources humaines dans plusieurs provinces (Ontario, Québec et Colombie-Britannique), ainsi qu’une expertise en droit de l’emploi, relations avec les employé·e·s et milieux de travail syndiqués.

RESPONSABILITÉS

Gestion des talents et de la main-d’œuvre

  • Diriger le processus de recrutement pour les postes de gestion et les postes de niveau inférieur.
  • Contribuer au recrutement pour les postes de direction.
  • Mettre à jour les descriptions de poste au besoin.
  • Collaborer avec l’équipe des finances concernant les besoins budgétaires liés au recrutement.
  • Soutenir le ou la coordonnateur·trice dans les processus d’intégration des nouveaux employé·e·s.
  • Soutenir les stratégies de gestion du rendement, de rétention et d’engagement du personnel afin de maintenir une main-d’œuvre mobilisée et performante.
  • Être accessible à l’ensemble du personnel et adopter une approche proactive en matière de relations avec les employé·e·s.

Avantages sociaux et rémunération

  • Administrer le régime collectif d’avantages sociaux de DSF.
  • Gérer les initiatives de bien-être de DSF, notamment Headspace.
  • Mettre à jour les échelles salariales au besoin.
  • Participer aux révisions salariales.
  • Gérer le processus annuel d’augmentation salariale en collaboration avec l’équipe des finances.
  • Administrer les échelles salariales établies par la convention collective.

Formation et développement

  • Élaborer le plan annuel de formation et en assurer la mise en œuvre.
  • Rechercher des occasions de formation et les harmoniser avec les objectifs d’apprentissage prioritaires du personnel.
  • Soutenir les employé·e·s dans leurs démarches de développement professionnel et dans les programmes de formation.

Fin d’emploi

  • Soutenir la gestionnaire et la direction dans les processus de cessation d’emploi.
  • Superviser les activités de départ des employé·e·s avec l’appui du ou de la coordonnateur·trice.
  • Mener les entrevues de départ.

Relations de travail et collaboration syndicale

  • Interpréter et appliquer les conventions collectives, assurer la conformité et favoriser des relations respectueuses et productives entre le syndicat et l’employeur.
  • Agir comme personne-ressource auprès des gestionnaires et des employé·e·s pour toute question liée au syndicat, en veillant à une communication claire des droits, responsabilités et processus.
  • Soutenir le traitement des griefs et le règlement des différends en collaboration avec le syndicat et la direction afin de parvenir à des solutions équitables et constructives.
  • Participer, au besoin, aux négociations syndicales, aux rencontres patronales-syndicales et aux processus de négociation collective.
  • Veiller à ce que les processus de discipline progressive et de gestion du rendement soient conformes à la convention collective, au droit du travail et aux valeurs de l’organisation.
  • Collaborer avec le syndicat dans le cadre d’initiatives en milieu de travail en favorisant la résolution conjointe de problèmes et la défense commune des enjeux liés aux personnes et à la culture.

Opérations RH et conformité

  • Veiller à ce que les politiques et programmes RH respectent les lois fédérales et provinciales en matière d’emploi.
  • En collaboration avec l’équipe, assurer le maintien de dossiers RH, d’analyses et de rapports exacts afin de soutenir une prise de décision fondée sur les données.
  • Formuler des recommandations visant à améliorer la prestation des services et des pratiques RH.

Projet SIRH (Système d’information des ressources humaines)

  • Diriger l’équipe de projet chargée de l’évaluation et de la sélection d’un nouveau SIRH.
  • Collaborer avec les fournisseurs de solutions SIRH.
  • Soutenir la mise en œuvre du système et assurer la coordination quotidienne du projet.

Autres tâches connexes, selon les besoins.

Qualifications

Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in Human Resources, administration, business, or another related field
  • 5+ years’ experience in HR Generalist or HR Business Partner role(s) or equivalent
  • Demonstrated experience in a unionized environment, including collective agreement interpretation and grievance handling, is required given the labor relations scope of this role.
  • HR designation preferred.

Knowledge, Skills, & Abilities

  • Advanced fluency in French and English language skills, written and verbal.
  • Working style is inclusive, relational, emotionally intelligent, transparent, self-reflective, and comfortable working through moments of difficulty, conflict, and ambiguity to support colleagues and the wider organization.
  • Knowledge and experience supporting current and emerging human resources practices, tools and systems.
  • Working knowledge of current Canadian and provincial (BC, Ontario, Quebec) laws regarding employment and human rights.
  • Sound understanding of and commitment to equity, diversity, inclusion and anti-racism.
  • Demonstrated communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Strong diplomacy and relationship building acumen.
  • Adept at managing organizational priorities.
  • Adept multi-tasker with an inclusive, systems, and process mindset.
  • Proven skills in judgement, solid ethics, and discretion with all dealings (especially with confidential and sensitive issues).

Qualifications

Formation et expérience

  • Baccalauréat ou expérience équivalente en ressources humaines, en administration, en gestion ou dans un domaine connexe.
  • Minimum de cinq (5) années d’expérience dans un rôle de généraliste RH, de partenaire d’affaires RH ou dans un poste équivalent.
  • Expérience démontrée dans un environnement syndiqué, incluant l’interprétation de conventions collectives et la gestion des griefs. Cette expérience est essentielle compte tenu de la portée du rôle en relations de travail.
  • La désignation professionnelle en ressources humaines (CRHA/CRIA ou équivalent) constitue un atout.

Connaissances, compétences et aptitudes

  • Excellente maîtrise du français et de l’anglais, tant à l’oral qu’à l’écrit.
  • Approche de travail inclusive, collaborative, empreinte d’intelligence émotionnelle, de transparence et de réflexion personnelle, avec la capacité d’accompagner les collègues et l’organisation dans des situations complexes, conflictuelles ou ambiguës.
  • Connaissance et expérience des pratiques, outils et systèmes actuels et émergents en ressources humaines.
  • Connaissance pratique des lois canadiennes et provinciales (Québec, Ontario et Colombie-Britannique) en matière d’emploi et de droits de la personne.
  • Compréhension approfondie et engagement envers les principes d’équité, de diversité, d’inclusion et d’antiracisme.
  • Excellentes habiletés de communication et de relations interpersonnelles.
  • Grande capacité de diplomatie et de développement de relations de confiance.
  • Capacité à gérer efficacement des priorités organisationnelles multiples.
  • Aptitude démontrée à gérer plusieurs dossiers simultanément avec une perspective inclusive, systémique et axée sur les processus.
  • Jugement irréprochable, solides valeurs éthiques et grande discrétion dans le traitement de renseignements confidentiels et de situations sensibles.

WHAT WE OFFER

  • Four-day workweek
  • Competitive salary and generous benefits package
  • Hybrid work opportunities

title: Overnight Supervisor
description:
POSITION SUMMARY:

Under the supervision of the Management team, the Overnight Supervisor provides daily direction to the Outfitters on the overnight shift within the retail store, to include: sales floor replenishment, merchandise presentation, seasonal resets, inventory management and price change execution.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

  • Delegates tasks and work assignments to team members by giving clear and concise direction and follow up to ensure proper execution.
  • Ensure adherence of all standard operating procedures and processes by team members, following up to provide training and guidance when needed.
  • Maintains visual presentation standards including in-store signage, proper execution of merchandise directives and planograms, merchandise recovering/front facing and general daily recovery ensuring a pleasant and productive shopping experience for all customers.
  • Ensures nightly replenishment of sales floor from backstock inventory, as well as new replenishment from the Distribution Centers and direct vendor deliveries.
  • Supports inventory management in partnership with the Inventory Control team by completing on demand counts, empty peg scanning, pick requests, display integrities, etc. during off peak business overnight.
  • Supports the Management team with coordination of all “Special Events”; maintenance of pricing and UPC integrity; determining proper assortments; accuracy of inventory; proper display, tagging, signing and pricing of all advertised items.
  • Supports the Management team in carrying out Supervisory responsibilities in accordance with the Company’s policies including training, planning, assigning and directing work, evaluating performance, and maintaining a positive work environment.
  • Assists the Management team and Human Resources Representative to staff the department with “service” oriented associates; participates in interviewing and makes recommendations for selection; coordinates training; consults with the Management team and gives input on preparation of performance appraisals; prepares weekly work schedules; coaches and motivates associates to promote positive customer relations and a productive team-oriented work environment.
  • Ensure all breaks and lunches are provided for overnight Outfitters in accordance with all provincial and local regulations.
  • ALL OTHER DUTIES AS ASSIGNED.

EXPERIENCE/QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Minimum Degree Required: High School Diploma or Equivalent
  • Years of experience: 2-4 Retail Years Retail Experience
  • Availability to work overnight shifts.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITY:

  • Ability to read and analyze certain reports.
  • Ability to effectively present information and respond to inquiries from Managers, Outfitters, customers and the general public .
  • Ability to conduct meetings and presentations to groups.
  • Proficiency with PC-based word processing, spreadsheets, data-based management and inventory management systems.
  • Demonstrated strong interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with co-workers, Outfitters, customers and with the Base Camp team.

TRAVEL REQUIREMENTS:

  • N/A

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:

Regularly walks, stands, and works on a computer.

Occasionally sits and lifts up to 50 lbs.

INDEPENDENT JUDGEMENT:

Performs tasks and duties under general supervision, using established procedures and innovation. Chooses from limited alternatives to resolve problems. Occasional independent judgment is required to complete work assignments. Often makes recommendations to work procedures, policies, and practices.

Starting Pay Rate: $21.00 - $23.75

title: Cyber Threat Exposure Management – Lead
description:
Senior technical lead to own strategy and drive maturity across attack surface management, vulnerability management, and cloud security posture using a continuous threat exposure management (CTEM) approach.

Accountable for programme delivery quality, tooling strategy, and governance. Requires deep technical expertise combined with the ability to lead and coach a team, shape a capability roadmap, and influence senior stakeholders without direct supervision.

Key Responsibilities

Strategy & Programme Direction

  • Own function strategy aligned to business risk appetite and security frameworks.
  • Drive continuous improvement across all CTEM programme phases.
  • Establish governance and standards across vulnerability management, ASM, CSPM, and secure development.
  • Own the exposure management roadmap; present evidence-based investment cases to senior stakeholders.

Tool Selection & Capability Development

  • Own toolchain selection for EASM/CAASM, vulnerability management, CSPM, and exposure correlation.
  • Integrate exposure management platforms with SIEM, SOAR, and DevSecOps pipelines.
  • Monitor emerging tooling and AI-augmented triage; recommend capability investments.
  • Define coverage requirements and onboarding standards for new assets and workloads.

Attack Surface Management (ASM / EASM)

  • Run continuous discovery and attribution of all Internet-facing assets, shadow IT, and third-party exposure.
  • Enrich findings with threat intelligence, KEV data, and active exploitation trends.
  • Maintain an accurate inventory as the authoritative basis for prioritisation.
  • Continuously improve coverage, reduce noise, and sharpen the prioritisation model.

Vulnerability Management

  • Own the vulnerability management programme end to end: triage, remediation, SLA governance, and closure.
  • Maintain risk-based scoring incorporating CVSS, EPSS, business criticality, and threat context.
  • Hold remediation teams to SLAs; resolve systemic blockers across functions.

Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM)

  • Own CSPM strategy across AWS, Azure, and OCI; keep visibility current with estate growth.
  • Partner with cloud platform and architecture teams to embed security posture requirements into platform design and IaC standards.
  • Eliminate recurring misconfigurations through root cause analysis; don't accept repeat findings.

Pentest & Purple Team Oversight

  • Commission and manage penetration testing and purple team engagements; QA external deliverables.
  • Translate findings into prioritised remediation and track to closure.
  • Use validation outputs to improve controls and update the exposure model.

Secure SDLC

  • Integrate security requirements, threat modelling, and code review into the SDLC.
  • Drive secure-by-design principles with engineering and architecture teams.
  • Measure secure development maturity and set improvement targets.

Leadership, Reporting & Stakeholder Engagement

  • Deliver executive dashboards translating technical risk into business impact; represent the function in ISO 27001, Cyber Essentials Plus, SOC 1, and MSP audit cycles.
  • Build credibility with senior stakeholders, client security teams, and third-party assessors.
  • Lead, coach, and develop the team; set clear goals, resolve conflicts, and create growth opportunities.
  • Foster a culture of learning and delivery excellence; act as escalation point for complex technical decisions.
  • Coordinate remediation owners, platform teams, and external parties; keep all stakeholders aligned on plans and blockers.

Beneficial Qualifications & Skills

  • 6+ years’ experience in cyber security, 2+ years in a senior exposure management, VM, or threat intelligence role; degree in Computer Science or Information Security, or equivalent.
  • Relevant certifications: CISSP, CISM, OSCP, or equivalent. CTEM-related training or Gartner CTEM methodology experience advantageous.
  • Experience evaluating and selecting security tooling across EASM/CAASM, CSPM, and VM platforms; hands-on with Defender XDR/CSPM, Zscaler, Tenable, Tanium, or equivalent.
  • Deep working knowledge of NIST CSF, ISO 27001, MITRE ATT&CK, and CTEM principles.
  • ISPM and attack path mapping experience; ability to communicate technical exposure as business risk to senior stakeholders.
  • Experience designing or maturing a CTEM programme; familiarity with AI-augmented vulnerability triage, attack path analysis, or BAS.
  • Exposure to audit frameworks (Cyber Essentials Plus, SOC 1, FSQS) or MSP/MSSP environment.

  • Share in our success with our Quarterly Performance-Related Profit Share Scheme, where employees collectively benefit from a share of our company's profits

title: Head of Engineering, Field Verification
description:
Who we are

Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month.

As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually.

Why Spain

Some of our most mission-critical team members are based in Spain, having joined us from companies like Wise and Glovo. Moniepoint is one of the largest and fastest-growing digital banks in Africa, and this is an opportunity to work on genuinely impactful problems: disrupting financial services at scale in emerging markets, and building systems and products that process hundreds of billions of dollars in transaction volume annually for tens of millions of people.

So, now we are looking for our Head of Engineering, Field Verification to join us in Spain.

About the role

Field Verification is how Moniepoint knows that the people and businesses on our platform are real. Every Moniepoint customer, retail and business, requires a completed field verification as part of KYC. The platform coordinates physical, in-person checks — verifying individuals, business owners, business addresses and loan guarantors — and it serves nearly every part of the company: onboarding, loans, compliance and the fraud team.

The system works today. A back office gives each business unit visibility and control over its own verification requests. A mobile-friendly web app puts the work in the hands of Field Verification Officers and the cluster leads who manage them across local government areas. An API layer lets other business units push verification requests in and receive results back by webhook, and an assignment algorithm routes each request to an officer close enough to carry it out.

We want to be straightforward about the rest. This domain has never had a dedicated engineering leader, and that is the single biggest constraint on it. The team is one lean, cross-functional squad — an Engineering Manager, four engineers and a QA — carrying verification volume for the entire customer base. They have done that impressively well, but running lean means running in keep-the-lights-on mode, and a long list of things that would make this platform substantially better has been waiting for someone to own it.

That list is the role. Trip and route management, so an officer can plan an optimal day across several sites rather than making a separate journey for each one — today we pay for a round trip per verification, and the logistics are nowhere near optimal. Capacity management. A native mobile app, wanted for a long time and never resourced. Liveness and identity verification tooling, exposed as APIs the rest of the business can build on. And as Moniepoint expands into markets where identity verification is as difficult as it is in Nigeria, Kenya among them, a platform that works beyond a single country.

There is a great deal of room to build here. Whoever takes this on will set the direction rather than inherit someone else's plan, on a system that already carries real weight for the business.

As Head of Engineering, Field Verification, your responsibilities will include:

  • Owning the technical strategy, architecture and roadmap for the Field Verification platform end to end, and setting direction for a domain that has been running without dedicated engineering leadership.
  • Moving the platform from keep-the-lights-on operation to deliberate, prioritised development.
  • Leading and growing the existing cross-functional team, and building the organisation out as scope expands.
  • Building the operational efficiency layer — trip and route optimisation, task allocation and capacity management for field officers.
  • Owning the platform's client-facing surface: the APIs and webhooks that other business units integrate with, and the back office those units rely on.
  • Delivering a native mobile experience for field officers.
  • Ensuring verification data is structured, auditable and fit for compliance scrutiny.
  • Building for multi-country expansion as Moniepoint enters new markets.
  • Partnering closely with Product and with the business units that depend on the platform — onboarding, loans, compliance and fraud.
  • Defining architecture standards, engineering processes and quality metrics, and hiring and developing engineers and Engineering Managers.

Who you are

  • You have built things yourself, and grew into leadership from there. We are explicit about this: we are not looking for someone who moved into management early and has led from a distance since. We want an engineer who became a leader.
  • You are capable across disciplines. Backend, web and mobile. This platform spans all three and you will need credibility in each — a specialist in one layer will struggle here.
  • You have built platforms, not just products. Systems used by several distinct groups of users and internal business units, with the flexibility to serve requirements you did not anticipate.
  • You are a problem solver first. We would rather have someone adaptable than someone with the exact domain experience. Having built across different industries — fintech, e-commerce, logistics or otherwise — is a positive signal, not a scattered CV.
  • You have 10+ years of overall software engineering experience, with substantial hands-on production engineering and strong backend depth. Our backend environment is Java and Spring Boot.
  • You have at least 5 years of engineering leadership, including managing Engineering Managers.
  • You collaborate well with product and business stakeholders, and can translate operational requirements into engineering solutions.
  • Experience working with location and geospatial data is a strong plus, including map integrations.
  • Experience with route, trip or delivery optimisation is a strong plus.
  • Experience building for compliance — where data must be structured to evidence what was done and when — is a strong plus.
  • Experience with identity, KYC or verification platforms is a plus. None of these four are requirements.

Cultural Alignment

As well, we assess every candidate across eight dimensions that define how great leaders operate at Moniepoint. We look for evidence of all eight throughout the process, not just in a single conversation.

  • Customer Obsession: Build deep empathy for users. Solve problems intuitively, and fix root causes, not just tickets.
  • Craft: Master the fundamentals. Reason from first principles, make trade-offs explicit, and raise the bar on quality.
  • Systemisation: Turn repeating decisions into scalable mechanisms. Reduce cognitive load and raise engineering quality.
  • Urgency: Move with disciplined speed. Act autonomously within scope, remove friction, and escalate risks early.
  • Ownership: Treat the platform as your own. Take initiative across boundaries and follow through without reminders.
  • No Ego: Put the mission first. Share credit, welcome debate, and never protect status over team outcomes.
  • Candour: Surface uncomfortable truths and risks early. Intelligent failure is welcome; concealment is not.
  • Integrity: Stay truthful and ethically consistent. Refuse toxic behavior. Performance without integrity is unacceptable.

What Success Looks Like

  • The domain has clear technical ownership and direction for the first time.
  • The team out of keep-the-lights-on mode and delivering against a prioritised roadmap.
  • Measurable improvement in field officer efficiency — more verifications per trip, lower cost per verification.
  • A native mobile experience shipped for field officers.
  • Verification data that stands up to compliance scrutiny across every business unit the platform serves.
  • The platform ready to support a new market.
  • A team grown beyond its current size, with a strong bench of engineers and managers.

Why Join Us

  • A genuinely greenfield mandate on a system that already matters. Every customer Moniepoint onboards passes through this platform.
  • A lean, capable team making outsized impact, and the remit to build the organisation around them.
  • Breadth: backend, web, mobile, location data, compliance and operational optimisation in one domain.
  • Be part of a mission-driven company expanding access to financial services for millions of businesses and individuals.

What To Expect in The Hiring Process

  • A preliminary phone call with the recruiter.
  • 60 minute High level System Design round with one of our Engineering Managers.
  • 60 minute Panel Interview with 2 of our Head of Engineering leaders. 30 minutes focused on a technical deep dive into your CV and into a project or system you built in the past. 30 minutes focused on testing for leadership attributes.
  • 60 minute Stakeholder Management Round with one of our Product Heads/VPs, focused on your stakeholder management and collaboration skills with product and business.
  • 60 minute Technical round and Culture fit interview with our Co-founder & Group CTO (the hiring manager).

title: Senior Solutions Engineer  - London
description:
About Neo4j:

Neo4j is the graph intelligence platform that transforms data into knowledge to power the next generation of intelligent applications and AI systems. It includes enterprise-ready knowledge graphs for accurate, explainable, and governed AI; the most comprehensive, trusted, and easy-to-deploy graph capabilities across any environment and data source; and an unmatched ecosystem trusted by 84 of the Fortune 100 and supported by the world’s largest graph community. Intelligence that works. Results that matter.

Built to work everywhere and integrate with everything across every cloud for dynamic, personalized, and autonomous AI systems. We deliver quicker results, contextual knowledge, and solutions that impact customers and employees across the business.

Our Vision:

At Neo4j, we have always strived to help the world make sense of data.

As business, society and knowledge become increasingly connected, our technology promotes innovation by helping organizations to find and understand data relationships. We created, drive and lead the graph database category, and we’re disrupting how organizations leverage their data to innovate and stay competitive.

The Role

Neo4j is the world’s leading graph database, and our Solutions Engineering (PreSales) team plays a pivotal role in helping customers unlock its potential every day. Neo4j has established itself as a premier data and AI platform for enterprise use cases across Knowledge Graphs, Network & Grid Topology, Root-Cause & Impact Analysis, Fraud & AML, Customer 360, Asset Intelligence, and modern AI workloads including GenAI, LLM-driven applications, and emerging Agentic AI architectures.

As part of Neo4j’s Solutions Engineering (PreSales) organization, you will work directly with strategic and enterprise customers across several key Benelux verticals — including High-Tech Manufacturing, Energy & Utilities, Telecommunications, Financial Services, and the Public Sector. You’ll provide technical and architectural leadership, helping customers design Neo4j-powered solutions that deliver measurable business value.

The role of a Solutions Engineer (PreSales) encompasses a broad range of responsibilities, starting with understanding a customer’s unique requirements and environment. You’ll translate these into tailored solution architectures that incorporate Neo4j’s advanced graph technology, guiding stakeholders throughout the sales cycle. Daily work includes demonstrating Neo4j’s capabilities, whiteboarding solution designs, and engaging with technical decision-makers to align solutions with their strategic priorities.

You’ll bridge the gap between business and technology, combining technical strength with the ability to articulate clear value and outcomes.

Main Responsibilities

  • Act as a central player in Neo4j Solution Engineering engagements, supporting customers across the entire customer lifecycle — from early discovery to architecture design, proof-of-value, and long-term adoption.
  • Build and nurture strong relationships with strategic and enterprise customer teams.
  • Partner closely with Account Executives to communicate the technical and business impact of graph solutions.
  • Ensure strong technical alignment and smooth integration of Neo4j into customer environments.
  • Provide architectural recommendations aligned with customer strategies and IT landscapes.
  • Design and present Neo4j-based prototypes that demonstrate both technical feasibility and business value.

Key Role Characteristics

  • Experience: At least 5 years in PreSales / Solutions Engineering or Professional Services, ideally with enterprise customers in High-Tech, Energy, Telecom, Financial Services, or Public Sector.
  • Database Expertise: Strong understanding of database platforms, particularly NoSQL.
  • Solution Design: Ability to translate business requirements into effective solution architectures.
  • Technical Proficiency: Familiarity with a programming or scripting language (Java, Python, JavaScript, etc.).
  • Consultative Skills: Proven experience guiding technical teams through complex, consultative engagements.
  • Adaptability: Strong desire to learn and quickly adopt emerging technologies.
  • Problem-Solving: Passion for tackling complex technical challenges with innovative solutions.
  • Enablement: Ability to lead technical workshops and small-group sessions.
  • Sales Alignment: Comfortable managing the technical aspects of enterprise sales cycles.

Beneficial Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience with graph technologies (Neo4j, Cypher, GDS, GraphQL).
  • Knowledge of GenAI, LLM architectures, RAG, or Agentic AI frameworks.
  • Experience with vector search, embeddings, or semantic retrieval.
  • Background in graph data science, network analysis, or ML pipelines.
  • ETL, data integration, or data virtualization expertise.
  • Familiarity with complex enterprise IT environments.
Why Join Neo4j?

Neo4j is, without question, the most popular graph intelligence platform in the world. We have customers in every industry globally, and our products are a proven product/market fit. Joining our team is an opportunity to shape the future of data and analytics. Below are just a few exciting facts about Neo4j.

  • Neo4j is one of the fastest-scaling technology companies in this industry. It recently surpassed $200M in annual recurring revenue (ARR), doubling its ARR over the past three years.
  • Raised the biggest funding round in database history ($325M Series F). Backed by world-class investors like Eurazeo, GV (formerly Google Ventures), and Inovia Capital, Neo4j has raised over $600M in funding and is currently valued at over $2Bn. This puts Neo4j among the most well-funded database companies in history.
  • 84% of the Fortune 100 and 58% of the Fortune 500 use Neo4j. Examples include Boston Scientific, BT Group, Caterpillar, Cisco, Comcast, Department for Education UK, eBay, NBC News, Novo Nordisk, Worldline, and others.
  • Co-founder and CEO Emil Eifrem has built an amazing culture that prides itself on relationships, inclusiveness, innovation, and customer success.
  • Countless industry awards. Massive enterprises and individual developers/data scientists love Neo4j. A strong sense of community and ecosystem is built around the platform.
  • A recent Forrester Total Economic Impact™ Study cited Neo4j as delivering 417% ROI to customers.

Research shows that members of underrepresented communities are less likely to apply for jobs when they don’t meet all the qualifications. If this is part of the reason you hesitate to apply, we’d encourage you to reconsider and give us the opportunity to review your application. At Neo4j, we are committed to building awareness and helping to improve these issues.

One of our central objectives is to provide an inclusive, diverse, and equitable workplace for everyone to develop their potential and have a positive, career-defining experience. We look forward to receiving your application.

Neo4j Values:

Neo4j is a Silicon Valley company with a Swedish soul. We foster collaboration and each of us is empowered to contribute and put our innovative stamp on projects. We hire candidates who reflect the following Neo4j core values:

(we)-[:DELIVER_ON]->(ourCommitments)

Senior Product Review Engineer (Liaison Engineering)

The Boeing Company

Boeing Commercial Airplanes (BCA) is hiring for Senior Product Review Engineers (Liaison Engineers) to join the 787 Production Engineering team located in North Charleston, SC.

This position includes a 9-to-12-month Boeing Training Rotation Program and will require a flexible schedule, which may involve assignments on 1st, 2nd, or 3rd shift, as well as occasional overtime, weekends, or holidays based on business needs.

The Product Review Engineers will perform/support troubleshooting, Root Cause Corrective Action (RCCA) technical analysis, and provide solutions to non-conforming products. They will work directly with cross functional and production engineering teams to meet production program objectives.

This position involves daily exposure to a factory environment which includes stairs, trip hazards, high noise areas, chemical hazards (breathing and handling), and entering airplanes during their many stages of building.

title: Principal Engineer, APTD Process Control System
description:
Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all.

Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.

Job Description

As a Process Control System Engineer, you will be primarily responsible for starting up, developing, and optimizing processes to enhance product quality and reliability. Your role includes improving process yield, reducing costs, increasing productivity, managing risks, and resolving manufacturing line issues. You will identify, diagnose, and resolve assembly process-related problems using methodologies such as failure analysis, FMEA, 8D, or SPC/FDC. Additional duties involve coordinating process, equipment, and material evaluations to implement process changes, leading and participating in yield improvement and cost reduction initiatives, managing new process baseline qualifications, and working with material suppliers to meet quality, cost, and risk management goals.

In this position, you will develop smart manufacturing solutions aligned with Industry 4.0 standards, gaining exposure to areas such as Machine Learning, Advanced Control Solutions, the Industrial Internet of Things (IIOT), and Deep Learning. You will have the opportunity to create comprehensive solutions, from requirements gathering and data analysis to system development, integration, and network-wide implementation. Your work will directly impact company performance by providing scrap/excursion control, Statistical Process Control (SPC), Advanced Process Control (APC or Run-to-Run), Fault Detection and Classification (FDC), and improved process capability. Collaboration with process teams to understand their tools, processes, and challenges is essential, as you will help develop process control models and strategies to ensure quality output.

Responsibilities

  • Develop, implement, and enhance smart control solutions for optimal manufacturing performance.
  • Provide technical oversight, guidance, and support for process control implementation.
  • Conduct in-depth data analysis and modeling to identify process variations and translate findings into control solutions.
  • Support teams in classification, characterization, and categorization, define data collection requirements, and perform integration and data setup in the E3 environment.
  • Define analysis and setup requirements, establish limits and OCAP, and participate in regular reviews with the process control team and network on best practices.
  • Develop and deliver training on control systems and related topics.
  • Leveraging Artificial Intelligence to develop control systems for process management (Claude code, LLM)

Requirements

  • Experience in semiconductor manufacturing and advanced process control.
  • PhD, Master’s, or bachelor’s degree in engineering, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or Physics.
  • Knowledge of various sensor applications for the Industrial Internet of Things (IIOT).
  • Strong passion for programming and data analysis.
  • Familiarity with machine learning and data science analytical skills.
  • Preferred experience with Python, R, SQL, Hadoop ecosystem, and/or developing web-based applications.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical abilities.
  • Outstanding verbal and written communication skills.
  • Excellent project management skills.
  • Ambitious, with the ability to multitask and manage dynamic priorities.
  • Team-oriented with strong interpersonal and communication skills.
  • Ability to work effectively in a cross-functional team environment.
  • Willingness and ability to travel internationally as required to fulfill objectives.
  • Familiar with AI tools or with AI capabilities is preferred

About Micron Technology, Inc.

We are an industry leader in innovative memory and storage solutions transforming how the world uses information to enrich life for all. With a relentless focus on our customers, technology leadership, and manufacturing and operational excellence, Micron delivers a rich portfolio of high-performance DRAM, NAND, and NOR memory and storage products through our Micron® and Crucial® brands. Every day, the innovations that our people create fuel the data economy, enabling advances in artificial intelligence and 5G applications that unleash opportunities — from the data center to the intelligent edge and across the client and mobile user experience.
