At Wells Fargo, we're more than a financial services leader – we’re a global trailblazer committed to driving innovation, empowering communities, and helping our customers succeed. We believe that a meaningful career is much more than just a job – it’s about finding all of the elements to help you thrive, in one place. About this role:

Wells Fargo is seeking a Senior Branch Premier Banker (SAFE) to play a pivotal role within our National Branch Network. This role grows, deepens, and manages relationships with affluent customers and those with more complex financial needs, serving as their primary point of contact for banking products and services through scheduled appointments, lobby engagement, and proactive outreach. This role is designed for growth oriented professionals who lead with advice to acquire and deepen relationships through meaningful discovery and translate customer goals into comprehensive financial strategies. You will own and actively grow a defined book of business, leveraging goals based planning, and prudent risk oversight to deliver integrated solutions across deposits, investments, credit, home lending, and business banking. In addition, you’ll help customers with everyday banking needs-opening accounts, handling service requests, and ensuring a seamless experience making it easier for them to manage their banking with confidence. Success in this role is driven by strong relationship acumen, proactive customer engagement, and seamless collaboration with internal partners across Wealth, Home Lending, and Business Banking to deliver a differentiated customer experience.

Wells Fargo rewards behaviors that consistently create long term customer value and support customers in making informed financial decisions. You’ll be supported with digital tools, industry leading training, ongoing coaching, and backed by one of the most recognized brands in banking. This role offers a clear platform for career growth for experienced professionals who excel at building trust, managing a portfolio, and delivering holistic, multi product solutions.

To support sustainable growth and meet evolving client expectations, each platform must play a clearly defined role in delivering a seamless and distinctive experience across online and offline touchpoints. Ideal attributes:

  • Strongly results-oriented, with the ability to define, track, and deliver against objectives and key performance indicators

title: Client Onboarding & Monitoring Lead
description:
OFX is a leading financial operations company providing businesses and accounting firms with real-time financial control and visibility to do business anywhere in the world. With an innovative platform and 24/7 human support, OFX automates and simplifies doing business across borders, reducing risk and eliminating routine operational tasks. Offering global business accounts, payments to 180 countries in 30+ currencies and currency risk management solutions to simplify global payments. OFX further enhances business operations by providing corporate cards with spend management, bill payments, vendor management, and integrations with popular accounting and HRIS software, to help achieve better business solutions so accounting firms and businesses thrive.

Headquartered in Sydney, Australia, with offices globally, in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, Ireland, New Zealand, Singapore and Hong Kong. OFX has been a trusted innovator in global money movement for over 25 years.

Purpose of your role

We are seeking an experienced Client Onboarding & Monitoring Lead to play a critical role in working within a high performing team, responsible for OFX’s ongoing client due diligence activities in Singapore and APAC.

This role is responsible for driving operational excellence, particularly compliance and strict adherence to Monetary Authority of Singapore (MAS) regulatory standards and associated MAS AML/CFT Guidelines for our client onboarding and monitoring processes, as well as other relevant regulatory bodies across the APAC region. The role will support the OFX Compliance team with MAS AML/CFT requirements and is responsible for effective client onboarding, monitoring and ongoing due diligence controls.

You will work collaboratively with the onboarding and client monitoring teams across APAC, and cross functionally with key stakeholders such as risk, compliance and legal. Your leadership will directly support OFX’s ability to maintain safe and trusted relationships with clients and stakeholders.

What you do

  • Support the Head of Customer Operations APAC and the Singapore CEO in leading and managing the following activities across Singapore (and APAC where required):
    • Client onboarding, monitoring activities and ensuring timely and accurate completion of all OCDD tasks.
    • Oversee periodic and trigger-based Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD) and customer risk rating refreshes in response to ongoing monitoring findings.
    • Oversee approval of reviews and escalations where required to ensure due diligence is completed.
    • Accountability for identifying and escalating material AML/CTF, sanctions and other financial crime risks to the Compliance team and management.
    • Assist in the completion of client onboarding checks in line with KYC, AML and CTF onboarding requirements, ensuring a smooth and efficient process in order to maximise conversion rates from online registrations to active clients.
    • Proactively assist the team’s caseload, particularly in managing Singapore and Hong Kong case queues and broader APAC activities where required.
    • Support regulatory reviews, audits and leading remediation activities relating to client monitoring.
    • Provide leadership and oversight of all Singapore monitoring activities, to drive quality and efficiency across all client monitoring processes through data-driven insights.
    • Provide coaching, training, and professional development to team members to build expertise and confidence.
    • Assist in overseeing performance management and resource planning to maintain operational excellence.
  • In addition to core responsibilities for Singapore, the role will also:
    • Work closely with teams across APAC to assist with onboarding and client monitoring activities across APAC where required.
    • Be a key contributor in the local Singapore Leadership Team and actively support the Singapore CEO and leadership team at scheduled management meetings to report and engage on matters arising from their areas of AML, onboarding and monitoring responsibilities.
    • Act as a key liaison with Risk & Compliance, Client Protection, and Frontline teams to ensure alignment on monitoring outcomes and regulatory obligations.
    • Champion continuous improvement initiatives that enhance quality, reduce inefficiency, and strengthen compliance controls. In particular, provide leadership and oversight with regards to quality assurance, monitoring control effectiveness backlog oversight and the continuous improvement of monitoring processes.
    • Ensure the team maintains a customer-first mindset, providing timely communication and care during reviews or information requests.
    • Provide reporting and insights to leadership on emerging risks, metrics, and performance trends.

What you bring

Knowledge, skills, experience

  • Minimum of 5 years’ experience in AML/CTF, financial crime, or CDD roles within a regulated financial services or FinTech environment in Singapore
  • 2+ years of team leadership or supervisory experience in a client onboarding, compliance or monitoring function, within a regulated environment
  • Proven ability to manage operational teams in a regulated environment with a focus on accuracy and timeliness.
  • Strong understanding of global regulatory frameworks (e.g. MAS, FATF, AUSTRAC, FCA, FINTRAC).
  • Proven expertise in conducting client onboarding activities.
  • Proven expertise in conducting periodic reviews and enhanced due diligence.
  • Demonstrated ability to review and guide others on complex cases.
  • Proven collaborator and works well with colleagues cross region, and experience supporting or mentoring colleagues in a regulated operations environment.
  • Familiarity with transaction monitoring and KYC systems and tools.
  • Demonstrated experience improving processes and driving a culture of continuous improvement.
  • Skilled at managing stakeholder relationships across Compliance, Risk, and Operations.
  • Strong Risk-Based Approach and Regulatory Awareness
  • Ability to think critically and provide sound judgement
  • Ability to use metrics and apply data driven decision making
  • Effective Communication & Stakeholder Collaboration
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills.
  • Customer Centricity & Empathy

What it's like working at OFX

We’re OFXers because we want to make a difference. We see challenges as opportunities and we’re not afraid to roll up our sleeves to get stuff done. We’re committed to making things easier for our clients, pushing boundaries and continuing to move with the times so that we can continue to inspire confidence every day and through every transaction.

We operate as one team, cross-functionally and globally, to drive outcomes that deliver excellence for our customers. We're curious self-starters who love learning and sharing our knowledge with others. We embrace change and use our initiative and resilience to overcome challenges.

  • Always keep learning. We offer a wide range of learning and career development opportunities to help every OFXer build their capacity and career, with leadership training, secondments, internal mobility and access to a large library of online learning.
  • Make a difference. Through our Make a Difference program, we encourage OFXers to give back to causes and communities that are important to them. We celebrate this with an annual volunteer day, which OFXers can use together or individually, as well as matched giving and the opportunity to nominate charity of choice every quarter.
  • Reward and recognition. We recognise a job well done. OFXers are encouraged to celebrate their peers’ effort, technical expertise or support through a range of global and regional channels and awards, including quarterly and annual awards, milestones and shout outs.
  • Showing our social side. Our Good Vibes employee-led committees around the globe organize events to help keep our employees engaged inside and outside the office. Whether it’s a wellbeing activity, end of year celebration, or a monthly team get-together, our team wants you to feel welcome!
  • Benefits that mean something. We offer a range of fantastic benefits, including primary and secondary gender neutral carer parental leave (16 weeks) or birthday leave, you'll feel well-supported at OFX.
  • A great work environment. Enjoy work-life balance and flexibility with our hybrid work model, in an inclusive, diverse and non-hierarchal culture.

#Li-Hybrid

At OFX, we are committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive and accessible workplace where we value, respect, and encourage our people to be their authentic selves. With an employee base as diverse as the clients we serve, we know that fostering an inclusive workplace is fundamental to our continued success. If you require accommodation for any portion of the recruitment and hiring process, please email us at people.culture@ofx.com.

We encourage you to apply if this role aligns with your career aspirations.

title: Bouvet Bergen søker nyutdannet utvikler og data engineer med oppstart høsten 2027
description:
Bouvet søker nyutdannede utviklere og data engineers i Bergen med oppstart i august 2027 for å jobbe med systemutvikling og dataplattform.

  • Gode muligheter for sertifiseringer, kurs og konferanser
  • Overskuddsdeling og aksjeprogram
  • Aktivt sosialt miljø med bedriftsidrett og fagkvelder

Bouvet Bergen søker nyutdannet utvikler og data engineer med oppstart høsten 2027

Vil du være med på å utvikle morgendagens samfunn?

I en tid der verden endrer seg raskere enn noensinne, er vi med på å skape løsningene som gjør en forskjell for mennesker, virksomheter og samfunnet rundt oss. Nå søker vi nyutdannede utviklere og data engineers som fullfører utdanningen sin i 2027 og som ønsker å bli en del av vårt sterke fagmiljø i Bergen. Oppstart er i august 2027. Bouvet er Norges største norskeide IT-konsulentselskap og har et av regionens sterkeste fagmiljøer innen utvikling, data, kunstig intelligens, skyteknologi og rådgivning. Sammen med noen av Norges mest fremtredende virksomheter skaper vi løsninger som betyr noe for både enkeltmennesker og samfunnet som helhet. Nysgjerrighet, raushet og faglig integritet preger måten vi jobber på hver dag.

Sammen med noen av Norges mest fremtredende virksomheter skaper vi løsninger som betyr noe for både enkeltmennesker og samfunnet som helhet. Nysgjerrighet, raushet og faglig integritet preger måten vi jobber på hver dag.

Er du interessert i ett eller flere av disse fagområdene? Da vil vi gjerne høre fra deg!
  • Systemutvikling
  • Frontend- og backendutvikling
  • Dataplattform og data engineering

Hos oss jobber vi med et bredt spekter av teknologier, plattformer og programmeringsspråk, blant annet .NET, C#, Java, Kotlin, JavaScript, React, Angular, Vue, Node.js og Python. Vi utvikler skyløsninger i Azure, AWS og GCP og bygger dataplattformer og KI-baserte løsninger, fra språkmodeller og agenter til maskinlæring og moderne datatjenester.

Høres dette ut som deg?

  • Du fullfører en mastergrad innen teknologi, IT eller et lignende fagområde i løpet av 2027
  • Du er nysgjerrig og motivert for å lære og utvikle deg
  • Du liker å løse problemer, både teknisk og funksjonelt
  • Du er opptatt av å forstå kundens behov og utfordringer
  • Du trives med å samarbeide med ulike mennesker og fagmiljøer
  • Du ønsker å dele kunnskap og erfaringer med andre
  • Du kommuniserer godt på norsk, både skriftlig og muntlig

Hvordan sikrer vi en god overgang til arbeidslivet for deg som er nyutdannet?

  • Innseiling: Et program med sosiale sammenkomster og faglige aktiviteter for alle med mindre enn to år i Bouvet. Programmet gir trygge rammer for utvikling, innsikt i Bouvets kultur og verdier, og et sterkt nettverk på tvers av fagmiljøene våre
  • Onboarding: Alle nyansatte deltar i et strukturert onboardingprogram med blant annet konsulentrollekurs. Her får du en grundig innføring i Bouvet-kulturen og hva det vil si å være konsulent
  • Et av Norges sterkeste fagmiljøer med over 200 hyggelige og engasjerte kolleger i Bergen
  • En sterk delingskultur, hvor vi deler erfaringer, utfordringer og løsninger på tvers av fagområder, kunder og prosjekter
  • Gode muligheter for faglig utvikling gjennom utviklingsplaner, sertifiseringer, kurs og konferanser
  • En trygg og solid arbeidsplass med fokus på langsiktighet, støtte og balanse mellom jobb og fritid
  • Et aktivt sosialt miljø med alt fra bedriftsidrett og friluftsaktiviteter til fagkvelder, feiringer og kulturelle arrangementer
  • Gode betingelser, inkludert overskuddsdeling og mulighet til å bli medeier gjennom vårt aksjeprogram
  • Varierte arbeidsdager med spennende prosjekter og utfordringer du vokser på
  • Kort vei til beslutninger og mulighet til å påvirke din egen arbeidshverdag

I Bergen har vi sterke fagmiljøer på tvers av teknologiområder. Enten du er interessert i systemutvikling, data engineering, dataplattform, kunstig intelligens, eller skyteknologi, blir du en del av et miljø som er opptatt av læring, deling og faglig utvikling. Vi møtes jevnlig til faglunsjer, hackathons og sosiale aktiviteter. Hos oss får du kolleger som brenner for faget og som gjerne deler erfaringer og hjelper deg videre.

Søknadsprosess

Last opp søknadsbrev, CV, vitnemål/karakterutskrift og svar på våre utvalgsspørsmål. Dersom du fortsatt er under utdanning, ber vi deg laste opp vitnemål for fullført grad og karakterutskrift fra pågående studium.

Søknadsfristen er satt for å sikre at alle vi møter på karrieredager på ulike universitet i løpet av høsten får anledning til å søke, og blir utvidet ved behov til alle plasser er besett.

Vi gleder oss til å høre fra deg!

Sikkerhetsklarering

Bouvet jobber med kunder som leverer samfunnskritiske tjenester. Derfor er norsk språk og sikkerhetsklarering et krav for alle stillinger. Det gjennomføres bakgrunnssjekk ved alle ansettelser.

title: TEST SOLUTIONS ENGINEER
description:
Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all.

Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.

JOB DESCRIPTION

As a High Bandwidth Memory Test Engineer at Micron, you will develop, debug, and maintain code that enables the parallel testing of advanced memory devices. Micron Test Engineers support R&D, interacting closely with global teams, as well as taking part in the designing and debugging of test hardware. In this position, you will constantly learn new device specifications and operations in order to develop efficient and innovative solutions of production test flows thru test algo optimization. Additionally, you will take responsibility to gain a firm understanding of the functionality of advanced memory devices as defined in product data sheets.

RESPONSIBILITIES AND TASKS:

  • Independency of development of new tests and test algorithms for HBM, which covers test software and hardware requirements, defect coverage, characterization, trending, process flow, and test times.
  • Experienced on test programs development for products using primarily Python and C coding on automated test equipment in the given area followed by test program release to manufacturing area.
  • Be a lead to new product introduction (NPI) as well as pre/post silicon tasks management.
  • Develop test Automation solutions as electrical validation and qualification of new test equipment and tools.
  • Independently debug and identify root causes on test issues and provide solutions across internal/external groups.
  • Provide meaningful statistical data analysis, analytics and justification on program validation and its release to ensure program quality.
  • Evaluate and verify yields/quality with global teams to ensure we are shipping the highest quality product to our customers with enforce to all data sheet specification.
  • Support both internal and external groups on experiments designed to improve yield or capacity by resolving test issues that impact site in a timely manner.
  • Maintain tactical and project updates on daily and weekly basis, respectively. Updates should show progress against the timelines.
  • Drive Innovation and Improvement with the end goal of reducing the Cost of Test for Micron in the Test Department.
  • Support intra-departmental (and multi-site) teams in development of new processes and capabilities to support product roadmap; lead teams and drive development where necessary.

SUCCESSFUL CANDIDATES for THIS POSITION MUST DEMOSTRATE:

  • Experienced with electrical engineering, as applicable to memory devices and test hardware.
  • Well know of digital systems and digital logic for DRAM or HBM.
  • Strong logical thinking, as applied to general programming and problem solving.
  • Experienced with testing logic and leading products/projects. Familiar on cross groups communication.

SKILLS:

  • Familiar for problem solving with experienced programming logic.
  • Familiar with C/C++, and python for APG programing and test hardware architecture.
  • Influent communication with English speaking and ability to work in a multi-national multi-functional team.
  • Familiar working on Unix/Linux terminal.
  • Familiar semiconductor device knowledge and semiconductor process manufacturing.
  • Familiar with HBM product architecture or DRAM operation logic.

    • Demonstrate proficiency in Microsoft Copilot, Open Code/GitHub Copilot, and AI-enabled engineering tools.

    • Drive AI adoption to improve engineering productivity, automate repetitive tasks, and accelerate decision-making.

title: Client Services Consultant
description:
The Role

We are seeking a highly organised, proactive and client-focused individual to join our Energy Solutions team. The successful candidate will support clients operating across the energy and water sectors, with a particular focus on smart infrastructure, utility services and technologies that enable the transition to net zero.

The role is primarily responsible for coordinating and supporting industry meetings, stakeholder engagement and the production of high-quality documentation to support governance and decision-making. Working with clients, Chairs, committee members, industry bodies, technology providers and internal specialists, you will provide reliable facilitation, coordination and quality support across energy, water and net zero technology programmes.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone with strong communication and relationship management skills, a keen eye for detail and a genuine interest in the modernisation of UK utilities. The role will contribute to work involving smart metering, energy and water efficiency, low-carbon solutions and other emerging technologies that support resilient, affordable and sustainable services.


Responsibilities

Client and Contract Management

  • Deliver day-to-day operational support across a portfolio of energy, water and net zero technology contracts, programmes and trade associations.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with utility clients, technology providers and key stakeholders, ensuring a consistently high level of customer satisfaction.
  • Act as a point of contact for routine client enquiries, responding promptly and referring complex contract, technology or governance matters to the appropriate colleague.
  • Work collaboratively with technical, regulatory and commercial colleagues to ensure clients receive the expertise required to meet their objectives.

Meeting and Governance Support

  • Coordinate and support forum meetings, working with Chairs and committee members to ensure effective preparation, facilitation and follow-up.
  • Deliver high-quality meeting papers, agendas, briefing notes, minutes, action logs, and governance documentation.
  • Monitor progress against actions and decisions, ensuring outcomes are effectively tracked and communicated.
  • Ensure governance processes are followed and that documentation is accurate, consistent, and professionally presented.

Quality Assurance and Continuous Improvement

  • Review and quality-assure documents, reports, and communications across contracts and projects.
  • Apply agreed quality, consistency and professional standards in own work and support colleagues in using established templates and processes.
  • Suggest practical improvements to processes, systems and client services, and support their implementation under appropriate guidance.
  • Support the development and maintenance of guidance documents, procedures, knowledge repositories, and FAQs.

Stakeholder Engagement and Market Awareness

  • Support effective working relationships with energy and water companies, regulators, government bodies, trade associations, innovators and technology providers.
  • Share relevant market information and potential client needs with senior colleagues to support service development activities.
  • Contribute research and draft content, as required, for market insight, website and promotional materials relating to energy, water and net zero innovation.
  • Represent the business professionally in stakeholder interactions and contribute to a positive client experience.
  • Knowledge Management and Collaboration
  • Develop and maintain knowledge of UK energy and water markets, utility regulation and net zero policy, with particular emphasis on metering, digitalisation, data, flexible demand and resource efficiency.
  • Track relevant technologies and market developments, including smart meters, advanced metering infrastructure, connected assets, energy storage, electric vehicle charging, heat decarbonisation, renewable energy and intelligent water networks.
  • Highlight recurring knowledge needs and contribute to the preparation of guidance or learning materials for colleagues and stakeholders.
  • Share expertise across the wider team and contribute to a culture of continuous learning and collaboration.
  • Provide practical support and share knowledge with colleagues as part of day-to-day collaborative working.
  • Risk and Issue Support
  • Identify and record operational, governance and knowledge-management risks or issues arising through day-to-day delivery.
  • Follow established controls and procedures that support service quality and customer experience.
  • Escalate risks and issues promptly to the appropriate colleague and assist with agreed follow-up actions.

Competitive salary plus excellent benefits package

Location : Either London or Birmingham office

Requirements

Essential

  • Excellent written, verbal, and numerical communication skills.
  • Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
  • Experience coordinating meetings, workshops, committees, or governance forums.
  • Ability to produce high-quality written documentation, including minutes, reports, briefing papers, and stakeholder communications.
  • Strong stakeholder management and relationship-building capabilities.
  • Experience working in a customer-facing or client management environment.
  • Proven ability to work independently while contributing effectively within a team environment.
  • Demonstrated commitment to quality, accuracy, and continuous improvement.

Desirable

  • Experience within UK energy, water or net zero markets, particularly smart metering, advanced metering infrastructure, digital networks or low-carbon technology.
  • Knowledge of energy or water regulation, industry codes, governance structures or assurance frameworks.
  • Understanding of technologies such as renewable generation, energy storage, electric vehicle charging, heat pumps, hydrogen, carbon management, water efficiency, leakage reduction or intelligent water networks.
  • Experience working with utilities, technology providers, trade associations, industry forums or member organisations.
  • Experience supporting budget administration, account coordination or contract reporting.
  • Experience sharing knowledge or providing practical support to colleagues.
  • Understanding of quality management and risk management principles.

What We Are Looking For

  • The successful candidate will demonstrate:
  • A positive, professional, and proactive approach.
  • Exceptional attention to detail.
  • A strong customer service ethos.
  • Confidence when engaging professionally with a range of stakeholders.
  • Flexibility and resilience when dealing with changing priorities.
  • Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills.
  • A commitment to excellence and continuous improvement.
  • A collaborative approach and willingness to support colleagues and share knowledge.

Upon employment, employees should also have a sound awareness of the Company's Information, Quality, Environmental and Energy Management Systems.

Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion commitments
Our commitment to sustainable and inclusive growth. As a socially responsible leader, Talan continually invests in sustainable growth, addressing both social and environmental challenges. We achieve this while preserving our core values and ensuring operational excellence for our clients. This commitment to excellence extends across all aspects of our Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) initiatives.

For the past three years, through our 360° approach to social and environmental responsibility, we have been driving significant change and strengthening these principles within our corporate DNA. The solid foundations we've been building since 2021 are enabling our organisation to transform in a sustainable and positive manner.

Disability Inclusion
We recognise that the diversity of legislative and cultural frameworks for supporting individuals with disabilities requires the implementation of specific policies and a unique approach in each country where the Group operates. Talan is committed to strengthening its involvement in promoting the inclusion of people with disabilities by implementing dedicated support systems and raising awareness among our teams on these issues.

We invest in great leaders who bring out the best in you and the company, enabling us to multiply our impact and results. This is why, year after year, we are recognized worldwide as a great place to work.

We set the standard for how organizations leverage artificial intelligence to drive meaningful impact. title: Global Deal Strategy Sr. Analyst
description:

This role will act as a strategic partner to Sales leadership on complex, high-value deals and opportunities, bringing sound judgment and financial rigor to structuring that balances revenue, profitability, and market share priorities.   • Independently evaluate and resolve non-standard deal requests, driving cross-functional solutions across Sales, Finance, and Legal with minimal oversight
  • Review and approve key terms on quotes, ensuring accuracy and alignment with pricing, revenue recognition, and operational guidelines
  • Ensure all transactions adhere to internal revenue recognition policies and operational guidelines, escalating and resolving edge cases as needed
  • Lead the development and rollout of best practices and playbooks that increase sales efficiency and shorten cycle times across the global team

title: EMEA Cash Management Operations Process Improvement Analyst - 12 Month Fixed Term Contract
description:
About this role:

Wells Fargo is seeking a Cash Management Operations Process Improvement Analyst to join our EMEA Cash Management Operations team.

In this role, you will use data, analytics, and business insights to support the effective management of cash positions, funding requirements, and intraday liquidity across EMEA entities. You will analyse cash flows, payment activity, liquidity trends, and operational performance metrics to identify emerging risks, investigate exceptions, and uncover opportunities to improve forecasting accuracy and operational efficiency.

Working closely with partners across Cash Management Operations, Treasury, Technology, Risk, and Change Management, you will transform complex data into actionable insights that support strategic decision-making and operational excellence. You will play a key role in monitoring intraday liquidity activity, identifying trends and anomalies, enhancing reporting capabilities, and providing recommendations that strengthen operational resilience and improve business outcomes.

The successful candidate will combine strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to build effective stakeholder relationships across multiple functions. You will be comfortable working with large datasets, challenging existing processes through data-driven insights, and influencing change that delivers measurable business value.

This is an exciting opportunity to join a highly collaborative team where your analysis and recommendations will directly contribute to the ongoing evolution of Cash Management Operations across EMEA. At Wells Fargo, we foster an inclusive culture that values diversity, equity, and collaboration, where different perspectives are encouraged and team members are empowered to grow, innovate, and make a meaningful impact.

Key Success Measures

  • Improvements in intraday liquidity forecasting accuracy.

  • Reduction in manual processes and operational inefficiencies.

  • Successful delivery of strategic improvement initiatives.

  • Enhanced management information and decision-support reporting.

  • Strengthened operational controls and reduced operational risk.

  • Positive stakeholder feedback and measurable business value delivered.


In this role, you will:

Process Improvement & Strategic Analysis

  • Conduct detailed reviews of existing cash management and liquidity management processes to identify operational inefficiencies, control enhancements and automation opportunities.

  • Analyse current operating models and recommend improvements to increase efficiency, scalability and risk mitigation.

  • Develop business cases and supporting analysis for process enhancement initiatives.

  • Evaluate emerging technologies, tools and data sources that could improve operational performance and forecasting capabilities.

  • Establish and maintain a pipeline of improvement opportunities aligned to departmental objectives.

Intraday Liquidity & Forecasting Enhancement

  • Analyse current projection methodologies and identify opportunities to improve intraday cash forecasting accuracy.

  • Review funding trends, payment behaviours and settlement patterns to uncover predictive indicators that could enhance liquidity forecasts.

  • Partner with Treasury, Operations and Technology teams to identify additional datasets, reporting capabilities and forecasting tools.

  • Develop recommendations that improve visibility of funding requirements and intraday liquidity positions.

  • Support the design and implementation of enhanced liquidity monitoring and forecasting frameworks.

Stakeholder Engagement

  • Act as a key liaison between Cash Management Operations, Treasury, Technology, Operations Change, Risk and other business partners.

  • Build strong working relationships across operational and strategic functions to support successful delivery of change initiatives.

  • Present recommendations, findings and progress updates to senior management and governance forums.

  • Collaborate with subject matter experts to ensure proposed solutions align with business needs and regulatory expectations.

Data Analysis & Reporting

  • Utilise data analysis techniques to identify trends, patterns and operational insights.

  • Develop management reporting and dashboards that support decision making and prioritisation of improvement opportunities.

  • Support creation of executive-level presentations and recommendations supported by quantitative analysis.

Risk & Control

  • Ensure all proposed enhancements align with the firm's risk and control framework.

  • Assess impacts of process changes on operational risk, controls and governance requirements.

  • Support audit, compliance and regulatory reviews where process improvement initiatives are in scope.

  • Proactively identify and escalate risks associated with change programmes and process redesign.

Required Qualifications:

  • Experience within Cash Management, Treasury Operations, Funding Operations, Liquidity Management or Capital Markets Operations.

  • Demonstrated experience leading process improvement, transformation or change initiatives.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate complex data into actionable insights.

  • Experience of developing business requirements, process maps, operating models and project documentation.

  • Advanced Microsoft Excel and strong PowerPoint presentation skills.

  • Experience with data visualisation and reporting tools such as Power BI or similar platforms is advantageous.

  • Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills across multiple levels of the organisation.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex information for diverse audiences.

  • Ability to challenge existing processes constructively and recommend innovative solutions.

  • Understanding of cash management, liquidity forecasting, payments, nostro management and financial markets operations.

  • Proven ability to investigate issues, perform root cause analysis, and deliver practical solutions.


Desired Qualifications:

  • Knowledge of intraday liquidity management, cash forecasting, payments, nostro accounts, or treasury operations.

  • Experience working with SQL, Power Query, Python, Alteryx, or other analytical tools.

  • Understanding of operational risk, governance, and regulatory requirements within a banking environment.

title: Senior Quality Assurance Engineer
description:
Kia ora!

At Air New Zealand, we’re constantly evolving, embracing innovation, and pushing boundaries to create extraordinary experiences for our customers and employees. As we continue to grow and transform, we're seeking individuals who are passionate about making a difference and playing a key role in our journey. This is why we are excited to offer the opportunity to join the QA team and help drive our digital transformation efforts forward.

To support our shift to a more agile and innovative way of working, we are looking for a Senior QA Engineer. This role is critical to ensuring that our technical teams deliver high-quality solutions that align with our core values of excellence and customer focus. We need someone who can lead by example and bring their expertise to the table to help us enhance our testing capabilities and ensure the highest standards of quality.

This role is based at our Auckland Airport Campus office.

Key Responsibilities

  • Use agile and lean methods (e.g. KANBAN, SCRUM, etc.) and get involved with all parts of the development process from inception through to release.
  • Design, develop and execute new automation scenarios from functional and technical requirements and change requests.
  • Maintain and monitor existing automation and regression testing, including ongoing refactoring of test suites.
  • Apply software engineering principles to test engineering to ensure maximum ongoing value of implemented test suites.
  • Work with technical teams (architects, software engineers, QA’s and BA’s) to diagnose issues and enhance the software design to best facilitate automation.
  • Actively contribute to the strategic direction and technical roadmap of our software automation toolset and automated testing processes.
  • Ensure both manual and automated tests adhere to testing processes, standards, and guidelines.
  • Facilitate user acceptance testing to ensure that all requirements, features, or stories have been fully tested and accepted by the stakeholders prior to deployment.
  • Provide coaching and mentoring to QA engineers.

Work Experience

  • 5+ years experience as a Senior QA Automation within a technology business environment.
  • Significant experience with testing of software and practical experience developing a test strategy within a complex technology environment.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Java automation frameworks, CI/CD, test-driven development, and testing technologies.
  • Strong experience in test automation tools and frameworks (e.g., Selenium, Playwright, Rest Assured, JUnit, TestNG).
  • Experience using testing, continuous integration and delivery toolsets to obtain fast quality states.
  • Experience in being a technical mentor to others.
  • Experience in working effectively and collaboratively across software product team disciplines and intra-team dependencies.
  • Solid knowledge of current quality assurance methodologies, best practices, and toolsets.
  • Solid knowledge of automation models and approaches.
  • In-depth understanding of SDLC and first-hand experience within an Agile team.
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills.

Applications close on 27 September 2026.

title: Werkscontroller (m/w/d) / Controller Manufacturing
description:
Welcome to Planet. We believe in using space to help life on Earth.

Planet designs, builds, and operates the largest constellation of imaging satellites in history. This constellation delivers an unprecedented dataset of empirical information via a revolutionary cloud-based platform to authoritative figures in commercial, environmental, and humanitarian sectors. We are both a space company and data company all rolled into one.

Customers and users across the globe use Planet's data to develop new technologies, drive revenue, power research, and solve our world’s toughest obstacles.

As we control every component of hardware design, manufacturing, data processing, and software engineering, our office is a truly inspiring mix of experts from a variety of domains.

We have a people-centric approach toward culture and community and we strive to iterate in a way that puts our team members first and prepares our company for growth. Join Planet and be a part of our mission to change the way people see the world.

Planet is a global company with employees working remotely world wide and joining us from offices in San Francisco, Washington DC, Germany, Austria, Slovenia, and The Netherlands.

About the Role:

We are seeking a versatile Werkscontroller (m/w/d) / Controller Manufacturing to serve as a key bridge between our newly established Berlin manufacturing facility and our US financial operations. In this dual-impact role, you will lead the cost accounting workflows and local compliance for our German entity (GmbH) while simultaneously supporting global cost accounting tasks, cross-border subsidiary reconciliations, and capital expenditure tracking. You will partner with operational leaders to establish scalable standard costing methodologies, maintain inventory integrity across multiple locations, and ensure seamless financial alignment between EMEA and US teams. Ideal candidates are detail-oriented professionals with background in multi-entity global structures who thrive in cross-functional environments.

This is a full-time, remote position based in Germany. If located near an office, you are expected to work from that office 3 days per week.

Impact You’ll Own:

  • Partner with Berlin Operations to establish scalable cost accounting workflows, standard costing methodologies, and manufacturing time-tracking for our local production line.
  • Lead monthly close processes for GmbH inventory, including raw materials, WIP, and finished goods reconciliations, while overseeing physical cycle counts and analyzing adjustments.
  • Ensure local accounting activities comply with German GAAP (HGB), prepare cost breakdowns for German R&D tax incentives (e.g., Forschungszulage), and manage financial documentation for local government grants and subsidies.
  • Manage PCard reconciliations for lab equipment and flight materials while reviewing capital expenditure vs. operational expenses (CIP/Expense classifications) for the German entity.
  • Serve as the dedicated backup for US cost accountants during time-off, high-volume periods, and initial US-hours coverage through cross-training on US month-end workflows.
  • Review and clear consolidated transfer orders between international subsidiaries, managing movements between locations for both PBC and GmbH entities.
  • Maintain costs associated with satellite materials, launch, and build processes while tracking movements across inventory, WIP, and internal fixed asset materials.
  • Assist in labor capitalization tracking across internal software development, satellite construction, and commissioning efforts.
  • Perform purchase price variance (PPV), production variance, scrap, and Excess & Obsolete (E&O) analysis while preparing balance sheet reconciliations, journal entries, and accrued purchases/prepaid manufacturing schedules for US and EMEA operations.
  • Support internal and external audits across US GAAP, local German GAAP, and SOX controls.

What You Bring:

  • 4+ years of relevant cost accounting experience in a manufacturing or high-tech operational environment.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or Business Administration (or a relevant German Ausbildung, e.g., Industriekaufmann/-frau, with specialized focus on accounting/controlling).
  • Experience with inventory controls and multi-entity global structures.
  • Proficiency with modern ERP systems and advanced capability in Excel or Google Sheets.
  • Professional working proficiency in German and English, the language of the company.

What Makes You Stand Out:

  • Working knowledge of both US GAAP and German GAAP (HGB).
  • Hands-on experience with NetSuite ERP.

title: Design-for-Test (DFT) Engineer — ASIC Backend – (Associate, Experienced, or Lead)
description:
Design-for-Test (DFT) Engineer — ASIC Backend – (Associate, Experienced, or Lead)

Company:

The Boeing Company

Boeing Space, Intelligence & Weapons Systems has an exciting opportunity for multiple Design-for-Test (DFT) Engineers — ASIC Backend to join us as part of our Boeing Electronic Products team at the heart of Boeing’s products to support advanced digital subsystem development in an aerospace environment in El Segundo or Huntington Beach, CA.

Position overview
The DFT team drives architecture, verification, and post-silicon validation for leading-edge ASICs. We seek engineers across experience levels (Jr → Principal) to design and validate test access mechanisms, memory BIST, scan compression, and related test infrastructure.

Key responsibilities

  • Design and implement DFT architectures: TAP/JTAG, IJTAG (IEEE 1687), Boundary Scan (BSCAN), MBIST, and scan compression

  • Develop and validate TAP/JTAG and IJTAG infrastructures, BSDL/ICL/PDL artifacts, and ATPG pattern generation

  • Drive pattern generation, coverage optimization, memory test validation, and silicon debug (scan, at-speed, bring-up)

  • Integrate DFT features across the chip design flow and collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure robust DFT integration

  • Coordinate with external partners/customers on custom DFT interfaces and security requirements when applicable

  • Contribute to development and deployment of DFT methodologies for next-generation products

  • Occasional travel and after-hours meetings during critical milestones

Boeing continuously shapes the future of aerospace and space systems, advancing U.S. leadership in space while amplifying human creativity and intelligence. As a Boeing engineer, you’ll join a diverse, collaborative team solving high‑impact challenges in complex semiconductor design. If you value a company that supports strong work–life balance and meaningful technical work, Boeing is the place to be.

How to make your application stand out:
If you are a creative, autonomous engineer passionate about advancing DFT for mission-critical ASICs, we want to hear from you. Please include a cover letter/brief summary of relevant DFT experience when submitting your application.

This position is expected to be 100% onsite. The selected candidate will be required to work onsite at one of the listed locations.

Basic Qualifications (Required Skills/Experience):

  • This position requires the ability to obtain a US Security Clearance for which the US Government requires US Citizenship as a condition of employment. An interim and/or final U.S. Secret Clearance Post-Start is required.

  • Bachelor of Science degree in Engineering (with a focus in Electrical, Mechanical or Aeronautical), Computer Science, Data Science, Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry or non-US equivalent qualifications directly related to the work statement

  • 2+ years of experience in Design for Testability (DFT) or equivalent (role level adjustable by experience).

  • Strong knowledge of ASIC/logic design flow, HDL (Verilog/SystemVerilog), static timing analysis, and ECO processes.

  • Hands-on expertise with TAP/JTAG, IJTAG (IEEE 1687), Boundary Scan (IEEE 1149.1), MBIST, scan compression, ATPG, at-speed test, and silicon debug.

  • Proficiency in scripting (Tcl/Perl/Python) and DFT verification methodologies.

  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications (Desired Skills/Experience):

  • Experienced, Level 3: 5+ years of related engineering experience

  • Lead, Level 4: 9+ years of related engineering experience

  • Bachelor’s Degree or Master's Degree in EE, Computer Engineering/Science, or related field

  • Active U.S. Secret Security Clearance

  • Requirements development and traceability experience

  • FPGA implementation including constraints and timing closure

  • Static timing analysis experience

  • Understanding of timing fundamentals and CDC concepts

  • Verification collaboration experience

  • High-speed interfaces, processor integration, memory subsystems, or SoC integration

  • Mentoring or technical leadership exposure

  • Familiarity with industry-standard tools and methodologies

Conflict of Interest:

Successful candidate for this job must satisfy the Company’s Conflict of Interest (COI) assessment process.

Typical Education/Experience:

Associate, Level 2: Education/experience typically acquired through advanced technical education from an accredited course of study in engineering, computer science, mathematics, physics or chemistry (e.g. Bachelor) and typically 2 or more years' related work experience or an equivalent combination of technical education and experience (e.g. Master). In the USA, ABET accreditation is the preferred, although not required, accreditation standard.

Experienced, Level 3: Education/experience typically acquired through advanced technical education from an accredited course of study in engineering, engineering technology (includes manufacturing engineering technology), computer science, engineering data science, mathematics, physics or chemistry (e.g. Bachelor) and typically 5 or more years' related work experience or an equivalent combination of technical education and experience or non-US equivalent qualifications. In the USA, ABET accreditation is the preferred, although not required, accreditation standard.

Lead, Level 4: Education/experience typically acquired through advanced technical education from an accredited course of study in engineering, engineering technology (includes manufacturing engineering technology), computer science, engineering data science, mathematics, physics or chemistry (e.g. Bachelor) and typically 9 or more years' related work experience or an equivalent combination of technical education and experience or non-US equivalent qualifications. In the USA, ABET accreditation is the preferred, although not required, accreditation standard.

This position offers relocation based on candidate eligibility. Note: Basic relocation will be offered for eligible internal candidates.

Boeing is a Drug Free Workplace where post offer applicants and employees are subject to testing for marijuana, cocaine, opioids, amphetamines, PCP, and alcohol when criteria is met as outlined in our policies.

title: MTS 2, Software Engineer - FullStack
description:
At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

Join eBay’s Advertising and Marketing Technology teams to build the platforms, services, and user experiences that help sellers grow their business and make eBay the destination website for existing and new customers. You’ll work on high-scale systems spanning frontend applications, backend services, APIs, data pipelines, and AI-assisted engineering workflows, partnering closely with product, design, analytics, and applied science. We’re looking for engineers who can turn business problems into reliable, maintainable software, make sound technical tradeoffs, and take ownership from design through production. This role is a strong fit for someone who enjoys solving practical engineering problems in a fast-moving environment where performance, quality, and measurable customer impact matter.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Design and build innovative advertising, marketing platform features that help eBay sellers, advertisers grow their business and help eBay become the dominant eCommerce platform.

  • Develop scalable, highly available applications, APIs, and services using technologies such as Marko, React, Node.js, Java, and Scala.

  • Own end-to-end delivery of complex features, from technical design and architecture through deployment and production support.

  • Drive technical decisions, system design, and cross-team collaboration to ensure scalable, reliable, and maintainable solutions.

  • Leverage AI-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude Code) throughout the development lifecycle for coding, debugging, testing, and code review to increase engineering velocity.

  • Contribute to AI-powered advertising and marketing features by collaborating with ML engineers on LLM integrations, recommendation systems, and intelligent campaign optimization.

  • Contribute to a culture of continuous learning, Agile development, open-source collaboration, and rapid software delivery.

  • Mentor team members, participate in technical discussions, and help shape engineering best practices across the organization.

Job Requirements:

  • BS/BA in Computer Science or related field plus 10+ years work experience or MS with 8+ years of relevant experience.

  • Strong experience in building modern web applications at scale with React (or similar frameworks), HTML/CSS, RESTful APIs and responsive design.

  • Experience with relational (Oracle/Postgres/MySQL) and/or NoSQL (Cassandra/MongoDB) databases, including schema design and query optimization.

  • Proven ability to own end-to-end system design: writing technical design documents, leading design reviews, and making architectural decisions for multi-service features.

  • Experience designing scalable distributed systems with a track record of evaluating trade-offs (consistency, availability, latency, cost) and driving technical alignment across teams.

  • Experience with AI-assisted development practices and tools to increase engineering productivity (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, or equivalent).

  • Experience building or integrating LLM-powered features, agentic workflows, or AI-driven automation in production systems is a plus.

  • Strong ownership mentality with ability to drive work end-to-end in a collaborative environment.

  • Exposure to GraphQL and experience in building Federated GraphQL APIs is highly desirable.

  • Experience on contributing to open-source is a plus.

Benefits are an essential part of your total compensation for the work you do every day. Whether you’re single, in a growing family, or nearing retirement, eBay offers a variety of comprehensive and competitive benefit programs to meet your needs. Including maternal & paternal leave, paid sabbatical, and plans to help ensure your financial security today and in the years ahead because we know feeling financially secure during your working years and through retirement is important.

Here at eBay, we love creating opportunities for others by connecting people from widely diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and geographies. So, being diverse and inclusive isn’t just something we strive for, it is who we are, and part of what we do each and every single day. We want to ensure that as an employee, you feel eBay is a place where, no matter who you are, you feel safe, included, and that you have the opportunity to bring your unique self to work. To learn about eBay’s Diversity & Inclusion click here:

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

Additional Details

eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay.com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for accommodation as soon as possible. View our accessibility statement to learn more about eBay's commitment to ensuring digital accessibility for people with disabilities.

We use cookies to enhance your experience and may use AI tools for administrative tasks in the hiring process. To learn how we handle your personal data and use AI responsibly, please visit our Talent Privacy Notice, Privacy Center, and AI Hiring Guidelines.

title: Supply chain planner
description:
Wat ga je doen?

Geen enkele dag is hetzelfde. Je bent de eigenaar van het volledige administratieve en logistieke proces van de productgroep food acties & vers en neemt je verantwoordelijkheid in:

  • Systeem- & Voorraadbeheer: Je beheert artikelinstellingen en parameters, bewaakt voorraadnauwkeurigheid en volgt kwaliteitsmeldingen op.

  • Operationeel Bestelproces: Je plaatst bestellingen, beheert retourstromen en stemt de goederenverdeling tussen distributiecentrum en filialen af met logistiek en inkoop.

  • Analyse & Rapportage: Je analyseert trends, bestelvolumes en knelpunten en vertaalt deze data naar concrete stuurinformatie.

  • Optimalisatie & Projecten: Je signaleert proactief verbeteringen in werkprocessen, ondersteunt bij projecten en houdt alle werkinstructies up-to-date.

  • Samenwerking: Je fungeert als vast aanspreekpunt voor interne en externe partners en rapporteert knelpunten direct aan je leidinggevende.

Wie ben jij?

  • Je bent analytisch sterk en hebt een nuchtere, probleemoplossende instelling: je ziet werk en pakt het vast.

  • Je hebt ervaring met of een grote affiniteit met cijfermatige analyses (basiskennis Google spreadsheets is een must).

  • Je bent een bruggenbouwer die vlot communiceert met verschillende afdelingen en teamspirit hoog in het vaandel draagt.

  • Je werkt graag zelfstandig en blijft koelbloedig in de dynamische en snelle wereld van retail.

  • Je bent flexibel en bereid om mee te groeien met een organisatie die nooit stilstaat.

Wat krijg jij van ons?

  • Een uitdagende rol in een groeiende onderneming waar jouw initiatief écht het verschil maakt.

  • Een competitief salaris aangevuld met een mooi pakket extralegale voordelen.

  • Een werkplek waar een topsfeer en collegialiteit centraal staan: kom elke dag met goesting werken!

title: [CES] Senior Delivery Management Specialist [L5] (Region Management)
description:
본 공고는 재직 임직원을 대상으로 하는 사내 공모 전용입니다. (임직원 추천은 Link로 진행)

This posting is exclusively for internal employees. (Employee referrals are submitted via the Link)

지원 시에는 반드시 첨부된 ‘사내 공모 지원서 양식’을 작성한 후, 쿠팡 이메일 계정으로 접수해 주시기 바랍니다.

To apply, please complete the attached ‘Internal Transfer Request Form’ and submit it via your Coupang email address.

  • 사내 공모 정책: [Link]
  • Internal Transfer Policy: [Link]

회사 소개

쿠팡이츠서비스(Coupang Eats Services)는 Delivery service에 대한 차별화 전략을 세우고, 쿠팡이츠의 고객, 상점주, 그리고 배달파트너들에게 한층 더 강화된 서비스와 지원을 제공하고 있습니다. 쿠팡이츠서비스는 원하는 음식을 언제 어디서든 빠르고 안전하게 배달함으로써 고객에게 놀라운 고객 경험을 선사하고, 상점주에게는 주문부터 배달, 고객응대까지 제공하는 원스톱 서비스를 통해 안정적인 판매 기회를 확보할 수 있는 시스템을 운영하고 있습니다. 여러 분야의 전문가로 구성된 쿠팡이츠서비스는 하나의 팀으로서 고객과 상점주, 배달파트너가 원하는 가치를 고민하고 연구하며, 새로운 혁신과 패러다임 변화를 이끌어가고 있습니다.

직무 소개

Region Management 조직은 Coupang Eats Services 내에서 지역 단위의 운영 성과를 총괄하고, 배달 대행사(협력사)의 성장과 서비스 품질을 체계적으로 관리하는 핵심 운영 조직입니다.

고객·상점주·배달파트너가 모두 만족하는 배달 경험을 제공하기 위해, 각 지역의 운영 전략 수립부터 협력사 관리, 프로세스 개선, 현장 실행까지 전반적인 운영의 품질을 책임지고 있습니다.

Region Management 조직은 고객에게는 빠르고 정확한 배달 서비스, 상점에게는 안정적 주문 처리 환경, 배달파트너에게는 효율적이고 안전한 활동 환경을 제공하기 위해 데이터 기반으로 문제를 진단하고, 실행력 있는 운영 개선을 만들어가는 팀입니다.

업무 내용

  • 신규 협력사 발굴, 계약, 온보딩 및 협력사 성장 전략 수립·운영
  • 지역별·협력사별 핵심 성과 지표 분석 및 관리
  • 배달 품질, 수익성, 운영 이슈 모니터링 및 현장 컨설팅 수행
  • 정책 운영 및 협력사 문의 대응을 통한 운영 안정성 확보
  • 데이터 기반 운영 프로세스 개선 및 운영 효율화 과제 실행
  • 협력사 대상 교육 및 커뮤니케이션을 통한 서비스 역량 강화
  • 우수 운영 사례 발굴 및 표준 운영 프로세스 확산

자격 요건

  • 물류, 유통 등 유관 업종에서 5년 이상 영업기획 또는 운영관리 경험을 보유하신 분
  • 성과 지표 관리 및 분석을 통해 서비스 품질 개선 경험이 있으신 분
  • Excel 등 데이터 분석을 활용해 비즈니스 문제를 구조화하고 해결한 경험이 있으신 분

우대 사항

  • 플랫폼 비즈니스 또는 F&B 산업에 대한 이해도가 높으신 분
  • PowerBI, SQL 등 데이터 기반으로 문제를 정의하고 개선 방안을 도출할 수 있는 분석 역량을 갖추신 분
  • 다양한 이해관계자와 원활히 협업할 수 있는 커뮤니케이션 스킬을 보유하신 분
  • 주도적으로 과제를 발굴하고 실행하는 Ownership을 갖춘 분

전형 절차 및 안내 사항

  • 전형절차
    • 서류전형 - 전화면접 - 대면(화상)면접 – 최종 합격
    • 전형절차는 직무별로 다르게 운영될 수 있으며, 일정 및 상황에 따라 변동될 수 있습니다.
    • 전형 일정 및 결과는 지원서에 등록하신 이메일로 개별 안내 드립니다.
  • 참고사항
    • 본 공고는 모집 완료 시 조기 마감될 수 있습니다.
    • 지원서 내용 중 허위사실이 있는 경우에는 합격이 취소될 수 있습니다.
    • 취업 보호 대상자(보훈대상자, 장애인 등)는 관련 법률에 따라 채용우대를 받을 수 있습니다.
    • 직급과 담당 업무 범위는 후보자의 전반적인 경력과 경험 등 제반사정을 고려하여 변경될 수 있습니다. 이러한 변경이 필요할 경우, 최종 합격 통지 전 적절한 시기에 후보자와 커뮤니케이션 될 예정입니다.
    • 채용 및 업무 수행과 관련하여 요구되는 법령상 자격이 갖추어지지 않은 경우 채용이 제한될 수 있습니다.

개인정보 처리방침

  • 쿠팡 그룹은 입사지원자 개인정보 처리방침(아래 링크)에 따라 귀하의 개인정보를 수집하여 처리합니다.

서류 반환 정책

  1. 본 고지는 『채용절차의공정화에관한법률』 제11조제6항에 따른 것 입니다.
  2. 당사 채용에 응시한 구직자 중 최종 합격이 되지 못한 구직자는 『채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률』에 따라 제출한 채용서류의 반환을 청구할 수 있음을 알려 드립니다. 다만, 홈페이지 또는 전자우편으로 제출된 경우나 구직자가 당사의 요구 없이 자발적으로 제출한 경우에는 그러하지 아니하며, 천재지변이나 그 밖에 당사에게 책임 없는 사유로 채용서류가 멸실된 경우에는 반환한 것으로 봅니다.
  3. 위2항 본문에 따라 채용 서류 반환 청구를 하는 구직자는 채용 서류 반환 청구서 [채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률 시행규칙 별지 제 3 호 서식]를 작성하여 이메일 (recruitingops@coupanges.com) 로 제출하면, 제출이 확인된 날로부터 14 일 이내에 지정한 주소지로 등기우편을 통하여 발송해 드립니다. 이 경우 등기우편요금은 수신자 부담으로 하게 되오니 유념하시기 바랍니다.
  4. 당사는 위2항 본문에 따른 구직자의 반환 청구에 대비하여 채용 여부가 확정된 날로부터 180 일간 구직자가 제출한 채용서류 원본을 보관하게 되며, 그때까지 채용서류의 반환을 청구하지 아니할 경우에는 『개인정보 보호법』에 따라 지체 없이 채용서류 일체를 파기할 예정입니다.
  5. 단, 위 1항 내지 4항의 내용은 대한민국의 노동 관계 법령이 적용되는 경우에만 적용됩니다. 그 이외의 경우에는 적용되지 않습니다.

반드시 첨부된 ‘사내공모지원서 양식’을 작성 후 제출하여 주시기 바랍니다.

title: Senior Premier Banker Broward North
description:
Why Wells Fargo:

Are you looking for more? Find it here. At Wells Fargo, we're more than a financial services leader – we’re a global trailblazer committed to driving innovation, empowering communities, and helping our customers succeed. We believe that a meaningful career is much more than just a job – it’s about finding all of the elements to help you thrive, in one place. Living the Well Life means you’re supported in life, not just work. It means having robust benefits, competitive compensation, and programs designed to help you find work-life balance and well-being. You’ll be rewarded for investing in your community, celebrated for being your authentic self, and empowered to grow. And we’re recognized for it – Wells Fargo once again ranked in the top five on the 2026 LinkedIn Top Companies list of best workplaces “to grow your career” in the U.S. Join us!

About this role:

Wells Fargo is seeking a Senior Branch Premier Banker (SAFE) to play a pivotal role within our National Branch Network. This role grows, deepens, and manages relationships with affluent customers and those with more complex financial needs, serving as their primary point of contact for banking products and services through scheduled appointments, lobby engagement, and proactive outreach. This role is designed for growth oriented professionals who lead with advice to acquire and deepen relationships through meaningful discovery and translate customer goals into comprehensive financial strategies. You will own and actively grow a defined book of business, leveraging goals based planning, and prudent risk oversight to deliver integrated solutions across deposits, investments, credit, home lending, and business banking. In addition, you’ll help customers with everyday banking needs-opening accounts, handling service requests, and ensuring a seamless experience making it easier for them to manage their banking with confidence. Success in this role is driven by strong relationship acumen, proactive customer engagement, and seamless collaboration with internal partners across Wealth, Home Lending, and Business Banking to deliver a differentiated customer experience.

Wells Fargo rewards behaviors that consistently create long term customer value and support customers in making informed financial decisions. You’ll be supported with digital tools, industry leading training, ongoing coaching, and backed by one of the most recognized brands in banking. This role offers a clear platform for career growth for experienced professionals who excel at building trust, managing a portfolio, and delivering holistic, multi product solutions.

In this role you will:

  • Proactively acquire new affluent consumer and business customers while deepening existing relationships through strategic outreach, referrals, and pre-planned customer appointments

  • Lead discovery‑driven conversations to understand customer goals and deliver tailored banking and credit strategies that strengthen relationships, increase retention, and drive balanced growth across deposits, lending, and investments

  • Serve as the primary financial partner delivering comprehensive, multi‑product guidance and ongoing reviews across life stages and evolving financial needs

  • Partner with a team of professionals across Wealth, Home Lending, and Business Banking to deliver integrated solutions by coordinating warm introductions, setting clear expectations, and taking personal ownership to convert qualified opportunities into closed outcomes

  • Champion digital adoption by educating customers on self-service and mobile banking options to elevate satisfaction, engagement, and service efficiency

  • Serve as an active member of the branch team by advising colleagues on relationship development and the management of complex client needs

  • Demonstrate risk excellence through accurate documentation, sound judgment, timely issue escalation, and adherence to policies and regulations to support strong control outcomes

  • The Senior Branch Premier Banker LP (license pending) role is a temporary position until employee has successfully completed licensing requirements and SAFE registration. Upon successful completion, employees will transition to the Senior Branch Premier Banker (SAFE) role. Employees hired into the Senior Branch Premier Banker LP role who are not fully licensed will participate in the Branch Network Licensed Banker program.

Required Qualifications:

  • 4+ years of customer service experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education

  • 3+ years of experience building and maintaining effective relationships with customers and partners

  • 3+ years of experience recommending products and services

Desired Qualifications:

  • Experience recommending financial products and translating customer goals into clear, actionable recommendations

  • Demonstrated ability to proactively source, acquire, and deepen relationships through proactive outreach and building strong internal partnership to support the customer experience

  • Proven experience managing a book-of-business, documentation of planning conversations, and consistent follow-through to drive retention and growth across deposits, lending, and investments

  • Experience coaching or supporting peers to strengthen team performance and customer impact

  • Demonstrated ability to communicate clearly and confidently, listen with empathy, and build credibility and trust quickly with others

  • Financial services industry experience in one or a combination of the following: consumer, home lending, business banking, or investments

  • 3+ years of experience in a licensed financial services position

  • Successfully completed Financial Industry Regulatory Authority (FINRA)Series 6 and 63 exams (or FINRA recognized equivalents) sufficient to qualify for immediate FINRA registration

  • State Insurance license(s)

Job Expectations:

  • Ability to work a schedule that will include most Saturdays

title: Workday Security Administrator
description:
The Workday Security Administrator is the subject matter expert for Workday security administration, operational support, and audit readiness. This role is responsible for maintaining a secure, scalable, and well-governed Workday environment by administering security roles, supporting access requests, troubleshooting complex issues, and partnering with Digital HR Technology, and audit stakeholders to ensure compliance and control effectiveness.

This position blends hands-on configuration with governance and support accountability. The ideal candidate brings strong Workday security expertise, understands how security decisions affect business processes and reporting, and can balance operational responsiveness with disciplined access controls and audit support.

Responsibilities

  • Serve as the primary administrator for Workday security, including user-based security role assignments, role based assignments, and security-related reporting.
  • Administer and maintain Workday security access in alignment with approved governance processes, ensuring requests are reviewed, documented, and executed according to established approval requirements.
  • Configure and support security for core Workday processes across HCM and adjacent modules, ensuring the right balance of access, usability, segregation of duties, and risk control.
  • Support day-to-day operational security activities including access provisioning, access changes, issue triage, root cause analysis, and resolution of security-related incidents and defects.
  • Maintain and improve security governance artifacts including approval matrices, role definitions, configuration standards, access procedures, and audit documentation.
  • Support internal and external audits by preparing evidence, validating access controls, documenting control execution, and responding to questions related to security design, approvals, and system access.
  • Perform periodic access reviews and help identify inappropriate, conflicting, or excessive access, recommending and implementing corrective actions where needed.
  • Support controlled migrations and deployments of security-related changes across environments, including coordination of temporary elevated access where required for testing and production implementation.
  • Participate in Workday releases, enhancements, and projects to assess security impacts, complete testing, and ensure changes are implemented in line with governance expectations.
  • Drive continuous improvement by identifying opportunities to simplify security administration, strengthen controls, improve documentation, and enhance the support model.
  • 3–5+ years of hands-on Workday experience with meaningful depth in Workday security administration, support, and configuration.
  • Strong understanding of Workday security architecture, including Security Administrator and Security Configurator responsibilities, security groups, domain policies, business process policies, and role-based access.
  • Experience supporting enterprise Workday environments, including access administration, issue resolution, testing, and ongoing production support.
  • Experience with audit support, access controls, approval workflows, and security governance documentation.
  • Ability to troubleshoot complex issues, perform root cause analysis, and communicate resolutions clearly to technical and functional stakeholders.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and documentation skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a controlled environment.
  • Ability to translate business needs into secure, maintainable Workday configuration and operational processes.

Preferred

  • Experience in a large, complex, global organization with multiple Workday functional domains and regional support considerations.
  • Experience with Workday reporting in support of security reviews, audits, and compliance activities.
  • Familiarity with migration and environment management practices for security-related changes.
  • Workday certification or advanced training in HCM and/or Security.

Success Profile

  • Operates with strong judgment and a control-minded approach
  • Balances service orientation with disciplined governance
  • Communicates clearly across technical, functional, and audit audiences
  • Brings a continuous improvement mindset to support, controls, and documentation
  • Works effectively across teams and through ambiguity in a global environment

  • Flexible working environment
  • Volunteer time off
  • LinkedIn Learning

title: Principal Engineer GenAI Architecture
description:
About the team:

Enterprise Risk & Finance Technology (ERFT) provides technology solutions supporting Risk, Audit, Finance, Compliance, and Enterprise Functions. As part of the Testing and Monitoring Services (T&M) organization, we are transforming our strategic platforms through AI-driven capabilities, intelligent automation, advanced analytics, and enterprise-scale Generative AI solutions.

At the heart of this effort is a regulated, enterprise-grade, AI-ready data platform that serves as the persistent memory layer for our Testing Teams and the AI agents — unifying procedural knowledge, captured operational observations, organizational context, and risk and control data into a single governed substrate that powers process discovery, process reimagination, and downstream agent execution across the bank. The platform spans a hybrid-cloud footprint, moving data reliably between on-premise systems and public cloud environments to keep the enterprise's AI agents fed with trustworthy, well-governed data.

About this role:

We are seeking a Principal Engineer to serve as a senior technical leader on our AI data platform, driving the architecture and implementation of the pipelines and data quality capabilities that turn raw enterprise process data into a trusted, enterprise-grade fuel source for AI agents.

You will own hard technical problems at the core of the platform — building scalable, production-grade data pipelines that move data between on-premise and cloud environments, instrumenting rigorous data quality and analytics capabilities, and applying Gen AI and agentic techniques to automate and scale data and analytics workflows.

This is a deeply technical, hands-on role for an engineer who wants to shape the foundational, AI-ready data infrastructure behind agentic AI at enterprise scale.


In this role, you will:

  • Design and build scalable, production-grade data pipelines that reliably move and transform data between on-premise systems and public cloud environments, keeping the platform's AI-ready data stores fresh, complete, and trustworthy.

  • Build Gen AI and agentic solutions that automate data curation, enrichment, and analysis — using AI agents to accelerate data quality checks, anomaly detection, and insight generation across the platform.

  • Own data quality and analytics capabilities end to end — designing validation frameworks, monitoring, profiling, and analytics tooling that give the platform and its consumers' confidence in the data.

  • Build production-grade data and ML pipelines in Python, leveraging modern ML and Gen AI frameworks for data transformation, enrichment, and agentic analytics at scale.

  • Own technical design across the ingestion-to-retrieval lifecycle — from on-prem and cloud ingestion through transformation, storage, and the gateway that serves governed, AI-ready data to downstream model applications.

  • Establish engineering rigor for the platform's data and AI-driven components — evaluation harnesses, data quality checks, drift monitoring, and reproducibility for pipelines and agentic analytics workflows.

  • Collaborate closely with data engineers, platform engineers, and applied AI engineers to ensure new pipeline, data quality, and agentic analytics capabilities integrate cleanly with the broader enterprise-grade data platform architecture.

  • Partner with the modeling and applied AI teams to ensure the data pipelines, quality signals, and agentic analytics you build translate directly into better agent performance in production.

  • Mentor engineers on the team in Gen AI and agentic solution design, scalable data pipeline engineering, and data quality and analytics best practices.

  • Contribute to architectural decisions and technical reviews, representing the data platform's pipeline, data quality, and agentic analytics capabilities in cross-team and leadership forums.


Required Qualifications:

  • 7+ years of Engineering experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education

  • 2+ years of experience building Gen AI and agentic solutions.

  • 3+ years of experience building scalable, production-grade data pipelines and data quality analysis.

  • 5+ years of experience with Python, with experience in ML frameworks.


Desired Qualifications:

  • Experience building or operating enterprise-grade, AI-ready data platforms in regulated industries (financial services, healthcare, or comparable).

  • Hands-on experience building data pipelines that move data between on-premise systems and public cloud environments.

  • Familiarity with vector databases, embedding models, and retrieval-augmented architectures.

  • Experience applying AI agents to data quality, data profiling, or analytics workflows.

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, or a related quantitative discipline.

Job Expectations and Core Values:

  • Be Humble: You're smart yet always interested in learning from others.

  • Work Transparently: You always deal in an honest, direct, and transparent way.

  • Take Ownership: You embrace responsibility and find joy in having the answers.

  • Learn More: You regularly self-educate and improve your skill set.

title: Sr. Portfolio Program Manager - R&D
description:
Our Mission:

6sense's mission is to multiply what matters: growth, retention, and efficiency. We envision a future where companies, teams and people reach their full potential.

Our People:

People are the heart and soul of 6sense. We serve with passion and purpose. We live by our Being 6sense values of Win as One Team, Stay Curious, Do The Right Thing, Own the Outcome, and Create Belonging.
