We want 6sense to be the best chapter of your career.

About the Role :

We are seeking a Senior Portfolio Program Manager to provide standing, exception-based orchestration across an assigned Research & Development (R&D) pillar. Reporting to the Head of Program Management, this individual contributor partners with Product and Engineering Pillar Leaders to maintain a connected view of portfolio commitments, dependencies, risks, capacity, readiness, and key decisions while improving delivery predictability and organizational effectiveness. Combining Agile coaching with portfolio program management, the role helps teams strengthen planning discipline, execution health, and continuous improvement while translating team-level insights into actionable portfolio visibility and leadership decision support.

The role also serves as a champion for AI-enabled Program Management, continuously identifying and introducing automation, emerging technologies, and workflow improvements that increase scalability, operational efficiency, and decision-making effectiveness. The Portfolio Program Manager coordinates, synthesizes, and escalates material exceptions across teams, product areas, pillars, and functions.

Accountability for product strategy, roadmap priorities, customer outcomes, engineering architecture, technical design, staffing, performance management, team execution, Scrum practices, backlog management, Jira hygiene, funding decisions, launch approvals, and risk acceptance remains with the appropriate Product, Engineering leaders. End-to-end ownership of strategic initiatives is assumed only when explicitly assigned.

Key Responsibilities :

  • Partner with Product and Engineering Pillar Leaders to establish and maintain portfolio baselines, including commitments, milestones, dependencies, ownership, readiness expectations, capacity assumptions, and success measures.
  • Maintain visibility into portfolio commitments and execution progress, surfacing material variances and coordinating appropriate change-management actions when scope, timeline, resource, or delivery commitments materially change.
  • Establish and continuously improve portfolio metrics, dashboards, reporting practices, automation, and AI-enabled workflows that strengthen portfolio visibility, decision-making, execution transparency, and operational efficiency.
  • Identify, evaluate, and introduce AI, automation, and emerging technologies that improve Program Management effectiveness, scalability, decision-making, and operational efficiency across the R&D pillar.
  • Partner with R&D Operating System teams to improve data quality, portfolio tooling, process standards, reporting, and adoption of portfolio management practices.
  • Establish and maintain visibility into cross-team and cross-pillar dependencies, ensuring ownership, impacts, required dates, and status are understood and tracked.
  • Coordinate dependency management across teams and pillars, facilitate alignment, resolution discussions, and escalate unresolved risks, impacts, and decisions through established governance forums.
  • Lead portfolio reviews focused on material changes, risks, dependencies, readiness gaps, capacity conflicts, and decisions requiring leadership attention.
  • Facilitate scaled planning, portfolio governance, and synchronization forums that improve alignment, transparency, and execution across the pillar.
  • Support quarterly planning cycles by validating commitments, dependencies, capacity assumptions, risks, and decision readiness across the pillar.
  • Synthesize portfolio information into decision-ready executive insights, including risks, dependencies, trade-offs, and recommendations, and ensure resulting decisions, escalations, and accountable follow-through are tracked through closure.
  • Coach Product and Engineering teams on Agile practices, planning discipline, delivery predictability, flow efficiency, and continuous improvement to strengthen execution effectiveness and delivery outcomes.
  • Identify work that may warrant dedicated Strategic Initiative Program Management support and provide evidence to support coverage decisions.
  • Coordinate with Strategic Initiative Program Managers to incorporate initiative health, dependencies, change impacts, and readiness into the pillar portfolio view.

Qualifications :

  • 8+ years of experience in Portfolio Management, Program Management, Technical Program Management, Product Operations, or related roles within a SaaS or technology environment.
  • Experience leading Product and Engineering portfolios spanning multiple teams, product areas, or organizational units.
  • Experience establishing and leading portfolio governance frameworks, operating rhythms, quarterly planning processes, executive review forums, and reporting mechanisms that improve visibility, alignment, decision-making, and execution predictability.
  • Demonstrated success managing portfolio risk, dependencies, capacity constraints, competing priorities, and roadmap execution at scale.
  • Experience facilitating executive, leadership, and cross-functional governance forums that drive alignment, accountability, and decision-making.
  • Demonstrated success improving team effectiveness, delivery predictability, planning maturity, flow efficiency, and execution outcomes through Agile coaching, facilitation, and continuous improvement practices.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence without formal authority, navigate ambiguity, clarify accountability, and drive alignment, decision-making, and follow-through across multiple stakeholders.
  • Experience identifying, evaluating, and implementing automation, AI-enabled workflows, and emerging technologies that improve portfolio visibility, operational efficiency, scalability, and decision-making effectiveness.
  • Strong analytical, facilitation, communication, and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to synthesize complex information into executive-ready insights and recommendations.
  • Working knowledge of Productboard, Jira, Confluence, dashboarding, and business intelligence platforms.
  • Agile coaching or Agile delivery certifications such as ICP-ACC, CSP, CSM, PSM, SAFe SPC, SAFe Agilist, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

Success In This Role :

  • Trusted portfolio visibility enables informed leadership decisions.
  • Risks, dependencies, and changes to commitments are identified and addressed early.
  • Capacity and readiness issues are surfaced before they impact delivery.
  • Portfolio governance drives timely decisions and clear accountability.
  • Strategic initiatives are integrated into a unified portfolio view.
  • Teams improve commitment reliability, delivery predictability, and flow efficiency over time.
  • Stakeholders experience greater alignment and faster decision-making with minimal reporting overhead.
  • Automation and AI improve operational efficiency, scalability, and insight quality.

Full-time employees can take advantage of health coverage, paid parental leave, generous paid time-off and holidays, quarterly self-care days off, and stock options. We’ll make sure you have the equipment and support you need to work and connect with your teams, at home or in one of our oﬃces.

title: Principal Engineer / Scientist
location: Kirtland Air Force Base, NM, us
description:
BryceTech is seeking a highly experienced Principal Engineer/Scientist to provide scientific, engineering, and technical strategic advisory support to the Air Force Research Laboratory (AFRL) under the Joint Use Professional Insight, Technology, Engineering, & Research (JUPITER) program. This individual will provide senior-level technical expertise and independent insight to support AFRL leadership in the assessment, planning, development, integration, and transition of advanced technologies and research programs.

The Principal Engineer/Scientist will apply deep technical expertise and demonstrated professional standing within their area of specialization to evaluate technology portfolios, conduct technical assessments and trade studies, advise on research and development priorities, and provide recommendations to senior AFRL leadership. The position may support areas including space warfare, information and spectrum warfare, space communications, positioning, navigation and timing, space cyber, ISR, space domain awareness, modeling and simulation, high-power electromagnetics, laser systems, electro-optics, and related advanced technologies.

Responsibilities

  • Provide senior-level scientific, engineering, and technical advisory support to AFRL leadership
  • Conduct strategic technology planning and provide recommendations concerning current and future research and development investments
  • Evaluate the status, technical merit, feasibility, and potential impact of ongoing and proposed technology programs
  • Conduct technical studies, analyses, evaluations, assessments, and trade studies
  • Perform systems engineering analyses and architecture assessments for advanced technology programs
  • Provide independent technical assessments and recommendations regarding technology development, maturation, transition, and implementation
  • Assess emerging technologies and identify opportunities to address future warfighter capability requirements
  • Support technology portfolio reviews and recommend redirection of existing programs or establishment of new programs
  • Analyze technology development strategies, acquisition approaches, and transition pathways
  • Prepare and deliver technical briefings, reports, papers, presentations, and other materials for AFRL leadership and other senior government stakeholders
  • Participate in technical review boards, Scientific Advisory Boards, working groups, committees, and other technical forums
  • Provide technical organization, execution, and feedback support for AFRL meetings, reviews, and advisory activities
  • Collaborate with government, industry, academia, federally funded research and development centers, and other research organizations to advance technology development and transition
  • Apply recognized expertise and professional judgment to complex technical problems where solutions require significant innovation and independent analysis
  • Maintain current knowledge of relevant scientific and engineering developments, emerging technologies, and advancements within the applicable technical community
  • Communicate complex technical concepts and recommendations clearly to both technical and senior executive audiences

Required Qualifications

  • Active DoD Top Secret Clearance with SCI Eligibility (TS/SCI)
  • Doctoral degree in engineering or science with at least 12 years of relevant experience, or a master's degree in engineering or science with at least 14 years of relevant experience, or a bachelor's degree in engineering or science with at least 20 years of relevant experience
  • Demonstrated experience with space or information/spectrum warfare systems and/or technologies
  • Demonstrated expertise in a relevant scientific or engineering discipline applicable to AFRL's research and development mission
  • Demonstrated professional standing and recognized expertise within the applicable technical community
  • Ability to provide independent technical advice, analysis, and recommendations to senior government leadership
  • Experience supporting advanced research and development, technology planning, technology assessment, or related technical activities

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting the Air Force Research Laboratory, Department of the Air Force, U.S. Space Force, DARPA, or other DoD science and technology organizations
  • Experience in one or more of the following areas:
    • Space systems and space warfare
    • Space communications
    • Positioning, navigation, and timing
    • Space cyber
    • Intelligence, surveillance, and reconnaissance
    • Space domain awareness
    • Modeling and simulation
    • Information warfare
    • Spectrum warfare
    • High-power electromagnetics
    • Laser systems
    • Electro-optics
  • Experience with DoD science and technology planning and investment processes
  • Experience with technology transition from research and development into operational capabilities
  • Experience supporting senior military, government, or industry leadership
  • Experience developing and presenting technical recommendations to executive-level audiences
  • Experience working across government, industry, academia, and research institutions
  • Published research, patents, professional awards, technical leadership, or other evidence of recognized standing in the relevant technical community

Position is contingent upon contract award.

BryceTech offers a full range of benefits, including competitive salary, a comprehensive health plan including dental and vision coverage, company-paid life & disability insurance policies, 401(k) plan with company match, and an educational reimbursement program.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

The role will ensure that solutions meet the highest standards of scalability, security, resiliency, operability, regulatory alignment, and engineering excellence within a complex banking environment.

title: Associate Astrodynamicist
description:
Associate Astrodynamicist

Company:

The Boeing Company

Boeing Defense, Space & Security (BDS) is seeking an Associate Astrodynamicist to join our Astrodynamics Team located in El Segundo, CA. This early-career position offers the opportunity to work within a highly collaborative team environment as part of the Astrodynamics group under the Mission Systems Engineering & Operations department in Space Mission Systems. Designed as a non-senior role, it requires flexibility to learn and operate beyond traditional definitions of astrodynamics, encompassing a broader range of orbital analysis and mission systems engineering responsibilities.

Position Responsibilities:

  • The team are the Rocket Scientists in the Mission Control Center, responsible for flying satellites with a primary focus on orbit mechanics, mission analysis and operations, though the role extends beyond the traditional non-Boeing definition of Astrodynamics.

  • Located in El Segundo, this group is a recognized ‘center of excellence,’ built on decades of accumulated knowledge and historical learning fostering continuous improvement and collaboration across multiple programs.

  • As part of a highly motivated team, members perform astrodynamics analyses including transfer orbit design, propellant budgeting, mission planning, and station keeping design and analysis.

  • Interact closely with customers, launch vehicle providers, subsystem leads, and program management supporting trade studies and new business across all orbit regimes (GEO, LEO, MEO, cis-lunar).

  • The environment encompasses concept design, proposal phases through to on-orbit mission operations—participating actively in mission activities from launch, transfer orbits, to in-orbit support.

  • Spacecraft systems engineering responsibilities include defining and flowing requirements between subsystems and astrodynamics to support mission design, as well as designing mission-specific analysis and operational tools.

  • Identify software requirements and support implementation of specialized astrodynamics software tools.

This position is expected to be 100% onsite. The selected candidate will be required to work onsite at the listed location.

  • This position requires the ability to obtain a US Security Clearance for which the US Government requires US Citizenship as a condition of employment: Ability to Obtain Tier 5 (formerly SSBI) - Post-Start

  • Bachelor of Science degree in Engineering, Engineering Technology (including Manufacturing Technology), Computer Science, Data Science, Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry or non-US equivalent qualifications directly related to the work statement

  • Academic or professional experience (2+ years) with Orbital Mechanics, Mission Analysis & Design, Spacecraft Operations, or System engineering

  • Basic coding skills, and familiarity with MATLAB or equivalent software

title: Transmission Operations Technician
description:
The Transmission Operations Technician is responsible for ensuring the reliable operation of scheduled and live broadcasts by configuring, monitoring, maintaining, and troubleshooting transmission systems in a broadcast production environment. The role provides advanced technical support to maintain broadcast continuity and quickly resolve transmission and system issues as they arise.

This is a project/limited term position, unless otherwise amended or terminated as deliverables within this project are completed.

Job Duties:

  • Responsible for rapidly responding to equipment failures and restoring transmission services across satellite, fiber, IP-based, and bonded cellular contribution and distribution paths.
  • Communicates and escalates technical and operational issues to management and engineering teams, providing accurate information regarding troubleshooting, impact, and resolution
  • Collaborates with Field Operations teams and provides advanced technical support in configuring and troubleshooting field transmission equipment, connectivity, and signal paths.
  • Serves as the primary technical contact for resolving live feed issues, coordinating with field, remote, studio, production, and control room personnel to troubleshoot and restore services.
  • Operates and troubleshoots various antenna control systems supporting satellite acquisition and transmission operations.
  • Configures, monitors, and troubleshoots video-over-IP transmission workflows, including IP addressing, ports, encoding/decoding, signal transport, and contribution feeds.
  • Configures, monitors, and troubleshoots bonded cellular transmission systems
  • Monitors fixed and critical transmission paths, including network returns, taking immediate corrective action when signal degradation, and equipment failures.
  • Collaborates with internal clients, production teams, vendors, and transmission providers to manage technical requirements, maintain production standards, and resolve complex transmission issues.
  • Works under the direct supervision of Director, Technical Operations and the Supervisor, Technical Operations Center and is responsible for completing any other tasks as assigned by Manager or Supervisor as needed

Basic Requirements:

  • Minimum three (3) years of relevant experience in a broadcast network distribution, satellite operations, or network engineering role
  • Fluent English and Spanish (both written & verbal)
  • Experience with Evertz video router panels, able to manipulate UDX setting in the router panels to adjust incoming signals
  • Experience operating video adjustments of UDX’s for incoming signal adjustment, RTS system for Communications, VUE panel for the Evertz video router
  • Experience in calibrating and utilizing a spectrum analyzer to define satellite signals, checking signal quality and anomalies
  • Experience operating GUI for satellite decoders/encoders on and Technician level, understanding the fiber network, Video over IP infrastructure and bonded cell workflows.
  • Exhibits advanced knowledge in understanding the equipment menu trees and the effects to the signal flow.
  • Exhibits advanced knowledge working with various satellite, fiber and IP encoders and decoders
  • Demonstrates ability to configure corresponding satellite transport encoders and various encoder parameters
  • Demonstrates ability to read and understand a waveform monitor and adjust video quality and audio as well as understanding loudness levels
  • Exhibits advanced knowledge of Evertz video router, UDX adjustment, remote source routing to production control rooms in a fast-paced environment.
  • Exhibits knowledge of the immense fiber connectivity highway throughout the USA and LATAM
  • Demonstrates strong knowledge of fiber-optic transmission infrastructure
  • Demonstrates in-depth knowledge and operational experience with KU-Band and C-Band satellite downlink and uplink systems supporting live broadcast operations.
  • Possesses strong knowledge of satellite transmission systems, including steerable antennas, satellite receivers and decoders, signal acquisition, frequency coordination, and associated transmission parameters.
  • Demonstrates in-depth technical knowledge of satellite, fiber, video-over-IP, and bonded cellular transmission infrastructure, with the ability to quickly identify, troubleshoot, and resolve equipment, connectivity, and signal-related issues.

Desired Characteristics:

  • Quick learner with emerging technology and system implementations.
  • Exceptional communication, time management, analytical and organizational skills with the ability to collaborate effectively with Engineering, News, Sports, Entertainment, Production, vendors, transmission providers, and external partners.
  • Self-starter who exhibits ownership on assigned tasks and who will push for solutions that solve immediate problems while building towards long-term goals
  • Ability to multitask and work in a fast paced, dead-line driven environment
  • Accustomed to working in a team and collaborating with all levels within the organization
  • Ability to build rapport with clients and manage expectations
  • Ability to effectively be flexible in approach, and respond well to pressure
  • Ability to lead and direct others, promote positive work environment and problem solve
  • Process oriented, good at identifying and implementing best practices
  • Change agent, creative and adaptable when facing challenges

Additional Requirements:

  • This position is required to be performed full-time from an NBCUniversal-designated worksite.
  • Must be willing to work in Miami, Florida
  • Willingness to travel and work overtime, and on weekends with short notice
  • Must have a valid driver’s license
  • The candidate must be willing to work flexible hours including late and/or last-minute scheduling changes in a 24/7 production work environment.
  • Must be available to work (whenever necessary for show production) early mornings, evenings, holidays and weekends.
  • Must have unrestricted work authorization to work in the United States.
  • Must be covered by Solutions, NBCU’s Alternative Dispute Resolution Program

description:

Responsibilities

You will champion the development of global relationships and account strategies, helping Workato expand from individual country or subsidiary engagements into broader, enterprise-wide partnerships.
You will work closely with Japan headquarters, overseas subsidiaries, regional business units and Workato teams across the world to identify strategic opportunities, align executive stakeholders and create multi-region growth.

title: Legal Director, Payments
description:
At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

Director, Payments Product

Let's be honest, you probably didn’t realize eBay is more than just the marketplace for things people love. eBay is a fintech platform in the making, and we’re looking for an experienced payments product lawyer to help us get there. With tens of billions of dollars flowing through our marketplace each year, payments are at the heart of the eBay experience—and we’re continuing to invest in new ways to make buying, selling, and moving money simpler, safer, and more seamless around the world.

This isn't just any product counsel role. It's a chance to join the e-commerce OG at a pivotal moment and help shape the next generation of payments and financial services for one of the world’s largest marketplaces.

This is not a plug-and-play role. We need an experienced, curious, and pragmatic product lawyer who can get into the weeds with our Product and Engineering teams, understand how our payments products actually work, and help turn complex legal and regulatory requirements into thoughtful product solutions. You’ll advise on products from idea to launch and beyond, tackle novel questions at the intersection of technology, commerce, and financial services, and help us find a path forward when the answer isn’t obvious.

You will have a real seat at the table.

A Day in the Life of Our Payments Product Guru

You'll be a trusted legal co-pilot to our Payments Product and Engineering teams as they build and evolve the products that power commerce on eBay. You'll get involved early—not just when a product is ready to launch—and help teams think through legal and regulatory considerations as part of how products are designed and built.

You’ll be:

  • Embedded in the Product: You'll partner closely with Product, Engineering, Risk, Compliance, and Operations from ideation through launch and beyond. You’ll dig into product requirements, user experiences, funds flows, and technical architecture to understand what we're building, why we are building it, and help teams build it thoughtfully.

  • A Regulatory Whisperer: Payments regulation is complicated. Your job is to make it less so. You'll navigate the evolving legal and regulatory landscape for payments and financial services and translate complex requirements into clear, actionable guidance for Product, Business and Engineering teams.

  • A Builder, Not Just a Reviewer: You won't simply tell teams whether something presents legal risk. You'll work alongside them to understand what they're trying to accomplish, identify the real issues, and develop practical solutions that enable innovation while managing risk responsibly.

  • A Product Launch Co-Pilot: You'll advise on new payments products, features, and experiences from concept through launch, helping teams spot issues early, make informed tradeoffs, and navigate the legal and regulatory questions that come with building payments products at global scale.

  • Our Payments Ecosystem Expert: You'll develop a deep understanding of how money moves across eBay and the broader payments ecosystem—including payment processing and acquiring, card networks, payouts, stored value and wallets, and emerging payment methods—and apply that knowledge to the products we're building.

  • A Scaler: You'll help us build smarter ways of working as our payments business evolves, including developing practical frameworks, playbooks, and product review processes that help teams identify issues earlier and make good decisions faster.

  • The Go-To Problem-Solver: Product teams will seek you out for your judgment, not just your legal analysis. You'll be comfortable with ambiguity, willing to ask the questions no one else has thought of, empowered to move the needle, and focus on finding a responsible path forward rather than simply flagging risk.

  • Team Player Extraordinaire: Collaboration isn't just a buzzword here. You'll work with colleagues across Product, Engineering, Compliance, Risk, Privacy, Operations and Legal, as well as teams around the world, all united by a common goal: building the future of commerce.

What You'll Need to Bring to the Table

  • A J.D. from an accredited law school and an active license to practice law in at least one U.S. state.

  • 10+ years of relevant legal experience, with significant experience providing payments counseling to fintechs, financial services, and/or technology companies.

  • Meaningful experience partnering directly with Product and Engineering teams and advising throughout the product lifecycle—from early design and development through launch and ongoing operation.

  • Deep knowledge of the payments ecosystem and the legal and regulatory frameworks that apply to payments products, particularly in the context of merchants, marketplaces, or technology platforms.

  • Familiarity with money transmission, electronic funds transfers and consumer protection, card network rules, bank payments, financial crime and sanctions requirements, and other laws, regulations, and industry rules relevant to payments.

  • The ability—and curiosity—to get into the details. You should be comfortable understanding product requirements, user journeys, technical systems and funds flows, and translating legal requirements into practical product guidance.

  • Excellent judgment and the ability to navigate novel legal questions where the law, technology, or business model may be evolving and there isn't always a perfect precedent or obvious answer.

  • A practical, solutions-oriented mindset. You don't just identify problems; you help teams understand the tradeoffs and figure out how to accomplish their goals responsibly.

  • The ability to communicate complicated legal concepts plainly and give clear advice that Product, Engineering, and business teams can actually use.

  • The ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment, manage multiple priorities, and operate with autonomy. You should be comfortable with ambiguity and have a bias for action.

  • A sense of humor and an ability not to take yourself too seriously.

Why You Should Care

This is your chance to make a tangible impact at a company that's been a household name for decades but is still evolving every day. Payments sit at the center of the eBay marketplace, connecting millions of buyers and sellers around the world—and the products we build have a direct impact on how easily and safely they can do business.

Our mission is to create economic opportunity for all, helping small businesses, entrepreneurs, and individuals succeed. Promoting environmental and social responsibility is part of our DNA, powering a circular economy by extending the life of products through our marketplace and investing in sustainable business practices.

We care about fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace, recognizing that different perspectives drive innovation and create a more equitable environment for both employees and sellers. And we're leaning in hard on AI and other advanced technologies, providing a challenging and dynamic environment to work on cutting-edge projects that transform the e-commerce experience.

We're building something truly new. Come join us.

Additional Details

The applicable base pay range for this position is dependent on work location. The base pay range in the San Francisco Bay Area, New York City Metro and Seattle Metro is expected in the range below:

$210,800 - $281,400

The base pay range for all other U.S. work locations is expected in the range below:

$162,800 - $244,000

The total compensation package for this position may also include other elements, including a target bonus and restricted stock units (as applicable) in addition to a full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits (including 401(k) eligibility and various paid time off benefits, such as PTO and parental leave). The Commerce Analytics team at NBC News Group sits at the intersection of data, storytelling, and growth—using insights to drive critical business decisions, uncover new audiences, and shape the future of shoppable content. title: Head of Engineering, Field Verification
description:
Who we are

Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month.

As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually.

Why South Africa

South Africa has one of the strongest engineering communities anywhere in the world, and we are deliberately growing our technology organisation in the country. We already have several team members based here. The work is fully remote, and the mission we are working on is a good deal closer to home than it is for our teams elsewhere.

So, now we are looking for our Head of Engineering, Field Verification to join us in South Africa.

About the role

Field Verification is how Moniepoint knows that the people and businesses on our platform are real. Every Moniepoint customer, retail and business, requires a completed field verification as part of KYC. The platform coordinates physical, in-person checks — verifying individuals, business owners, business addresses and loan guarantors — and it serves nearly every part of the company: onboarding, loans, compliance and the fraud team.

The system works today. A back office gives each business unit visibility and control over its own verification requests. A mobile-friendly web app puts the work in the hands of Field Verification Officers and the cluster leads who manage them across local government areas. An API layer lets other business units push verification requests in and receive results back by webhook, and an assignment algorithm routes each request to an officer close enough to carry it out.

We want to be straightforward about the rest. This domain has never had a dedicated engineering leader, and that is the single biggest constraint on it. The team is one lean, cross-functional squad — an Engineering Manager, four engineers and a QA — carrying verification volume for the entire customer base. They have done that impressively well, but running lean means running in keep-the-lights-on mode, and a long list of things that would make this platform substantially better has been waiting for someone to own it.

That list is the role. Trip and route management, so an officer can plan an optimal day across several sites rather than making a separate journey for each one — today we pay for a round trip per verification, and the logistics are nowhere near optimal. Capacity management. A native mobile app, wanted for a long time and never resourced. Liveness and identity verification tooling, exposed as APIs the rest of the business can build on. And as Moniepoint expands into markets where identity verification is as difficult as it is in Nigeria, Kenya among them, a platform that works beyond a single country.

There is a great deal of room to build here. Whoever takes this on will set the direction rather than inherit someone else's plan, on a system that already carries real weight for the business.

As Head of Engineering, Field Verification, your responsibilities will include:

  • Owning the technical strategy, architecture and roadmap for the Field Verification platform end to end, and setting direction for a domain that has been running without dedicated engineering leadership.
  • Moving the platform from keep-the-lights-on operation to deliberate, prioritised development.
  • Leading and growing the existing cross-functional team, and building the organisation out as scope expands.
  • Building the operational efficiency layer — trip and route optimisation, task allocation and capacity management for field officers.
  • Owning the platform's client-facing surface: the APIs and webhooks that other business units integrate with, and the back office those units rely on.
  • Delivering a native mobile experience for field officers.
  • Ensuring verification data is structured, auditable and fit for compliance scrutiny.
  • Building for multi-country expansion as Moniepoint enters new markets.
  • Partnering closely with Product and with the business units that depend on the platform — onboarding, loans, compliance and fraud.
  • Defining architecture standards, engineering processes and quality metrics, and hiring and developing engineers and Engineering Managers.

Who you are

  • You have built things yourself, and grew into leadership from there. We are explicit about this: we are not looking for someone who moved into management early and has led from a distance since. We want an engineer who became a leader.
  • You are capable across disciplines. Backend, web and mobile. This platform spans all three and you will need credibility in each — a specialist in one layer will struggle here.
  • You have built platforms, not just products. Systems used by several distinct groups of users and internal business units, with the flexibility to serve requirements you did not anticipate.
  • You are a problem solver first. We would rather have someone adaptable than someone with the exact domain experience. Having built across different industries — fintech, e-commerce, logistics or otherwise — is a positive signal, not a scattered CV.
  • You have 10+ years of overall software engineering experience, with substantial hands-on production engineering and strong backend depth. Our backend environment is Java and Spring Boot.
  • You have at least 5 years of engineering leadership, including managing Engineering Managers.
  • You collaborate well with product and business stakeholders, and can translate operational requirements into engineering solutions.
  • Experience working with location and geospatial data is a strong plus, including map integrations.
  • Experience with route, trip or delivery optimisation is a strong plus.
  • Experience building for compliance — where data must be structured to evidence what was done and when — is a strong plus.
  • Experience with identity, KYC or verification platforms is a plus. None of these four are requirements.

Cultural Alignment

As well, we assess every candidate across eight dimensions that define how great leaders operate at Moniepoint. We look for evidence of all eight throughout the process, not just in a single conversation.

  • Customer Obsession: Build deep empathy for users. Solve problems intuitively, and fix root causes, not just tickets.
  • Craft: Master the fundamentals. Reason from first principles, make trade-offs explicit, and raise the bar on quality.
  • Systemisation: Turn repeating decisions into scalable mechanisms. Reduce cognitive load and raise engineering quality.
  • Urgency: Move with disciplined speed. Act autonomously within scope, remove friction, and escalate risks early.
  • Ownership: Treat the platform as your own. Take initiative across boundaries and follow through without reminders.
  • No Ego: Put the mission first. Share credit, welcome debate, and never protect status over team outcomes.
  • Candour: Surface uncomfortable truths and risks early. Intelligent failure is welcome; concealment is not.
  • Integrity: Stay truthful and ethically consistent. Refuse toxic behavior. Performance without integrity is unacceptable.

What Success Looks Like

  • The domain has clear technical ownership and direction for the first time.
  • The team out of keep-the-lights-on mode and delivering against a prioritised roadmap.
  • Measurable improvement in field officer efficiency — more verifications per trip, lower cost per verification.
  • A native mobile experience shipped for field officers.
  • Verification data that stands up to compliance scrutiny across every business unit the platform serves.
  • The platform ready to support a new market.
  • A team grown beyond its current size, with a strong bench of engineers and managers.

Why Join Us

  • A genuinely greenfield mandate on a system that already matters. Every customer Moniepoint onboards passes through this platform.
  • A lean, capable team making outsized impact, and the remit to build the organisation around them.
  • Breadth: backend, web, mobile, location data, compliance and operational optimisation in one domain.
  • Be part of a mission-driven company expanding access to financial services for millions of businesses and individuals.

What To Expect in The Hiring Process

  • A preliminary phone call with the recruiter.
  • 60 minute High level System Design round with one of our Engineering Managers.
  • 60 minute Panel Interview with 2 of our Head of Engineering leaders. 30 minutes focused on a technical deep dive into your CV and into a project or system you built in the past. 30 minutes focused on testing for leadership attributes.
  • 60 minute Stakeholder Management Round with one of our Product Heads/VPs, focused on your stakeholder management and collaboration skills with product and business.
  • 60 minute Technical round and Culture fit interview with our Co-founder & Group CTO (the hiring manager).

title: Lead HR Compliance and Governance

title: Trust and Safety Policy, Ads Policy,  Lead (Europe)
description:
Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit .

We are looking for an experienced Ads Policy Lead who has significant subject matter expertise, strong policy development capabilities, and thrives in dynamic environments. This is a senior individual contributor role, with no people management responsibilities, reporting to our Head of Ads Policy. This hire will be primarily responsible for driving the research and development of large-scale policies that impact Reddit's global advertising platform. This critical new role will partner with colleagues and leaders across Legal, Sales, Operations,Product, Trust & Safety Policy and other departments to tackle cutting edge challenges, enable responsible business opportunities, and work on other high impact advertising policy projects that help Reddit continue to scale its business across the world.

What You’ll Do:

  • Drive the development, drafting, and maintenance of strategic advertising policies across Reddit's ads products acting as subject matter expert in the EMEA region
  • Draft risk assessments and strategic policy recommendations for senior cross-functional leaders and executive stakeholders, representing the Ads Policy perspective with clarity and confidence.
  • Act as a role model of Reddit’s Company Values, assisting teammates and providing guidance as a senior peer leader
  • Serve as the decision-maker on highly complex, grey-area ads policy escalations, delivering definitive, risk-balanced rulings on high-impact issues

Qualifications:

  • 7+ years of experience in compliance, standards, or policy development and implementation, with significant experience in tech, digital platforms, advertising, Trust and Safety, or a related policy function
  • Proven track record of taking complete, reliable ownership of complex policy projects, demonstrating a strong ability to personally research, draft, implement, and maintain policies autonomously in fast-paced environments
  • Deep subject matter expertise in advertising or content policy on an international scale, with a proven track record of working with global teams and advising stakeholders across multiple jurisdictions
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex policy/regulatory matters into simple business terms
  • Exceptional ability to synthesize complex, ambiguous problems into structured decision documents that clearly lay out risks, trade-offs, and proposed solutions.

Nice to Have:

  • Direct experience working on advertising policies within a major tech platform
  • Familiarity with leveraging AI tools to streamline workflows, enable automated and tailored assistance for partners and clients, and help scale processes with limited resources.

Benefits:

  • Global Benefit programs that fit your lifestyle, from workspace to professional development to caregiving support
  • Family Planning Support
  • Gender-Affirming Care
  • Mental Health & Coaching Benefits
  • Private Medical, Dental, and Vision Benefits
  • Personal Retirement Savings Account with matching contribution
  • Cycle to Work and Tax Saver schemes
  • Flexible Vacation & Paid Volunteer Time Off
  • Generous Paid Parental Leave

title: Senior Engineer, EDG Validation
description:
Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all.

Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.

Micron is seeking a highly motivated and dedicated engineer to join our growing SSD Validation Engineering team. This team plays a critical role in the development and validation of Client SSD products, ensuring timely delivery to market and exceptional product quality. In this role, you will work closely with cross-functional and global teams, including R&D, Quality, Manufacturing, and other engineering organizations, to develop and execute comprehensive validation strategies that drive product success.

Responsibilities :

Technical Ownership

  • Understand product life cycle and associated industry standards.
  • Reviews and challenges current test plans, coverage, and testing activities to drive both increased effectiveness and efficiencies across the product portfolio
  • Recommend and instrument new validation approaches that drive better end-to-end coverage, more accurate testing, and expanded testing services

Requirements Analysis

  • Thorough understanding of product requirements and develop adequate coverage
  • Feedback & influence product design for the definition and implementation of new requirements/ performances
  • Plan test schedules or strategies in accordance with project scope and delivery dates

Validation Strategy

  • Definition of test cases to verify that functional and non-functional requirements are complying to system requirements
  • Identification of PASS/FAIL criteria for test cases in term of number of cycles, statistical and temperature
  • Enable shift-left efforts to move detection of failures from customer tests to internal-developed and maintained test frameworks

Test Implementation

  • Define the Test Implementation Strategy and Software Architecture to encompass both development and debug.
  • Define, plan and implement a test automation strategy, to supply to the ongoing development of in-house automation frameworks/tools.
  • Constantly evaluate, refine and implement validation processes/methodologies

Test Execution

  • Execution of Product Validation flow to match programmed validation plan
  • Monitoring of test time – Test time reduction
  • Results analysis – Bin Pareto
  • Report Generation - Report data in a clear format including concise comments about findings
  • Track document revision to provide historical reference.

Defect Management

  • Root-cause and drive failures to a closure by working with associated teams.
  • Implement systematic clear steps to reproduce failures while providing traceability to the bugs/gaps/escapes.

Qualifications and Skills

  • BS in an engineering subject area or equivalent
  • 4+ years of validation experience, with validated ability to craft and implement outstanding product test strategies.
  • Deep of knowledge of PCIe SSDs, NAND, Memory storage hierarchy and NVMe Protocol.
  • Strong Python scripting experience
  • Apply AI/ML techniques to analyze large-scale validation and test data to identify patterns, anomalies, and quality risks.
  • Develop and utilize AI-enabled tools for failure triage, root cause analysis, and test automation
  • Ability to analyze problems, diagnose to root cause, and apply corrective actions

We are an industry leader in innovative memory and storage solutions transforming how the world uses information to enrich life for all. With a relentless focus on our customers, technology leadership, and manufacturing and operational excellence, Micron delivers a rich portfolio of high-performance DRAM, NAND, and NOR memory and storage products through our Micron® and Crucial® brands. title: Project Director, Colocation Development
description:
As a Project Director within NEXTDC's Colocation Development team, you will hold full accountability for the successful delivery of major data centre developments and play a key leadership role in supporting NEXTDC's ongoing development program.

This senior leadership role spans the full project lifecycle, from design and procurement through to construction and operational handover. As the Principal's Representative, you will lead multidisciplinary teams, manage key stakeholder relationships, and ensure projects are delivered safely, on time, on budget, and to the highest quality standards.

Reporting to the Chief Development Officer you will bring extensive experience delivering data centres or other mission critical infrastructure.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Leadership & Safety – Embed a safety-first culture, championing zero harm throughout design, construction and operations.
  • Governance & Risk – Establish and implement governance frameworks, oversee compliance, and proactively manage risk registers.
  • Financial & Commercial – Lead project budgets, cashflow, procurement strategies, and financial reporting, ensuring alignment to business objectives.
  • Programme Delivery – Direct the overall development programme, optimise timelines, monitor progress, and drive corrective action to accelerate outcomes.
  • Design & Authorities – Oversee design finalisation, authority approvals, and regulatory compliance, maintaining strong stakeholder and community engagement.
  • Stakeholder Engagement – Act as key interface for customer, internal and external stakeholders, providing clear reporting and ensuring alignment to business goals.
  • Innovation & Improvement – Mentor teams, drive accountability, and embed continuous improvement in design, programme, safety and cost methodologies.
  • 15+ years' experience leading and delivering large-scale, complex projects and teams in the data centre, mission-critical or highly services infrastructure sectors
  • Bachelor's degree in property development, construction management, engineering, architecture, or related fields.
  • Strong leadership, commercial acumen, and negotiation skills with the ability to influence at all levels.
  • Excellent knowledge of building codes, regulatory approvals, and authority processes.
  • A collaborative, can-do leader who thrives in fast-paced environments and empowers high-performing teams.
  • Be part of a fast-growing, future-focused technology company
  • Play a key role in supporting AI and digital infrastructure in Australia
  • Thrive in a collaborative, inclusive, and values-driven culture
  • Access career development and progression opportunities as we expand

Our mission is to continue building a diverse and inclusive workforce which represents the communities in which we operate.

Make NEXTDC your next move.

title: Analista de Contas a Receber
description:
• Gerenciar o processo de faturamento, emissão de notas fiscais, boletos, faturas e demais documentos de cobrança.
  • Controlar títulos a receber, baixas financeiras, descontos, devoluções, créditos e renegociações.

  • Identificar oportunidades de melhoria, automação e otimização dos processos de cobrança e recebimento.
  • Aplicar soluções de IA e análise de dados para segmentação de carteira, previsão de inadimplência e automação de relatórios.
  • Atender clientes, parceiros ou áreas globais em inglês.
  • Ensino superior completo em Administração, Ciências Contábeis, Economia, Finanças ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência sólida/sênior em contas a receber, crédito e cobrança, faturamento ou tesouraria.
  • Inglês fluente obrigatório, escrito e verbal.
  • Excel avançado, com domínio de tabelas dinâmicas, fórmulas avançadas, PROCV/PROCX, Power Query, gráficos e análise de dados.
  • Experiência com sistemas ERP, ferramentas de cobrança e conciliação financeira.
  • Conhecimento de IA, automações e ferramentas digitais aplicadas às áreas financeira e de cobrança.
  • Conhecimento de faturamento, documentos fiscais, conciliações e indicadores financeiros.
  • Perfil analítico, negociador, comunicativo, resiliente e com alto senso de prioridade.

Diferenciais

  • Estar cursando ou possuir MBA ou pós-graduação em Finanças, Controladoria, Gestão Empresarial, Contabilidade, Auditoria ou áreas correlatas.
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de Business Intelligence.
  • Experiência em empresas multinacionais, centros de serviços compartilhados (CSC) ou ambientes corporativos globais.
  • Vivência em projetos de automação de cobrança, implantação de sistemas ou melhoria de processos financeiros.

title: Senior Software Engineer (AI/Developer Tools)
description:
Czym będziesz się zajmować?

100% remote | B2B | 110 - 140 PLN/h + VAT | długoterminowa współpraca (min. 12 miesięcy)

Do międzynarodowego projektu technologicznego poszukujemy Senior Software Engineera, który poza mocnym doświadczeniem programistycznym aktywnie wykorzystuje rozwiązania oparte o generatywną AI w codziennym procesie tworzenia oprogramowania.

Projekt realizowany jest w środowisku dużej, globalnej organizacji technologicznej dostarczającej rozwiązania IT i usługi cyfrowe dla klientów enterprise. Zespół koncentruje się na rozwoju narzędzi zwiększających produktywność developerów oraz praktycznym wykorzystaniu AI w procesie software development.

Zakres roli

Będziesz łączyć klasyczny software engineering z pracą nad nowoczesnymi rozwiązaniami AI dla developerów. Do Twoich zadań będzie należeć m.in.:

  • projektowanie i rozwijanie narzędzi wspierających programistów w pracy z AI,
  • tworzenie integracji umożliwiających modelom i agentom współpracę z narzędziami developerskimi oraz wewnętrznymi systemami,
  • rozwój narzędzi uruchamianych z poziomu terminala oraz komponentów rozszerzających możliwości asystentów AI,
  • testowanie nowych sposobów wykorzystania AI
  • wypracowywanie dobrych praktyk dotyczących AI-assisted development,


Kogo poszukujemy?

Szukamy osoby, która

  • posiada doświadczenie na poziomie Senior Software Engineer,
  • bardzo dobrze programuje w Pythonie i/lub TypeScript,
  • regularnie wykorzystuje AI coding tools jako część swojego workflow developerskiego,
  • ma praktyczne doświadczenie z rozwiązaniami pozwalającymi łączyć modele AI z zewnętrznymi narzędziami i źródłami danych, w tym MCP,
  • dobrze rozumie architekturę aplikacji, struktury danych i podstawowe zagadnienia algorytmiczne,
  • swobodnie pracuje z Git oraz procesami CI/CD,
  • zna środowiska chmurowe, np. AWS lub GCP,
  • pracowała z Dockerem i/lub Kubernetesem,
  • potrafi nie tylko tworzyć rozwiązania techniczne, ale również przekazywać wiedzę i wspierać innych developerów,
  • swobodnie komunikuje się w języku angielskim.


Czego wymagamy?

Znajomości:
  • Python
  • AI
Mile widziane:
  • Model Context Protocol
  • CI/CD
  • AWS
  • GCP
  • Docker
Języki:
  • Polski
  • Angielski


Jakie warunki i benefity otrzymasz?
  • 18k–23k PLN netto/m (B2B)
  • B2B - Stałe godziny pracy (100%)
  • Praca zdalna: W całości


Kim jesteśmy?

Smart Topaz to polska firma doradczo-konsultacyjna z Warszawy, która pomaga przedsiębiorstwom w rozwijaniu ich potencjału technologicznego i efektywności biznesowej.

Marka Smart Topaz powstała w odpowiedzi na konkretną potrzebę rynku. Widzimy popyt na ekspertyzę technologiczną, dostarczaną w modelu partnerskiego doradztwa.

Zrozumieliśmy, że rynek poszukuje praktycznego know-how, popartego solidnym doświadczeniem. I właśnie na fundamencie naszego wieloletniego doświadczenia budujemy markę Smart Topaz.

title: UI/UX Designer
description:
Mitä jos seuraava suunnitteluratkaisusi näkyisi satojentuhansien asiakkaiden arjessa?

Etsimme Consumer Sales Nordic -organisaatioon UI/UX Designeria kehittämään liiketoimintakriittisiä digitaalisia palveluita, jotka ovat keskeinen osa asiakkaidemme digitaalista asiakkuutta. Tässä roolissa yhdistyvät käyttäjäkokemus, visuaalinen suunnittelu, data ja liiketoiminnan kehittäminen, kun rakennat ratkaisuja, jotka tekevät energia-asioinnista sujuvampaa, saavutettavampaa ja merkityksellisempää.

Digitaaliset palvelut ovat strategisesti tärkeä osa Vattenfallin tulevaisuuden asiakaskokemusta. Osana pohjoismaista tiimiä vaikutat siihen, miten asiakkaamme asioivat kanssamme nyt ja tulevaisuudessa samalla, kun edistämme tavoitettamme mahdollistaa fossiilivapaa elämä.

Mitä pääset tekemään

Vastaat digitaalisten palveluidemme ja uusien ominaisuuksiemme suunnittelusta ideasta tuotantoon. Työskentelet osana pohjoismaista tiimiä ja vaikutat suoraan siihen, millaiseksi kuluttaja- ja pienyritysasiakkaidemme digitaalinen asiakkuus muodostuu. Roolissa osallistut aktiivisesti palveluiden kehityssuunnan määrittämiseen ja päätöksentekoon, jossa tasapainotetaan asiakastarpeita, liiketoiminnan tavoitteita ja datasta saatavia oivalluksia.

Työssäsi pääset:

  • Määrittämään ja kehittämään käyttäjäkokemusta verkkopalveluissamme ja mobiilisovelluksissamme yhdessä liiketoiminnan, tuoteomistajien ja kehitystiimien kanssa
  • Muuttamaan asiakasymmärrystä, liiketoiminnan tavoitteita ja dataan perustuvia havaintoja ratkaisuiksi, jotka tuottavat mitattavaa arvoa
  • Suunnittelemaan käyttäjäystävällisiä, saavutettavia ja visuaalisesti korkeatasoisia käyttöliittymiä koko asiakaspolun eri vaiheisiin
  • Fasilitoimaan työpajoja ja ohjaamaan suunnitteluprosesseja eri sidosryhmien kanssa
  • Toteuttamaan käyttäjätutkimuksia, käytettävyystestauksia ja muita tutkimusmenetelmiä suunnitteluratkaisujen validoimiseksi
  • Kehittämään ja ylläpitämään design-järjestelmää, joka tukee johdonmukaista asiakaskokemusta kaikissa digitaalisissa kanavissamme
  • Hyödyntämään analytiikkaa, kokeiluja ja A/B-testausta asiakaskokemuksen ja konversioiden (CRO) jatkuvassa kehittämisessä
  • Vaikuttamaan digitaalisten palveluidemme tulevaisuuden suuntaan osana kansainvälistä ja ketterää organisaatiota

Mitä toivomme sinulta

Olet kokenut UI/UX Designer, Product Designer tai vastaavassa roolissa työskennellyt ammattilainen. Nautit monimutkaisten ongelmien ratkaisemisesta ja osaat muuttaa ne selkeiksi, toimiviksi ja viimeistellyiksi asiakaskokemuksiksi.

Rakennat luottamusta erilaisten sidosryhmien välille, viet asioita määrätietoisesti eteenpäin ja uskallat haastaa olemassa olevia toimintatapoja, kun näet mahdollisuuden parempaan ratkaisuun. Ymmärrät käyttäjien tarpeita ja liiketoiminnan tavoitteita sekä osaat hyödyntää dataa päätöksenteossa. Aiempi kokemus kansainvälisestä ja kaupallisesta toimintaympäristöstä tai suuresta organisaatiosta on etu, mutta tärkeintä on halu oppia, kehittyä ja vaikuttaa.

Tehtävässä menestyminen edellyttää:

  • Kokemusta kaupallisten digipalveluiden suunnittelusta verkkopalveluissa ja mobiilisovelluksissa
  • Kykyä viedä ratkaisuja ideasta valmiiksi toteutukseksi yhteistyössä liiketoiminnan, tuoteomistajien ja kehitystiimien kanssa
  • Vahvaa visuaalista suunnitteluosaamista sekä ymmärrystä käytettävyydestä, saavutettavuudesta ja asiakaskokemuksesta
  • Erinomaista suullista ja kirjallista viestintätaitoa sekä kykyä johtaa suunnitteluun liittyvää keskustelua, tehdä monimutkaisista ratkaisuista ymmärrettäviä ja perustella valintoja vakuuttavasti eri sidosryhmille
  • Kykyä rakentaa yhteistä suuntaa liiketoiminnan, tuoteomistajien ja kehitystiimien välille
  • Käytännön kokemusta käyttäjätutkimuksista, käytettävyystestauksesta ja käyttäjäymmärryksen hyödyntämisestä päätöksenteossa
  • Kokemusta design-järjestelmien kehittämisestä ja ylläpidosta
  • Tulosorientoitunutta työskentelyotetta sekä kykyä toimia iteratiivisissa designprosesseissa myös silloin, kun suunta muuttuu
  • Suomen kielen taitoa äidinkielen tasolla sekä erittäin vahvaa englannin kielen suullista ja kirjallista taitoa. Ruotsin kielen osaaminen nähdään etuna.

Lisäksi arvostamme:

  • Kokemusta konversion optimoinnista (CRO), analytiikasta ja kokeellisesta kehittämisestä
  • Osaamista työkaluista kuten Figma, Sketch, Adobe Creative Suite, Rive tai Maze.

Mitä tarjoamme

Meille Vattenfallilla on tärkeää, että työn ja vapaa‑ajan välillä on hyvä tasapaino, joten tarjoamme joustavuutta ja mahdollisuuden työskennellä hybridimallilla toimistolla ja etänä. Sinulla on myös käytössäsi laaja valikoima henkilöstöetuja.

Saat meillä ammatillisesti haastavan ja kansainvälisen työympäristön sekä mahdollisuuden työskennellä alan huippuosaajien kanssa. Työskentelet monialaisissa tiimeissä, ja voit aina luottaa sitoutuneiden kollegoiden tukeen. Tarjoamme houkuttelevat työsuhde-edut (älykäs työnteko, joustavat työajat ja hyvä työn ja vapaa-ajan tasapaino) sekä mahdollisuuksia henkilökohtaiseen ja ammatilliseen kehittymiseen. Lisätietoja saat klikkaamalla tästä.

Tehtävän lokaatio: Helsinki

Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa rekrytoiva esihenkilö Ville-Veikko Perintö (ville-veikko.perinto@vattenfall.com / +358406304154). Mikäli haluat keskustella tehtävästä tarkemmin, pyydämme varaamaan sinulle sopivan soittoajan ensin tekstiviestitse tai sähköpostilla.

Rekrytointiprosessiin liittyvissä kysymyksissä voit olla yhteydessä rekrytoija Anders Nielseniin (anders1.nielsen@vattenfall.com / +46700786840). Otathan yhteyttä Andersiin englanninkielellä.

Tervetuloa jättämään hakemuksesi ja CV:n englanniksi viimeistään 30.9.2026. Haastattelut voivat alkaa jo hakuaikana ja jatkuvat tarvittaessa hakuajan päätyttyä. Haastattelujen yhteydessä pyydämme sinua valmistautumaan esittelemään aiempia työnäytteitäsi ja/tai portfoliotasi. Vastaanotamme hakemuksia vain verkkosivujemme kautta.

Varmistathan, että CV-tiedostosi koko ei ylitä 10 Mt:tä.

Rekrytointiprosessiin sisältyy verkkotesti, joka lähetetään kaikille haastatteluvaiheeseen eteneville hakijoille prosessin alkuvaiheessa. Haastattelut rekrytointiprosessissa toteutetaan englanninkielellä.

Monimuotoisuus

Vattenfallilla olemme vakuuttuneita siitä, että monimuotoisuus edistää yrityksen kannattavuutta ja houkuttelevuutta, ja pyrimme olemaan hyvä roolimalli monimuotoisuuden suhteen. Vattenfall työskentelee aktiivisesti sen eteen, että kaikilla työntekijöillä on samat mahdollisuudet ja oikeudet sukupuolesta, etnisyydestä, iästä, sukupuoli-identiteetistä, uskonnosta tai muusta vakaumuksesta, vammaisuudesta tai seksuaalisesta suuntautumisesta riippumatta.

Tietoa meistä

Olemme yksi Euroopan suurimmista sähkön ja lämmön tuottajista ja jälleenmyyjistä, toimien Ruotsissa, Suomessa, Saksassa, Alankomaissa, Tanskassa ja Iso‑Britanniassa. Konsernissa on noin 21 000 työntekijää. Olemme yli sadan vuoden ajan uudistaneet ja sähköistäneet yhteiskuntia, ja tavoitteemme on nyt mahdollistaa fossiilivapaa elämä.

Vattenfall Consumer Sales Nordic vastaa markkinoinnista ja sähkösopimusten myynnistä kotitalouksille ja pienille ja keskisuurille yrityksille Pohjoismaissa. Organisaatiossamme toimii useita ketteriä, monialaisia tiimejä.

Haluamme olla energiamurroksen suunnannäyttäjä ja tehdä fossiilivapaasta liikkumisesta, valmistamisesta ja elämisestä mahdollista kannattavana energiayhtiönä. Strategiamme ytimessä ovat asiakkaiden ja kumppaneiden kanssa toteutettava hiilestä irtautuminen, sähköistyminen, fossiilivapaan energiantuotannon varmistaminen sekä digitalisaatiota hyödyntävä tehokas toiminta.

title: Er du klar til å bli vår nye data engineer hos Sonat Consulting?
description:
Hos Sonat Consulting brenner vi for teknologi som skaper verdi, og nå leter vi etter deg som vil være med på reisen! Vi er et voksende konsulentselskap med kontorer i Oslo, Bergen og Trondheim, og med rundt 120 ansatte har vi bygget en kultur der samarbeid, faglig utvikling og innovasjon står i sentrum. Som data engineer i Oslo får du sjansen til å jobbe med spennende dataplattformer, samarbeide med kunder og kolleger, og bidra til hvordan data brukes i praksis for å skape forretningsverdi. Uansett hvor du er i karrieren din, vil vi gjerne ha deg med på laget!

Hva får du jobbe med som data engineer hos oss?

Som data engineer i Sonat blir du en viktig brikke i å bygge og videreutvikle robuste, skalerbare og fremtidsrettede dataløsninger. Her er noe av det du kan se frem til:

  • Bygging som betyr noe: Utvikle og vedlikeholde moderne datapipelines og dataplattformer med fokus på kvalitet, ytelse og pålitelighet.

  • Fra rådata til innsikt: Jobb med innhenting, transformasjon og tilgjengeliggjøring av store datamengder for analyse, rapportering og videre bruk.

  • Samarbeid i fokus: Jobb tett med utviklere, analytikere, arkitekter, prosjektledere og kunder for å sikre helhetlige og velfungerende løsninger.

  • Stødig leveranse: Bidra til gode praksiser for datamodellering, overvåking, dokumentasjon og automatisering gjennom hele verdikjeden.

  • Være med å bygge og videreutvikle vår Data & Insight-avdeling, bidra til kunnskapsdeling og kompetanseheving i teamet.

Hvem ser vi etter?

Vi tror de beste data engineerne er nysgjerrige, løsningsorienterte og liker å dele kunnskap. Kanskje dette passer deg?

  • Du holder til i Oslo, Bergen eller Fredrikstad

  • Har minst fem års erfaring innen data engineering eller tilsvarende roller.

  • Du har jobbet med, eller er nysgjerrig på verktøy som Snowflake, Databricks, Azure Data Factory eller tilsvarende.

  • Du har vært borti skytjenester som AWS, Azure eller Google Cloud, eller ønsker å lære hvordan vi bygger dataplattformer i skyen.

  • Mestrer minst ett språk som kan brukes til å wrangle data og sjekke dataintegritet, som f.eks. Python.

  • Du synes databaser (SQL/NoSQL), datavarehus eller streamingteknologier som Kafka og Spark er spennende (erfaring er en fordel, men ikke et krav).

  • Du bryr deg om datakvalitet, sikkerhet og personvern og har gjerne kjennskap til GDPR eller lyst til å lære mer.

  • Du liker å bygge løsninger som fungerer godt i dag, men som også tåler vekst og endring over tid.

  • Du evner å forklare tekniske løsninger på en forståelig måte, både til tekniske og ikke-tekniske interessenter.

Har du en bachelor- eller mastergrad i et relevant fag, som informatikk, data science eller lignende? Flott – men vi er like opptatt av hva du brenner for og hva du ønsker å bidra med, uansett utgangspunkt!

Hva kan vi tilby deg?

Vi er et selskap som verdsetter både folk og fag. Her er noe av det du får hos Sonat:

  • Meningsfulle prosjekter: Vær med på å forme dataløsninger for spennende bransjer og kunder.

  • Tid til å vokse: 8 fagdager i året til å utforske ny teknologi og bygge kompetansen din.

  • Varierte utfordringer: Jobb med noen av Norges mest innovative selskaper – alltid noe nytt å lære!

  • Gode betingelser: Konkurransedyktig lønn som matcher deg, pluss to årlige firmaturer til steder som Geilo, England eller Kroatia.

  • Et fellesskap: Bli del av et sterkt fagmiljø der vi deler lidenskapen for teknologi og løfter hverandre opp.

title: BOSS Fulfillment Seasonal Associate
description:
'Tis the Season for Hiring!

Are you looking for a fun seasonal position with the opportunity to earn extra money for the holidays AND enjoy our Outfitter Discount?

Join us for our National Hiring Event:

  • Wednesday, October 7th and Thursday, October 8th
  • 10 am - 7 pm
  • Bass Pro Shop/Cabela's 1000 Bass Pro Dr, Altoona, Iowa 50009

Be prepared to interview for various positions on the spot!

Apply prior to arrival to expedite the process at careers.basspro.com

POSITION SUMMARY:

BOSS (Buy Online Ship from Store) is a process that allows us to improve our overall shopping experience for our customers. By accessing inventory in all of our retail locations, it helps us quickly find the right product for our customers no matter where they are shopping. The BOSS Fulfillment Outfitter must be familiar with the products we sell, will be responsible for filling BOSS orders, sorting, picking, packing, and loading merchandise for shipment to direct customers and retail stores as needed. Ensures merchandise is handled to maintain quality and appearance for customers.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

  • Performs multiple functions within the back room of the retail store such as receiving merchandise, inspecting merchandise, filling orders, sorting and packing merchandise in appropriate box size for shipment to customers as needed. In fulfillment of these duties may spend majority of time in one of the following areas, but has knowledge and experience to move among multiple area functions as needed.
  • Sorts merchandise into order groupings and/or pack merchandise using proper containers, cartons, or packaging for shipment. Applies designated labels and visually inspects product for quality and presentation to customer.
  • Fills retail and/or direct customer orders by inspecting merchandise and matching merchandise to order. Pulls merchandise from designated stock locations and place in proper containers.
  • Moves merchandise among warehouse locations using authorized material handling equipment (i.e. stock pickers, lift trucks, etc.) or manually load and/or unload trailers.
  • Maintains housekeeping and cleanliness and follows procedures for a safe work environment.

title: ASL Interpreter, Relief
description:
JOB SUMMARY

This paragraph summarizes the general nature, level and purpose of the job.

Under the direct supervision of the manager of interpreter services, the Relief ASL interpreter conducts medical and general interpreting for the patient care staff and for patients and their families throughout LPCHS and its satellite locations. The interpreter acts as Language Bridge to ensure best outcomes in communication between the hearing and/or speech impaired and their caregivers. The interpreter acts as a cultural consultant to staff and as an advocate, when appropriate, for non-hearing patients and families. The interpreter assesses and monitors patients' understanding of the information conveyed and keeps physicians/nurses informed as to the level of that understanding. Suggest referrals to medical staff, clinical social workers, patient representation staff, chaplains and ancillary services. Records services provided in electronic patient's chart. Represent LPCHS/SHC interpreter services at various functions.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

The essential functions listed are typical examples of work performed by positions in this job classification. They are not designed to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, tasks, and responsibilities. Employees may also perform other duties as assigned.

Employees must abide by all Joint Commission Requirements including but not limited to sensitivity to cultural diversity, patient care, patient rights and ethical treatment, safety and security of physical environments, emergency management, teamwork, respect for others, participation in ongoing education and training, communication and adherence to safety and quality programs, sustaining compliance with National Patient Safety Goals, and licensure and health screenings.

Must perform all duties and responsibilities in accordance with the hospital's policies and procedures, including its Service Standards and its Code of Conduct.

* Assesses patient's and family's comprehension of "informed consent" as needed.
* Encourages patients' compliance with treatment acting as cultural broker.
* Advises physician/patient care team of need for clarification.
* Assists LPCHS clinical staff in the assessment of situations in culturally different context.
* Performs medical interpretation and transliteration for patients and their families; medical staff and other care providers; including in-group settings, such as family conferences. This will include but is not limited to interpreting when a care giver is:

a) Taking a patient's medical history,

b) Giving diagnoses,

c) Performing medical procedures,

d) Explaining treatment plan

e) Explaining medicine prescription and regimen,

f) Providing patient education or counseling,

g) Describing discharge and follow up plans.


* Works with scheduling system and coordinators or managers to assess daily need for services. Documents sessions in CERNER, manages conflicts of scheduling to ensure best outcome for patients.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

Any combination of education and experience that would likely provide the required knowledge, skills and abilities as well as possession of any required licenses or certifications is qualifying.

* Education: Bachelors degree in a work-related discipline/field from an accredited college or university.
* Experience: Five (5) years of progressively responsible and directly related work experience.
* License/Certification: None required.

KNOWLEDGE

These are the observable and measurable attributes and skills required to perform successfully the essential functions of the job and are generally demonstrated through qualifying experience, education or licensure/certification.

* Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships.
* Ability to maintain confidentiality of sensitive information.
* Ability to remain calm under pressure and apply sound judgment.
* Ability to respond to on-call needs, and to accommodate last minute requests.
* Knowledge of cultural and perceptual factors that may affect patient treatment and communication.
* Knowledge of extensive medical terminology and sign vocabulary and continue to improve sign competencies and medical terminology through continuing education.
* Knowledge of healthcare interpreter and professional standards of best practice, to ensure consistent quality and performance, including: accuracy, confidentiality, impartiality, respect, cultural awareness, role boundaries, professionalism, self development and advocacy.
* Knowledge of, and adherence to the healthcare professional interpreter's code of ethics.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

The Physical Requirements and Working Conditions in which the job is typically performed are available from the Occupational Health Department. Reasonable accommodations will be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the job.

Engineering is going through an AI-first transformation, rethinking how teams are structured and how they ship. It's changing what a small team can do! We empower our teams to make decisions, move fast, and take full responsibility for the solutions they deliver. You’ll join a team where curiosity is encouraged and collaboration across Product, Data, Delivery and Engineering is the norm.

The role:

As an Analytics Engineer, you’ll design and own the transformation layer that turns raw operational data into reliable, well-documented analytical assets.

Working at the intersection of data engineering and business analytics, you’ll build trusted data models, metrics and entities that power dashboards, reporting and business decisions across Liberis. You’ll take ownership of analytical problems from initial discovery through to production, working closely with data engineers, analysts and business stakeholders.

You’ll also use AI tools such as Claude Code and Codex to accelerate delivery, automate routine work and improve how analytical solutions are developed—while maintaining appropriate review, testing and human oversight.

Success in this role means creating high-quality data products that stakeholders trust, enabling greater self-service and making our analytics platform easier to maintain and evolve.

What you'll get to do:

  • Design & build dbt models with a clear layering and data modelling approach.
  • Own data model quality through comprehensive testing.
  • Build semantic layers (LookML, dbt Semantic Model, or equivalent) to enable self-serve analytics.
  • Collaborate across functions to understand business requirements and translate them into data models; provide feedback on downstream usage.
  • Use AI tools effectively to accelerate SQL/dbt writing, generate tests, automate routine work, and build an end-to-end harness from plan to production with a proper human-in-the-loop workflow.
  • Review peers' work, focusing on design patterns, testing strategy, and architectural decisions.
  • Maintain and evolve models based on user feedback; handle schema changes with minimal downstream disruption.
  • Automate analytical work for stakeholders using lightweight Python/SQL workflows when appropriate.

The interview process:

  • Screening call with Chess - Internal Recruiter (30 mins)
  • Video interview with the Hiring Manager (1 hour)
  • Technical interview with a member of Engineering team (1 hour)
  • Video interview with the wider Liberis team (1 hour)

What we think you'll need:

  • Proven hands on analytics engineering, data engineering, or BI engineering experience, working with dbt in production.
  • Strong SQL - window functions, CTEs, and complex joins; can explain query performance.
  • Dimensional modeling or data modeling experience; understand grain, facts, dimensions, historization, and various data modelling topologies.
  • Production judgment - have shipped models used by real stakeholders; can discuss what worked and what didn't.
  • Git & CI/CD - comfortable with PRs, code review, and version control.
  • AI coding tools - hands-on experience with Claude Code, Cursor, or a similar LLM IDE.

Next steps If this opportunity feels like the right fit for your next career move, we’d love to hear from you!

Even if you don’t meet every requirement, don’t hesitate to apply or reach out to Chess (Internal Recruiter) on chess.crossley@liberis.com

Our hybrid approach

Working together in person helps us move faster, collaborate better, and build a great Liberis culture. This role requires at least three days per week in the office, with flexibility around which days depending on team and business needs. Our ways of working may evolve over time, including office attendance expectations. At Liberis, we embrace flexibility as a core part of our culture, while also valuing the importance of the time our teams spend together in the office.
