  • 3+ years of experience (or equivalent) working in an analytics function, ideally within digital entertainment, subscription, media, technology or a related digital business.
  • Strong technical proficiency in SQL, Python and/or R, alongside spreadsheet applications such as Excel or Google Sheets.
  • Proven ability to translate ambiguous business questions and requirements into structured analysis and meaningful, actionable insights.

  • Experience creating data visualisations, dashboards and reports that clearly communicate insights and support decision-making.

  • Ability to collaborate effectively with stakeholders across different teams, functions and levels of seniority.
  • Strong organisational and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
  • Ability to adapt and work effectively in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.
  • Flexibility to collaborate with colleagues across global time zones, including occasional meetings outside standard local working hours.

Desirable:

  • Experience with additional analytics, data or visualisation tools such as VBA, Airflow, Tableau or Domo.
  • Knowledge of, or a strong interest in, the gaming and digital entertainment industry, including key players and competitive offerings.
  • Experience working with subscription-based products or businesses.

title: Circle K Solna Järva Krog söker butikssäljare för varannan helg 19.61%
description:
Vart är du på väg?

Nu söker vi butikssäljare – ja, alltså riktiga servicehjältar!

Vi vill bli världsbäst på service. Och därför söker vi nu fler servicehjältar. Vad gör en sådan? Jo, du möter våra kunders behov med kunskap, fingertoppskänsla och ett härligt leende – ofta samtidigt som du kanske fyller på kaffemaskinen eller lägger upp en korv. För vi är en butikskedja som erbjuder allt från god mat och bakverk, till bra drivmedel och fräscha toaletter. Är du vår nästa talang? Då hittar du vänner för livet här på Circle K.

Vi söker nu dig som vill jobba som butikssäljare hos oss på Circle K Järva Krog i Solna. Vi har två likadana tjänster som motsvarar 19,61% där man arbetar varannan helg. Den ena är en tillsvidare anställning och den andra är ett vikariat på ca 1 år med chans till förlängning. Arbetspassen för denna tjänst är förlagda 17-01 varannan lördag och söndag antingen jämna eller ojämna veckor. Utöver ditt schema finns det även möjligheter att ta extrapass för att komma upp i sysselsättningsgrad. Ensamarbete förekommer. För att vara aktuell för tjänsten hos oss behöver du ha körkort.

Som butikssäljare hos oss har du en månadslön som baseras på din tidigare erfarenhet inom service. Månadslönen vid heltidsarbete varierar mellan 27400-33065 kr/månad. Utöver din månadslön får du extra OB-ersättning för arbete under kvällar, nätter, helger och röda dagar. Eftersom vi har en CV-lös och fördomsfri rekrytering behöver du styrka din tidigare erfarenhet genom att uppvisa arbetsgivarintyg under rekryteringsprocessen. För att söka tjänsten fyller du enkelt i dina uppgifter, anger vilka tider du kan arbeta och genomför därefter ett kort servicetest som tar cirka 10 minuter. Är du vår nya butikssäljare som gillar varierande arbetsuppgifter och att ge service utöver det vanliga? Vi jobbar med löpande urval i rekryteringen så sök tjänsten omgående för att inte missa chansen!

Varmt välkommen in med din ansökan senast 25.09.2026

Om dig:

  • Du är en teamplayer – du sätter laget före jaget.
  • Du är en fixare – du hittar lösningar på allt.
  • Du älskar människor.
  • Du är en allkonstnär: Du gillar att ha koll på allt, och tycker om att göra många saker samtidigt.
  • Du vill lära dig nya saker och utvecklas, kanske är du redo för mer ansvar.
  • Du har förmodligen arbetat inom service och är redo för nästa steg i karriären.
  • Du pratar och förstår svenska.
  • Du är över 18 år.

Om oss:

  • Vi är en plantskola för social skills – vi lägger en bra grund för alla framtida yrken. Och du får ett snyggt CV!
  • För dig som redan kommit en bit i yrkeslivet kan vi erbjuda ett utvecklande och mångsidigt jobb.
  • Du får kunskap om hur det är att driva butik.
  • Du lär dig att bli en ledare med förståelse för service.
  • Du får specialistkunskap – vi kan allt från att driva butik och sälja drivmedel, till marknadsföring och ledarskap.
  • Du får en möjlighet till att göra karriär inom företaget – kanske vill du driva din egen butik, eller sikta mot ett jobb på vårt huvudkontor.
  • Du får ett roligt jobb med härliga kollegor.
  • Vi är ett internationellt företag med kollegor runt omkring i hela världen.
  • Våra stationer kan ha biluthyrning, då är körkort B-manuell ett krav.
  • Vi erbjuder dig ett förmånligt friskvårdsbidrag och personalrabatt på alla våra stationer.

Circle K är ett framgångsrikt globalt företag med mer än 17 300 butiker i 27 länder. Totalt har vi cirka 150 000 anställda som arbetar i våra butiker och på kontoren. Vårt nätverk består av butiker som drivs både i bolags- och franchisedrift. Vår kultur och våra värderingar: One Team, Take Ownership, Play to Win och Do the Right Thing är grunden i allt vi gör. Vi vill göra det enkelt för våra kunder längs vägen genom att erbjuda bra produkter och snabb service i världsklass.


För den här tjänsten krävs att du antingen är medborgare i Sverige, ett annat nordiskt land eller ett EU/EES-land, har permanent uppehållstillstånd i Sverige, eller är asylsökande med giltig rätt att arbeta. Under rekryteringsprocessen behöver du kunna visa upp handlingar som styrker ditt medborgarskap eller din arbetsrätt i Sverige.


Vi förbehåller oss rätten att göra bakgrundskontroller på slutkandidater i rekryteringsprocessen.

title: Staff Engineer, SSD Validation
description:
Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all.

Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.

Join our forward-thinking engineering group at Micron, where you will have a key role in changing how the world accesses information. As a Staff Engineer for SSD Validation, you will coordinate the validation, system integration, and joint qualification of our elite Enterprise and Datacenter NVMe SSD products. This is your chance to contribute in a cooperative and welcoming setting while promoting technical excellence and innovation!

Position Overview

The Staff Engineer for SSD Validation directs the technical activities in validation, system integration, and collaborative qualification of Enterprise and Datacenter NVMe SSD products. This position oversees the validation strategy and actively engages in firmware, hardware, and system testing. It holds primary responsibility for assisting new customers through joint qualification (JQ). The Staff Engineer serves as a specialist in NVMe/PCIe, encourages automation and early quality improvements, and mentors other engineers. They also guarantee that products are prepared for production on both internal and customer platforms. Working with Firmware, Hardware, Product Engineering, Manufacturing, and Customer Engineering teams, this role fosters internal coordination and uniform qualification outcomes.

Responsibilities

  • Lead system-level validation and qualification, performing end-to-end testing across SSDs, firmware, drivers, OS, networking, and platform configurations.

  • Direct validation test plans from development through completion, including failure analysis, reporting, and coordination with customer joint qualification (JQ) requirements.

  • Perform hands-on system bring-up, debug, and configuration, including OS installation, driver validation, and storage-stack verification.

  • Support customer and partner issue reproduction, converting field/JQ findings into internal test cases and improving validation coverage.

  • Develop and improve automated test frameworks and Python-based tools while driving shift-left validation to influence build and improve product testability.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical/Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related field

  • 5+ years of experience in SSD, storage, or semiconductor validation with deep knowledge of NVMe and PCIe protocols

  • Hands-on expertise with Linux environments, system setup, OS bring-up, drive triage, and root-cause analysis of complex issues

  • Proven background in Enterprise/Datacenter SSD firmware validation, including system-level joint qualification

  • Proficiency in Python for automation and data analysis, paired with strong communication skills for conveying technical results to internal and external partners

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience leading or assisting customer joint qualification (JQ) efforts with OEMs, hyperscalers, or strategic partners

  • Familiarity with networked storage environments, platform interoperability, and multi-system qualification flows

  • Hands-on experience with protocol analyzers (e.g., Lecroy, JDSU) and third-party SSD test platforms (e.g., UNH-IOL, PCI-SIG compliance, SanBlaze)

  • Strong understanding of PCIe topology, BIOS/firmware behavior, Linux storage stacks, and drivers

  • Knowledge of NAND flash, storage architecture, and FTL development

title: Satellite Electrical Power and Harness Systems Engineer (Associate, Experienced, or Lead)
description:
Satellite Electrical Power and Harness Systems Engineer (Associate, Experienced, or Lead)

Company:

The Boeing Company

Boeing Defense, Space & Security (BDS) is seeking Associate, Experienced, or Lead Satellite Electrical Power and Harness Systems Engineers (Level 2, 3, or 4) to join our team in El Segundo, California.

The Space, Intelligence, and Weapon Systems (SIWS) team designs and delivers next-generation satellite products and services for both commercial and proprietary customers. Our team supports all engineering phases, including technology investment, concept development, proposal writing, requirements definition, design, build, integration, testing, and demonstration in operational environments.

The Electrical Power System (EPS) and Harness Engineering team is responsible for the design, analysis, testing, and operation of power systems across a variety of vehicle classes. This includes power generation, energy storage, power regulation, and power distribution. We seek candidates with a strong engineering / scientific / analytical background to work on system level issues including, but not limited to: proposal work, power system design, power system testing, and anomaly resolution.

Ideal candidates will possess expertise in harness design tools, electrical modeling tools, power systems architecture, and regulated power systems and familiarity with modern "battery-on-bus" architectures to enable future technology insertion.

Position Overview:

As a Satellite Electrical Power and Harness Systems Engineer at Boeing, you will be part of a high-performing, dynamic team working on intensive satellite development projects. Your work will span power and harness subsystems for both one-time development and sustaining engineering efforts.

Our team includes engineers focused on power system design and harness system design. While expertise in both areas is highly desirable, distinct roles exist during the design phase. Post-critical design reviews, during integration and test phases, these responsibilities typically consolidate under a single engineer. Below are the key responsibilities for this role:

Position Responsibilities:

  • Define and refine requirements and develop verification artifacts for satellite electrical power and/or harness subsystems

  • Perform detailed power subsystem analyses, including:

    • Battery performance modeling and battery charge management planning,

    • Bus voltage regulation and stability analysis (including ripple and transients)

    • Redundancy and fault-tolerance strategies

  • Conduct harness analyses such as voltage drop calculations, fuse blow assessments, short circuit clearing, failure modes and effects analyses (FMEA)

  • Develop, maintain, and update vehicle-level power budgets for all mission phases

  • Assume end-to-end ownership of the EPS/harness subsystem throughout the spacecraft lifecycle

  • Lead power subsystem architecture and sizing efforts, including block diagram development, solar array sizing, and battery capacity determination

  • Collaborate across multidiscipline teams (thermal, mechanical, software, avionics) to ensure design integrity and subsystem compatibility

This position is expected to be 100% onsite. The selected candidate will be required to work onsite in El Segundo, CA.

Basic Qualifications (Required Skills/ Experience):

  • Bachelor of Science degree in Engineering, Engineering Technology (including Manufacturing Technology), Computer Science, Data Science, Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry or non-US equivalent qualifications directly related to the work statement

  • 2+ years of related work experience or an equivalent combination of technical education and experience

  • 2+ years of experience working with space related electrical power and harness subsystems

Preferred Qualifications (Desired Skills/Experience):

  • Level 3 (Experienced): 5+ years of related work experience or an equivalent combination of education and experience

  • Level 4 (Lead): 9+ years of related work experience or an equivalent combination of education and experience

  • Experience with DC-DC converters and power electronics design to optimize efficiency and mass savings

  • Familiarity with electromagnetic interference (EMI) and electromagnetic compatibility (EMC) analysis, which is critical for power and harness integration

  • Knowledge of industry space qualification standards and guidelines, including radiation effects on power electronics and battery systems

  • Experience with software tools such as MATLAB/Simulink, PSpice, Schematic capture/ECAD tools (e.g., Mentor, Cadence), and power system simulation software

  • Understanding of failure investigations and root cause analysis (RCA) methodologies for spacecraft power anomalies

  • Ability to support mission operations with anomaly resolution and power subsystem troubleshooting

The Boeing Company also provides eligible employees with an opportunity to enroll in a variety of benefit programs, generally including health insurance, flexible spending accounts, health savings accounts, retirement savings plans, life and disability insurance programs, and a number of programs that provide for both paid and unpaid time away from work.

title: Junior Logistiek Planner Inbound/Outbound 32-40 uur
description:
In verband met uitbreiding van ons logistieke team zijn wij op zoek naar een Junior Logistiek Planner Inbound/Outbound.

Wat ga je doen?

Als Junior Logistiek Planner leer je hoe je (inter)nationale transportopdrachten van A tot Z plant en coördineert. Je werkt samen met ervaren planners en wordt stap voor stap meegenomen in het vak. Je krijgt te maken met zowel Inbound als Outbound logistiek.

Je werkzaamheden bestaan onder andere uit:

  • Ondersteunen bij het plannen en coördineren van transportopdrachten.
  • Afstemmen met Sales, Inkoop, Warehousing en vervoerders.
  • Signaleren van knelpunten in de planning en deze bespreken met collega’s.
  • Monitoren van transportprocessen via dashboards.
  • Uitvoeren van administratieve taken zoals ordervoorbereiding voor facturatie en controle van transportdocumenten.
  • Meedenken over verbeteringen in logistieke processen.

Je komt terecht in het logistieke team (Inbound & Outbound) dat bestaat uit 8 planners. Afhankelijk van je team focus je je op inkomende of uitgaande goederen. Je werkt nauw samen met ervaren collega’s en rapporteert aan de Teamlead In- en Outbound.

Hoe ziet je werkdag eruit?

Je dag is afwisselend: de ene keer ondersteun je bij het aanpassen van een planning, de andere keer stem je met Sales af hoe een levering het beste kan worden ingericht. Je leert omgaan met onverwachte situaties en krijgt steeds meer verantwoordelijkheid naarmate je groeit in je rol.

Wie ben jij?

Je staat aan het begin van je carrière en wilt graag leren in een dynamische logistieke omgeving. Je houdt van plannen, schakelen en samenwerken.

Verder:

  • Werk/denkniveau, mbo 3-4 of hbo, met voorkeur richting logistiek of supply chain. 1–2 jaar relevante werkervaring (stage-ervaring telt mee).
  • Je werkt nauwkeurig en behoudt overzicht.
  • Je bent communicatief vaardig en niet bang om vragen te stellen.
  • Kennis van Microsoft Office (Excel), Basiskennis van ERP/WMS is mooi meegenomen
  • Goede beheersing van Nederlands en Engels.
  • Je woont bij voorkeur binnen 45 minuten reisafstand van Oud-Beijerland.

Wat bieden wij?

  • Salaris tussen €2.700 – €3.000 bruto per maand, afhankelijk van kennis en ervaring.
  • 32 tot 40-urige werkweek.
  • Begeleiding en een goed inwerkprogramma.
  • 28 vakantiedagen (o.b.v. 40 uur) + mogelijkheid om 10 extra dagen bij te kopen.
  • Reiskostenvergoeding en pensioenregeling (Topbrands betaalt 2/3).
  • Laptop, fruit, bedrijfsfeesten, bootcamp en padel.
  • Toegang tot het 'Benefits at Work'-platform, met korting op topmerken, dagjes uit en andere extra's.

Onze sollicitatieprocedure:

We starten met een eerste kennismakingsgesprek om te kijken of er een wederzijdse klik is. Is die er? Dan plannen we een tweede gesprek.

Tussen deze gesprekken door vragen we je om een online assessment te maken. Dit kan gewoon thuis, op je eigen moment en helpt ons én jou om te ontdekken of de rol echt bij je past.

Wil je na het eerste of tweede gesprek graag nog even sfeer proeven of meekijken op de afdeling? Dat kan! We vinden het belangrijk dat jij een goed beeld krijgt van de functie en de werkomgeving.

Na het tweede gesprek doen we je, als we allebei enthousiast zijn, een passend aanbod.

Vriendelijke herinnering; we zijn niet op zoek naar externe dienstverleners bij de invulling van deze vacature!

title: Director, Ads & MarTech Engineering
description:
At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

About Ads Engineering and Marketing Technology Development

Ads Engineering creates platforms, services, APIs, and experiences for sellers that drive advertising on eBay. The team covers campaign and advertising workflows, dashboards and reporting, public APIs, selling flows, and foundational systems that enable sellers and advertisers to grow their enterprises.

MarTech Engineering develops the platforms and capabilities that drive customer marketing and lifecycle engagement throughout eBay. The team concentrates on customer marketing platforms, performance marketing, marketing implementation systems, and the technological foundations that support personalized, measurable, and scalable customer engagement.

About the team and the role

The Ads Engineering and MarTech Engineering teams build extensive products, platforms, and workflows that support sellers in growing their businesses. They help advertisers meet clear objectives and guide customers to the right inventory when needed. Their work spans frontend applications, backend services, APIs, data pipelines, and current engineering techniques. These teams collaborate with Product, Development, Analytics, Applied Science, and program leadership.

As Director, Ads & MarTech Engineering, you will lead a Bengaluru engineering unit focused on building and improving vital Ads and MarTech products and platforms. You will manage organizational configuration, technical execution, quality management, leadership development, and collaborative project delivery. The ideal candidate is a leader with strong engineering expertise who can grow teams, coach leaders, and convert business priorities into durable technological strategies.

What you will accomplish

  • Lead and scale a high-performing Bengaluru-based software engineering organization, including managers and engineers, with clear accountability for delivery, quality, team health, and organizational efficiency.

  • Define and finalize the engineering strategy and multi-quarter roadmap for your area, aligning technology investments with product priorities and business outcomes across Ads and MarTech.

  • Build the operating cadence, execution clarity, and decision-making mechanisms that enable teams to deliver complex initiatives predictably across build, development, testing, release, observability, and production support.

  • Collaborate closely with Product, Program Management, Build, Analytics, Applied Science, and global Engineering leaders to align priorities, resolve dependencies, and deliver measurable customer and business impact.

  • Improve engineering excellence by driving scalable architecture, reliability, security, maintainability, and developer efficiency across the organization.

  • Hire, mentor, and develop engineering managers and senior engineers. Build a strong leadership bench and an inclusive culture. This culture helps teams do their best work and grow their careers.

What you will bring

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical area, or equivalent practical experience.

  • Over 15 years of experience leading software engineering teams in either enterprise or consumer software environments. You have guided senior individual contributors and/or managers within complex organizations.

  • Demonstrated experience leading several software engineering groups via managers, responsible for strategy, implementation, talent growth, and organizational results.

  • Strong technical depth in large-scale distributed systems, platform architecture, and modern software development practices, with good judgment across speed, quality, reliability, and scale trade-offs.

  • Demonstrated ability to translate business priorities into engineering strategy, roadmaps, team structures, and action plans that deliver measurable results.

  • Track record of attracting, retaining, and developing high-performing engineering talent, including organizational build, succession planning, manager mentoring, and performance leadership.

  • Experience driving multi-functional and cross-organizational alignment across Product, Engineering, Build, Analytics, and other partner teams in complex, fast paced environments.

  • Excellent communication and leadership presence, with the ability to influence senior collaborators, build clarity across global teams, and represent the Bengaluru organization effectively across time zones.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience in Ads, MarTech, eCommerce, or other customer-facing product and platform organizations operating at scale.

  • Experience leading organizations responsible for user-facing applications, backend services, APIs, data systems, and platform capabilities.

  • Familiarity with modern developer efficiency practices, including AI-assisted software development, engineering efficiency improvements, and continuous delivery.

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical area, or a comparable combination of education and practical experience in the field.

Additional Details

title: Equity Research – Analyst/Associate, Hardlines, Broadlines & Food Retail (New York)
location: New York, New York, United States of America
description:
Research

Morgan Stanley Investment Research is uniquely committed to being an essential part of our clients’ investment process. We strive to be the sell-side research provider that best understands the buy side. Through relevant and timely conversations with leading investors, we focus resources on risk-reward essentials: identifying the investor debates, assessing the potential outcomes, and uncovering the evidence our clients need to validate their investment decisions. Our equity analysts cover some 3,000 stocks; our economists, strategists, and fixed income analysts cover all major regions and other asset classes around the globe.

Equity Research

The Equity Research department is responsible for researching macroeconomic and microeconomic conditions, along with company fundamentals. It also collects and analyses financial information to make investment recommendations on stocks in specific sectors. Research analysts build financial models to explore alternative scenarios, examine industries, and communicate with companies and investors. Equity Research team members discuss their analysis and investment recommendations in research notes. A career in investment research at Morgan Stanley demands a commitment to excellence, a passion for the markets, and the highest level of integrity.

We are seeking an Analyst-level or Associate-level individual to join our Hardlines, Broadlines, and Food Retail team in New York City, covering a wide variety of retailers, including Walmart, Home Depot, and Costco.

Primary Responsibilities

• Create and maintain earnings, valuation, and industry models, leveraging skills in accounting, finance, and economics
• Translate company, industry, consumer, market, and alternative data into insightful research reports with clear investment debates, differentiated conclusions, and actionable stock calls
• Write research reports for initiations of coverage, data analysis, earnings results, company updates, and industry news
• Develop and maintain relationships with investor relations personnel, management of companies under coverage, industry specialists, and other key leaders of opinion
• Engage with institutional investors by responding to in-depth questions, addressing bespoke requests, and helping communicate the team’s highest-conviction views
• Support internal sales and trading teams with timely analysis of sector breaking news
• Adopt and apply AI-enabled research tools judiciously to accelerate information gathering, model maintenance, data analysis, and workflow execution while maintaining analytical rigor, source verification, and quality control
• Conduct industry diligence and primary research through surveys, expert conference calls, and channel checks to evaluate industry trends
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to produce larger industry reports

Qualifications

• 1-3 years of professional experience in equity research, investment banking, or capital markets
• Proven experience using Excel to build and maintain financial models; advanced Excel proficiency is required
• Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present analysis clearly, defend conclusions, and contribute positively in client-facing discussions
• Demonstrated interest in public markets and a genuine curiosity about what drives stock performance, investor debates, and valuation
• Curiosity about retail, consumer behavior, brand dynamics, competitive positioning, pricing, category trends, and how these factors translate into revenue growth, margins, valuation, and stock performance
• Comfort adopting AI-enabled tools and new technologies to improve research efficiency, with the judgment to verify outputs, protect data integrity, and apply tools appropriately
• Demonstrated strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy
• Ability to adapt quickly and work well under pressure
• High EQ, strong personal drive, intellectual curiosity, organizational discipline, and a team-oriented mindset
• Strong PowerPoint skills are required, and experience with Python is a plus but not required
• CFA designation or progress toward CFA preferred

WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT FROM MORGAN STANLEY:

At Morgan Stanley, we raise, manage and allocate capital for our clients – helping them reach their goals. We do it in a way that’s differentiated – and we’ve done that for 90 years. Our values - putting clients first, doing the right thing, leading with exceptional ideas, committing to diversity and inclusion, and giving back - aren’t just beliefs, they guide the decisions we make every day to do what's best for our clients, communities and more than 80,000 employees in 1,200 offices across 42 countries. At Morgan Stanley, you’ll find an opportunity to work alongside the best and the brightest, in an environment where you are supported and empowered. Our teams are relentless collaborators and creative thinkers, fueled by their diverse backgrounds and experiences. We are proud to support our employees and their families at every point along their work-life journey, offering some of the most attractive and comprehensive employee benefits and perks in the industry. There’s also ample opportunity to move about the business for those who show passion and grit in their work.

To learn more about our offices across the globe, please copy and paste https://www.morganstanley.com/about-us/global-offices​ into your browser.

Expected base pay rates for the role will be between $110,000 and $125,000 per year for Analyst, and between $150,000 and $200,000 per year for Associate, at the commencement of employment. However, base pay if hired will be determined on an individualized basis and is only part of the total compensation package, which, depending on the position, may also include commission earnings, incentive compensation, discretionary bonuses, other short and long-term incentive packages, and other Morgan Stanley sponsored benefit programs.

title: ASIC Physical Design Engineer — Synthesis and Timing – (Associate or Experienced)
description:
ASIC Physical Design Engineer — Synthesis and Timing – (Associate or Experienced)

Company:

The Boeing Company

Boeing Space, Intelligence & Weapons Systems has an exciting opportunity for multiple ASIC Physical Design Engineers – Synthesis and Timing to join us as part of our Boeing Electronic Products team at the heart of Boeing’s products to support advanced digital subsystem development in an aerospace environment in El Segundo, CA.

Position overview
We are hiring an ASIC Physical Design Engineer — Synthesis and Timing to help implement advanced SoCs used in mission-critical satellite and space applications. You will own portions of the full physical design flow—from synthesis and STA through ECOs and tapeout—collaborating closely with architecture, RTL, verification and outside companies.

Key Responsibilities

  • Help in driving frontend and backend implementation including synthesis, equivalence checking, floor-planning, timing constraints, timing and power convergence, and ECO implementation

  • Ensure clean netlist handoffs and predictable convergence by partnering with RTL, verification, DFT, and backend partner companies

  • Support chip‑level integration, top‑level timing closure, signoff readiness, and tapeout activities

  • Contribute to methodology, automation, tool evaluations, and flow documentation

  • Troubleshoot complex cross‑domain timing issues and propose robust, repeatable fixes

Boeing continuously shapes the future of aerospace and space systems, advancing U.S. leadership in space while amplifying human creativity and intelligence. As a Boeing engineer, you’ll join a diverse, collaborative team solving high‑impact challenges in complex semiconductor design. If you value a company that supports strong work–life balance and meaningful technical work, Boeing is the place to be.

If you are a creative, autonomous engineer passionate about building your career in ASIC Physical design engineering for ASICs, we want to hear from you. Please include a cover letter/brief summary of relevant ASIC physical design experience when submitting your application.

This position is expected to be 100% onsite. The selected candidate will be required to work onsite at the listed location.

  • This position requires the ability to obtain a US Security Clearance for which the US Government requires US Citizenship as a condition of employment. An interim and/or final U.S. Secret Clearance Post-Start is required.

  • Bachelor of Science degree in Engineering (with a focus in Electrical, Mechanical or Aeronautical), Computer Science, Data Science, Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry or non-US equivalent qualifications directly related to the work statement

  • 1+ years of practical experience in synthesis and static timing analysis (STA)

  • Solid understanding of timing convergence, constraints generation/management, and logic synthesis at block or full‑chip level

  • Familiarity with DFT, UPF/CPF power intent, ECO implementation, and signoff flows

  • Experience with industry-standard EDA tools for synthesis, STA, and equivalence checking

  • Hands‑on experience across the complete physical design flow (synthesis, floorplanning, P&R, CTS, STA, physical verification)

  • Background in radiation‑hardened or space‑qualified ASIC design

Job Summary
As an Environmental Test Technician B, you will assist in the set up and execution of environmental tests including vibration testing, shock testing, thermal vacuum and thermal cycle testing. Work directly with the test conductor to perform the testing on space flight hardware. This role requires the ability to work first shift.

This position's internal job code is Environmental Test Technician B. Our team is currently hiring for labor grade 15.

title: Information Security Manager
description:
About this role:

Wells Fargo is seeking an Information Security Manager (Identity & Access Management) to lead the strategic direction, operational execution, and continuous evolution of the IAM Onboarding, Integration, and Validation organization. This leader will be responsible for ensuring enterprise applications, platforms, and technology solutions are effectively validated as onboarded and integrated into the firm's IAM ecosystem while maintaining strong security controls, regulatory compliance, and operational efficiency.

The successful candidate will serve as a key liaison between cybersecurity, technology, application owners, risk management, compliance, audit, and business stakeholders to ensure identity and access controls are implemented consistently, validated thoroughly, and aligned with enterprise security policies and standards. This leader will drive assessment and validation activities for onboarding of applications into IAM services and capabilities, champion automation opportunities, and ensure access governance processes effectively mitigate risk while enabling business growth and digital transformation.

This role requires a strong combination of technical expertise, strategic leadership, and operational discipline. The Information Security Manager will oversee complex IAM onboarding and integration initiatives, ensuring applications are properly connected to enterprise identity governance solutions, access management platforms, authentication services, and lifecycle management processes. The individual will be accountable for driving validation activities that confirm entitlement structures, provisioning controls, role models, segregation of duties requirements, and identity data accuracy meet security, compliance, and operational expectations.

The leader will establish and execute a comprehensive strategy focused on improving application onboarding efficiency, integration quality, data integrity, control effectiveness, and customer experience. They will proactively identify, assess, and resolve challenges, risks, and control gaps while driving accountability across multiple technology and business organizations. This individual must possess the ability to translate complex technical security concepts into meaningful business outcomes and provide strategic guidance to senior leaders regarding IAM-related risks, priorities, and remediation plans.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Leading enterprise IAM validation programs across a diverse application portfolio for onboarding and integration.
  • Manage and develop a team of individual contributors with moderate + complexity and risk
  • Support adoption of Identity Governance and Administration (IGA), authentication, authorization, and access certification capabilities.
  • Establishing governance processes to ensure applications meet onboarding standards, security control requirements, and data quality expectations.
  • Overseeing validation activities to confirm identity data accuracy, entitlement integrity, provisioning effectiveness, and compliance with regulatory and internal policy requirements.
  • Identifying opportunities to streamline onboarding workflows through automation, standardization, and continuous process improvement.
  • Managing onboarding validation pipelines, operational metrics, service-level objectives, and program performance reporting.
  • Partnering with risk, compliance, audit, and cybersecurity organizations to address findings, implement corrective actions, and strengthen IAM controls.
  • Lead team to achieve objectives

This leader will build and develop a high-performing team of IAM professionals responsible for onboarding, integration, validation, governance, and operational support activities. They will foster a culture of accountability, ownership, continuous improvement, innovation, and talent development while ensuring the organization remains focused on delivering secure, scalable, and compliant IAM services that protect the enterprise and support strategic business objectives.

The ideal candidate demonstrates deep expertise in Identity and Access Management, Identity Governance and Administration (IGA), application onboarding, identity lifecycle management, entitlement management, access certifications, role-based access control, privileged access concepts, and regulatory compliance. They possess a proven record of leading large-scale IAM programs, influencing senior stakeholders, driving operational transformation, and delivering sustainable security outcomes across complex enterprise environments.

Required Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of Information Security Analysis experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education
  • 2+ years of Leadership experience
  • 3+ years of Identity Access Management experience

Desired Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of Identity Access Management experience preferred
  • 3+ years of Technology or Business controls experience
  • 3+ years related work experience in financial industry operations or systems.
  • Strong understanding of IAM frameworks, identity governance, and security best practices.
  • Experience with IAM technologies such as Saviynt, Microsoft Azure AD, CyberArk, Okta, or similar platforms.
  • Experience with authentication protocols (SAML, OAuth, OpenID Connect, LDAP) and compliance frameworks.
  • Experience leading complex, cross functional initiatives across multiple organizational departments/divisions to successful outcomes
  • Proven ability to conceptualize, drive and deliver multiple concurrent projects on time
  • CISSP, CISM, or other relevant information security professional certifications.

Job Expectations:

  • This position offers a hybrid work schedule - ability to work in office
  • This position is not eligible for Visa sponsorship
  • Relocation assistance is not available for this position
  • Ability to travel for business up to 10%

$119,000.00 - $206,000.00

Employees support our focus on building strong customer relationships balanced with a strong risk mitigating and compliance-driven culture which firmly establishes those disciplines as critical to the success of our customers and company. They are accountable for execution of all applicable risk programs (Credit, Market, Financial Crimes, Operational, Regulatory Compliance), which includes effectively following and adhering to applicable Wells Fargo policies and procedures, appropriately fulfilling risk and compliance obligations, timely and effective escalation and remediation of issues, and making sound risk decisions. title: Director, Program Management
description:
NIQ technology initiatives, like our clients, span the globe and require leaders who can connect the dots between business strategy, technology execution, and organizational transformation. We are building a world-class Program Management organization comprised of highly motivated, analytical, and dynamic leaders who drive outcomes across Product, Technology, Operations, and Enterprise-wide Business Functions.

As a Program Director at NIQ, you will lead strategic programs and portfolios that drive business transformation, operational excellence, technology modernization, and enterprise-wide capabilities across the organization.

You will oversee a team of program managers responsible for delivering large, complex initiatives spanning multiple business functions, geographies, stakeholders, and technology domains. Success in this role requires the ability to align business and technology priorities, lead cross-functional teams, manage strategic investments, and deliver measurable business outcomes.

This role combines portfolio leadership, organizational transformation, financial stewardship, stakeholder engagement, and people leadership. You will partner closely with senior business and technology leaders to define priorities, remove barriers, and ensure successful execution of strategic initiatives that support NIQ's long-term objectives.

At NIQ, we empower our Program Management leaders to drive results and organizational change. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment and enjoy partnering across every business function, you would be a great fit for our team.

Roles and Responsibilities

Program & Portfolio Leadership

  • Coordinate between stakeholders and technology teams to develop and manage plans throughout the program lifecycle.
  • Lead and mentor program managers and program leads, providing guidance, coaching, and support.
  • Manage and develop a team of 4-8 Program managers or Senior Program managers, including performance management and career development.
  • Develop and implement program management processes, governance frameworks, best practices, and delivery standards across the organization.
  • Ensure successful delivery and tracking of portfolio and program objectives while maintaining overall program performance and value realization.
  • Manage program documentation, scope changes, stakeholder communications, and governance requirements.
  • Facilitate planning sessions to identify dependencies, resource constraints, risks, and mitigation strategies.
  • Monitor and communicate program status, business outcomes, and portfolio performance to executive leadership and stakeholders.
  • Lead portfolio reviews, governance forums, steering committees, and cross-functional planning activities.
  • Proactively identify and resolve issues, risks, and dependencies that may impact successful delivery.
  • Ensure appropriate operational readiness, compliance, approvals, and transition activities are completed prior to deployment.
  • Lead annual and multi-year strategic planning efforts, including business case development, investment planning, budget management, and resource forecasting.
  • Establish, track, and report portfolio and program metrics that enable informed decision-making and transparency.
  • Collaborate with business and technology leadership to define and execute strategic initiatives aligned with organizational priorities.
  • Develop and manage capital and operational budgets supporting portfolio and program objectives.
  • Conduct regular executive portfolio reviews to assess delivery performance, financial health, strategic alignment, risks, and opportunities.
  • Partner with leadership teams to develop and maintain multi-year business and technology roadmaps.
  • Engage senior leaders in evaluating strategic priorities, investment opportunities, and long-term business objectives.
  • Maintain transparent and effective communication across stakeholders to ensure alignment and support for program goals.
  • Foster talent development, succession planning, and organizational growth within the program management organization.
  • Promote Agile and modern delivery methodologies that improve execution, predictability, and business outcomes.

Business Transformation & Strategic Delivery

  • Lead large-scale business transformation, process optimization, automation, and operational excellence initiatives.
  • Partner with business executives and technology leaders to align investments, priorities, and delivery plans with organizational objectives.
  • Collaborate with business, product, engineering, architecture, operations, finance, and support teams to ensure successful program execution.
  • Facilitate prioritization of initiatives by balancing business value, resource capacity, risks, and organizational goals.
  • Establish governance processes that provide executive visibility, accountability, risk management, and delivery oversight.
  • Ensure programs deliver measurable business outcomes, operational efficiencies, compliance objectives, and user adoption goals.
  • Lead organizational change management efforts that support successful adoption of new processes, technologies, and capabilities.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to senior business and technology leaders on strategic initiatives and transformation efforts.
  • Manage relationships with external vendors, consulting partners, and service providers supporting program delivery.
  • Foster a culture of continuous improvement, collaboration, accountability, and execution excellence.
  • 15+ years of experience in program management, portfolio management, transformation leadership, or a related role leading large-scale technology and business initiatives.
  • 8+ years of leadership experience managing complex programs, portfolios, and cross-functional teams.
  • Proven experience leading large-scale business transformation, operational improvement, enterprise application, or technology modernization initiatives within global organizations.
  • Strong understanding of enterprise business processes and operating models across functions such as Finance, Human Resources, Commercial Operations, Corporate Services, or Shared Services.
  • Demonstrated ability to partner with executive business and technology leaders to define strategy, prioritize investments, and deliver measurable business outcomes.
  • Experience overseeing complex initiatives involving process transformation, systems modernization, integrations, automation, data initiatives, or organizational change.
  • Strong portfolio management, governance, strategic planning, and execution capabilities.
  • Ability to prioritize, manage, and deliver multiple competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Exceptional communication, presentation, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Strong executive presence with the ability to influence, negotiate, and gain alignment across organizational levels, functions, and geographies.
  • Expertise in developing executive presentations and business communications using PowerPoint, Excel, and analytics tools.
  • Proven ability to lead globally distributed teams and work effectively across diverse cultures and regions.
  • Strong financial management experience, including business cases, budget planning, forecasting, investment management, and value realization.
  • Experience managing third-party vendors, consulting partners, and external service providers.
  • Practical experience with Agile delivery methodologies and organizational transformation initiatives.
  • Strong leadership skills with a bias toward action, ownership, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
  • Positive attitude, team player, self-starter, and demonstrated ability to achieve results in ambiguous environments.

Preferred Qualification

  • Experience leading portfolios that support enterprise-wide business capabilities and critical operational processes.
  • Experience managing large-scale transformation initiatives spanning multiple business functions and stakeholder groups.
  • Familiarity with modern cloud-based, Software-as-a-Service (SaaS), and enterprise technology environments.
  • Experience working with globally distributed delivery teams and external consulting organizations.
  • PMP, PgMP, Agile, SAFe, or related professional certifications.

Education

  • Master's degree in Business Administration, Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field.

Our Benefits

title: Enterprise Infrastructure Engineer
description:
Build the payment infrastructure powering global commerce.

Boku connects billions of consumers to the payment methods they prefer, one market at a time. Our platform connects the world’s leading digital businesses to the local payment methods their customers already use. Spotify, Meta, Microsoft, Netflix and Tencent already run on Boku’s payment infrastructure. We operate across 60+ countries, support 200+ local payment methods and reach 7.5 billion consumer accounts.

With headquarters in London and San Francisco and colleagues working across markets around the world, Boku is global by default. From London to Mumbai, São Paulo to Singapore, our teams collaborate across time zones, markets and cultures to build products for customers around the world.

Join us to solve complex, real-time payment challenges at global scale. We share knowledge freely, take ownership of complexity and look for people who question how things are done and find better ways to build.

Boku Inc. (BOKU.L) is the leading global provider of local mobile-first payments solutions. Global brands including Amazon, DAZN, Meta, Google, Microsoft, Netflix, Sony, Spotify, and Tencent rely on Boku to reach millions of new paying consumers who do not use credit cards with our purpose-built payment network of more than 300 local payment methods across 70+ countries. Every year, Boku processes over $10 billion in value for our customers. Incorporated in 2008, Boku is headquartered in London and San Francisco and has employees in over 39 countries around the world, including Brazil, China, Estonia, Germany, Ireland, Japan, Singapore, and the UAE. Boku is a truly global company that takes pride in its diversity and thriving equal opportunity workplace.

Role Purpose

Boku operates a cloud-first, global enterprise infrastructure estate spanning Azure, Microsoft 365, and 40+ SaaS products. As Enterprise Infrastructure Engineer, you will contribute to the design, build, and ongoing maintenance of Boku's core infrastructure as part of the infrastructure team, with a strong focus on automation, Infrastructure-as-Code, and AI-driven operational tooling. You will work closely with, and under the guidance of, senior infrastructure engineers on complex infrastructure problems, building your expertise across the estate while collaborating with the Head of Global IT and across the Service Delivery and Solution Engineering teams to deliver secure, scalable, and well-governed platforms.

Key Responsibilities

Infrastructure Design, Build & Maintenance

  • Support the build and maintenance of core cloud infrastructure across Azure, with a strong emphasis on repeatable, well-documented, Infrastructure-as-Code delivery.
  • Contribute to the lifecycle of critical infrastructure components, from architecture through to day-to-day operation and continuous improvement, as part of the infrastructure team.
  • Support identity and access management using Entra ID, including RBAC and Conditional Access, under the guidance of senior engineers.
  • Support the configuration and maintenance of enterprise networking and firewall infrastructure, including routing, WAN connectivity, and firewall administration, working alongside senior engineers.
  • Support Privileged Access Management (PAM) using Delinea, including day-to-day vault administration and access requests, under senior engineer oversight.

Automation & AI-Driven Operations

  • Contribute to Infrastructure-as-Code development using Terraform for provisioning and configuration of Azure resources.
  • Support Power Platform environments, including day-to-day administration and access requests, under senior engineer guidance.
  • Write scripts and tooling in Python and PowerShell to support automation of infrastructure tasks, reporting, and system integrations.
  • Support the identification and delivery of opportunities to embed AI and intelligent automation into infrastructure operations, working alongside senior engineers and the Solution Engineering team.
  • Support systems integrations that allow infrastructure and operational tooling to interact with AI-driven platforms and agents.

Endpoint & Device Management

  • Own day-to-day configuration and administration of Microsoft Intune, including policy design, compliance profiles, app deployment, and patch management.
  • Support the configuration and administration of Kandji for macOS device management, covering enrolment, configuration, and compliance.
  • Manage endpoint enrolment, patching, and compliance reporting across the device fleet, escalating exceptions to senior engineers where required.

Cloud & SaaS Ecosystem

  • Support and help maintain Boku's wider SaaS estate, ensuring infrastructure decisions align with a cloud-first strategy.
  • Partner with Security to harden the Microsoft 365 tenant and infrastructure estate against relevant compliance frameworks (ISO 27001, SOC 2, DORA).

Collaboration & Escalation

  • Work closely with senior infrastructure engineers on infrastructure design decisions, escalating complex troubleshooting and design questions as needed.

Change Control & Documentation

  • Ensure all infrastructure changes are properly documented, tested, and communicated in line with IT change control processes.
  • Produce and maintain clear technical documentation, runbooks, and architecture records.

What good looks like

  • Core Azure infrastructure is built and documented using Infrastructure-as-Code, with minimal manual configuration.
  • Identity and access controls (Entra ID, RBAC, Conditional Access) are consistently applied and regularly reviewed.
  • Infrastructure and operational tasks are automated wherever practical, using Terraform, Power Platform, Python, or PowerShell.
  • Opportunities to apply AI and intelligent automation to infrastructure operations are identified and progressed with Solution Engineering.
  • Endpoint fleets managed through Intune and Kandji are compliant, patched, and enrolled to policy.
  • The Microsoft 365 tenant and wider SaaS estate meet relevant compliance frameworks (ISO 27001, SOC 2, DORA).
  • Infrastructure changes are documented, tested, and follow IT change control processes without exception.
  • Technical documentation, runbooks, and architecture records are kept current and usable by others.

Skills & Experience

Experience

  • 3-5 years in infrastructure or cloud engineering roles, ideally within a cloud-first, SaaS-centric organisation.
  • Demonstrable experience designing, building, and maintaining production infrastructure end-to-end.

Technical skills

  • Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure, including core infrastructure, networking, and identity services.
  • Solid working knowledge of Entra ID: RBAC, Conditional Access, app registrations, and identity governance.
  • Practical experience writing and maintaining Terraform for Infrastructure-as-Code.
  • Experience building automation or workflow solutions using Microsoft Power Platform, including environment management and CI/CD pipeline creation and design.
  • Strong scripting ability in Python and PowerShell.
  • Strong hands-on experience configuring and administering Microsoft Intune (policies, compliance, app deployment, patching); working knowledge of Kandji for macOS device management.
  • Practical experience with enterprise networking and firewall administration (routing, WAN, firewall configuration and management).
  • Experience with Privileged Access Management (PAM) solutions, ideally Delinea.
  • Understanding of how infrastructure and operational systems can interact with AI-driven tooling and platforms.

Desirable

  • Knowledge of AI platforms and APIs such as OpenAI and Anthropic, and how they can be applied to infrastructure and operational workflows.
  • Familiarity with Cloudflare, including Zero Trust and related network/security services.
  • Experience in a global or enterprise IT environment operating across multiple regions.
  • Familiarity with compliance frameworks such as ISO 27001, SOC 2, or DORA.
  • Experience administering Zoom telephony and contact centre solutions.

Leadership & mindset

  • Strong stakeholder management, able to translate technical concepts for non-technical audiences.
  • Customer-focused, proactive problem-solver who thrives in ambiguous, fast-paced environments.
  • Passion for continuous learning and driving operational excellence through automation and best practice.
  • End-to-End ownership

Technologies & Tools

  • Microsoft Azure
  • Microsoft Entra ID
  • Terraform
  • Microsoft Power Platform
  • Dynamics 365
  • Python
  • PowerShell
  • Microsoft Intune
  • Kandji
  • Microsoft 365
  • Delinea
  • Cloudflare

title: Senior Credit Controller
description:
Amoria Group

Senior Credit Controller

Location: Manchester

OUR WORKPLACE VALUES

Positivity, Respect, Ownership, Fun, Excellence and Success (PROFES) are the values that make up the heart of our culture at Amoria Group, and we expect all employees to consistently demonstrate these behaviours in the workplace.

We believe in creating an environment where people can thrive professionally whilst enjoying being part of a supportive, ambitious and collaborative team.

ROLE OVERVIEW

We are looking for an experienced and proactive Senior Credit Controller to join our Finance Operations team based in Manchester.

This is a key role within the business, responsible for managing complex ledgers, driving collections performance, reducing aged debt and building strong relationships with both internal stakeholders and external clients across our UK and US operations.

The successful person will take ownership of the end to end credit control process, ensuring outstanding balances are collected efficiently whilst maintaining excellent client relationships and supporting wider business performance.

This role will also play an important part in improving processes, supporting team development and driving continuous improvement initiatives across the finance function.

DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES:

Credit Control & Collections

  • Manage and collect outstanding debt across complex, high value ledgers
  • Reduce debtor days and improve overall cash flow performance
  • Monitor aged debt and proactively escalate high risk accounts
  • Conduct regular ledger reviews and provide updates on performance, risks and trends
  • Issue account statements, reminders and resolve invoice related queries
  • Negotiate payment plans where required
  • Liaise with legal representatives on escalated debt recovery matters
  • Conduct credit risk assessments for new and existing clients

Stakeholder Management & Customer Service

  • Build strong relationships with clients and internal stakeholders across Sales, Operations and Leadership teams
  • Partner closely with consultants and managers regarding outstanding debt, billing issues and queries impacting commission or payroll
  • Respond to queries professionally and efficiently, ensuring a high level of service at all times

description:
Why Wells Fargo:

Are you looking for more? Find it here. At Wells Fargo, we're more than a financial services leader – we’re a global trailblazer committed to driving innovation, empowering communities, and helping our customers succeed. About this role:

Wells Fargo is seeking a Senior Branch Premier Banker (SAFE) to play a pivotal role within our National Branch Network. This role grows, deepens, and manages relationships with affluent customers and those with more complex financial needs, serving as their primary point of contact for banking products and services through scheduled appointments, lobby engagement, and proactive outreach. This role is designed for growth oriented professionals who lead with advice to acquire and deepen relationships through meaningful discovery and translate customer goals into comprehensive financial strategies. You will own and actively grow a defined book of business, leveraging goals based planning, and prudent risk oversight to deliver integrated solutions across deposits, investments, credit, home lending, and business banking. In addition, you’ll help customers with everyday banking needs-opening accounts, handling service requests, and ensuring a seamless experience making it easier for them to manage their banking with confidence. Success in this role is driven by strong relationship acumen, proactive customer engagement, and seamless collaboration with internal partners across Wealth, Home Lending, and Business Banking to deliver a differentiated customer experience.

Wells Fargo rewards behaviors that consistently create long term customer value and support customers in making informed financial decisions. You’ll be supported with digital tools, industry leading training, ongoing coaching, and backed by one of the most recognized brands in banking. This role offers a clear platform for career growth for experienced professionals who excel at building trust, managing a portfolio, and delivering holistic, multi product solutions.

In this role you will:

  • Proactively acquire new affluent consumer and business customers while deepening existing relationships through strategic outreach, referrals, and pre-planned customer appointments
  • Lead discovery‑driven conversations to understand customer goals and deliver tailored banking and credit strategies that strengthen relationships, increase retention, and drive balanced growth across deposits, lending, and investments
  • Serve as the primary financial partner delivering comprehensive, multi‑product guidance and ongoing reviews across life stages and evolving financial needs
  • Partner with a team of professionals across Wealth, Home Lending, and Business Banking to deliver integrated solutions by coordinating warm introductions, setting clear expectations, and taking personal ownership to convert qualified opportunities into closed outcomes
  • Champion digital adoption by educating customers on self-service and mobile banking options to elevate satisfaction, engagement, and service efficiency
  • Serve as an active member of the branch team by advising colleagues on relationship development and the management of complex client needs
  • Demonstrate risk excellence through accurate documentation, sound judgment, timely issue escalation, and adherence to policies and regulations to support strong control outcomes
  • The Senior Branch Premier Banker LP (license pending) role is a temporary position until employee has successfully completed licensing requirements and SAFE registration. Upon successful completion, employees will transition to the Senior Branch Premier Banker (SAFE) role. Employees hired into the Senior Branch Premier Banker LP role who are not fully licensed will participate in the Branch Network Licensed Banker program.

Required Qualifications:

  • 4+ years of customer service experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education
  • 3+ years of experience building and maintaining effective relationships with customers and partners
  • 3+ years of experience recommending products and services

Desired Qualifications:

  • Experience recommending financial products and translating customer goals into clear, actionable recommendations
  • Demonstrated ability to proactively source, acquire, and deepen relationships through proactive outreach and building strong internal partnership to support the customer experience
  • Proven experience managing a book-of-business, documentation of planning conversations, and consistent follow-through to drive retention and growth across deposits, lending, and investments
  • Experience coaching or supporting peers to strengthen team performance and customer impact
  • Demonstrated ability to communicate clearly and confidently, listen with empathy, and build credibility and trust quickly with others
  • Financial services industry experience in one or a combination of the following: consumer, home lending, business banking, or investments
  • 3+ years of experience in a licensed financial services position
  • Successfully completed Financial Industry Regulatory Authority (FINRA)Series 6 and 63 exams (or FINRA recognized equivalents) sufficient to qualify for immediate FINRA registration

  • Ability to work a schedule that will include most Saturdays
  • This role requires FINRA Series 6 and Series 63 (or FINRA recognized equivalents), and State Insurance license(s) which must be active or completed within a designated timeframe. For any FINRA qualification exams earned after Sept. 30, 2018, the Securities Industry Essentials (SIE) exam is also required.

Wyoming allows referral-only licensed bankers to receive the IAR registration without the Series 65/66. Requirements may change based on current state regulations.
  • Obtaining and maintaining required FINRA licenses is necessary for continued employment. This role also requires meeting enhanced financial fitness and criminal background standards. Wells Fargo will begin the FINRA review process once an offer is accepted.
  • SAFE registration is required at the time of employment and Wells Fargo will initiate the process after your start date.Loan Originators must meet LO/CFPB requirements and comply with Wells Fargo policies, including standards related to financial responsibility, character, fitness, and criminal background. A credit report may be reviewed (credit score not included) and additional ongoing screening may apply.
