회사 소개

쿠팡은 고객 감동 실현을 위해 존재합니다. 고객들이 "쿠팡 없이 그동안 어떻게 살았을까?" 라고 말할 때, 비로소 우리의 미션을 실현하고 있음을 알 수 있습니다. 고객들의 쇼핑과 식사, 생활 전반을 편하게 만들겠다는 유일한 집념으로 쿠팡은 수억 달러 규모의 이커머스 산업 전반의 혁신을 이끌고 있습니다. 쿠팡은 가장 빠르게 성장하는 이커머스 기업 중 하나로, 국내 커머스 업계에서의 독보적인 입지와, 고객 신뢰를 구축했습니다.

쿠팡은 스타트업 문화를 기반으로 한 글로벌 대형 상장사라고 자부합니다. 이것이 창립 당시의 기민함을 지하며, 신규 서비스를 끊임없이 출시하며 비즈니스를 확장해 나가는 우리의 성장 동력입니다. 쿠팡의 모든 임직원에게는 기업가 정신을 갖추고 새로운 혁신과 이니셔티브를 추진할 수 있는 기회가 주어집니다. 주저 없이 일에 뛰어들어 성과를 이루고자 하는 과감성이, 바로 쿠팡이 일하는 방식의 본질입니다. 쿠팡에서는 여러분 자신, 동료, 팀 그리고 회사 전체가 매일 성장하는 모습을 목격할 것입니다.

쿠팡의 모든 직원은 커머스의 미래를 만들겠다는 쿠팡의 미션에 진심입니다. 우리는 고객의 문제를 해결해 나가고, 전통적인 관념과 통념에 맞서며 실현 가능한 한계를 뛰어넘고 있습니다. 고가용성 (always-on) 과 최첨단의 앞선 기술 (high-tech), 초연결사회 (hyper-connected world) 에서의 놀라운 업무 경험을 원하신다면, 지금 바로 쿠팡에 합류하세요.

팀 소개

Detection Engineering(DE) 팀은 쿠팡 보안조직(Digital Trust) 내에서 보안 위협의 탐지와 대응 자동화를 엔드투엔드로 설계하고 구현하는 팀입니다. 위협 시나리오 정의부터 로그 수집, 탐지 룰 배포, AI 기반 자동 대응까지 전 주기를 한 팀에서 커버하며, Detection-as-Code 철학을 기반으로 모든 탐지 로직을 코드로 관리합니다.
DE팀은 AI 기술을 각 도메인에 적극적으로 접목하고 있습니다. AI-SOC를 직접 구현하고, 보안 로그의 AI 기반 분석, LLM을 활용한 자동화 등, AI는 별도 기능이 아닌 팀 전체의 업무 방식에 내재되어 있습니다.
이 포지션은 SIEM과 SOAR를 아우르는 보안 탐지·자동화 전 영역에서 깊은 기술적 전문성을 발휘하는 역할입니다. 데이터 파이프라인부터 탐지 엔진, 자동화 워크플로우, AI-SOC까지 DE팀의 기술 스택 전체를 관통하는 시야로 아키텍처 설계와 기술적 난제 해결에 기여합니다.

이런 분과 함께하고 싶습니다
  • 하나의 도메인에 갇히지 않고, 데이터부터 자동화까지 전체를 조망할 수 있는 분
  • "이게 왜 이렇게 되어 있지?"라는 질문에서 시작해 아키텍처를 개선한 경험이 있는 분
  • 직접 코드를 쓰면서도, 동료 엔지니어에게 좋은 영향을 주는 분
  • 복잡한 문제를 단순하게 정리하고, 명확한 근거로 방향을 제시할 수 있는 분

업무 내용

  • 보안 데이터 플랫폼(SIEM) 및 자동화 플랫폼(SOAR) 전체 아키텍처에 대한 기술적 방향 수립 및 설계
  • 대규모 보안 로그 파이프라인의 안정성, 성능, 비용 효율성에 대한 아키텍처 레벨의 문제 해결
  • SOAR 워크플로우 및 AI-SOC 체계의 설계, 기술적 난제 해결, 품질 기준 정의
  • Detection-as-Code 프레임워크의 고도화 — 탐지 룰 라이프사이클, 테스트 자동화, 배포 파이프라인 개선
  • 보안 솔루션 선정·도입·교체에 대한 기술적 평가
  • 전사 보안 아키텍처 변경, 신규 시스템 도입 시 DE 관점의 기술 자문 및 영향도 분석
  • AI/LLM 기반 보안 자동화의 아키텍처 설계

자격 요건

  • 보안 엔지니어링 또는 보안 인프라 분야 경력 10년 이상
  • SIEM 플랫폼의 아키텍처, 데이터 파이프라인, 탐지 엔진에 대한 깊은 기술적 이해 — 구축부터 대규모 운영, 성능 최적화, 마이그레이션까지 경험
  • SOAR 또는 보안 자동화 플랫폼의 설계·구축·운영 경험 — 워크플로우 설계 원칙, 솔루션 연동 아키텍처, 장애 대응 체계에 대한 실무 역량
  • Python 기반의 개발 역량 — 프로토타이핑에서 프로덕션 수준의 코드까지 작성할 수 있는 엔지니어
  • 다양한 보안 솔루션(EDR, CTI, 티켓 시스템, 클라우드 보안 서비스 등)의 동작 원리와 연동 방식에 대한 폭넓은 실무 경험
  • AI/LLM 기반 보안 자동화 또는 AI-SOC 시스템에 대한 이해 — LLM Agent 아키텍처, 프롬프트 설계, 자동 분석/판단 워크플로우 구축 경험
  • 복잡한 기술적 문제를 구조화하고, 트레이드오프를 명확히 정리할 수 있는 역량
  • SIEM과 SOAR를 모두 깊이 있게 다뤄본 경험 — 두 영역의 접점에서 아키텍처 의사결정을 내려본 경험
  • 클라우드 환경(AWS 등)에서의 대규모 시스템 아키텍처 설계 및 운영 경험

우대 사항

  • AI-SOC 또는 LLM 기반 보안 자동화 시스템의 아키텍처 설계 또는 도입 경험
  • 대규모 보안 데이터 플랫폼의 비용 최적화 프로젝트 수행 경험
  • Detection-as-Code 또는 보안 데이터 모델링(OCSF, CIM 등)에 대한 깊은 이해
  • 보안 솔루션 선정·교체 과정에서 기술 평가를 수행한 경험
  • Kubernetes 기반 인프라의 보안 로그 수집 및 모니터링 아키텍처 설계 경험
  • 이커머스/핀테크 등 대규모 트래픽 환경에서의 보안 인프라 운영 경험
  • 엔지니어링 프로세스(코드 리뷰, 설계 리뷰, 기술 표준 등) 개선에 기여한 경험

근무지: 쿠팡 서울 구의오피스

전형 절차 및 안내 사항

  • 전형 절차
    • 서류전형 - 화상기술면접 1차 - 화상기술면접 2차 – 최종 합격
    • 전형절차는 직무별로 다르게 운영될 수 있으며, 일정 및 상황에 따라 변동될 수 있습니다.
    • 전형 일정 및 결과는 지원서에 등록하신 이메일로 개별 안내 드립니다.
  • 참고 사항
    • 본 공고는 모집 완료 시 조기 마감될 수 있습니다.
    • 지원서 내용 중 허위사실이 있는 경우에는 합격이 취소될 수 있습니다.
    • 취업 보호 대상자(보훈대상자, 장애인 등)는 관련 법률에 따라 채용우대를 받을 수 있습니다.
    • 직급과 담당 업무 범위는 후보자의 전반적인 경력과 경험 등 제반사정을 고려하여 변경될 수 있습니다. 이러한 변경이 필요할 경우, 최종 합격 통지 전 적절한 시기에 후보자와 커뮤니케이션 될 예정입니다.
    • 채용 및 업무 수행과 관련하여 요구되는 법령상 자격이 갖추어지지 않은 경우 채용이 제한될 수 있습니다.
    • 고용형태는 정규직으로 수습기간 12주를 포함합니다. 단, 업무상 필요한 경우에는 상기 수습기간을 적용하지 않거나 단축 또는 연장할 수 있습니다.

개인정보 처리방침

  • 쿠팡 그룹은 입사지원자 개인정보 처리방침(아래 링크)에 따라 귀하의 개인정보를 수집하여 처리합니다.

서류 반환 정책

  1. 본 고지는 『채용절차의공정화에관한법률』 제11조제6항에 따른 것 입니다.
  2. 당사 채용에 응시한 구직자 중 최종 합격이 되지 못한 구직자는 『채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률』에 따라 제출한 채용서류의 반환을 청구할 수 있음을 알려 드립니다. 다만, 홈페이지 또는 전자우편으로 제출된 경우나 구직자가 당사의 요구 없이 자발적으로 제출한 경우에는 그러하지 아니하며, 천재지변이나 그 밖에 당사에게 책임 없는 사유로 채용서류가 멸실된 경우에는 반환한 것으로 봅니다.
  3. 위2항 본문에 따라 채용 서류 반환 청구를 하는 구직자는 채용 서류 반환 청구서 [채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률 시행규칙 별지 제 3 호 서식]를 작성하여 이메일 (recruitingops@coupang.com) 로 제출하면, 제출이 확인된 날로부터 14 일 이내에 지정한 주소지로 등기우편을 통하여 발송해 드립니다. 이 경우 등기우편요금은 수신자 부담으로 하게 되오니 유념하시기 바랍니다.
  4. 당사는 위2항 본문에 따른 구직자의 반환 청구에 대비하여 채용 여부가 확정된 날로부터 180 일간 구직자가 제출한 채용서류 원본을 보관하게 되며, 그때까지 채용서류의 반환을 청구하지 아니할 경우에는 『개인정보 보호법』에 따라 지체 없이 채용서류 일체를 파기할 예정입니다.
  5. 단, 위 1항 내지 4항의 내용은 대한민국의 노동 관계 법령이 적용되는 경우에만 적용됩니다. 그 이외의 경우에는 적용되지 않습니다.

title: Shift Supervisor
description:
About this opportunity

The Shift Supervisor is responsible for overseeing all activities and persons within the production hall on the designated shift. Directly reporting to the Manufacturing Manager and working closely with the Site Quality Officer.

Your key responsibilities will be to:

  • Lead and support the shift production team to achieve safety, quality, and production targets.
  • Allocate daily tasks and monitor production performance.
  • Ensure machines operate safely, efficiently, and within specification.
  • Conduct product quality checks and address non-conformances.
  • Coordinate maintenance activities and support breakdown resolution.
  • Monitor waste, downtime, and operational issues, taking corrective action as required.
  • Complete accurate production records and shift handovers.
  • Ensure compliance with WHS, Food Safety, Quality, and Business Management System requirements.

Your skills and experience

To be successful in this role, you’ll have:

  • Experience leading or coordinating teams in a manufacturing or production environment.
  • Must have experience in plastic moulding be it injection, blow or extrusion
  • Strong understanding of production processes, equipment operation, and troubleshooting.
  • Proven ability to monitor quality standards and address non-conformances.
  • Working knowledge of WHS, Food Safety, Quality, and Environmental requirements.
  • Strong leadership, communication, and people management skills.
  • The ability to prioritise tasks and make sound decisions in a fast-paced environment.
  • Experience coordinating maintenance activities and responding to operational issues.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with a focus on continuous improvement.
  • Competent computer and reporting skills, with experience maintaining production records.
  • Flexibility to manage changing production priorities, rostering, and overtime requirements.
  • Experience in FMCG, food manufacturing, packaging, plastics, or a similar high-volume production environment.
  • A technical or trade qualification in manufacturing, engineering, or a related discipline.

title: Shunter
description:
We are looking for an experienced Yard Shunter to join our Rugby depot. This is a dedicated yard-based role, ideal for someone who has previous shunting experience and is looking for a stable, consistent shunting position rather than a driving role on the road.

Shift pattern: 4 on 4 off Night Shifts,14.00 - 22.00, 40.25 hours per week

Salary: £39,317.64 per annum

What you'll be doing:

  • Observing and adhering to company rules, site procedures and all aspects of Health & Safety and Hygiene at all times
  • Moving trailers safely on and off loading bays throughout the shift.
  • Supporting yard safety by monitoring, patrolling and maintaining safe yard movements.
  • Operating a dedicated yard-based shunting vehicle.
  • Helping ensure trailers are positioned correctly and loaded on time.
  • Conducting daily checks, immediately reporting any defects and / or damage and completing associated documentation
  • Carrying out trailer checks on loaded trailers and report to ops staff
  • Completing trailer checklist and reporting to operations desk
  • Carrying out shunting duties including relevant maintenance and safety checks
  • Liaising with the warehouse control and goods in staff to ensure smooth and efficient loading / unloading of trailers
  • Completing vehicles downloads as per the company policy
  • Monitoring services / MOTs – liaising with Transport Office and with service vendor
  • Assisting with fuel delivery / manual dip of fuel
  • Keeping yard in clean / tidy condition
  • Liaising with Transport Office as and when required i.e. special promotions and / or livery schedules
  • Manage the flow of traffic in and out of the yard

What we're looking for:

  • Previous yard shunting experience is strongly preferred.
  • Someone who wants a dedicated shunting role and understands the pace, safety standards and responsibility of working in a busy yard environment.
  • Current or previous Class 1 licence experience is preferred
  • A safety-first approach and confidence moving trailers in a live operational environment.
  • Reliability, good communication skills and the ability to work well as part of a wider transport team.

As part of our drive to make Great Bear a great place to work, we are proud to be an inclusive and diverse organisation where we are committed to employee development and recognising success for hard working performers.

Our dedicated learning and development programmes are open to every employee to give you the opportunity to shape your own future within logistics and continue to work in an environment where team culture thrives.

Our people are the driving force behind our success, which is why we offer a wide range of benefits which include:

  • Annual Leave – 20 days inclusive of the bank holidays.
  • Pension scheme – We want colleagues to enjoy a comfortable retirement so we offer a great contribution of 4% employee and 4% employer.
  • Life Assurance - x2 your annual salary.
  • Wellness – Via our Employee Assistance Programme we offer immediate access to a confidential telephone counselling and legal information service that operates 24 hours a days, 365 days a year.
  • Eye Care Vouchers – We can provide you with substantial savings with free eye tests and discounts on prescription glasses.
  • Reward & Recognition – We recognise that employees have gone the extra mile via Employee of the Month and Year, special recognition and long service awards.
  • Everyday discounts - Via our benefit platform you will have access to over 50 retailer discounts for everyday savings!

If you meet the requirements for the above role and are looking for your next career opportunity, please apply now and become a part of our #WinningTeam!

title: Used Firearms Lead, Full-Time
description:
POSITION SUMMARY:

The Used Firearms Team Lead operates a business within a business. Their responsibilities are, but not limited to, the daily operations of the used firearms business.

This includes three phases of business: buying, selling, and firearms customer service.

This position initiates all 4473 forms with customers and is responsible for conducting the final check of applicable company, state, and federal forms prior to a firearm being transferred to the customer.

The Team Lead focuses on creating a fair-trade environment focusing on a customer-satisfaction selling culture. Thus, reaching monthly sales goals in order to achieve maximum profit through buying, selling, and trading pre-owned firearms.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

  • Evaluates and appraises used firearms exhibiting knowledge of fair market values, professional negotiation skills, research, and a high degree of firearms identification knowledge. The Team Leader is in control of used firearm inventory and must obtain the highest % margin based on negotiated acquisition.
  • Initiates all 4473 forms with customers and is responsible for conducting the final check of applicable company, state, and federal forms prior to a firearm being transferred to the customer.
  • Maintains inventory through daily buying and cultivating leads for potential buying of gun collections outside of the store, along with awareness of local auctions, estate sales, and any other avenue of supply.
  • Complies with all Local, State, and Federal firearms regulations as an employee of an ATF FFL licensed dealer.
  • Conducts monthly ATF compliance audits and company required audits.
  • Merchandises used firearms and is proactive in the arrangement of merchandise.
  • Partners with Internet Specialist recommending to post those firearms that will achieve the highest potential margin and sell quickly.
  • Interacts and communicates with Regional Gun Library Managers and the corporate used firearm merchandising team.
  • Train and educate Outfitters on acquiring and disposing of used firearms, current sales trends, policy and procedure updates and changes, negotiation skills, providing resources to properly identify used firearm values, and other educational aspects of the used firearm business. 5%
  • Participate in ongoing training including, but not limited to firearms and shooting product information, diverse shooting discipline awareness, systems training, compliance related training, and selling skills / techniques.
  • Provide highest quality customer service on the sales floor and assisting with customer phone calls, when developing relationships with customers in answering questions about their firearm, quoting a price for their firearm or a retail price of firearms and when responding and handling customer issues by using good judgment and logic in solving problems and making decisions within the job scope.
  • ALL OTHER DUTIES AS ASSIGNED.

EXPERIENCE/QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Minimum Degree Required: High School Diploma or equivalent experience
  • Experience: 2-4 years experience

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITY:

  • Must be 21 years of age
  • Safely handle firearms
  • Knowledge of purchasing firearms by either working in the firearms industry or collecting firearms
  • Good understanding of retail and a knowledge of computers
  • Background in current firearms models
  • Able to appraise and know the marketable value of used firearms
  • Must have a great work ethic and ability to multi task

TRAVEL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Local travel to purchase used firearms out of store

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Constantly stand and/or walk during shift
  • Constantly communicate with others to exchange information
  • Constantly repeat motions that may include the wrists, hands and/or fingers
  • Constantly assess the accuracy, neatness, and thoroughness of the work assigned
  • Light work that includes constantly lifting and moving objects up to 20 pounds, occasionally move and lift objects up to 100 pounds or more (utilizing a team lift as needed)
  • Occasionally ascend or descend ladders, stairs, step stools, etc.
  • Occasionally operate machinery and/or power tools

title: Director – Corporate Tax Advisory
description:
Join a growing, collaborative Corporate Tax team where you will work directly with partners and senior client stakeholders on complex, commercially significant matters for leading Australian and multinational organisations. As a Director, you will have the autonomy to lead key relationships and engagements, shape market opportunities, develop high-performing teams and build a future career opportunities.

Our Corporate Tax team helps organisations navigate their most important tax challenges, from major transactions and restructures to tax governance, controversy, financing and cross-border investment. Drawing on deep technical expertise and KPMG’s connected Australian and global specialist network, we deliver practical, strategic advice that creates value beyond compliance.

This opportunity will suit an established tax leader who is ready to broaden their market impact, take greater ownership of client and team outcomes, and help shape the continued growth of the practice.

Your Opportunity

As a senior leader within the Corporate Tax team, you will:

  • Build trusted relationships with senior client stakeholders, understand their strategic priorities and identify opportunities for KPMG to create value.
  • Lead complex, high-profile engagements and deliver clear, commercially focused advice on significant Australian and cross-border tax matters.
  • Own engagement strategy, quality, risk management and commercial outcomes across a portfolio of clients.
  • Develop new market opportunities, contribute to proposals and thought leadership, and strengthen your external profile and client portfolio.
  • Collaborate across KPMG’s Australian and global network to bring the right specialists and perspectives to each client challenge.
  • Lead, coach and sponsor high-performing teams, creating an inclusive environment in which people can grow and succeed.

How Are You Extraordinary?

  • You combine strong tax technical capability with commercial judgement and communicate complex issues clearly to boards, executives and senior tax and finance stakeholders.
  • You are an inclusive, collaborative leader who builds trust, develops others and creates accountability for high-quality outcomes.
  • You identify and convert opportunities, bringing a strong market perspective and the confidence to challenge established thinking.
  • You exercise sound judgement, manage risk effectively and remain focused on practical solutions that advance your client’s objectives.

Why Join Our Team?

  • Direct access to partners, senior client stakeholders and significant, market-shaping work.
  • Meaningful autonomy and influence over client relationships, engagements and the direction of the practice.
  • A supportive, collegiate and inclusive culture that values diverse perspectives and shared success.
  • Opportunities to build your market profile, originate work and develop a sustainable client portfolio.
  • Access to KPMG’s Australian and global network of tax, legal, deals, technology and industry specialists.
  • Targeted support for sustainable career progression.

Your Experience

We value diversity of thought, background and experience. You may have developed your career in professional services, legal practice, an in-house tax team or another relevant advisory environment. To succeed in this role, you are likely to bring:

  • Substantial experience advising on Australian corporate and international tax matters, supported by strong technical knowledge and commercial judgement.
  • A demonstrated record of leading complex engagements and building enduring relationships with senior client stakeholders.
  • Experience developing people, managing engagement economics and contributing to business development and market growth.
  • The ability to produce and present clear, well-researched and commercially focused advice.
  • Australian tax experience, or relevant overseas experience together with the capability and commitment to transition quickly into the Australian tax environment.
  • A relevant degree in law, commerce, accounting, economics or a related discipline.
  • Professional tax, legal or accounting qualifications are highly regarded.

If you do not meet every criterion but believe you bring the expertise, judgement and leadership to make a strong contribution, we encourage you to apply.

KPMG is a professional services firm with global outreach and deep sector experience. We work with clients across an array of industries to solve complex challenges, steer change and enable growth.

Our people are what make KPMG the thriving workplace that it is and what sets us apart is that we know great minds think differently. Collaborate with a team of passionate, highly skilled professionals who’ve got your back. You’ll build relationships with unique and diverse colleagues who will provide you with the support you need to be your best and produce meaningful and impactful work in an inclusive, equitable culture.

At KPMG, you’ll take control over how you work. We’re embracing a new way of working in many ways, from offering flexible hours and locations to generous paid parental leave and career breaks. Our people enjoy a variety of exciting perks, including retail discounts, health and wellbeing initiatives, learning and growth opportunities, salary packaging options and more.

Diverse candidates have diverse needs. During your recruitment journey, information will be provided about adjustment requests. If you require additional support before submitting your application, please contact the Talent Attraction Support Team.

At KPMG every career is different, and we look forward to seeing how you grow with us.

KPMG Australia: grow with us!

description:
We’re looking for a passionate Data Scientist who enjoys solving real business problems with data and machine learning. title: Technology Director Lead Architect, Commercial Banking
description:
About this role

Wells Fargo is seeking a Technology Director to serve as Lead Architect for the Commercial Banking business. Based in London, this role will provide enterprise and portfolio-level architecture leadership across Commercial Banking as well as the bank's international intersections. The role reports to the Head of Architecture for CCIBT and will work closely with the CIO of Commercial Banking Technology and the CIO of the International Bank, acting as a trusted advisor on technology strategy, modernization, risk, investment priorities, and major architectural decisions.

This is a senior leadership role requiring the maturity, judgement, executive presence, and organizational influence expected of a Technology Director, combined with deep, hands-on architecture expertise. The successful candidate will define target-state direction, resolve complex cross-domain challenges, strengthen architecture governance, and translate business strategy into practical, executable technology roadmaps. They will influence across business, product, engineering, risk, cyber, data, and enterprise technology teams, often without direct authority.

Define and drive the target-state architecture for Commercial Banking, aligning technology strategy, modernization initiatives, AI adoption, and investment priorities with business objectives. Serve as a trusted advisor to senior business and technology leaders, providing direction on architecture, risk, resiliency, governance, and strategic technology decisions. Lead complex cross-domain initiatives across Commercial Banking, International Banking, and enterprise platforms while establishing architecture standards, reusable patterns, and roadmaps that improve consistency, scalability, and regulatory compliance. Partner with engineering, product, cyber, data, risk, and operations teams to simplify the technology landscape, accelerate modernization, and improve organizational effectiveness. Additionally, develop and mentor senior architects, strengthen architecture capabilities, and identify emerging technologies that enhance client outcomes, operational efficiency, and long-term business value.

In this role, you will:

  • Manage a team of engineering managers and engineering leads

  • Focus on delivering commitments aligned to enterprise strategic priorities

  • Build support for strategies with business and technology leaders

  • Guide development of actionable roadmaps and plans

  • Identify opportunities and strategies for continuous improvement of software engineering practices

  • Provide oversight to software craftsmanship, security, availability, resilience, and scalability of solutions developed by the teams or third party providers

  • Identify financial management and strategic resourcing

  • Set risk management guidelines and partner with stakeholders to implement key risk initiatives

  • Develop strategies for hiring engineering talent

  • Lead implementation of projects and encourage engineering innovation

  • Collaborate and influence all levels of professionals including more experienced managers

  • Lead team to achieve objectives

  • Interface with external agencies, regulatory bodies or industry forums

  • Manage allocation of people and financial resources for Technology Strategic Leadership

  • Develop and guide a culture of talent development to meet business objectives and strategy

Required qualifications

  • Significant experience in engineering, architecture, or technology leadership, or an equivalent combination of work experience, military service, training, and education.

  • Experience leading major technology initiatives, architecture organizations, and complex cross-functional programs that deliver meaningful business outcomes.

  • Demonstrated success leading senior technology professionals, including hiring, performance management, compensation and talent processes, succession planning, employee development, and the management of complex or sensitive people matters.

  • Proven experience defining and leading architecture strategies for large-scale, distributed enterprise systems and technology portfolios.

  • Strong ability to solve abstract, systemic, and cross-domain challenges requiring advanced analytical thinking, strategic perspective, and sound commercial judgement.

  • Extensive experience influencing CIO-level executives, senior technology leaders, and business stakeholders on technology strategy, investment priorities, risk management, and architecture decisions.

  • Deep understanding of architecture governance, non-functional requirements, technology risk, cybersecurity, resiliency, and regulatory control expectations.

  • Exceptional executive communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex technical concepts, articulate trade-offs and consequences, and build alignment among senior stakeholders.

  • Demonstrated maturity, credibility, and sound judgement in high-stakes environments, including the ability to challenge constructively and operate effectively through ambiguity and change.

  • Demonstrated experience designing, implementing, or governing enterprise AI solutions, including Generative AI, machine learning platforms, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), agentic workflows, model lifecycle management, evaluation frameworks, observability, and integration with enterprise data and application architectures.

Desired qualifications.

  • Experience within Commercial Banking, Corporate & Investment Banking, International Banking, or another highly regulated financial services technology environment.

  • Experience working across UK, international, and global technology organizations with complex legal entity, regulatory, data, and operational dependencies.

  • Expertise in several of the following areas: cloud and platform architecture, distributed systems, data architecture and integration, API and event-driven architectures, resiliency and fault-tolerant design, cybersecurity, and high-performance or high-volume systems.

  • Experience leading large-scale modernization and transformation initiatives, including application rationalization, platform consolidation, cloud adoption, data modernization, and legacy technology reduction.

  • Proven experience developing enterprise architecture patterns, standards, reference architectures, and decision frameworks that drive consistency and adoption at scale.

  • Ability to connect architectural decisions to measurable business value, client outcomes, operational efficiency, risk reduction, and investment priorities.

  • Experience identifying and prioritizing AI opportunities that enhance client outcomes, employee effectiveness, control execution, operational efficiency, or revenue growth, and translating those opportunities into governed experiments, reusable capabilities, and enterprise-scale production solutions.

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

Job expectations

  • Based in London and able to work on-site in accordance with company expectations.

  • Operate at enterprise and portfolio scale across Commercial Banking and relevant international and shared-technology domains.

  • Maintain substantial engagement with the CIO of Commercial Banking Technology and the CIO of the International Bank, as well as senior product, engineering, risk, and business leaders.

  • Focus on strategic architecture, governance, modernization, and cross-domain alignment rather than ownership of a single application.

  • Ability to travel domestically and internationally as business needs require.

  • Perform consistently as a senior representative of the architecture organization in executive, governance, and external forums.

Leadership & Success

The successful candidate will be a highly influential enterprise leader with the strategic vision, technical credibility, and executive presence to shape long-term technology direction across Commercial Banking. As a trusted advisor to CIOs and senior leaders, they will drive alignment on complex business and technology decisions, translate strategy into actionable outcomes, and champion modernization, AI adoption, risk reduction, and architectural excellence. Success will be measured through the establishment of a clear and adopted target architecture, improved decision quality, accelerated transformation, stronger organizational capability, and a more resilient, efficient, and strategically aligned technology estate that delivers sustainable business value.

    • Process Standardization: Design, implement, and audit standardized processes and SOPs across all warehousing units to elevate overall operational quality. System & Tech Alignment: Liaise closely with technical support and central logistics teams regarding Warehouse Management Systems (WMS) updates, incidents, and system troubleshooting.
    • Out-of-Stock (OOS) Control: Implement proactive inventory protocols to prevent out-of-stock scenarios across Jumia online shops.

title: Associate, Global Intelligence
description:
Introducing Morgan Stanley at Work:

We know a lot about investing and are certain there’s no better investment a company can make than in its employees. People don’t just drive a company; they are the company. So, when people work at their best, companies do too. Morgan Stanley at Work, a division of Morgan Stanley Wealth Management, provides workplace financial solutions that build employee financial confidence, foster loyalty and help our corporate clients attract and retain top talent. Our end-to-end offering spans Equity, Financial Wellness and Retirement Solutions. Plus, we provide all employees with Financial Empowerment, so they have the knowledge, tools and support needed to make the most of their workplace financial benefits.

What you’ll be part of – our Morgan Stanley at Work culture:

At Morgan Stanley at Work, we walk the talk. We have created a place for our employees to learn, achieve and grow – a place for people to build a career where you can thrive both personally and professionally. We are passionate about exceeding our clients’ expectations and helping them succeed. We are fearless in taking on new challenges that deliver exceptional results. We believe amazing things can happen when we work together in an environment where everybody has a true sense of belonging and their ideas are heard.

We value differences and are committed to providing a work environment where our people can do their best work. We look for people who are problem solvers, empathetic listeners, team players and inclusive leaders. We are committed to your growth and development, and your entire employee experience. We recognize that our people and culture are the keys to our success. We invite you to explore how you can be an integral part of our team.

The Global Intelligence Organization:

As part of this group, our dedicated team of equity plan specialists in Global Intelligence partner with law firms across the world to deliver a cost effective employee equity plan compliance management service for global private and public companies, ensuring clients have the information they need to successfully operate their plans. Our Global Intelligence platform provides direct support and expertise including tax and legal information, tax guides, project management tools and additional resources for over 150 jurisdictions. Our tax withholding product for non-mobile, mobile and 3rd party tax calculations within equity administration platforms enables clients to apply the required rates and withholding positions and provides visibility and clarity to participants on how and why tax is applied to equity compensation.

Associate, Global Intelligence Role:

Located in Calgary, Alberta and reporting into our client service team, the Associate, Global Intelligence role leads in delivering and embedding Global Intelligence products and services to our current and newly implemented clients. The role focuses on increasing adoption of the platform amongst established clients, assisting clients to better understand and use the platform, resolving queries, identifying opportunities to improve the client experience and supporting initiatives that drive greater engagement, usage, and long-term satisfaction.

Over time, the role will lead to development into a subject matter expert in regulatory compliance and global tax for global share plans and an expert in the Global Intelligence platform and Equity Solutions tax tools.

The successful candidate will work closely with internal teams to monitor client needs, provide timely and accurate support, contribute to adoption-focused campaigns, and help develop materials, insights, and process improvements that encourage clients to derive greater value from the platform.

Our ideal candidate is technically savvy, with strong communication and client relationship management skills. You are passionate about delivering excellent client service and bring knowledge of employee equity plans, global regulatory requirements, and tax compliance. You are committed to team success, comfortable adapting to continuous change and evolving technology solutions, and motivated to take ownership of your responsibilities. You also have a demonstrated ability to build effective, trusted relationships with clients, colleagues, and other stakeholders.

Associate Responsibilities:

  • Responding to client queries relating to the Global Intelligence platform and service, providing timely and accurate information.
  • Achieving an expert understanding of the Global Intelligence platform and ultimately the Shareworks tax tool functionality to support clients' share plan compliance.
  • Supporting initiatives designed to increase client engagement, adoption, and ongoing usage of the platform.
  • Assist with special projects, including client outreach, usage analysis, process enhancements, and adoption campaigns.
  • Help create or maintain client-facing and internal support materials, FAQs, and guidance documents.
  • Collaborating and communicating with internal and external stakeholders to ensure understanding of tax and legal regulatory requirements.
  • Contribute to a high-quality client experience that supports retention and long-term relationship growth.

Qualifications & Experience:

  • At least 2 years of relevant experience.
  • Equity plan management/administration experience desirable.
  • Strong client service mindset with excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to explain information clearly and confidently to a range of audiences.
  • Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple priorities.
  • Comfortable working with data, platforms, reporting tools, or information-based products.
  • Collaborative approach with the ability to work across teams.
  • Incredible attention to detail.
  • Practical experience, preferably in equity compensation, equity plan management, global regulatory advisory, financial services, or tax industry.
  • Comfortable delivering effective presentations to a variety of audiences at all levels across different media and deploying differing styles.
  • Demonstrated competency with common technology and technical concepts, including: Software as a Service (SaaS), Microsoft Excel. Knowledge of Shareworks and/or EEO is an asset.
  • Comfortable in a fast-paced and evolving environment which includes ongoing learning and training opportunities.
  • Bachelor’s degree or similar area of focus

While we thank all applicants for their interest in a career with Morgan Stanley at Work, please note that only those individuals selected for an interview will be contacted.

WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT FROM MORGAN STANLEY:

At Morgan Stanley, we raise, manage and allocate capital for our clients – helping them reach their goals. We do it in a way that’s differentiated – and we’ve done that for 90 years. Our values - putting clients first, doing the right thing, leading with exceptional ideas, committing to diversity and inclusion, and giving back - aren’t just beliefs, they guide the decisions we make every day to do what's best for our clients, communities and more than 80,000 employees in 1,200 offices across 42 countries. At Morgan Stanley, you’ll find an opportunity to work alongside the best and the brightest, in an environment where you are supported and empowered. Our teams are relentless collaborators and creative thinkers, fueled by their diverse backgrounds and experiences. We are proud to support our employees and their families at every point along their work-life journey, offering some of the most attractive and comprehensive employee benefits and perks in the industry. There’s also ample opportunity to move about the business for those who show passion and grit in their work.

To learn more about our offices across the globe, please copy and paste https://www.morganstanley.com/about-us/global-offices​ into your browser.

Morgan Stanley is an equal opportunity employer committed to building and maintaining a workforce that is diverse in experience and background. Our recruiting efforts reflect our strong commitment to a culture of inclusion, where individuals are hired, developed, and advanced based on their skills and talents.

Our workforce reflects a broad cross-section of the global communities in which we operate, bringing a variety of backgrounds, talents, perspectives, and experiences.

title: Technology Project Manager
description:
We are seeking a highly experienced and technically advanced Technology Project Manager who can bridge business needs with technical execution. This role requires a strong client-facing professional who can consult on IT/AV strategy, design enterprise-grade systems, manage projects end-to-end, and support installations when required.

The ideal candidate will be equally comfortable presenting IT/AV solutions to executive stakeholders, designing complex video conferencing systems, leading integration teams, and supporting end users in a fast-paced, high-demand environment.

1. Client & Business Engagement

  • Serve as the primary IT/AV subject matter expert (SME) for clients and business partners.
  • Conduct client needs assessments and recommend scalable IT/AV solutions.
  • Confidently present and explain IT/AV technologies, including Voice/Data networking, structure cabling, surveillance camera, video conferencing systems and collaboration services.
  • Translate business requirements into technical IT/AV designs.
  • Maintain strong relationships with customers, vendors, and integration partners.

2. IT/AV System Consulting, Design & Engineering

  • Design enterprise-level IT/AV systems including:
    • Voice/Data Network
    • Structure Cabling
    • Surveillance Camera
    • Video conferencing rooms (huddle, conference, boardroom, training rooms)
    • Collaboration spaces and multi-purpose environments
  • Demonstrate deep knowledge of:
    • Cisco Systems network and video conferencing solutions
    • Cisco CUCM
    • Structure cable type and use
    • Poly video collaboration systems
    • Cisco Webex
    • Microsoft Teams
    • Zoom
  • Design systems with proper signal flow, network integration, DSP configuration concepts, and control systems.
  • Ensure interoperability between conferencing platforms and room systems.

3. Project Management & Leadership

  • Lead IT/AV projects from concept through completion.
  • Manage internal technicians and/or third-party IT/AV integration partners.
  • Inbound/Outbound quotation review and compose.
  • Develop project timelines, milestones, and resource plans.
  • Coordinate with IT, network, facilities, and construction teams.
  • Ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget, and aligned with scope.
  • Proactively mitigate project risks and resolve technical challenges.

4. Bill of Materials (BoM) & Commercial Review

  • Develop detailed Bills of Materials (BoM) with appropriate IT/AV components.
  • Ensure selected equipment aligns with design intent, compatibility, and budget.
  • Review vendor quotations and validate technical accuracy.
  • Review partner invoices against approved scope and pricing.
  • Support procurement processes and cost optimization strategies.

5. Scope Documentation & Reporting

  • Clearly define and communicate full project scope to both clients and tech integrators.
  • Produce technical design documentation and system diagrams.
  • Prepare project completion reports including:
    • Final as-built documentation
    • Equipment lists
    • Test results
    • Client sign-off documentation
  • Maintain organized documentation for audit and service continuity.

6. Installation Oversight & Technical Support

  • Oversee and, when required, assist with IT/AV system installation and commissioning.
  • Perform system testing, validation, and user acceptance support.
  • Provide advanced troubleshooting for technical integration issues.
  • Deliver end-user training and ongoing support.
  • Provide white-glove executive support when necessary.

7. Operational & Strategic Contribution

  • Establish technology standards and best practices.
  • Recommend lifecycle upgrades and technology roadmaps.
  • Stay current with emerging IT/AV technologies and collaboration trends.
  • Support business development efforts with technical consultation.

  • 5+ years of experience in IT/AV system consultation, and project management.
  • Proven experience managing enterprise technology deployments.
  • Strong understanding of networking fundamentals, and UC platforms.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with executives, engineers, and technicians.
  • Experience leading cross-functional teams in high-demand environments.
  • Strong documentation and reporting skills.

Preferred Certifications

  • Vendor certifications from:
    • Cisco Systems
    • Poly
    • Microsoft
    • Zoom Video Communications
  • PMP (Project Management Professional) certification is a plus.

Key Competencies

  • Executive-level communication skills
  • Technical depth with business acumen
  • Strong leadership and decision-making abilities
  • Detail-oriented with high accountability
  • Ability to thrive in fast-paced, high-pressure environments
  • Customer-first mindset

What Success Looks Like in This Role

  • Seamlessly guiding clients from concept to deployment
  • Delivering complex technology projects with minimal rework
  • Creating accurate BoMs and preventing cost overruns
  • Maintaining high client satisfaction and repeat business
  • Acting as a trusted advisor for enterprise technology strategy

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

title: Senior Premier Banker West Paces Ferry
description:
Why Wells Fargo:

Are you looking for more? Find it here. At Wells Fargo, we're more than a financial services leader – we’re a global trailblazer committed to driving innovation, empowering communities, and helping our customers succeed. We believe that a meaningful career is much more than just a job – it’s about finding all of the elements to help you thrive, in one place. Living the Well Life means you’re supported in life, not just work. It means having robust benefits, competitive compensation, and programs designed to help you find work-life balance and well-being. You’ll be rewarded for investing in your community, celebrated for being your authentic self, and empowered to grow. And we’re recognized for it – Wells Fargo once again ranked in the top five on the 2026 LinkedIn Top Companies list of best workplaces “to grow your career” in the U.S. Join us!

About this role:

Wells Fargo is seeking a Senior Branch Premier Banker (SAFE) to play a pivotal role within our National Branch Network. This role grows, deepens, and manages relationships with affluent customers and those with more complex financial needs, serving as their primary point of contact for banking products and services through scheduled appointments, lobby engagement, and proactive outreach. This role is designed for growth oriented professionals who lead with advice to acquire and deepen relationships through meaningful discovery and translate customer goals into comprehensive financial strategies. You will own and actively grow a defined book of business, leveraging goals based planning, and prudent risk oversight to deliver integrated solutions across deposits, investments, credit, home lending, and business banking. In addition, you’ll help customers with everyday banking needs-opening accounts, handling service requests, and ensuring a seamless experience making it easier for them to manage their banking with confidence. Success in this role is driven by strong relationship acumen, proactive customer engagement, and seamless collaboration with internal partners across Wealth, Home Lending, and Business Banking to deliver a differentiated customer experience.

Wells Fargo rewards behaviors that consistently create long term customer value and support customers in making informed financial decisions. You’ll be supported with digital tools, industry leading training, ongoing coaching, and backed by one of the most recognized brands in banking. This role offers a clear platform for career growth for experienced professionals who excel at building trust, managing a portfolio, and delivering holistic, multi product solutions.

In this role you will:

  • Proactively acquire new affluent consumer and business customers while deepening existing relationships through strategic outreach, referrals, and pre-planned customer appointments
  • Lead discovery‑driven conversations to understand customer goals and deliver tailored banking and credit strategies that strengthen relationships, increase retention, and drive balanced growth across deposits, lending, and investments
  • Serve as the primary financial partner delivering comprehensive, multi‑product guidance and ongoing reviews across life stages and evolving financial needs
  • Partner with a team of professionals across Wealth, Home Lending, and Business Banking to deliver integrated solutions by coordinating warm introductions, setting clear expectations, and taking personal ownership to convert qualified opportunities into closed outcomes
  • Champion digital adoption by educating customers on self-service and mobile banking options to elevate satisfaction, engagement, and service efficiency
  • Serve as an active member of the branch team by advising colleagues on relationship development and the management of complex client needs
  • Demonstrate risk excellence through accurate documentation, sound judgment, timely issue escalation, and adherence to policies and regulations to support strong control outcomes
  • The Senior Branch Premier Banker LP (license pending) role is a temporary position until employee has successfully completed licensing requirements and SAFE registration. Upon successful completion, employees will transition to the Senior Branch Premier Banker (SAFE) role. Employees hired into the Senior Branch Premier Banker LP role who are not fully licensed will participate in the Branch Network Licensed Banker program.

Required Qualifications:

  • 4+ years of customer service experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education
  • 3+ years of experience building and maintaining effective relationships with customers and partners
  • 3+ years of experience recommending products and services

Desired Qualifications:

  • Experience recommending financial products and translating customer goals into clear, actionable recommendations
  • Demonstrated ability to proactively source, acquire, and deepen relationships through proactive outreach and building strong internal partnership to support the customer experience
  • Proven experience managing a book-of-business, documentation of planning conversations, and consistent follow-through to drive retention and growth across deposits, lending, and investments
  • Experience coaching or supporting peers to strengthen team performance and customer impact
  • Demonstrated ability to communicate clearly and confidently, listen with empathy, and build credibility and trust quickly with others
  • Financial services industry experience in one or a combination of the following: consumer, home lending, business banking, or investments
  • 3+ years of experience in a licensed financial services position
  • Successfully completed Financial Industry Regulatory Authority (FINRA)Series 6 and 63 exams (or FINRA recognized equivalents) sufficient to qualify for immediate FINRA registration
  • State Insurance license(s)

Job Expectations:

  • Ability to work a schedule that will include most Saturdays
  • This role requires FINRA Series 6 and Series 63 (or FINRA recognized equivalents), and State Insurance license(s) which must be active or completed within a designated timeframe. For any FINRA qualification exams earned after Sept. 30, 2018, the Securities Industry Essentials (SIE) exam is also required.
  • For the following states where hired, FINRA Series 65 (or equivalent) examination will also be required within a specified period of time: AK, AL, CT, DE, HI, IA, ID, IN, KS, MD, MI, MN, MS, NC, ND, NE, NM, SC, SD, TN, TX, UT, VA, WA, WI, and WY. Wyoming allows referral-only licensed bankers to receive the IAR registration without the Series 65/66. Requirements may change based on current state regulations.
  • Obtaining and maintaining required FINRA licenses is necessary for continued employment. This role also requires meeting enhanced financial fitness and criminal background standards. Wells Fargo will begin the FINRA review process once an offer is accepted.
  • SAFE registration is required at the time of employment and Wells Fargo will initiate the process after your start date.Loan Originators must meet LO/CFPB requirements and comply with Wells Fargo policies, including standards related to financial responsibility, character, fitness, and criminal background. A credit report may be reviewed (credit score not included) and additional ongoing screening may apply.
  • This position is not eligible for Visa sponsorship

Posting Location:

  • 3393 Northside Pkwy NW, ATLANTA, GA 30327-2242

Posting End Date:

14 Sep 2026

*Job posting may come down early due to volume of applicants.

We Value Equal Opportunity

Wells Fargo is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other legally protected characteristic.

Employees support our focus on building strong customer relationships balanced with a strong risk mitigating and compliance-driven culture which firmly establishes those disciplines as critical to the success of our customers and company. They are accountable for execution of all applicable risk programs (Credit, Market, Financial Crimes, Operational, Regulatory Compliance), which includes effectively following and adhering to applicable Wells Fargo policies and procedures, appropriately fulfilling risk and compliance obligations, timely and effective escalation and remediation of issues, and making sound risk decisions. title: Sustainable Infrastructure Specialist
description:
Major Functions:

The Sustainable Infrastructure Specialist will be responsible for assessing the potential impacts of large-scale infrastructure on conservation and developing strategic, collaborative approaches to address the issue in an amicable manner. Under the supervision of the Conservation Program Director, the Specialist will be responsible for building and strengthening the capacity of government agencies, civil society organizations, development partners, and academic institutions while coordinating closely with relevant stakeholders to promote sustainable green infrastructure (wildlife-friendly and climate-smart) to reduce any adverse impacts of infrastructure on the ecosystem and biodiversity.

Major Duties and Responsibilities:

1. Technical support to appraise and address the adverse impacts of infrastructure development

Working closely with the supervisor, as well as internal and external stakeholders at both field and central levels, the incumbent will support work on sustainable green infrastructure—both broadly and within WWF’s priority landscapes—to assess and, where possible, mitigate the adverse impacts of infrastructure (primarily linear and point) development on biodiversity, including wildlife, freshwater systems, and forests. Key responsibilities include, but are not limited to: identifying and mapping planned infrastructure developments across landscapes; reviewing environmental and social impacts, including those arising from unsustainable extraction of construction materials; assessing and providing inputs on developers’ Environmental Impact Assessments (EIA/IEE); identifying cumulative impacts of multiple infrastructure projects and preparing case studies and analytical reports grounded in data and evidence; coordinating stakeholder identification and engagement in the environmental flows (E-flows) process; and identifying best practices and recommending appropriate mitigation measures for the planning, design, and implementation of major linear and point infrastructure projects. The role is expected to focus primarily on hydropower development, transmission lines, new roads and railway lines, highway expansions, irrigation systems, urban growth, and other emerging infrastructure priorities.

2. Provide technical support in Green recovery and mainstreaming Climate Change and DRR in infrastructure work

Work closely with WWF core team, disaster relief committees, donors, and other networks; promote awareness, provide technical advice, and develop a strategy for Green recovery and reconstruction, identifying priority needs and opportunities based on needs using WWF’s existing experience and knowledge. The incumbent works closely with the Climate and Energy thematic team, promotes mainstreaming of climate adaptation and Disaster Risk Reduction (DRR) into the infrastructure sector, identify measures together with developers and donors to take account of possible risks from climate and development scenarios. Support building climate resilient and carbon neutral infrastructure through designing and implementation of practices, protocols, and guidelines.

3. Technical Suggestion to senior leadership team and Cross Learning among WWF’s Thematic Teams

Proactively update WWF Nepal’s senior management team and thematic leads on major infrastructure developments, as well as relevant laws, policies, and emerging environmental risks associated with development activities, to help shape and position WWF Nepal’s response. This includes regularly monitoring key projects, synthesizing complex information, and delivering timely analyses supported by accurate data, verified evidence, geospatial insights, and illustrative case studies to inform strategic decision-making and programmatic actions.

4. Coordinate with donors, developers, academics, and government to strengthen the enabling environment and best practices

Develop working relationships with developers, donors, and relevant government departments, local and state governments to enhance the enabling environment and best practices in environmentally friendly infrastructure development. Provide inputs in policies (drafting and revision) related to infrastructure development and natural resources safeguards. This responsibility may include coordination with different CSO/Network/interest groups that are actively engaged in any infrastructure development project in the country. Coordinate with academia (School, Campus and university) to support mainstreaming infrastructure issues in their curricula.

5. Support the development team and field team in the design and implementation of safeguard measures in related projects

Work as focal point for nature safeguarding of all infrastructure related works as demanded by infrastructure related projects. The incumbent will work closely with WWF’s development team towards the inception of new concept notes and design of projects relevance to WWF’s infrastructure work. Specialists shall contribute towards other thematic teams in developing integrated projects in WWF’s working landscape. For assigned projects, provide technical guidance for implementation to the field team, researcher/consultants and contribute to project completion reports and address relevant thematic areas as required by the project deliverables. Keep track of issues or related developments that are useful for safeguards implementation and new or updates to country safeguard systems (e.g., laws, policies, regulations, and procedures).

6. Monitoring, Evaluation, Knowledge and Learning

Working closely with Monitoring and Evaluation staff, monitoring progress of the infrastructure work and contributing to performance monitoring, progress reports and final program reports. Enhance knowledge and learning on best practices including Sustainable Green Infrastructure (SGI) practices; document lessons from infrastructure work and contribute to WWF Nepal's learning program including knowledge sharing and capacity building. The incumbent should keep track of the progress in the field of infrastructure development, including at bilateral and multilateral levels. In addition, s/he should be continuously keeping track of public sector investment by local and state level governments in areas of WWF interest, particularly conservation landscapes and areas of biodiversity significance.

7. Communication and Technical Reporting

Promote communication of messages on infrastructure impacts and ways to reduce them, such as modeling tools for decision makers; awareness and outreach events; and production of publications, technical reports, and other materials; for key audiences including decision makers, developers, donors, practitioners, partners, and the public. Communication work will be undertaken in coordination with the WWF communication team.

8. Other Duties

Perform other duties as assigned by the supervisor and play an active role in successful operation of the department.

Supervisory Responsibility: None

Working Relationships:

Internal: This position is cross cutting in nature. It requires close coordination with staff members from goal and landscape teams in the Kathmandu office as well as relevant members of the field team.

External: Interacts regularly with consultants, developers, donors, and Government of Nepal officials.

    Minimum Work Requirements:

    Knowledge: A master’s degree in civil engineering or environmental engineering

    Experience: At least 5 years of experience working on infrastructure development, with strong experience in environmental impact assessment/initial environmental examination is essential; experience in environmental management related with roads, railways, transmission lines, and hydropower development is preferred. Knowledge and/or experience in green-resilient infrastructure development, natural resources safeguards, DRR, and climate change adaptation is desirable.

    Skills and Abilities:

    • This position requires commitment to reducing adverse impacts of infrastructure on the biodiversity and overall environment.
    • Strong analytical skills and ability to think outside the box; good facilitation and communication skills including written and spoken English is required.
    • S/he should have the ability to work with a wide range of stakeholders including government, academia, developers, donors, NGOs, research groups, and local community groups.
    • S/he should be effectively able to prioritize and work under time constraints, using initiative and judgement.
    • Strong interpersonal, diplomatic and team-player skills are essential.

    Interested applicants are requested to apply for the position by 17:00 hours on September 16, 2026. Only shortlisted candidates will be informed.

    All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

    WWF is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Please join us in our mission to save life on Earth.

title: Head of Engineering, Field Verification
description:
Who we are

Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month.

As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually.

Why Pakistan

Pakistan is home to the third-largest concentration of technology team members at Moniepoint, and it's one of the fastest-growing markets we hire into, with real headroom for growth in seniority and scope. We look for people here who understand first-hand what it means for financial services to be difficult to access, and who want to work on problems at a genuine international scale - changing how banking works across emerging markets.

So, now we are looking for our Head of Engineering, Field Verification to join us in Pakistan.

About the role

Field Verification is how Moniepoint knows that the people and businesses on our platform are real. Every Moniepoint customer, retail and business, requires a completed field verification as part of KYC. The platform coordinates physical, in-person checks — verifying individuals, business owners, business addresses and loan guarantors — and it serves nearly every part of the company: onboarding, loans, compliance and the fraud team.

The system works today. A back office gives each business unit visibility and control over its own verification requests. A mobile-friendly web app puts the work in the hands of Field Verification Officers and the cluster leads who manage them across local government areas. An API layer lets other business units push verification requests in and receive results back by webhook, and an assignment algorithm routes each request to an officer close enough to carry it out.

We want to be straightforward about the rest. This domain has never had a dedicated engineering leader, and that is the single biggest constraint on it. The team is one lean, cross-functional squad — an Engineering Manager, four engineers and a QA — carrying verification volume for the entire customer base. They have done that impressively well, but running lean means running in keep-the-lights-on mode, and a long list of things that would make this platform substantially better has been waiting for someone to own it.

That list is the role. Trip and route management, so an officer can plan an optimal day across several sites rather than making a separate journey for each one — today we pay for a round trip per verification, and the logistics are nowhere near optimal. Capacity management. A native mobile app, wanted for a long time and never resourced. Liveness and identity verification tooling, exposed as APIs the rest of the business can build on. And as Moniepoint expands into markets where identity verification is as difficult as it is in Nigeria, Kenya among them, a platform that works beyond a single country.

There is a great deal of room to build here. Whoever takes this on will set the direction rather than inherit someone else's plan, on a system that already carries real weight for the business.

As Head of Engineering, Field Verification, your responsibilities will include:

  • Owning the technical strategy, architecture and roadmap for the Field Verification platform end to end, and setting direction for a domain that has been running without dedicated engineering leadership.
  • Moving the platform from keep-the-lights-on operation to deliberate, prioritised development.
  • Leading and growing the existing cross-functional team, and building the organisation out as scope expands.
  • Building the operational efficiency layer — trip and route optimisation, task allocation and capacity management for field officers.
  • Owning the platform's client-facing surface: the APIs and webhooks that other business units integrate with, and the back office those units rely on.
  • Delivering a native mobile experience for field officers.
  • Ensuring verification data is structured, auditable and fit for compliance scrutiny.
  • Building for multi-country expansion as Moniepoint enters new markets.
  • Partnering closely with Product and with the business units that depend on the platform — onboarding, loans, compliance and fraud.
  • Defining architecture standards, engineering processes and quality metrics, and hiring and developing engineers and Engineering Managers.

Who you are

  • You have built things yourself, and grew into leadership from there. We are explicit about this: we are not looking for someone who moved into management early and has led from a distance since. We want an engineer who became a leader.
  • You are capable across disciplines. Backend, web and mobile. This platform spans all three and you will need credibility in each — a specialist in one layer will struggle here.
  • You have built platforms, not just products. Systems used by several distinct groups of users and internal business units, with the flexibility to serve requirements you did not anticipate.
  • You are a problem solver first. We would rather have someone adaptable than someone with the exact domain experience. Having built across different industries — fintech, e-commerce, logistics or otherwise — is a positive signal, not a scattered CV.
  • You have 10+ years of overall software engineering experience, with substantial hands-on production engineering and strong backend depth. Our backend environment is Java and Spring Boot.
  • You have at least 5 years of engineering leadership, including managing Engineering Managers.
  • You collaborate well with product and business stakeholders, and can translate operational requirements into engineering solutions.
  • Experience working with location and geospatial data is a strong plus, including map integrations.
  • Experience with route, trip or delivery optimisation is a strong plus.
  • Experience building for compliance — where data must be structured to evidence what was done and when — is a strong plus.
  • Experience with identity, KYC or verification platforms is a plus. None of these four are requirements.

Cultural Alignment

As well, we assess every candidate across eight dimensions that define how great leaders operate at Moniepoint. We look for evidence of all eight throughout the process, not just in a single conversation.

  • Customer Obsession: Build deep empathy for users. Solve problems intuitively, and fix root causes, not just tickets.
  • Craft: Master the fundamentals. Reason from first principles, make trade-offs explicit, and raise the bar on quality.
  • Systemisation: Turn repeating decisions into scalable mechanisms. Reduce cognitive load and raise engineering quality.
  • Urgency: Move with disciplined speed. Act autonomously within scope, remove friction, and escalate risks early.
  • Ownership: Treat the platform as your own. Take initiative across boundaries and follow through without reminders.
  • No Ego: Put the mission first. Share credit, welcome debate, and never protect status over team outcomes.
  • Candour: Surface uncomfortable truths and risks early. Intelligent failure is welcome; concealment is not.
  • Integrity: Stay truthful and ethically consistent. Refuse toxic behavior. Performance without integrity is unacceptable.

What Success Looks Like

  • The domain has clear technical ownership and direction for the first time.
  • The team out of keep-the-lights-on mode and delivering against a prioritised roadmap.
  • Measurable improvement in field officer efficiency — more verifications per trip, lower cost per verification.
  • A native mobile experience shipped for field officers.
  • Verification data that stands up to compliance scrutiny across every business unit the platform serves.
  • The platform ready to support a new market.
  • A team grown beyond its current size, with a strong bench of engineers and managers.

Why Join Us

  • A genuinely greenfield mandate on a system that already matters. Every customer Moniepoint onboards passes through this platform.
  • A lean, capable team making outsized impact, and the remit to build the organisation around them.
  • Breadth: backend, web, mobile, location data, compliance and operational optimisation in one domain.
  • Be part of a mission-driven company expanding access to financial services for millions of businesses and individuals.

What To Expect in The Hiring Process

  • A preliminary phone call with the recruiter.
  • 60 minute High level System Design round with one of our Engineering Managers.
  • 60 minute Panel Interview with 2 of our Head of Engineering leaders. 30 minutes focused on a technical deep dive into your CV and into a project or system you built in the past. 30 minutes focused on testing for leadership attributes.
  • 60 minute Stakeholder Management Round with one of our Product Heads/VPs, focused on your stakeholder management and collaboration skills with product and business.
  • 60 minute Technical round and Culture fit interview with our Co-founder & Group CTO (the hiring manager).

title: Staff/Principal AI Engineer, SMAI
description:
Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all.

Join an inclusive team passionate about one thing: using their expertise in the relentless pursuit of innovation for customers and partners. The solutions we build help make everything from virtual reality experiences to breakthroughs in neural networks possible. We do it all while committing to integrity, sustainability, and giving back to our communities. Because doing so can fuel the very innovation we are pursuing.

Staff/Principal Full-Stack AI Engineer, IPAI, SMAI

Job Summary

Lead the Future of AI-Powered Manufacturing at Micron

Micron is accelerating its transformation toward Autonomous Operations through Artificial Intelligence, advanced analytics, digital twins, robotics, and intelligent automation. As a Staff/Principal Full-Stack AI Engineer, you will be a technical leader driving the strategy, architecture, and delivery of next-generation AI products that power smarter manufacturing across Micron's global network of fabs and assembly/test sites.

In this highly influential role, you will own AI solutions end-to-end—from data engineering, machine learning, and agentic AI systems to modern full-stack applications, digital twin platforms, robotics integration, and edge-to-cloud deployment. Working closely with data scientists, software engineers, robotics teams, and manufacturing leaders, you will transform innovative ideas into scalable, production-grade solutions that improve efficiency, increase automation, and enable intelligent decision-making at enterprise scale.

This is a unique opportunity to shape the future of AI in semiconductor manufacturing and directly contribute to Micron's vision of autonomous, data-driven operations worldwide.

Main Responsibilities

  • Design, architect, and build end-to-end AI products, including data ingestion pipelines, feature engineering, model training and inference, APIs, web applications, and observability frameworks.

  • Develop responsive front-end applications using React, Angular, or Streamlit, backed by Python/FastAPI services, with strong type-safe development and test coverage practices.

  • Architect and maintain scalable, modular application layers that bridge real-time sensor, robotics, and manufacturing data with enterprise-facing dashboards and decision-support systems.

  • Design and develop full-stack integration of robotics platforms, Autonomous Mobile Robots (AMRs), tool automation systems, and control systems with smart manufacturing applications and the Micron smart manufacturing ecosystem.

  • Design and implement digital twin environments, including 3D representations of fab layouts, AMR fleets, and tool stations using platforms such as NVIDIA Omniverse, Gazebo, Unity Robotics Hub, or equivalent technologies.

  • Interface with Smart Manufacturing systems to integrate structured operational data into AI pipelines and digital twin environments.

  • Design and integrate LLMs and agentic AI frameworks into production workflows for manufacturing and engineering users.

  • Develop AI-assisted robotics orchestration capabilities and 3D-aware AI features that leverage spatial data, equipment positioning, robot trajectories, and fab maps to improve anomaly detection, route optimization, and predictive maintenance.

  • Containerize AI and robotics services using Docker and deploy solutions through Kubernetes, OpenShift, and modern cloud-native platforms.

  • Package and deploy robotics software stacks, AI services, and 3D rendering workloads as containerized microservices supporting cloud, on-premises, and edge manufacturing environments.

  • Manage GPU-accelerated inference workloads and real-time simulation environments supporting AI, robotics, and digital twin applications.

  • Optimize AI application performance and cost through caching, batching, GPU utilization, model quantization, and inference optimization strategies.

  • Validate digital twin and simulation scenarios against real-world operational constraints before production deployment to support safe and reliable autonomous operations.

Other Responsibilities

  • Lead implementation of CI/CD, automated software releases, monitoring, model evaluation, drift detection, and AI application lifecycle management for production AI applications.

  • Apply Responsible AI practices, including input validation, prompt-injection defense, PII/IP protection, model governance, auditability, and compliance requirements.

  • Design and implement improvements to AI platform scalability, reliability, maintainability, performance, and cost efficiency.

  • Develop and communicate descriptive, diagnostic, predictive, and prescriptive analytics to support manufacturing and operational decision-making.

  • Develop, implement, and optimize machine learning, deep learning, and statistical models for structured and unstructured data.

  • Perform code reviews, provide technical mentorship, and drive software engineering best practices across project teams.

  • Lead testing, debugging, technical documentation, installation procedures, and maintenance strategies for AI and software solutions.

  • Integrate AI-assisted tools and insights into daily work to improve efficiency, quality, and effectiveness while complying with organizational standards, legal requirements, and governance policies.

  • Contribute to a culture of continuous improvement by identifying, testing, and sharing AI-enabled enhancements within one's scope of work.

Minimum Required Qualifications / Experience

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, or a related field; equivalent industry experience accepted.

  • 8+ years building and shipping production web, software, machine learning, or AI applications end-to-end.

  • Track record of delivering solutions in complex cross-functional environments spanning software engineering, data science, robotics, manufacturing, automation, and infrastructure teams.

  • Experience designing and deploying scalable AI applications, APIs, and data-driven solutions in production environments.

Must Have Technical Skills

  • Expert programming skills in Python and modern JavaScript/TypeScript, with experience designing scalable software architectures.

  • Strong SQL proficiency and experience designing data ingestion and feature engineering pipelines for AI/ML workloads at scale.

  • Experience with Docker, Kubernetes/OpenShift, cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP), and CI/CD pipeline ownership.

  • Experience with machine learning, deep learning, statistical modeling, predictive analytics, and large-scale computing frameworks.

  • Strong knowledge of GenAI technologies, including prompt engineering, function/tool calling, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), LLM integration, agentic AI patterns, model evaluation, and Responsible AI practices.

  • Experience working with distributed data processing platforms, enterprise AI systems, and production AI operations.

  • Ability to apply AI literacy and digital fluency to use AI-enabled tools responsibly and effectively for research, analysis, content creation, problem-solving, operational tasks, automation, and achieving business outcomes.

Must Have Soft Skills

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

  • Ability to influence technical decisions across cross-functional teams.

  • Strong collaboration, ownership, and execution mindset.

Highly Desirable / Preferred Skills or Experience:

  • Master’s degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Robotics, Data Science, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

  • Prior experience in semiconductor manufacturing, advanced manufacturing, industrial automation, digital twin development, or other high-reliability operational environments.

  • Experience implementing Generative AI solutions, including RAG architectures, prompt engineering, function/tool calling, agentic workflows, and LLMOps practices.

  • Experience applying Responsible AI, security, audit logging, and model governance practices within production applications.

  • Knowledge of GPU-accelerated computing, model optimization techniques, and deployment of AI workloads in cloud and edge environments.

  • Hands-on experience with digital twin and simulation platforms (NVIDIA Omniverse, Gazebo, Unity Robotics Hub, Siemens Tecnomatix, Unreal Engine) and the Autodesk stack (Revit, Navisworks, ACC, ReCap), including point-cloud processing, photogrammetry, Gaussian splatting, and geometry optimisation via IFC and Revit APIs.

  • Experience integrating robotics, autonomous mobile robots (AMRs), industrial automation, and IoT sensor networks into software applications, with proven robotics development in ROS/ROS 2 and Isaac Sim/Lab — including SLAM perception, LiDAR/depth-camera data processing, and sim-to-real transfer (imitation learning, domain randomization).

  • Proven experience in integration of SCADA/FMCS/BMS systems for smart facilities and EHS , ideally in semiconductor, data center, pharmaceutical, or other mission-critical/cleanroom environments

Embody Micron's Core Values

  • People – Respect, develop, and empower others.

  • Innovation – Drive continuous improvement and breakthrough thinking.

  • Tenacity – Show grit and determination.

  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives that enhance analytical capability, cycle time, productivity, and engineering effectiveness.

description:
