Join us at headspace
headspace is the National Youth Mental Health Foundation, with Each as a leading agency since 2006. We provide early intervention mental health services to 12-25 year olds across Australia, offering support through over 145 communities, online and phone counselling, vocational services, and schools.


About the program
This role sits within the headspace Dandenong vocational recovery program, delivering the Individual Placement and Support (IPS) model. You’ll work closely with young people experiencing mental health challenges, their families, employers, and a multidisciplinary headspace team to help them build working lives that reflect who they are and where they want to go.


Your role, your impact
As a Vocational Specialist, you’ll work directly with young people (up to age 25) to support their journey into work or study, while strengthening connections between mental health, community and employers.

Key responsibilities:

  • Employing youth engagement skills to provide centre-based and outreach vocational support to young people experiencing a range of mental health barriers
  • Working intensively with young people and their families (where appropriate) to ensure they achieve and maintain sustainable participation in vocational education and competitive employment
  • Supporting the establishment of the Individual Placement and Support (IPS) vocational program within the headspace clinical service, ensuring all supports are individualised to young people needs and preferences
  • Developing and maintaining relationships with local employers to create opportunities that align with each young person’s strengths, interests and career goals, while providing employers with appropriate education and support
  • Conducting regular job development and job search activities with young people to help them secure suitable opportunities
  • Working as part of a multidisciplinary clinical team, participating in care planning and ensuring vocational goals are embedded within young people’s mental health recovery journey

See the impact of headspace Work and Study support: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Y00rK8GzyLI


About you
We’re looking for someone who is values‑led, curious, and motivated by making a real difference.

To succeed in this role, you’ll bring:

  • Understanding of how mental health, confidence, identity and life circumstances can impact a young person’s pathway into work or study
  • A genuine belief in young people’s capacity to grow, recover and achieve meaningful futures, and a passion for walking alongside them on that journey
    Strong organisational and administrative skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities, maintain accurate documentation, while balancing meaningful client engagement
  • Qualifications and/or experience in employment services, vocational rehabilitation, career development, or a related field
  • Career coaching experience with a strong understanding of the barriers young people face in employment and education
  • Proven ability to build and maintain effective business and stakeholder relationships


What will make you stand out

  • A warm, engaging approach that helps young people feel safe, understood and hopeful about their future
  • Understanding of the IPS (Individual Placement and Support) model
  • Ability to build positive, trusting connections with young people and employers
  • Experience working with headspace, youth mental health, or community-based services
  • Familiarity with Centrelink, DES, Workforce Australia, or other youth employment programs


What’s in it for you
Each is the Lead Agency for headspace Dandenong. At Each you’ll be supported to be your best.

title: Building Maintenance & Security Junior Coordinator
description:
Ebury helps ambitious businesses unlock global growth, and we take the same approach with our people. We encourage innovation and movement, collaboration and problem-solving, and foster an environment where everyone can feel they belong, are valued, supported and empowered to succeed.

If you’re a collaborator who wants to help transform how businesses operate globally, get in touch - we’d love to discuss how Ebury can accelerate your career so you can shape the future.

León Building Maintenance & Security Junior Coordinator

The Role

As the Building Maintenance & Security Coordinator for Ebury's new headquarters in León, you will be the single point of contact for all technical and office support operations. You will be responsible for transforming newly acquired facilities into a first-class office experience, ensuring that all complex building systems—from power to advanced climate control—are managed to the highest standards.

You will act as the "Property Representative," guaranteeing zero downtime for our critical infrastructure. You will be responsible for the long-term value and resilience of the asset, moving beyond day-to-day maintenance toward strategic asset management and decarbonization.

You will report directly to the Head of Global Business Services, who will act as the primary stakeholder for local infrastructure and employee safety, and you will also have a key local stakeholder, the Director of Ebury León. Additionally, you will work side-by-side with the León Office Manager.

Responsibilities

24/7 Facility Operations & Critical Systems

  • Responsible for the effective operation of all contracted facility services, specifically managing the BMS (Building Management System), HVAC system, ventilation (AHU/UTA), and general building maintenance.
  • Critical Infrastructure Maintenance: Oversee planned and ad hoc maintenance of UPS systems (Uninterruptible Power Supply), electrical panels, and building plumbing to guarantee 100% operational continuity.

24/7 Critical Operations & Asset Management

  • Business Continuity & Emergency Response: Establish and lead a 24/7 technical emergency response protocol to guarantee uptime for critical systems, including UPS, server room cooling, and security systems.
  • Advanced Security Supervision: Manage 24/7 security protocols, including multi-zone access control and integrated CCTV monitoring in coordination with the security vendor.
  • Property Regulatory Compliance: Guarantee 100% compliance with all statutory inspections (OCA, Fire Safety, Legionella, Elevator safety) to mitigate Ebury's legal and operational risks.
  • Vendor Management: Manage relationships with key technical vendors (General Maintenance, Elevators, Security/Fire Protection, and Utilities).

Safety & Compliance

  • Duty of Care: Lead Health & Safety programs with comprehensive policies for the office and 24/7 shifts.
  • Total Compliance: Responsible for ensuring Health & Safety compliance in accordance with local Spanish regulations, ensuring all mandatory inspections (electrical OCA, fire safety, and elevators) are completed as the property owner.

Projects & Sustainability

  • Project Coordination: Lead moves and project coordination, including the upcoming renovation of the ground-floor commercial space and the potential installation of rooftop photovoltaic panels.
  • Environmental Supervision: Oversee specialised services, such as Building Maintenance Units (Gondolas/BMU) for facade care, and supervise waste management and pest control.

Skills, Experience & Qualifications

Experience

  • Solid Industry Experience: A minimum of two years in corporate office management, hospitality environments, or high-traffic complex facilities.
  • Seamless Operations (Zero-Downtime): Proven track record in maintaining 24/7 mission-critical centres, such as operations rooms or global headquarters, where infrastructure resilience is paramount.

Education & Technical Credentials

  • Technical Background: A Vocational Training degree (Formación Profesional) focused on the electrical field or similar technical disciplines is highly desirable.

Technical Mastery & Systems

  • Fundamental Maintenance: Practical, hands-on proficiency in general electrical systems, plumbing, and climate control operations.
  • Specialised Infrastructure: Comprehensive understanding of UPS redundancy, electrical load balancing, and RITE regulations.
  • Software & Digital Controls: Direct experience using Building Management System (BMS) software for environmental monitoring.
  • Practical Skills: High level of manual dexterity and a strict focus on safety when operating various technical tools.

Strategic Assets & Technical Documentation

  • Asset Management: Proficiency in managing as-built technical records and maintenance histories to preserve long-term asset value and regulatory compliance status.

Language & Interpersonal Skills

  • Multilingual Capability: Fluency in English and Spanish, essential for coordinating with global teams and negotiating with local service vendors.

Key Competencies

  • Problem Solver: Analytical mindset capable of quickly identifying and resolving building issues, such as thermal bridges or moisture infiltration.
  • Self-Sufficient: Ability to independently prioritise urgent technical tasks, demonstrating meticulous attention to detail and office upkeep.
  • Operational Resilience: Calm and focused demeanour during high-pressure scenarios involving critical infrastructure or end-of-life equipment.
  • Leadership: Taking ultimate ownership over total building operability and smooth facility operations.

Benefits & Value Proposition

  • Competitive Compensation: Salary package commensurate with experience and position responsibility.
  • Work-Life Balance & Flexibility: Results-oriented flexible hours that enable professional and personal balance.
  • Long-Term Growth: Stable employment within a strategic project linked to the new corporate headquarters.
  • Comprehensive Well-Being: Access to private healthcare programs and flexible benefits schemes.

Why Ebury?

  • Competitive Starting Salary with an annual discretionary bonus that truly rewards your performance from day one.
  • Dedicated Mentorship: Learn directly from experienced managers who are invested in your success.
  • Cutting-Edge Technology: Leverage state-of-the-art tailor made tools and systems that enable you to perform at your best.
  • Clear, Accelerated Career Progression: Defined pathways to leadership and specialist roles within Ebury.
  • Dynamic & Supportive Culture: Work in a collaborative environment where teamwork and personal growth are prioritized.
  • Generous Benefits Package: Access competitive benefits tailored to your location, which typically include health care and social benefits.
  • Central Office: A fantastic location with excellent transport links.

Ready to launch your career with a global FinTech? Click the ‘Apply’ Today and discover your potential at Ebury

About us

Ebury delivers sophisticated, integrated solutions — business accounts, hedging, and financing — on a single platform with a seamless workflow. Our success is built on a simple premise and singular purpose: To help businesses operate and scale globally.

Since its founding in 2009, Ebury has always been a fast-growing leader in fintech. Today, we bring together 2000+ Eburians across nearly 70 cities and we’re always looking to add to our team.

At the heart of our offering is a proprietary platform, purpose-built to help businesses seamlessly streamline and manage global cash flow. We focus on continuous product evolution and innovation to build the infrastructure for borderless growth and help our clients scale at every stage.

The opportunities at Ebury are as diverse as our people, ranging from business development to engineering roles across our tech pillars.

We believe in inclusion. We stand against discrimination in all forms and are against the intolerance of differences that makes us a modern and successful organisation. At Ebury, you can be whoever you want to be and still feel a sense of belonging no matter your story.

Ebury only accepts applications via official Ebury channels. We will only contact you from an @ domain. Always check the emails you receive from us, and note that we will never request payment for any part of the recruitment process. Stay safe and report suspicious activity.

title: PDE API PI, Engineer
description:
Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all.

Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.

The PDE API Process Integration (PI) Engineer is responsible for driving process integration excellence for Advanced Packaging products, including High Bandwidth Memory (HBM) products across sites during New Product Introduction (NPI). This role ensures robust process readiness, yield ramp, and cross‑module integration across Front-end to Assembly interactions, PWF, Assembly, and Test, enabling successful execution of HBM technology roadmaps.

The PI Engineer works cross‑functionally with different cross-functional teams including Fab, Assembly, Test, Yield, Quality, and central engineering teams to identify risks early, resolve complex integration issues, and deliver NPI milestones on time.

Job Responsibilities

Technical Leadership

  • Serve as the Process Integration Subject Matter Expert, owning end‑to‑end integration across PWF, assembly, and test from NPI through sustained HVM
  • Define PI technical direction, integration frameworks, and success criteria for HBM programs
  • Lead process characterization strategy, window definition, and systemic yield improvement
  • Resolve complex yield, reliability, and performance issues through deep technical analysis and integration expertise
  • Drive resolution of high‑impact, ambiguous, cross‑site integration challenges affecting ramp, quality, or business commitments
  • Anticipate risks early and define mitigation strategies across programs and sites

Cross‑Functional & Strategic Engagement

  • Represent PI in program and leadership forums, delivering clear, data‑driven technical recommendations
  • Influence and align global cross‑functional stakeholders through technical authority and credibility
  • Evaluate existing workflows, identify strategic enhancement opportunities, and lead cross-functional implementation of process improvements to accelerate time-to-market

Integrating Artificial Intelligence

  • Integrates AI-assisted tools and insights into daily work to improve efficiency, quality, or effectiveness, exercising sound judgement and complying with organizational standards and legal requirements
  • Contributes to a culture of continuous improvement by identifying, testing, and sharing AI-enabled enhancements within one’s scope of work

Job requirements

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering or related discipline
  • Ability to apply baseline digital fluency and role-appropriate AI literacy to use AI-enabled tools responsibly and effectively for research, analysis, content creation, problem-solving, operational tasks, and achieving business outcomes

About Micron Technology, Inc.

We are an industry leader in innovative memory and storage solutions transforming how the world uses information to enrich life for all. With a relentless focus on our customers, technology leadership, and manufacturing and operational excellence, Micron delivers a rich portfolio of high-performance DRAM, NAND, and NOR memory and storage products through our Micron® and Crucial® brands. Every day, the innovations that our people create fuel the data economy, enabling advances in artificial intelligence and 5G applications that unleash opportunities — from the data center to the intelligent edge and across the client and mobile user experience.

title: OSHC Coordinator | Hocking Area
description:

You’ll work Monday to Friday across our before and after school care programs:

Rise then Shine: 6:30am – 8:30am
Stay and Play: 2:30pm – 6:00pm

As Coordinator, you’ll lead a team of dedicated Educators, build strong relationships with children, families and the school community, and bring fun, creativity and care into each day. If you’re ready to step into a rewarding leadership role where no two days are the same, we’d love to hear from you!

title: MTS-2 Software Engineer - Backend
description:
At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

Join eBay’s Advertising and Marketing Technology teams to build the platforms, services, and user experiences that help sellers grow their business and make eBay the destination website for existing and new customers. You’ll work on high-scale systems spanning frontend applications, backend services, APIs, data pipelines, and AI-assisted engineering workflows, partnering closely with product, design, analytics, and applied science. We’re looking for engineers who can turn business problems into reliable, maintainable software, make sound technical tradeoffs, and take ownership from design through production. This role is a strong fit for someone who enjoys solving practical engineering problems in a fast-moving environment where performance, quality, and measurable customer impact matter.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Design and build innovative advertising, marketing platform features that help eBay sellers, advertisers grow their business and help eBay become the dominant eCommerce platform.

  • Develop scalable, highly available applications, APIs, and services using technologies such as Marko, React, Node.js, Java, and Scala.

  • Own end-to-end delivery of complex features, from technical design and architecture through deployment and production support.

  • Drive technical decisions, system design, and cross-team collaboration to ensure scalable, reliable, and maintainable solutions.

  • Leverage AI-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude Code) throughout the development lifecycle for coding, debugging, testing, and code review to increase engineering velocity.

  • Contribute to AI-powered advertising and marketing features by collaborating with ML engineers on LLM integrations, recommendation systems, and intelligent campaign optimization.

  • Contribute to a culture of continuous learning, Agile development, open-source collaboration, and rapid software delivery.

  • Mentor team members, participate in technical discussions, and help shape engineering best practices across the organization.

Job Requirements:

  • BS/BA in Computer Science or related field plus 9+ years work experience or MS with 8+ years of relevant experience.

  • Strong experience in Java (17+) and building services with Spring Boot or similar frameworks.

  • Experience building scalable backend systems and RESTful APIs in distributed environments.

  • Experience with event-driven architectures and message queues (Kafka, RabbitMQ, or similar).

  • Experience with relational (Oracle/Postgres/MySQL) and/or NoSQL (Cassandra/MongoDB) databases, including schema design and query optimization.

  • Familiar with Big Data stack (Hadoop, Spark, Flink etc).

  • Proven ability to own end-to-end system design: writing technical design documents, leading design reviews, and making architectural decisions for multi-service features.

  • Experience designing scalable distributed systems with a track record of evaluating trade-offs. (consistency, availability, latency, cost) and driving technical alignment across teams.

  • Experience with AI-assisted development practices and tools to increase engineering productivity (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, or equivalent).

  • Experience building or integrating LLM-powered features, agentic workflows, or AI-driven automation in production systems is a plus.

  • Strong ownership mentality with ability to drive work end-to-end in a collaborative environment.

  • Exposure to GraphQL and experience in building Federated GraphQL APIs is highly desirable.

  • Experience on contributing to open-source is a plus.

Benefits are an essential part of your total compensation for the work you do every day. Whether you’re single, in a growing family, or nearing retirement, eBay offers a variety of comprehensive and competitive benefit programs to meet your needs. Including maternal & paternal leave, paid sabbatical, and plans to help ensure your financial security today and in the years ahead because we know feeling financially secure during your working years and through retirement is important.

Here at eBay, we love creating opportunities for others by connecting people from widely diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and geographies. So, being diverse and inclusive isn’t just something we strive for, it is who we are, and part of what we do each and every single day. We want to ensure that as an employee, you feel eBay is a place where, no matter who you are, you feel safe, included, and that you have the opportunity to bring your unique self to work.   • Manipulovať s chladeným a mrazeným tovarom – v rôznych teplotných podmienkach.
  • Pravidelne kontrolovať dátumy spotreby a podieľať sa na inventúrach.
  • Starať sa o čistotu predajne a poriadok v regáloch.
  • Striedať sa v rôznych činnostiach podľa potreby tímu.
  • Pracovať budeš na zmeny a ponúkneme ti plný alebo skrátený úväzok podľa aktuálnych potrieb.
Tvoj profil

  • Si spoľahlivý, priateľský a rád komunikuješ so zákazníkmi.
  • Počítaš s prácou cez víkendy a fyzická práca ti vyhovuje.
Naše benefity

Lidl ti dá viac

  • Dobijeme ti kredit na nákup v Lidli v hodnote 40 € mesačne.

title: Principal Product Owner , SMART MFG & AI
description:
Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all.

Join an inclusive team passionate about one thing: using their expertise in the relentless pursuit of innovation for customers and partners. The solutions we build help make everything from virtual reality experiences to breakthroughs in neural networks possible. We do it all while committing to integrity, sustainability, and giving back to our communities. Because doing so can fuel the very innovation we are pursuing.

As a Principal AI Product Owner at Micron Technology, Inc., you will report to the Smart Manufacturing and Artificial Intelligence organization within FE Procurement. The team defines, drives, and delivers end-to-end AI and agentic solutions across procurement and adjacent functions. You will own the AI product vision, strategy, and roadmap, applying industry-leading methodologies in data science, automation, AI, and agentic systems to enhance Micron's procurement, planning, and business processes.

In this role, you will work with an internal team of Data Scientists and Data Engineers and engage functional executives, leaders, and external partners in the design, analysis, and implementation of AI solutions. You will be accountable for the full product lifecycle, from discovery through delivery, adoption, and realized impact, and will have the opportunity to build deep data fluency across procurement workflows. Most importantly, you will work closely with key stakeholders across FE Procurement to ensure positive impact and sustainable results from the Smart Manufacturing and AI solutions.

Responsibilities and Tasks

  • Own the AI product vision and roadmap across FE Procurement, Planning, and related functions; define outcomes, set priorities, and align the portfolio to business strategy.

  • Work with users to capture and analyze information related to the adoption of AI and agentic applications for procurement through stakeholder engagement.

  • Manage the product backlog end to end: refine requirements, write clear user stories and acceptance criteria, and prioritize using value-versus-effort and strategic-fit frameworks.

  • Lead product discovery: define user personas, map procurement workflows and pain points, and validate use cases before committing to build.

  • Collaborate with Data Engineers and Data Scientists to design, execute, and deliver projects that require the coordination, support, and management of resources from global teams.

  • Assess data readiness for every use case: evaluate data availability, quality, lineage, and governance, and define the data requirements that solutions depend on.

  • Develop an understanding of data science and agentic systems and use these skills to execute and steer solutions from POC through scaled production.

  • Partner with procurement, planning, and functional organizations to identify and prioritize opportunities that improve cost efficiency, productivity, and capital efficiency.

  • Gather, analyze, and translate business requirements into functional and data requirements, user stories, and implementation plans.

  • Define solution scope, business requirements, success criteria, and key performance indicators (KPIs).

  • Lead cross-functional projects from problem definition through solution deployment, business adoption, and value realization.

  • Analyze operational and business processes to identify improvement opportunities and drive continuous optimization.

  • Leverage Artificial Intelligence (AI), Generative AI, and agentic tools to improve decision making, automate workflows, and accelerate solution delivery.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree and at least 10 years of work experience in semiconductor manufacturing, procurement, supply chain, management consulting or a related field.

  • Demonstrated experience owning the full product lifecycle for data-driven, AI, or agentic products, from discovery through adoption.

  • Strong data fluency: able to reason about data models, data quality, pipelines, and analytics, and to work directly with data engineering and data science teams to define requirements.

  • Superb interpersonal skills with demonstrable ability to effectively lead and present to small and large groups. Work multi-functionally with peers and senior and mid-level management.

  • Peer leadership and relationship management skills.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

  • Highly organized and able to remain flexible to changing business needs.

  • Outstanding customer focus with ability to prioritize and projectize work you're doing.

About Micron Technology, Inc.

We are an industry leader in innovative memory and storage solutions transforming how the world uses information to enrich life for all. With a relentless focus on our customers, technology leadership, and manufacturing and operational excellence, Micron delivers a rich portfolio of high-performance DRAM, NAND, and NOR memory and storage products through our Micron® and Crucial® brands. Every day, the innovations that our people create fuel the data economy, enabling advances in artificial intelligence and 5G applications that unleash opportunities — from the data center to the intelligent edge and across the client and mobile user experience.

title: IT Data Center Infrastructure Coordinator
description:
Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all.

Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.

In the role of IT Data Center Infrastructure Coordinator at Micron Technology, you will manage routine operations, planning, and maintenance for enterprise-level data centers. You will define and coordinate data center architectural standards. You will also work with global teams to develop build requirements. You will coordinate with Facilities, Network, Compute, Storage, Security, and Infrastructure Engineering teams. This role involves maintaining physical facility systems to ensure they are stable, secure, and able to support business and technology demands.

This role serves as the primary coordinator for activities related to data center facilities, including facilities support, structured cabling services, capacity management, infrastructure lifecycle planning, and operational readiness. You will help guide progress across multiple teams while ensuring alignment with operational procedures and service expectations.

Responsibilities:

  • 5+ years of experience supporting data center operations, infrastructure deployment, facilities coordination, and projects involving multi-functional infrastructure teams.
  • Manage daily enterprise data center operations, including infrastructure installations, moves, adds, changes, decommissions, and lifecycle management activities.
  • Monitor and optimize data center capacity, space, power, cooling, environmental requirements, and DCIM accuracy using AI/ML-driven insights.
  • Lead structured cabling operations, including rack installations, pathway management, cable documentation, labeling standards, and infrastructure record accuracy.
  • Coordinate with Network, Server, Storage, Facilities, vendors, and contractors to deliver infrastructure projects on schedule and in compliance with standards.
  • Serve as the primary IT liaison for facilities activities involving power, cooling, environmental systems, physical security, maintenance planning, and site readiness initiatives.

  • Ensure successful delivery of data center cabling, infrastructure, and maintenance projects.

title: Head of Information Security
description:
Our mission

Constructor’s mission is to enable all educational organisations to provide high-quality digital education to 10x people with 10x efficiency.

With strong expertise in machine intelligence and data science, Constructor’s all-in-one platform for education and research addresses today’s pressing educational challenges: access inequality, tech clutter, and low engagement of students.

Please send your resume in English only.

About the Role

We're looking for a Head of Cybersecurity to expand and lead our security function across four areas: application security, security compliance, infrastructure & cloud security, and business application security. You'll take over a small existing security team, with a mandate to grow it as the company scales.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You'll set direction and represent security to leadership, but you're also expected to dig into technical detail with engineering, IT, and compliance teams.

Duties & Responsibilities

Application security

  • Build and run our AppSec program, including agentic/AI-assisted security reviews of code and pull requests
  • Integrate security checks into CI/CD pipelines so vulnerabilities are caught before production
  • Run developer security training and champion secure coding practices org-wide
  • Evaluate and roll out AI coding tools in ways that improve, not undermine, code security

Security compliance

  • Own ISO 27001 and SOC 2 certification and ongoing security audits
  • Collect requirements from stakeholders and build a roadmap for additional certifications as the business requires them
  • Maintain policies, controls, and evidence in a way that scales without slowing teams down

Infrastructure & Cloud Security

  • Work closely with our DevOps organization to secure our Kubernetes infrastructure and cloud environments, including sovereign cloud deployments
  • Define security standards for infrastructure-as-code, network architecture, and access control
  • Partner with Engineering teams on secure-by-default configurations

Business Application Security

  • Work closely with IT and Business application teams to secure Microsoft 365 and other line-of-business systems, including CRM and ERP
  • Own identity, access, and data protection controls across business applications
  • Manage third-party/vendor risk for business-critical SaaS

Qualifications & Experience:

  • 8+ years in information security, including 3+ years in a leadership role, preferably in all-remote or hybrid international organizations
  • Track record running application security programs, ideally with CI/CD-integrated tooling and modern (AI-assisted) code review
  • Hands-on experience with ISO 27001 and/or SOC 2, proven experience leading and successfully completing the audit, not just reading the standard
  • Experience securing business applications (M365, CRM, ERP) and vendor risk management
  • Ability to explain risk and trade-offs clearly to both engineers and executives
  • Comfortable operating with a small team and prioritizing across competing demands
  • Working knowledge of Kubernetes and cloud security; sovereign cloud experience is a plus

What We Offer

  • 💻 Choice of work equipment (e.g., laptop, monitor, etc.)
  • 🇬🇧 English classes (iTalki – $130 monthly)
  • ⏰ Flexible schedule (we usually work between 09:00/10:00 and 18:00/19:00)
  • 👶 Newborn bonus (€500 per child)
  • 🧠 Patent remuneration
  • 🌴 Paid leave
  • 🧑‍💻 Remote work in locations without our offices
  • Hybrid work in locations with offices (2 days in-office, 3 days remote)

Constructor fosters equal opportunity for people of all backgrounds and identities. We are led by a gender-balanced board committed to building a diverse and inclusive organisation where everyone can become their best self. We do not discriminate based on age, disability, gender identity, sexual orientation, ethnicity, race, religion or belief, parental and family status, or other protected characteristics. We welcome applications from women, men and non-binary candidates of all ethnicities and socio-economic backgrounds. We encourage people belonging to underrepresented groups to apply.

description:
Position Summary

Bosch Home Solutions is seeking an Steel Press Setup Operator. This position performs die changeovers, setups, and operates single stroke mechanical presses (70 tons and up) to blank, punch, and form parts to specifications.

Key Responsibilities

  • Read, communicate, and understand Operational Method Sheets (OMS) and job instructions
  • Handle materials to and from workstations and prepare equipment for production

title: DATA SCIENTIST, SMAI
description:
Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all.

Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.

Join Micron as a Staff Data Scientist and spearhead the evolution of semiconductor development, manufacturing, and core business areas using advanced AI and machine learning approaches. This senior-level role is perfect for those eager to develop agentic AI systems, lead algorithm invention, and collaborate across functions to boost product engineering and manufacturing efficiency. We rely on your knowledge of machine learning, programming (mainly Python), and cloud platforms (GCP, Snowflake), supported by a Master’s or PhD in a relevant field.

What You’ll Do

  • Design and implement cutting-edge algorithms and agentic AI systems.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to optimize engineering and manufacturing processes.

  • Work with massive datasets (terabytes to petabytes) to uncover insights and enable automation.

  • Apply statistical modeling, feature engineering, and supervised/unsupervised/semi-supervised learning techniques.

  • Extract and cleanse data from diverse sources using SQL and other query languages.

  • Identify outliers, handle missing data, and ensure data integrity for robust modeling.

What We’re Looking For

  • Education: Master’s or PhD in Data Science, Computer Science, or related field.

  • Technical Expertise:

    • Machine learning and advanced analytics

    • Python and/or PySpark

    • SQL databases (Snowflake preferred)

    • Familiarity with JavaScript, AngularJS 2.0, Tableau

  • Bonus Skills:

    • Exposure to semiconductor industry (preferred, not required)

    • Knowledge of Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES)

  • Strong communication skills and ability to work across teams.

Why Join Us?

You’ll be part of a team that’s shaping the future of semiconductor technology through AI-driven innovation. Your work will directly impact efficiency, quality, and scalability in one of the most advanced manufacturing environments in the world.

We are an industry leader in innovative memory and storage solutions transforming how the world uses information to enrich life for all. With a relentless focus on our customers, technology leadership, and manufacturing and operational excellence, Micron delivers a rich portfolio of high-performance DRAM, NAND, and NOR memory and storage products through our Micron® and Crucial® brands. Every day, the innovations that our people create fuel the data economy, enabling advances in artificial intelligence and 5G applications that unleash opportunities — from the data center to the intelligent edge and across the client and mobile user experience.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Senior Software Engineer

Say hello to opportunities.

If you’re looking to be part of what’s next in communication, you’re in the right place.

At RingCentral, we believe the best customer experiences happen when humans and AI work together. Our agentic voice AI portfolio—AIR, AVA, and ACE—brings together automation, assistance, and insights across the entire conversation lifecycle. The result? More seamless, intelligent experiences for businesses everywhere.

With $2.5B+ in ARR and $250M invested in R&D annually, we’re building the future of AI-powered business communications.

This is where you and your skills come in. We’re currently looking for:

The Engineering department within RingCentral's Professional Services Delivery team is responsible for executing the technical implementation, configuration, and deep integration of RingCentral's solutions for customers across all segments.

This team acts as the technical engine of the delivery process. They bridge the gap between the initial sale and the final launch, turning high-level business requirements into fully functional, customized technical architectures (such as AI-powered Unified Communications and Contact Center environments).

As a Senior Software Engineer, you play a role in the architectural planning and advanced functionality of our contact center solutions, driving implementation of RingCX and RingCentral Contact Center (RCCC) functionality for high-end enterprise call centers. Beyond configuration, you provide technical architecture leadership — analysis, design, and enhancement — helping complex customers transition successfully and maximize ROI

Job Responsibilities:

  • System Build & Implementation: Manage end-to-end technical builds for RingCX and RCCC projects, including Studio logic configuration, IVR/ACD routing, predictive dialer setup, SIP/analog gateway configuration, and network/QoS verification.

  • Architecture & Data Modeling: Own database design and CRM data modeling for complex deployments, including managing changes to existing CRM applications.

  • Integrations & Automation: Map complex data models and build system-to-system connectivity using RingCentral's REST APIs, webhooks, and SDKs; use iPaaS tools (e.g., Workato, Zapier, Make) to orchestrate data sync across CRM/helpdesk platforms (Salesforce, HubSpot, ServiceNow, Zendesk).

  • Testing & Validation: Run UAT and end-to-end testing to confirm custom architecture, call flows, and failover routing meet business requirements.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Project Managers, Solution Architects, and customer IT teams through design reviews to keep technical requirements aligned.

  • Troubleshooting: Serve as a senior technical resource during rollout and hypercare, resolving complex issues such as API limits, WebRTC/network quality problems, and CRM integration bugs.

  • Technical Consulting: Assess complex solution architectures against customer requirements and recommend design changes that improve platform value and adoption; contribute to client information management standards.

  • Account Growth Support: Identify opportunities to expand a customer's use of the platform and flag them to the account team during the project lifecycle.

  • Documentation: Produce technical documentation including LLDs, BRDs, call flow maps, and UAT sign-off agreements.

  • Project Delivery: Manage multiple concurrent enterprise deployments, operating with minimal oversight.

  • Continuous Learning: Stay current on new RingCentral and AI capabilities relevant to delivery projects.

To succeed in this role you must have experience in:

Success in this Level II role means providing technical leadership on complex, high-value engagements — from architecture design through implementation — that result in scalable, well-adopted solutions. A successful senior engineer is recognized internally and externally as a trusted subject matter expert, known for reliable delivery and strong client relationships.

Desired Qualifications:

  • Education & Experience: BS in a technical discipline or equivalent experience. 3 to 6 years of experience in a Professional Services Implementation role is required, including demonstrated ownership of complex or enterprise-scale engagements, with hands-on experience in the UCaaS and CCaaS industry.

  • Technical Competence: Advanced expertise in one or more core disciplines — UCaaS, CCaaS, Network Readiness, or Cloud software — with a strong architectural background in industry-leading contact center platforms (e.g., RingCX, NICE CXone/InContact Studio, Five9, Genesys).

  • Core Knowledge: Deep working knowledge of C#, C++, SIP/WebRTC networking, RESTful APIs, webhooks, QM/WFM/WEM, Cloud PBX, predictive dialers, ACD, CTI, VoIP, and advanced IVR logic; strong knowledge of Internet protocols, QoS, and hosted cloud ecosystems.

  • Front-End Scripting: Basic understanding of JavaScript, HTML, and CSS — enough to read, adapt, and troubleshoot scripts and templates used in contact center configurations.

  • Problem-Solving Skills: Strong analytical skills, including the ability to resolve complex technical problems using tools like the RingCentral QoS Analytics portal or trace logs.

  • Communication: Strong verbal and written communication skills (English minimum) and effective customer-facing presentation skills, including with executive stakeholders.

  • Work Environment: Willingness to work a schedule that supports customers across global time zones; ability to operate autonomously in a fast-paced delivery environment.

  • Desired Qualifications: Active contact center platform certifications, and experience integrating RingCentral with CRM, ITSM, or Lead Management systems (e.g., Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics 365, HubSpot, NetSuite, ServiceNow, Zendesk, Zoho, Freshdesk, Freshservice).

What we offer:

  • Comprehensive HMO package (medical and dental)

  • Personal Time Off Leaves

  • Quarterly Performance Bonus

  • Employee Assistance and Wellness Programs

RingCentral’s work culture is the backbone of our success. And don’t just take our word for it: we are recognized as a Best Place to Work by BuiltIn, the Top Work Culture by Comparably and hold local BPTW awards in every major location. Bottom line: We are committed to hiring and retaining great people because we know you power our success.


About RingCentral/Acquire Intelligence

RingCentral is a global leader in agentic voice AI–powered business communications, delivering an integrated platform for business phone, SMS, contact center, workforce engagement management, video collaboration, and messaging. As the communications layer connecting businesses and customers, RingCentral is the front door of business communication and is in the advantageous position to apply AI at every phase of the conversation journey — before, during, and after each interaction. Our agentic AI portfolio includes autonomous voice-first AI agents that automate calls, assist in the moment, and analyze every interaction – enabling businesses to work smarter, respond faster, and connect more meaningfully with their customers. title: Senior Premier Banker North Fulton
description:
Why Wells Fargo:

Are you looking for more? Find it here. At Wells Fargo, we're more than a financial services leader – we’re a global trailblazer committed to driving innovation, empowering communities, and helping our customers succeed. We believe that a meaningful career is much more than just a job – it’s about finding all of the elements to help you thrive, in one place. Living the Well Life means you’re supported in life, not just work. It means having robust benefits, competitive compensation, and programs designed to help you find work-life balance and well-being. You’ll be rewarded for investing in your community, celebrated for being your authentic self, and empowered to grow. And we’re recognized for it – Wells Fargo once again ranked in the top five on the 2026 LinkedIn Top Companies list of best workplaces “to grow your career” in the U.S. Join us!

About this role:

Wells Fargo is seeking a Senior Branch Premier Banker (SAFE) to play a pivotal role within our National Branch Network. This role grows, deepens, and manages relationships with affluent customers and those with more complex financial needs, serving as their primary point of contact for banking products and services through scheduled appointments, lobby engagement, and proactive outreach. This role is designed for growth oriented professionals who lead with advice to acquire and deepen relationships through meaningful discovery and translate customer goals into comprehensive financial strategies. You will own and actively grow a defined book of business, leveraging goals based planning, and prudent risk oversight to deliver integrated solutions across deposits, investments, credit, home lending, and business banking. In addition, you’ll help customers with everyday banking needs-opening accounts, handling service requests, and ensuring a seamless experience making it easier for them to manage their banking with confidence. Success in this role is driven by strong relationship acumen, proactive customer engagement, and seamless collaboration with internal partners across Wealth, Home Lending, and Business Banking to deliver a differentiated customer experience.

Wells Fargo rewards behaviors that consistently create long term customer value and support customers in making informed financial decisions. You’ll be supported with digital tools, industry leading training, ongoing coaching, and backed by one of the most recognized brands in banking. This role offers a clear platform for career growth for experienced professionals who excel at building trust, managing a portfolio, and delivering holistic, multi product solutions.

In this role you will:

  • Proactively acquire new affluent consumer and business customers while deepening existing relationships through strategic outreach, referrals, and pre-planned customer appointments

  • Lead discovery‑driven conversations to understand customer goals and deliver tailored banking and credit strategies that strengthen relationships, increase retention, and drive balanced growth across deposits, lending, and investments

  • Serve as the primary financial partner delivering comprehensive, multi‑product guidance and ongoing reviews across life stages and evolving financial needs

  • Partner with a team of professionals across Wealth, Home Lending, and Business Banking to deliver integrated solutions by coordinating warm introductions, setting clear expectations, and taking personal ownership to convert qualified opportunities into closed outcomes

  • Champion digital adoption by educating customers on self-service and mobile banking options to elevate satisfaction, engagement, and service efficiency

  • Serve as an active member of the branch team by advising colleagues on relationship development and the management of complex client needs

  • Demonstrate risk excellence through accurate documentation, sound judgment, timely issue escalation, and adherence to policies and regulations to support strong control outcomes

  • The Senior Branch Premier Banker LP (license pending) role is a temporary position until employee has successfully completed licensing requirements and SAFE registration. Upon successful completion, employees will transition to the Senior Branch Premier Banker (SAFE) role. Employees hired into the Senior Branch Premier Banker LP role who are not fully licensed will participate in the Branch Network Licensed Banker program.

Required Qualifications:

  • 4+ years of customer service experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education

  • 3+ years of experience building and maintaining effective relationships with customers and partners

  • 3+ years of experience recommending products and services

Desired Qualifications:

  • Experience recommending financial products and translating customer goals into clear, actionable recommendations

  • Demonstrated ability to proactively source, acquire, and deepen relationships through proactive outreach and building strong internal partnership to support the customer experience

  • Proven experience managing a book-of-business, documentation of planning conversations, and consistent follow-through to drive retention and growth across deposits, lending, and investments

  • Experience coaching or supporting peers to strengthen team performance and customer impact

  • Demonstrated ability to communicate clearly and confidently, listen with empathy, and build credibility and trust quickly with others

  • Financial services industry experience in one or a combination of the following: consumer, home lending, business banking, or investments

  • 3+ years of experience in a licensed financial services position

  • Successfully completed Financial Industry Regulatory Authority (FINRA)Series 6 and 63 exams (or FINRA recognized equivalents) sufficient to qualify for immediate FINRA registration

  • State Insurance license(s)

Job Expectations:

  • Ability to work a schedule that will include most Saturdays

  • This role requires FINRA Series 6 and Series 63 (or FINRA recognized equivalents), and State Insurance license(s) which must be active or completed within a designated timeframe. For any FINRA qualification exams earned after Sept. 30, 2018, the Securities Industry Essentials (SIE) exam is also required.

  • For the following states where hired, FINRA Series 65 (or equivalent) examination will also be required within a specified period: AK, AL, CT, DE, HI, IA, ID, IN, KS, MD, MI, MN, MS, MT, NC, ND, NE, NM, OR, SC, SD, TN, TX, UT, VA, WA, WI, and WY. Wyoming allows referral-only licensed bankers to receive the IAR registration without completing the Series 65/66 exam requirement. Requirements may change based on current state regulations.

  • Obtaining and maintaining required FINRA licenses is necessary for continued employment. This role also requires meeting enhanced financial fitness and criminal background standards. Wells Fargo will begin the FINRA review process once an offer is accepted.

  • SAFE registration is required at the time of employment and Wells Fargo will initiate the process after your start date.Loan Originators must meet LO/CFPB requirements and comply with Wells Fargo policies, including standards related to financial responsibility, character, fitness, and criminal background. A credit report may be reviewed (credit score not included) and additional ongoing screening may apply.
